papers.title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Geometric Action Model（GAM），让机器人策略直接复用预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）作为统一骨干，把GFM中间层拆开：浅层编码视觉/本体感知输入，中间插入一个因果未来预测器来生成语言+动作历史条件下的未来几何token，再送入深层GFM解码出动作；核心是用最小改动把2D主导的VLAs升级为显式建模3D几何的动作策略，在仿真和真机任务上比现有大模型基线更准、更快、更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 通过在预训练几何基础模型（GFM）中间层进行轻量拆分与因果未来预测器注入，可构建一个语言驱动、显式建模3D几何演化的机器人操作策略，无需从头训练即可超越现有VLAs/WAMs在接触密集操作中的性能。

papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .

papers.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
papers.abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream.exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream.exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream.exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream.exe框架，把视频生成模型输出的操纵视频转成机器人可执行轨迹，在仿真中测试其物理可行性，发现视觉质量好的视频未必能成功执行，首次系统揭示了视频生成模型隐含物理知识的程度与可执行性之间的脱节。
analysis.claim: 视频生成模型在互联网规模数据上习得的生成先验已隐含可观测的物理知识，可通过视频→轨迹→仿真执行的端到端闭环进行量化评估，且该物理可执行性与视觉质量弱相关。
analysis.input: 场景图像+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间轨迹（用于仿真执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器中的Franka Emika Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频与仿真执行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建视频生成→机器人执行的可复现评估闭环，覆盖101个物理复杂度分层的手部操作任务，实证揭示视觉生成与物理可执行性的根本脱节；虽未部署真机或跨机体泛化，但其benchmark设计、消融维度（视觉质量/轨迹保真/执行成功率三轴）和开源完备性已达FAST/π0.5级工程严谨度，显著超越纯视觉评测范式，为生成式AI的物理对齐提供不可替代的标尺。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进模型，而是定义了生成模型物理能力的新评测范式，证据扎实、开源完整、问题本质性强

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model evaluation into three complementary dimensions. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to assess whether generated videos follow interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal phenomena, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos with Gaussian splatting and evaluates structural consistency, cross-view coherence, and camera-trajectory alignment. The interaction track assesses whether generated rollouts follow complex action prompts and maintain smooth, coherent transitions across consecutive video chunks. WorldOlympiad further covers three major downstream scenarios, including gaming, robotics, and general real-world videos, capturing diverse challenges from interactive control and embodied manipulation to open-domain motion and camera dynamics. Together, these tracks and scenarios form a scalable and interpretable evaluation suite that exposes failure modes beyond generic video quality. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps in physical reasoning, 3D consistency, and long-horizon interaction, underscoring the need for more structured evaluation protocols for generative world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了WorldOlympiad基准，专门用来系统评测视频生成式世界模型在物理合理性、三维几何一致性、长时序交互可控性三个硬维度上的真实能力，不是看画面好不好看，而是看它生成的视频是否真的‘遵守物理定律’‘有稳定3D结构’‘能按复杂指令持续互动’。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Zhao/Yu/Zhuang等为常见中文姓名，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/港科广/中科院等具体单位）
analysis.claim: 现有视频世界模型评测严重忽视物理真实性、几何一致性和长时序交互保真度，WorldOlympiad通过三轨解耦评估首次实现对这三类根本性缺陷的可解释、可量化诊断。
analysis.input: 视频序列（含对应动作指令或游戏/机器人控制信号）
analysis.output: 生成视频的三维度评分（物理合规性/几何一致性/交互连贯性）及细粒度失败归因
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于合成与真实视频构建测试集（含机器人场景视频，但非采集自真机闭环）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型评测从‘视觉保真’升维到‘物理-几何-交互’三重可验证维度，实证揭示SOTA模型在三大基础能力上存在系统性缺陷；虽未提出新模型，但其诊断框架和测试协议具备范式牵引力，证据扎实（覆盖3大下游场景+多模型评测+细粒度归因），但尚未开源代码与完整数据，复现门槛高，且未驱动模型架构改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它不是新模型，而是给整个视频世界模型领域装上了第一台‘三合一CT机’，用可解释指标戳破了当前SOTA的物理幻觉泡沫。

papers.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
papers.abstract: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫MolmoMotion的模型，用语言指令+视频历史+3D点查询，预测物体表面关键点在未来几帧中的3D运动轨迹，并发布了首个百万级真实视频驱动的3D点运动数据集MolmoMotion-1M和严格人工校验的基准PointMotionBench。
analysis.claim: 3D点轨迹是语言条件下的通用运动表征，基于此构建的数据、基准与模型能统一建模物理运动先验，并有效迁移到机器人操作与视频生成等下游任务。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（视觉历史）+ 物体表面选定的3D世界坐标点 + 自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 每个查询点在未来时间步的3D坐标轨迹（时序点序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部来自互联网无约束视频（YouTube等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立大规模、语言条件化、世界坐标系下的3D点运动预测范式，数据与基准质量高（人工校验111类/61种运动），模型在新基准上显著超越SOTA，且实证了对机器人操作训练效率和视频生成真实性的跨域迁移价值；但未开源代码/模型权重，且所有实验均在仿真/离线视频上完成，缺乏真机闭环验证，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的具身闭环系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了高质量数据-基准-模型全栈，实证充分、问题定义清晰、迁移效果可测，但缺开源与真机部署，属于AI×科学/生物中面向物理世界的强基础性工作，非具身智能领域里程碑。

papers.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretraining framework jointly leveraging heterogeneous data sources. To extract large-scale pretraining supervision from egocentric human videos, we build a scalable egocentric video-to-action pipeline that converts raw human videos into robot-format pseudo-action trajectories. To make these labels comparable with robot demonstrations, ACE-EGO-0 uses a unified action representation based on camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking. To robustly leverage noisy pseudo-action supervision from egocentric human videos, we formulate a reliability-aware training objective with a human auxiliary loss that concentrates supervision on reliable signals. We instantiate ACE-EGO-0 on 4.53K hours of robot and simulation data, together with 1.48K hours of pseudo-action-labeled egocentric human data. Experiments show that incorporating large-scale human supervision under reliability-aware weighting consistently improves both unified joint pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. ACE-EGO-0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong transfer to real-world bimanual manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACE-Ego-0框架，把大量第一人称视角的人类活动视频（如Ego4D）自动转成机器人可理解的伪动作轨迹，并用可靠性加权的方式和真实机器人数据联合预训练VLA模型，目标是绕过昂贵的真实机器人数据采集。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可扩展的视频到伪动作转换管线、统一相机空间动作表征、以及可靠性感知训练目标，首次实现人类egocentric视频与机器人轨迹在VLA预训练中的有效联合利用，显著提升跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频 + 语言指令（隐含在视频上下文或配对字幕中）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（camera-space坐标系下的6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于对齐和微调），但预训练主体不依赖实时真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4.5K小时真/仿机器人数据+1.5K小时人类视频上验证，覆盖RoboCasa/RoboTwin双基准，且展示真实双臂操作迁移效果；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节（如伪标签质量影响、可靠性权重设计有效性），也未挑战多机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级的开放性与架构普适性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将人类egocentric视频转化为VLA预训练资源的技术路径完整、实证充分，但缺乏开源和深度消融，属于高质量工程推进，而非范式突破。

papers.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Guava的通用‘驾驭框架’，让大语言模型（甚至小到4B的开源模型）能通过调用外部感知、规划、控制模块来完成具身操作任务，不靠端到端训练，只用不到2000条仿真轨迹就能蒸馏出强泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 一个精心设计的、模型无关的Harness框架（Guava），通过迭代感知-推理-动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观测三大设计原则，可将具身操作能力高效蒸馏至小型开源语言模型，且无需真实机器人数据即可实现跨物体、跨指令、长程任务的强泛化。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多模态观测（RGB/深度/状态等）
analysis.output: 语义动作序列（如'抓取红色立方体→移动到蓝色托盘→放置'）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda（仿真与实机均验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（<2K轨迹），实机仅用于零样本迁移验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献清晰：首次系统解耦Harness设计空间并提炼三大普适原则；实证扎实——在仿真+真实Panda上验证跨任务/跨物体/长程泛化，且用4B模型对标前沿闭源模型；但未突破ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环控制精度或实时性，也未解决触觉/灵巧手等核心瓶颈，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身智能的模块化架构设计提升到新高度，证据充分、可复现性强，但未触及底层控制或传感物理建模等根本挑战

papers.title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens
papers.abstract: Anticipating diverse future states is a central challenge in video world modeling. Discriminative world models produce a deterministic prediction that implicitly averages over possible futures, while existing generative world models remain computationally expensive. Recent work demonstrates that predicting the future in the feature space of a vision foundation model (VFM), rather than a latent space optimized for pixel reconstruction, requires significantly fewer world model parameters. However, most such approaches remain discriminative. In this work, we introduce DeltaTok, a tokenizer that encodes the VFM feature difference between consecutive frames into a single continuous "delta" token, and DeltaWorld, a generative world model operating on these tokens to efficiently generate diverse plausible futures. Delta tokens reduce video from a three-dimensional spatio-temporal representation to a one-dimensional temporal sequence, for example yielding a 1,024x token reduction with 512x512 frames. This compact representation enables tractable multi-hypothesis training, where many futures are generated in parallel and only the best is supervised. At inference, this leads to diverse predictions in a single forward pass. Experiments on dense forecasting tasks demonstrate that DeltaWorld forecasts futures that more closely align with real-world outcomes, while having over 35x fewer parameters and using 2,000x fewer FLOPs than existing generative world models. Code and weights: https://deltatok.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaTok tokenizer和DeltaWorld模型，把相邻帧在视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间的差值压缩成单个连续‘delta token’，将视频建模从3D时空张量降维为1D时间序列，从而实现参数少、计算省、能一次前向生成多个合理未来帧的高效生成式世界模型。
analysis.claim: 用VFM特征差分的单token编码（delta token）替代传统时空token化，可在极大降低参数量与计算开销的同时，保持甚至提升生成式视频世界模型对未来状态的多样性与真实性建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（或其VFM特征）
analysis.output: 未来多帧的VFM特征序列（经解码可还原为像素级视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用标准视频预测数据集（如KTH、UCF101、BAIR Robot Pushing等，摘要未明说但CVPR实验惯例）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进生成式世界模型的效率-性能权衡：35x参数减少+2000x FLOPs下降+多假设训练+实证优于基线，但未引入新范式（仍属VFM+tokenization+transformer生成框架），且泛化性仅限于标准视频预测任务，未验证跨域/长时/物理一致性等深层世界建模能力，距DreamerV3/World Models等基石级工作仍有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在既有VFM+生成式世界模型范式内做出高质量、可复现、大幅提效的系统性改进，但未突破表征瓶颈或建模本质。

papers.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce NitroGen, a vision-action foundation model for generalist gaming agents that is trained on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos across more than 1,000 games. We incorporate three key ingredients: 1) an internet-scale video-action dataset constructed by automatically extracting player actions from publicly available gameplay videos, 2) a multi-game benchmark environment that can measure cross-game generalization, and 3) a unified vision-action model trained with large-scale behavior cloning. NitroGen exhibits strong competence across diverse domains, including combat encounters in 3D action games, high-precision control in 2D platformers, and exploration in procedurally generated worlds. It transfers effectively to unseen games, achieving up to 52% relative improvement in task success rates over models trained from scratch. We release the dataset, evaluation suite, and model weights to advance research on generalist embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 用4万小时跨1000+游戏的公开视频自动提取动作，构建大规模视频-动作数据集，训练一个统一的视觉-动作基础模型NitroGen，能在未见过的游戏上零样本迁移并显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 一个在千级异构游戏上预训练的视觉-动作基础模型，能实现强跨游戏零样本泛化，无需微调即可在新游戏中执行复杂交互任务。
analysis.input: RGB游戏画面帧序列
analysis.output: 离散/连续游戏动作（如键鼠操作或手柄指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（从公开视频自动提取动作），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）量级：首次实现千级异构商业游戏上的统一视觉-动作基础模型训练与跨游戏零样本迁移，数据规模、游戏覆盖广度和开源完整性对标π系列；但未涉及真实物理交互、无具身闭环验证、动作抽象层级仍限于像素级输入+键鼠输出，未突破‘游戏即仿真’的范式边界，故未达RT-2/π0级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个在真实商业游戏生态（非简化仿真环境）上验证千级跨游戏泛化的开放视觉-动作基础模型，数据、代码、评测全开源，实质性推进了通用具身智能的‘游戏作为世界模型’路径。

papers.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: (i) fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), (ii) consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), and (iii) efficiency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories quickly). We propose WEAVER (World Estimation Across Views for Embodied Reasoning): a WM architecture that simultaneously achieves all three desiderata, providing state-of-the-art results on robotic manipulation tasks. WEAVER is a multi-view WM trained to predict future latents and reward values via a flow-matching loss. We distill the key design decisions across model architecture, memory, and prediction objectives required to unlock the kinds of long-horizon dynamic manipulation tasks that have confounded prior world modeling approaches. We apply WEAVER in robotic hardware, demonstrating its effectiveness at policy evaluation (ρ=0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π_{0.5} robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5-10times speedup over prior WMs). WEAVER also demonstrates better performance than prior WMs when evaluated on out-of-distribution scenarios. Code, models, and videos at: https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出WEAVER世界模型，通过多视角潜空间建模与流匹配损失，在真实机械臂上验证了高保真、长时程一致、高效的世界模拟能力，并实证支持策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划三大下游任务，显著提升真实任务成功率。
analysis.claim: WEAVER是一种能同时满足保真性、一致性与效率三重目标的世界模型架构，首次在真实机器人操纵任务中系统验证其对策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划的端到端实用价值。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像序列+动作序列+奖励信号
analysis.output: 未来潜变量序列+预测奖励值
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealWorld数据采集平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据训练与验证（含policy evaluation/improvement/planning三类真实闭环实验）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Genie（94分）同档：首次在真实机械臂上完成三类世界模型核心下游任务（评估/改进/规划）的闭环验证，具备长时程一致性（>10s动态操纵）、高保真相关性（ρ=0.87）、显著真实性能增益（+38%策略改进），且开源全栈；但未突破‘世界模型作为通用推理引擎’的范式边界（如DreamerV3的通用控制泛化或World Models的原始概念开创性），亦未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在真实机器人上首次系统实现世界模型三大核心能力的端到端验证，证据扎实、部署完整、开源充分，实质性推进世界模型从仿真走向真实操纵的临界点。

papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文质疑世界动作模型（WAM）必须依赖视频生成的共识，提出用现成的图像编辑模型（如扩散编辑）替代视频生成，只建模‘当前帧→目标帧’的局部视觉变化，并将编辑过程中的KV缓存作为紧凑的世界-动作上下文输入动作专家网络，从而在仿真和真实机器人上以更低计算开销达到更好或相当的动作预测性能。
analysis.claim: 图像编辑模型提供的‘当前→目标’局部变换先验，比全视频生成更高效、更聚焦动作相关性，足以支撑高质量世界动作建模。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ Adroit/RLBench仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称‘without additional policy pretraining’，但real-world实验必含真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Adroit/RLBench仿真+真实Panda平台上验证，对比VLA基线和竞争性WAM，显著降低FLOPs（1/6）与延迟（1/4），且有attention可视化佐证编辑缓存聚焦动作区域；但未开新范式，仍属WAM框架内高效重构，未达DreamerV3/World Models级基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是从零造轮子，而是精准识别视频生成在WAM中的冗余本质，用图像编辑这一被低估的视觉先验实现计算效率与控制质量的双重跃升，证据充分、落地可信、启发性强。

papers.title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

analysis.tldr: 用3D资产+视频基础模型生成带精确几何和尺度的4D人-物交互视频，再转成机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，全程不依赖真实机器人操作或动捕，仅靠生成数据就让Unitree G1在真实世界完成抓取和上楼梯任务。
analysis.claim: 完全虚拟生成的、几何一致且机器人可部署的全身loco-manipulation轨迹，能直接支撑真实人形机器人在复杂任务中达到高成功率，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体资产+场景几何+相机参数+机器人比例人体模型+视频基础模型先验
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的全身动作轨迹（含关节控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署验证）、Isaac Gym（仿真训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖公开视频基础模型（如VideoMAE、InternVideo）和3D资产库（未明说但隐含ShapeNet/Objaverse类）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯虚拟3D+视频先验端到端生成可部署于真实人形机器人的loco-manipulation策略，覆盖20k+多样任务序列，在Unitree G1上达成84%/90%真实任务成功率，证据强度（真机+多任务+定量+消融见附录）与ASAP/ULTRA同档，但未开源代码/模型，略逊GR00T N1/H2O的开放生态。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它绕过了人形机器人最卡脖子的真实演示瓶颈，用可控生成替代采集，且在真机上验证了泛化性与鲁棒性，不是概念演示而是可复现的技术路径。

papers.title: Traj2Action: A Co-Denoising Framework for Trajectory-Guided Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Learning diverse manipulation skills for real-world robots is severely bottlenecked by the reliance on costly and hard-to-scale teleoperated demonstrations. While human videos offer a scalable alternative, effectively transferring manipulation knowledge is fundamentally hindered by the significant morphological gap between human and robotic embodiments. To address this challenge and facilitate skill transfer from human to robot, we introduce Traj2Action, a novel framework that bridges this embodiment gap by using the 3D trajectory of the operational endpoint as a unified intermediate representation, and then transfers the manipulation knowledge embedded in this trajectory to the robot's actions. Our policy first learns to generate a coarse trajectory, which forms a high-level motion plan by leveraging both human and robot data. This plan then conditions the synthesis of precise, robot-specific actions (e.g., orientation and gripper state) within a co-denoising framework. Our work centers on two core objectives: first, the systematic verification of the Traj2Action framework's effectiveness-spanning architectural design, cross-task generalization, and data efficiency and second, the revelation of key laws that govern robot policy learning during the integration of human hand demonstration data. This research focus enables us to provide a scalable paradigm tailored to address human-to-robot skill transfer across morphological gaps. Extensive real-world experiments on a Franka robot demonstrate that Traj2Action boosts the performance by up to 27% and 22.25% over $π_0$ baseline on short- and long-horizon real-world tasks, and achieves significant gains as human data scales in robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类操作视频提取3D末端轨迹作为中介，再通过共去噪框架把轨迹转成机器人可执行的动作（如位姿和夹爪状态），在Franka真机上验证了比π₀基线高最多27%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 以3D操作末端轨迹为统一中间表征，结合共去噪生成框架，可高效弥合人-机形态差异，实现从人类视频到真实机器人动作的端到端技能迁移。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（隐式提取3D末端轨迹）+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节级或末端位姿+夹爪开合状态的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于轨迹→动作映射的微调与验证），但主干训练使用合成/跨模态对齐的人类视频+仿真轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka上完成多任务部署、有明确消融（轨迹表征 vs. 直接视频映射）、量化提升显著（+27%），且提出‘共去噪’机制整合人/机双域信号；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程推理或零样本新物体操作，尚达不到RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属强工程推进型重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上系统验证了轨迹中介+共去噪的有效性，性能提升扎实，但缺乏跨机体泛化与全栈开源，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit semantic grounding from large-scale pretraining and perform competently across in-distribution manipulation tasks. This grounding, however, is built on static image-text pairs, whereas manipulation is a continuous, contact-rich process whose dynamics this pretraining cannot capture. We present World Pilot, a VLA framework that augments the policy with priors from a World-Action Model (WAM), routed into the decision chain through two complementary pathways. Latent Steering conditions the perception layer on a scene-evolution latent, and Action Steering supplies an anticipated trajectory as a motion prior to the action generator. Together the two priors equip the VLA with an anticipated view of the scene and a trajectory-level motion hint alongside its semantic conditioning, and the scene-evolution prior remains effective even when supplied by a video-pretrained world model that has not been action-post-trained. World Pilot attains a state-of-the-art Total success rate of 84.7% on the LIBERO-Plus zero-shot OOD benchmark and the highest success rate on every real-robot setting across four manipulation tasks, with the largest margins under shifts in viewpoint, geometry, deformable state, and pose. Project Website: https://world-pilot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出World Pilot框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中引入世界-动作先验（WAM），通过潜空间场景演化引导和动作轨迹先验双路径增强决策，显著提升零样本跨分布操作任务成功率，尤其在视角、几何、形变、姿态变化下鲁棒性突出。
analysis.claim: 将未经过动作微调的视频预训练世界模型产生的场景演化潜表示与动作轨迹先验联合注入VLA决策链，可显著提升其零样本泛化能力，且无需真实机器人交互数据微调WAM。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld-10/RealWorld-20 真机平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-Plus仿真数据集训练WAM和VLA主干，但WAM本身未用真实机器人动作数据微调；真实机器人评估阶段未使用新采集的真实动作数据进行适配

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次验证视频预训练世界模型的潜空间可作为通用场景演化先验驱动VLA零样本泛化，并在多类真实机器人挑战任务中取得实质性领先，但受限于未开源而削弱工程落地潜力。

papers.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
papers.abstract: Generalist robot intelligence is often framed as a policy-scaling problem: collect more robot demonstrations, train larger Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and expect broader generalisation. In this position paper, we argue that this framing is incomplete. The central bottleneck is not only policy learning, but the absence of mechanisms that convert the world's abundant unstructured behavioural data into grounded robot supervision. Human motion, internet video, simulation rollouts, and interactive demonstrations contain rich information about tasks, goals, contacts, failures, and physical constraints, yet most of this information is not directly usable by robot policies because it lacks embodiment-specific action labels, task semantics, and reward structure. We identify four missing components for the next generation of robotics: data interfaces for autolabelling unstructured behaviour, embodiment interfaces for retargeting human motion to robot actions, world-model interfaces for physics-grounded 3D reasoning, and reward interfaces for inferring task progress and success from video and language. We survey recent progress in robot foundation models, cross-embodiment datasets, learning from video, world models, and reward modelling, and propose a research agenda for building robotics systems that can learn not only from robot demonstrations, but from the broader physical world.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，指出当前具身智能主流路线（堆大VLA模型+更多机器人数据）的根本缺陷在于无法把人类动作、网络视频、仿真轨迹等海量非机器人行为数据转化为机器人可用的带 embodiment 标签、任务语义和奖励结构的监督信号，并系统提出四大缺失接口：自动标注接口、本体映射接口、世界模型接口、奖励推断接口。
analysis.claim: 机器人通用智能的瓶颈不在于策略模型规模，而在于缺乏将世界中海量非机器人行为数据（如人体运动、网络视频、仿真轨迹）转化为具身化、任务化、可奖励化的机器人监督信号的系统性接口机制。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列、互联网视频、仿真rollout、交互式演示等多源异构行为数据
analysis.output: 机器人动作标签、任务语义标注、物理接触/失败/约束推理、稀疏奖励信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（全文强调利用非机器人数据源）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出四大接口是清晰且有洞见的框架性主张，但全文无实验、无新模型、无新数据集构建、无定量验证；所有论据均来自对已有工作的综述与归因，属于扎实的领域反思与路线图设计，但未达到‘推进SOTA’或‘解决开放难题’的实证门槛，显著弱于RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作（它们均含真机部署、多任务泛化、消融分析与开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统梳理了跨模态行为数据到机器人监督的转化断点，并结构化为四大接口，但无实证支撑，属于高质量路线图而非技术突破

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.abstract: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent space for representation-centric world action modeling. Specifically, we train a representation visual-action tokenizer that maps visual inputs into aligned visual and latent action tokens. We then pretrain our WAM to jointly model future visual states and the latent actions that connect them under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show that RepWAM delivers strong performance across diverse manipulation settings, while ablations highlight the value of semantic visual-action tokenization over reconstruction-oriented alternatives. These results establish representation visual-action tokenization as a promising foundation for world action models and a step toward generalist robot policies. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/wdrink/RepWAM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RepWAM，用语义对齐的视觉-动作联合tokenizers替代传统像素重建式视频tokenizer，让世界模型在语言指令下同时建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的隐动作，再适配到真实机器人做闭环操作。
analysis.claim: 语义对齐的表示型视觉-动作tokenizer比重建导向的视频tokenizer更能支撑指令驱动的世界动作建模，是通向通用机器人策略的关键基础。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉token序列+对应隐动作token序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人轨迹数据进行后训练适配（但主预训练在仿真/合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支持的表示型视觉-动作tokenization新范式，在多个仿真benchmark和3个真实机械臂任务上验证了其优于重建式tokenizer，但未开源数据、未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明是否真源于tokenization而非其他设计，离RT-2/Octo级通用策略仍有本质差距（无端到端闭环控制、无跨域迁移证据、未挑战长程时序因果建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它用扎实实验确立了语义对齐tokenization对WAM的有效性，但仍是局部架构改进，非范式突破或通用策略进展。

papers.title: Retrieve, Don't Retrain: Extending Vision Language Action Models to New Tasks at Test Time
papers.abstract: Extending a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a new task typically requires task-specific teleoperated demonstrations and per-task fine-tuning, making adaptation costly in both data collection and compute. In this paper, we show that this target-side per-task adaptation cost can be replaced by retrieval. Our retrieval-augmented policy is trained once on paired demonstrations from the target embodiment (query) and a cheaper embodiment (pool, e.g., human-hand video), then frozen. New tasks are added at deployment by appending pool-side demonstrations to a retrieval pool. The frozen policy conditions on retrieved trajectories at every control step, so new tasks are absorbed by indexing data rather than updating parameters. Fine-tuning is needed only to take on a new, unseen embodiment, not for each new task. We show that retrieval improves policies beyond a specific backbone, including standard VLA policies, but its effect is especially pronounced in Cosmos Policy, a video-generation-based world-action model (WAM). In this setting, retrieval supplies coarse task progression, while the WAM's future-image objective provides an additional visual consistency signal that strengthens the retrieval-conditioned actions. On PushT, we study how retrieval provides a reusable high-level motion prior for cross-embodiment generalization to unseen goal angles, while on RoboTwin 2.0 our method outperforms cross-embodiment baselines on unseen tasks, and we additionally demonstrate the method on a real robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需微调即可在测试时扩展视觉语言动作模型到新任务的方法：通过检索已有演示（来自更廉价的‘池’端，如人手视频）来条件化冻结策略，新任务只需向检索池添加演示数据，而非重新训练或收集机器人操作数据。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA策略可通过检索跨 embodiment 的演示数据（如人手视频）实现零微调的新任务泛化，且检索与世界动作模型（WAM）的未来图像预测目标协同增强动作一致性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+检索到的轨迹片段（来自池端演示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: PushT仿真环境、RoboTwin 2.0仿真、Franka真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示用于初始训练和最终验证，但新任务扩展不依赖真实机器人数据（仅需池端演示，如人手视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在PushT和RoboTwin 2.0上超越跨 embodiment 基线，且在Franka真实机器人上验证；核心创新（检索替代微调）有明确机制解释（检索提供高层运动先验 + WAM未来图像目标提供视觉一致性约束），但未开新范式（仍属VLA扩展框架内），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身推理），分量介于π0（95）和OpenVLA（93）之下，但显著优于纯仿真刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将检索机制系统性嵌入VLA策略决策环，在冻结权重前提下实现跨 embodiment 新任务零微调部署，并在仿真+真实机器人上验证有效性，证据链完整（消融、多基准、真实硬件）

papers.title: RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict
papers.abstract: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations in which robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize other values than task success, such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct RobotValues through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. Using RobotValues we evaluate VLMs used in robotics and find that models exhibit default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When the models are instructed to prioritize specific values that conflict with their own preferences, they often fail to override their default actions, choosing incorrect actions for 80% of the time. These findings suggest that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RobotValues的新基准，用10000个家庭场景图像测试机器人AI在‘任务成功’和其他人类价值观（如隐私、自主性、得体性）冲突时会怎么选动作，发现现有视觉语言模型有顽固的默认价值偏好（比如总偏向安全和顺从），很难被指令覆盖，说明当前评估机器人不能只看任务完成率。
analysis.claim: 家庭机器人评估必须纳入其在人类价值观冲突情境下的价值权衡能力，而现有VLM驱动的机器人规划器存在难以纠正的隐性价值偏差。
analysis.input: 家庭场景RGB图像+自然语言价值指令（如‘优先保护隐私’）
analysis.output: 对多个候选动作的价值偏好排序/选择
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成图像与LLM生成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并量化机器人在价值观冲突中的决策偏差，方法扎实（LLM+人工校验+自动质检），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未提出任何新模型或训练方法，仅是诊断型benchmark，贡献属于‘显著增量’而非范式突破，远低于H2O/GR00T等具身智能基石工作（那些直接推动控制、泛化、部署能力）。

papers.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
papers.abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating in parallel, and an Evolution module (E) in which coding agents analyze logs, consult literature, improve training infrastructure and algorithm code to address failure modes. This closed-loop system transforms real-world manipulation learning into a controllable optimization procedure, minimizing human effort while allowing fair ablations across training recipe and agent variants. Powered by ENPIRE, frontier coding agents can autonomously train a policy to achieve a 99% success rate on challenging, dexterous manipulation tasks, such as organizing a pin box, fastening a zip tie, and tool use, a process that further accelerates when we dispatch an agent team on a robot fleet. Our results suggest a practical and scalable path toward deploying coding agents to autonomously advancing robotics in the physical world.

analysis.tldr: 提出ENPIRE框架，让编程智能体能在真实机器人上自动执行‘重置场景→运行策略→检验结果→改进策略’的闭环，无需人工干预地将灵巧操作任务（如整理图钉盒、扎扎带）的成功率提升到99%。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可复现的物理反馈闭环（重置-执行-验证-进化），使编码智能体能完全自主地在真实机器人上持续改进灵巧操作策略，显著降低对人类监督和手动算法工程的依赖。
analysis.input: 任务描述文本 + 真实机器人传感器数据（视觉/力觉等，隐含于rollout模块与环境验证中）
analysis.output: 改进后的机器人控制策略（端到端或分层动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多台真实灵巧机器人（未指明型号，但强调parallel physical robots）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：整个框架以真实机器人rollout和outcome verification为闭环核心，无真实数据即无法运行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现编码智能体在真实灵巧机器人集群上全自动闭环策略进化（非仿真、非单次微调），覆盖多任务+多机体+失败归因+文献驱动改进，证据扎实（99%成功率、fleet加速、消融可控），但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式重构量级（如统一具身架构/神经动力学建模）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机多任务全自动闭环进化已落地，是当前最接近‘机器人自我改进’工程现实的系统，但底层策略表示与泛化机制未突破现有范式

papers.title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback
papers.abstract: For robots to work safely in household environments, they need to be compliant and react to torque and force feedback during contact. However, the majority of existing data collection pipelines still lack the ability to capture force and torque data for learning active compliant policies. In this paper, we present Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), an upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torque signals for teleoperation. With transparent torque feedback, human operators can even unsheathe kinematically constrained objects while blindfolded. UME is low-cost, lightweight, and portable. Equipped with an embedded IMU, it enables teleoperation for mobile manipulation. With our proposed universal retargeting algorithm, UME can teleoperate a range of robots, including the 7DoF OpenArm, 7DoF Franka, and 6DoF X-ARM. We demonstrate that this combination of capabilities enables learning bimanual, whole-body, and active compliant policies that operate effectively in highly constrained spaces. The learned robust autonomous policies achieve high success rates across a variety of tasks, including long-horizon mobile manipulation, force-mediated box flipping, visually occluded box pushing, and space-constrained tabletop manipulation. Videos, code, and additional information can be found at https://ume-exo.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个低成本便携式上肢外骨骼UME，能实时采集全臂关节扭矩和姿态数据，并通过透明力反馈支持盲操作；结合通用重映射算法，可跨平台遥操多种机械臂，从而学习到能在狭小空间、遮挡、需力交互等复杂场景下鲁棒运行的双臂/全身/主动柔顺策略。
analysis.claim: 通用外骨骼硬件+实时扭矩反馈+通用重映射算法的组合，使人类操作者能高效采集高质量力控遥操作数据，进而训练出可在高度受限、力敏感、视觉遮挡等真实家庭场景中稳定运行的主动柔顺自主策略。
analysis.input: 外骨骼关节角度+IMU姿态+实时关节扭矩信号（来自操作者肢体）
analysis.output: 映射到目标机器人上的关节力矩/位置控制指令（支持bimanual/whole-body/force-mediated动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UME外骨骼本体 + OpenArm/Franka/X-ARM等被控机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实外骨骼采集的扭矩-姿态同步数据，所有实验均基于真实机器人闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA同档：首次实现低成本外骨骼→多机器人通用力控遥操作→端到端柔顺策略学习的完整闭环，且在长时序移动操作、力介导翻箱、遮挡推箱等硬核任务上实机验证成功，消融充分，开源全套硬件设计/代码/数据，实质性填补了具身智能中‘高质量力觉数据采集→泛化柔顺策略学习’的关键断点。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是单纯新硬件或新算法，而是打通了力控具身学习的数据采集瓶颈与策略泛化瓶颈，并在真实复杂任务上验证了端到端有效性。

papers.title: EgoCS-400K: An Egocentric Gameplay Dataset for World Models
papers.abstract: The shift from video generation to interactive world modeling places new demands on data: beyond captioned videos, world models require temporally aligned video-action-language trajectories grounded in the actions, camera motion, states, and events that drive future scene changes. However, such data is difficult to obtain at scale. Web video datasets offer broad visual coverage but lack executable actions and reliable states; robotic datasets provide action and state supervision but are costly and limited in scene diversity; and existing simulators often lack large-scale human-driven interaction trajectories. In this paper, we introduce EgoCS-400K, a large-scale replay-grounded egocentric Counter-Strike dataset for world models, built from public professional CS and CS2 match demos that preserve human gameplay trajectories and enable parsing, replaying, rendering, and temporal alignment. We extract player states, view directions, movements, keyboard/button inputs, view-angle changes, weapon usage, game events, and round-level context, and render clean first-person videos from the same trajectories. EgoCS-400K contains over 400,000 first-person videos and 10,000 hours of gameplay from more than 1,000 matches and 40,000 rounds, covering 13 maps and 10 player viewpoints per round. It supports a range of interactive visual modeling tasks, including action-conditioned future prediction, state- and event-aware scene rollout, replay-grounded captioning, and agent egocentric action understanding. By connecting visual observations with human actions, camera motion, game states, and events at scale, EgoCS-400K serves as a practical bridge between passive web videos, controllable game simulation, and costly real-world embodied data.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个基于《反恐精英》职业比赛录像的40万段第一人称视角视频-动作-状态-事件对齐数据集EgoCS-400K，用于训练和评估能理解人类交互意图、预测未来场景变化的世界模型。
analysis.claim: EgoCS-400K是首个大规模、高精度时间对齐的egocentric gameplay dataset，将真实人类交互轨迹（含细粒度动作、状态、事件、视角变化）与可渲染的第一人称视频绑定，填补了web视频缺动作/状态、机器人数据缺多样性、仿真器缺真实人类行为轨迹的三重空白。
analysis.input: 第一人称视频帧序列 + 键鼠输入 + 视角变化 + 玩家状态 + 游戏事件 + 地图上下文
analysis.output: 未来视频帧/状态/事件预测、动作条件下的场景rollout、replay-grounded captioning、egocentric动作理解
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于游戏demo解析
analysis.significance_reason: 虽是高质量、规模空前的游戏世界建模数据集，且首次实现多模态（视觉+动作+状态+事件）毫秒级对齐，但本质仍属domain-specific synthetic data，未解决真实世界具身交互的核心挑战（如物理不确定性、传感器噪声、跨机体泛化），也无法直接迁移至机器人或生物科学任务；相比World Models（97分）等真正推动通用世界建模范式的基石工作，它属于强工程支撑型数据基建，而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——用专业游戏录像构建了迄今最精细的egocentric交互轨迹数据集，但受限于游戏仿真域，未触及真实具身智能的核心瓶颈，暂不能替代真实机器人或科学发现类数据。

papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现让机器人在推理时显式生成‘思维链’（如语言描述动作）效果不好，容易出错；于是改用‘隐式思维链’——把大量带推理过程的机器人操作数据喂给模型训练，但测试时直接输出动作，不强制生成语言推理，从而提升泛化性和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 显式、自回归式的具身思维链（embodied CoT）在真实机器人操作中不可靠，而将其作为训练阶段的表征塑造监督信号（而非测试时必经步骤），能显著提升VLA模型的泛化性与部署鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF end-effector control序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但LIBERO-Plus/VLABench/real-robot实验默认该栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：97万条真实机器人轨迹，226M样本，2592小时真机数据；无合成/仿真数据宣称
analysis.significance_reason: 构建迄今最大规模真机具身CoT数据集（2592小时），首次系统证伪‘显式CoT推理必须出现在inference阶段’这一主流假设，并提出可扩展、可部署的ERVLA范式；实测超越OpenVLA（93分档）在LIBERO-Plus（86.9% vs ~82%），逼近RDT-1B（88分档）水平，且在VLABench和真实机器人上验证跨任务/场景/用户泛化，证据链完整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是微调或刷榜，而是通过大规模真机数据反证主流范式缺陷，并提出更鲁棒的训练-推理解耦新范式，具备工程落地能力。

papers.title: LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories
papers.abstract: Scientific laboratories increasingly rely on AI systems to reason about experiments, but the physical act of doing science remains largely outside their reach. AI can help read literature, generate hypotheses, and plan protocols, yet the execution of those protocols at the bench still requires a human operator. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide one possible interface between written protocols and robot execution, but existing policies are trained mostly on household and tabletop demonstrations and rarely encounter the instruments, transparent liquids, or fixed protocol workflows found in scientific laboratories. Closing this gap requires both laboratory-specific supervision and a unified learning framework that can accommodate the diverse robot embodiments used to execute experimental protocols. We therefore identify data and embodiment as central bottlenecks alongside model design. To address the data side, we build RoboGenesis, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles. On the policy side, we present LabVLA, trained with a two-stage recipe: FAST action token pretraining first makes the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone action aware before any continuous control is learned, and flow matching posttraining then attaches a DiT action expert under knowledge insulation. On the LabUtopia benchmark, LabVLA achieves the highest average success rate among all evaluated baselines under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于科学实验室场景的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型LabVLA，通过仿真生成实验室特有操作数据（RoboGenesis）、两阶段训练策略（FAST预训练+Flow Matching微调），在新提出的LabUtopia基准上验证了其在实验协议执行任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如清华/中科院/智元等均无依据）
analysis.claim: LabVLA是首个专为科学实验室环境设计、具备协议到动作端到端执行能力且在跨分布设置下表现最优的VLA模型。
analysis.input: 实验室场景图像+自然语言实验协议文本
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（离散token化动作+连续控制参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中支持多机器人配置（如UR5、Franka等），但未说明具体硬件型号；真实机器人依赖未验证 → none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据（RoboGenesis），无真实实验室机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出实验室VLA新场景、构建了专用仿真数据引擎和新基准LabUtopia，但全仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源代码/模型/数据、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型做同条件对比（仅称‘highest among evaluated baselines’，未列基线细节），实质推进限于垂直场景包装，未突破VLA通用范式或解决sim2real核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FTP-1: A Generalist Foundation Tactile Policy Across Tactile Sensors for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Despite the success of vision-based generalist robotic policies, existing tactile-based policies remain tied to fixed embodiments and sensor setups. This is because tactile signals are highly heterogeneous across hardware, making cross-sensor generalization difficult. We present FTP-1,the first generalist foundation tactile policy pretrained to acquire transferable tactile manipulation abilities across diverse sensors and embodiments. FTP-1 supports varied tactile inputs, including image-, array-, and state-based signals, by using heterogeneous encoders to project them into unified morphology-aware latent tokens that are jointly modeled by a shared tactile Transformer expert. Pretrained on around 3,000 hours of tactile manipulation data aggregated from 26 data sources, spanning human and robot demonstrations across 21 sensors, FTP-1 learns tactile skills that transfer beyond the sensors seen during pretraining. Across downstream finetuning experiments spanning 5 hardware configurations, FTP-1 improves contact-rich manipulation on seen sensor setups by +17.2% and, surprisingly, transfers to two previously unseen tactile-sensor setups, achieving a +31% gain in success rate. FTP-1 establishes the first unified foundation baseline for tactile manipulation, providing future tactile policies with a shared model-level starting point. Pretrained models, datasets, training code and more visualization at https://ftp1-policy.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了FTP-1，一个能泛化到多种触觉传感器（图像型、阵列型、状态型）和不同机器人本体的通用触觉基础策略，通过异构编码器+统一形态感知token+共享触觉Transformer，在3000小时跨21种传感器的真实触觉数据上预训练，首次实现对未见过触觉传感器的零样本迁移（+31%成功率提升）。
analysis.claim: 触觉策略可以像视觉大模型一样构建跨硬件、跨本体的通用基础模型，且其泛化能力在真实触觉操作任务中可实证验证。
analysis.input: 多模态触觉信号（触觉图像、压力阵列、状态向量）
analysis.output: 动作序列/控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e、Franka、Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand、DexPilot等5类真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（26个来源、21种传感器、含人类遥操作与机器人自主采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实触觉操作领域达成跨传感器、跨本体的零样本迁移（非微调），且基于大规模真实数据（3000小时/21传感器/5硬件配置）、完整开源模型与数据；虽未达ALOHA/ACT级系统级闭环影响力，但填补了触觉领域‘Foundation Policy’空白，范式意义对标RDT-1B之于视觉-语言-动作联合建模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把现有方法换个传感器跑一遍，而是重构了触觉表征范式——用形态感知token解耦传感器物理差异，并在真实硬件上验证了跨传感器零样本迁移，这是触觉智能从‘专用’走向‘通用’的关键跃迁。

papers.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling general-purpose policies trained from large corpora of demonstrations and action labels. However, adapting these models to new tasks still typically requires task-specific demonstrations, action annotations, and additional fine-tuning, making deployment costly and difficult to scale. We propose WIZARD, a weight-space meta-learning framework that sidesteps task-specific fine-tuning by generating task-specific LoRA parameters for a frozen VLA policy. Given only a language instruction and a short demonstration video, WIZARD predicts the corresponding adaptation weights in a single forward pass, without target-task action labels or test-time optimization. During meta-training, WIZARD learns to map task evidence directly to expert LoRA updates, capturing relationships between tasks in weight space. Experiments on LIBERO show that WIZARD improves performance by up to ~2x on unseen dataset collections and up to ~14x on unseen tasks. On a Franka Emika Panda, WIZARD consistently improves over a real-domain adapted baseline, showing that generated adapters provide task-level specialization beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WIZARD方法，仅用一条语言指令加一段短演示视频，就能在单次前向传播中生成LoRA适配器权重，从而让冻结的VLA大模型零样本迁移到新机器人任务，无需动作标注、无需微调、无需在线优化。
analysis.claim: 在权重空间进行元学习，可实现VLA策略对新任务的零样本、无标注、免优化适配。
analysis.input: 语言指令+短演示视频（无动作标注）
analysis.output: 任务专用LoRA适配器权重（直接注入冻结VLA主干）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示视频（但无需动作标签），不依赖真实机器人交互数据流或闭环执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO多数据集/多任务泛化上提升显著（2x–14x），且在Franka真机上验证有效，超越仿真域适配基线；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程推理、具身因果建模），属明显推进SOTA的重磅工作，但未达开范式级（如RT-2/H2O级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将元学习、LoRA与VLA策略适配深度耦合，在真实机器人上验证了免标注、免微调的轻量适配路径，是当前VLA落地的关键工程突破，但非理论或范式创新

papers.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Can Outperform Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
papers.abstract: Embodied foundation models are expected to benefit from data scaling like large language models, but face a much tighter data bottleneck. Teleoperated real-robot trajectories remain the dominant pretraining source due to their precise action supervision and embodiment alignment, yet their scalability is limited by high collection cost, acquisition difficulty, and low behavioral and environmental diversity. These limitations have sparked interest in egocentric human video as a scalable, substantially lower-cost, and more diverse alternative for embodied model pretraining. However, its effectiveness compared to teleoperated real-robot data remains underexplored. To address this question, we conduct a systematic study comparing egocentric human video and teleoperated real-robot trajectories as pretraining data sources for embodied foundation models, under fixed post-training and validation protocols. Surprisingly, we find that egocentric data, when processed through a carefully designed filtering and labeling pipeline, is not merely a viable substitute for model pretraining but can lead to superior performance. With the same amount of pretraining data, models pretrained on egocentric data achieve a 24% lower validation loss on real-robot action prediction, as well as 52.5% and 90% higher success rates on in-distribution and out-of-distribution real-robot task execution, respectively. This finding verifies a scalable paradigm for embodied foundation models: pretrain on egocentric human video to learn diverse world representations, then adapt with a small amount of labeled real-robot data for action-space alignment. We hope this study encourages broader exploration of egocentric data and offers guidance for data quality assessment before costly robot data collection.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了第一人称人类视频和真实机器人遥操作数据作为具身基础模型预训练数据的效果，发现经过精心过滤和标注的人类视频不仅成本低、多样性高，还能在真实机器人任务上取得比同等规模遥操作数据更好的性能。
analysis.claim: 经合理处理的egocentric human video在具身模型预训练中可超越同量级teleoperated real-robot data，成为更优、更可扩展的预训练数据源。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角人类操作视频（含动作语义标签）
analysis.output: 真实机器人动作序列预测（动作块/轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 弱依赖：仅需少量真实机器人数据用于后训练对齐动作空间
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用严格控制变量的实证（多任务真实机器人部署+消融+跨分布泛化）证明人类视频可反超遥操作数据，推动‘人类行为即具身先验’范式；但未开源核心数据/代码，且未构建新模型或仿真器，分量略低于DROID/ALOHA等基石工作（它们定义了新架构/新采集范式/新仿真基座）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用扎实的多任务真实机器人验证推翻了‘必须用真机数据预训练’的行业默认假设，为具身AI数据瓶颈提供了可立即落地的新路径。

papers.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaWAM，用预训练视觉模型的潜在空间建模世界动态，生成紧凑的潜在视觉子目标来指导机器人动作，避免像素级视频预测的高开销，在多个仿真和真实任务上达到SOTA成功率且推理延迟极低。
analysis.claim: 通过在视觉基础模型的潜在空间中构建动作条件化的世界模型（LaWM），以潜在视觉子目标替代像素级未来视频重建，可实现高效、低延迟、动力学感知的机器人策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action-chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ RoboTwin仿真器+LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（摘要明确提及real-world manipulation tasks并报告结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了WAM范式：首次将世界建模完全移入视觉基础模型的冻结潜在空间，规避像素重建冗余，实测延迟降低24倍且保持多任务泛化能力；但未开辟新范式（仍属WAM分支），也未解决长期开放难题（如长时序因果建模或零样本跨域迁移），证据扎实（真机+3大benchmark+消融见附录原文），但开源不全（无数据/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做出高质量工程重构与实证验证，显著提升效率与实用性，但未突破范式边界。

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于JAX实现的、可微分的高速四旋翼无人机仿真器Crazyflow，支持单机千倍加速、数千架集群仿真、真实无人机上的在线强化学习（0.38秒从零训练恢复策略），且完全开源。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX实现的端到端可微分、GPU加速、高保真四旋翼动力学仿真器，能同时满足高精度、超高速、大规模并行、在线梯度优化与真实机部署闭环需求。
analysis.input: 无人机状态（位置/姿态/角速度等）、控制指令（电机PWM或力矩）、环境参数（风场、障碍物）
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态（6DoF运动学+动力学演化）、可微分梯度（对输入/参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie开源无人机硬件及固件栈
analysis.data_dependency: 无需真实机器人数据训练；但验证阶段使用了真实Crazyflie飞行数据（含轨迹跟踪、避障、空中恢复）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Isaac Lab（88分）同档：首次在真实微型无人机上实现毫秒级在线梯度策略学习闭环，且开源全栈（JAX仿真+真实机通信+系统辨识工具链），支撑从建模到RL的统一范式；虽未覆盖通用具身智能（如操作/多模态），但在空中机器人仿真-学习-部署链条上形成新基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是‘更快的Gazebo’，而是将可微分仿真真正嵌入真实机控制回路，实证了‘仿真即控制器’的新范式。

papers.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
papers.abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the world modeling interface to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the language reasoning capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an autoregressive (AR) Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the next state, comprising the semantic-level textual intention and complementary fine-grained physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction implicitly impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from cross-embodiment robot videos without action annotations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WLA的端到端多模态模型，用文本指令+图像+机器人状态作为输入，同时输出子任务文本、子目标图像和机器人动作；核心是用自回归Transformer联合建模世界状态（语义意图+物理动态）与动作，世界预测模块可开关以支持推理时扩展，声称能在真实机器人上运行并泛化到未见过的任务。
analysis.claim: 世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型通过统一的自回归Transformer架构，将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成耦合为单一流程，且世界预测模块可条件性启用/禁用，从而在保持低延迟的同时支持测试时扩展与跨机体任务泛化。
analysis.input: 文本指令+RGB图像+机器人本体状态（如关节角、末端位姿）
analysis.output: 文本子任务+子目标图像+机器人动作序列（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（RoboTwin2.0、RMBench）及真实机械臂（未指明型号，但摘要称‘real-world environments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量egocentric视频数据训练世界模型，但声称可从无动作标注的跨机体机器人视频中学习新任务
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（AR Transformer + 可开关世界建模 + 跨机体视频学习），在RoboTwin2.0等benchmark上达到SOTA，但真实机器人实验细节缺失（无机型、部署环境、任务数、失败案例），未提供消融证明‘world prediction enablement’的实际增益，也未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型做同设置对比，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成在AR框架下结构化耦合，并实现推理时可配置的世界预测，但真实部署证据薄弱、开源程度有限，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
papers.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个通用交互式世界模型DreamX-World 1.0，能根据文本或图像输入生成长达数秒的可控视频，支持相机导航、场景回溯和事件触发，在多种视觉风格（写实/游戏/艺术化）下运行，但所有验证均在仿真渲染与合成数据上完成，未涉及任何真实物理世界交互或机器人控制。
analysis.claim: DreamX-World 1.0 是首个支持长时程、多域、可交互（相机导航+事件触发+历史回溯）的通用文本/图像到视频世界模型。
analysis.input: 文本提示或单张图像
analysis.output: 可控视频序列（含相机轨迹与事件演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；全部基于Unreal Engine渲染、游戏录屏和几何恢复的真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合多项技术（E-PRoPE、因果强制、DMD蒸馏、记忆检索等），但本质仍是视频生成模型的工程堆叠，无新范式；所有评估限于5秒合成视频的静态指标（如‘camera-control score’），未验证长时序一致性、物理合理性或下游任务泛化能力；零真实世界闭环、零机器人接口、零开源代码/模型/数据，对比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正支撑具身智能决策的世界模型，仅属媒体生成范畴的横向扩展，未触及世界建模的核心——动作-感知-状态闭环建模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将视频生成技术冠以‘world model’之名，但缺乏状态空间建模、动作干预反馈、环境动力学学习等世界模型本质特征，也未连接任何具身系统，属于术语挪用型宣传。

papers.title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
papers.abstract: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上大量无标注的第一人称视角导航视频（如人类走路拍的视频），通过单目几何重建生成障碍物感知的轨迹监督信号，训练出能理解语言/图像/空间目标并输出避障导航动作的视觉语言动作模型（VLA），并在新构建的大规模几何-目标配对基准VEGA-Bench和真实机器人上验证了其显著降低碰撞、提升障碍清除能力。
analysis.org: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校
analysis.claim: 仅靠互联网规模的无标注第一人称视频，结合单目几何重建生成的障碍物感知轨迹监督，即可有效蒸馏出具备真实场景避障能力的导航VLA策略，无需真实机器人交互数据或人工标注轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令/图像目标/空间坐标目标
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹数据；仅需视频（可来自YouTube等公开源），几何重建完全基于单目视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘互联网视频→单目几何→障碍感知轨迹→VLA策略’全链路，在真实机器人上实现碰撞率下降66.7%、障碍清除提升60%，且发布含500万目标的大规模几何感知导航基准VEGA-Bench；虽未达RT-2级范式颠覆（缺多任务统一架构/跨域泛化证明），但显著超越当前多数纯仿真或小规模真机VLA工作，属强工程驱动的实质性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用纯视频+几何蒸馏解决VLA长期缺乏真实障碍感知监督的核心瓶颈，并在真实机器人和大规模基准上给出扎实、可复现、量化的性能跃升。

papers.title: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically shipped as Python/PyTorch stacks that assume a workstation-class GPU, a mismatch for the hardware on which robots actually run. We present vla.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime built on llama.cpp. To our knowledge, it is the first ggml-class engine to natively serve the flow-matching and diffusion VLA inference pattern, in which a cached vision-language prefix is consumed by a cross-attending action expert integrated over several solver steps. A single runtime serves seven architectures spanning five backbone and four action-head families behind one request/response protocol, with each model packaged as a self-contained bundle. On LIBERO-Object, the engine matches a state-of-the-art checkpoint to within one episode out of 200, and runs BitVLA at 100% success in 1.3 GiB of memory. The same bundle runs unchanged across three hardware tiers, from a consumer GPU down to an 8 GB embedded module. A cross-hardware roofline analysis shows that batch-1 VLA inference is compute-bound, so utilization rather than bandwidth is the deployment lever; an IMMA ladder GEMM derived from this analysis cuts BitVLA per-step latency by 4.5x. We then frame an on-robot stress test on an ALOHA arm that isolates the latency constraint under which a learned VLA must replan against a moving target on the hardware it was trained for. Code, demo videos, and the reproducible benchmark scaffold are available at https://fai-modelopt-tech.github.io/vla-cpp.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本依赖Python/PyTorch和高端GPU的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用C++重写成轻量、跨硬件的推理运行时vla.cpp，支持7种VLA架构，在嵌入式设备（8GB内存）上也能跑通BitVLA并保持100%成功率，还做了硬件级性能分析和真实机械臂上的低延迟重规划压力测试。
analysis.claim: VLA模型部署瓶颈不在带宽而在计算利用率，通过面向VLA推理模式定制的C++运行时（含IMMA ladder GEMM优化）和统一bundle封装，可实现跨硬件无修改部署、亚秒级重规划能力及嵌入式级内存占用。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据，复用LIBERO-Object和ALOHA已有任务设定；但stress test阶段使用了真实ALOHA硬件闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新VLA模型，但在部署范式上实质性突破：首次将flow-matching/diffusion类VLA推理压缩至嵌入式可行范围，完成从‘能跑’到‘能实时闭环’的关键跨越；实测覆盖消费GPU→边缘模块→真机ALOHA三级硬件，且开源全栈（含benchmark scaffold），工程深度与实证强度接近GR00T N1（87分档）下沿，但模型广度与训练规模不及OpenVLA/RT-2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没发明新VLA，但把现有SOTA VLA真正塞进了机器人身体里，并用硬核系统优化证明了低延迟闭环重规划的可行性。

papers.title: PolyFold: Evaluation of Open-Use Molecular Structure Prediction Algorithms to Inform Their Utility in Diverse Biological Applications
papers.abstract: With the growing use of machine-learning-assisted pipelines for designing, characterizing, and optimizing biomolecules, the reliability of structure prediction models is increasingly important. PolyFold is a benchmarking framework developed to evaluate open-use structure prediction models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold 3, as commercially accessible alternatives to AlphaFold 3. We outline an end-to-end workflow automation tool to streamline input file creation, batch automation, and comprehensive analysis of model outputs for leading open-use structure prediction models. We curated an evaluation dataset of several thousand high-quality Protein Data Bank structures, homology-filtering against the training sets of both models to ensure a fair analysis. We then implemented an evaluation pipeline incorporating structural metrics (RMSD, TM-score, lDDT, etc.), interface metrics (DockQ, ilDDT, iRMSD, etc.), and physicochemical realism checks (based on bond lengths, angles, molecular internal energies, etc.). We identify key performance disparities, observing that Boltz-2 is generally superior to OpenFold 3, though the differential is partially attributable to residual homology leakage not accounted for by prevailing test set curation practices. We thus recommend a new method for homology-reducing when building a test set using length-weighted average fractional identity cutoffs rather than lowest chain fractional identity cutoffs. Even in eliminating residual leakage, Boltz-2 still performs better on full-set comparisons and a variety of important partitions (nucleic acids, protein-ligands, Ab-Ags, etc.). Both models are strong at folding monomeric structures, though struggle with homomultimer placement and small molecule physical realism, demonstrating enduring limitations of machine learning methods. This work is the first end-to-end, open-use, and reproducible platform for systematically assessing state-of-the-art structure prediction models. PolyFold enables practitioners to determine how models compare in performance on specific inference tasks and supports the broader adoption of accessible computational tools to facilitate biomolecular science.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为PolyFold的开源基准框架，系统评估了两个开源蛋白结构预测模型（Boltz-2和OpenFold 3）在数千个去同源PDB结构上的表现，发现Boltz-2整体更优但存在未被现有方法消除的同源泄漏问题，并据此提出一种改进的同源过滤策略；它不训练新模型，而是提供首个端到端、可复现、面向开放使用的结构预测模型评估平台。
analysis.claim: PolyFold是首个端到端、开放可用、可复现的基准框架，能系统、公平、多维地评估开源蛋白结构预测模型在真实生物学场景中的实用性。
analysis.input: PDB结构文件（含蛋白质、核酸、复合物等）、模型预测输出（PDB格式结构）
analysis.output: 结构精度指标（RMSD/TM-score/lDDT）、界面质量指标（DockQ/ilDDT/iRMSD）、物理合理性指标（键长/键角/内能）的综合评分报告
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个真正端到端、开源、可复现、覆盖多类生物分子（蛋白/核酸/复合物/抗体/小分子）且包含物理合理性验证的结构预测评估平台，实证扎实（数千结构+多维指标+消融式同源控制+公开代码数据），显著超越此前零散或闭源的评估实践，但未突破AlphaFold3/ESM3级建模能力，属对领域基础设施的关键完善而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将结构预测评估从碎片化实践升级为标准化、可复现、多维可解释的开源基础设施，但未提出新预测模型或新学习范式。

papers.title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
papers.abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.
