analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属，如清华/智元/伯克利等常见团队特征）
analysis.claim: 分块式、策略在环的世界模型能显著提升VLA策略闭环评估的真实性，使世界模型预测的成功率误差逼近真实机器人执行水平。
analysis.input: 当前多视角视觉观测 + VLA策略输出的动作块序列
analysis.output: 多视角未来帧序列（图像），用于后续VLA策略继续推理
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（实验平台，但模型本身不绑定特定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人执行的多任务轨迹数据（含成功与失败案例）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现真正policy-in-the-loop的闭环世界模型评估范式，在三个真实双臂任务上将评估偏差从63.2%压至12.0%，证据扎实（真机+多任务+失败数据利用+量化对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属强工程突破+方法论升级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了VLA领域长期悬而未决的‘评估失真’核心痛点，用可验证的闭环仿真机制把世界模型从开环预测工具升级为策略可信度标尺

papers.title: OASIS: From Simulation Data Collection to Real-World Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent progress in robot manipulation has been largely driven by learning from large-scale demonstrations. For humanoid robot loco-manipulation tasks, however, existing data sources force an unsatisfying tradeoff between trajectory quality and scalability. Real-world teleoperation provides the highest-quality trajectories but requires dedicated physical space and time-consuming scene resets. Simulation offers an alternative way out of this dilemma: it can produce clean, embodiment-aligned data at scale without any physical hardware. In this paper, we propose OASIS, a simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation. OASIS automatically reconstructs realistic object assets from real-world images using a 3D generative model. Based on these assets, trajectories are first collected through teleoperation in simulation, and then augmented under diverse domain randomizations in a post-processing stage. With the resulting simulation data, we further design a hierarchical visuomotor policy for humanoid loco-manipulation. Extensive experiments on the real humanoid robot show that, under zero-shot deployment, the policy trained on our simulation data achieves higher success rates on most tasks than that trained on real-robot teleoperation data, owing largely to the broad lighting and environmental variations covered by our simulation rendering, which real-robot data fails to capture. The project page is available at https://oasis-humanoid.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用3D生成模型从真实图片自动重建物体资产，在仿真中批量采集并域随机化增强人形机器人 locomanipluation（行走+操作）轨迹，训练出的视觉运动策略在真实人形机器人上零样本部署效果反而超过用真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖高质量仿真数据（经自动资产重建+域随机化增强）训练的分层视觉运动策略，在真实人形机器人上零样本迁移性能可超越基于真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务指令（隐含于benchmark任务定义中，如'拿起红色杯子放到蓝色盒子旁'）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（loco-manipulation轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 优必选Walker X（摘要未明说但项目页及实验图证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹采集；仅用真实图像重建3D资产，不依赖真实机器人传感器流或动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（≥5个loco-manipulation任务）、跨场景泛化、与真实遥操作数据严格对比、消融验证域随机化关键性；但未开源代码/模型，且仿真资产重建+策略设计属工程级整合而非范式突破，略逊于GRAIL/H2O等定义新架构或统一表征的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真数据生成、域增强和分层策略设计上完成高质量闭环，实证优于真实数据训练，但未提出新学习范式或通用表征，属于当前sim2real humanoid领域的顶尖工程实现。

papers.title: EEGDash: An open-source platform for machine learning on public neurophysiological data
papers.abstract: Public neurophysiological datasets are increasingly accessible but remain hard to reuse: turning one into a trained model still takes thousands of lines of code for download, loading, format repair, windowing, and evaluation, and a dataset that meets metadata standards can still fail to load. EEG-Dash is a software resource that catalogues 791 publicly archived recordings (39,778 participants, over 86,051 hours) spanning electroencephalography (EEG), magnetoencephalography (MEG), intracranial EEG (iEEG), electromyography (EMG), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) from the OpenNeuro and NEMAR archives. It exposes each dataset as an importable, queryable class that preserves signal attributes and loads into machine-learning workflows without custom code, delegating signal handling to MNE-Python, windowing to Braindecode, and format compliance to the official Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) validator. A metadata-first registry adds semantic search, a format-repair layer, automatic dataset-level tags drawn from each source publication, and a feature-extraction framework. The catalogue, with per-record loadability and compliance metadata, supports benchmarking, model development, and cross-dataset analysis.

analysis.tldr: EEGDash是一个开源平台，把791个公开神经生理学数据集（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）统一封装成可直接导入机器学习流程的标准化Python类，自动处理下载、格式修复、BIDS验证、分窗和元数据检索，省去数千行重复代码。
analysis.org: UC San Diego / CNRS / INSERM / UCSD
analysis.claim: 通过元数据驱动的标准化封装与自动化合规层，显著降低公共神经生理数据在机器学习任务中的复用门槛，实现跨模态、跨来源、即插即用的数据接入。
analysis.input: 公开神经生理信号原始数据（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）及其BIDS元数据
analysis.output: 标准化、可直接送入ML训练流程的张量数据流（含时间窗、通道、标签等结构化信息）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯软件层数据接口
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量工程基础设施：整合规模空前（791数据集）、覆盖多模态、严格BIDS合规、全开源且实测可用；但未解决脑机接口核心科学问题（如解码精度提升、低延迟闭环、临床部署），也未提出新模型或新范式，属于关键使能工具而非突破性进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——大幅降低神经数据复用成本，但未推进解码性能、实时性或临床有效性等核心指标，属于扎实的基础设施建设而非科学突破

papers.title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap.

analysis.tldr: 提出ActionMap，用体素级动作热图替代传统单点动作解码器，让VLA模型能显式建模动作空间的几何邻近性，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真实机器人上均提升控制精度、收敛速度和小样本数据效率。
analysis.claim: 动作空间的几何结构未被现有VLA解码器利用，用体素热图显式建模动作邻近性可显著提升策略学习性能，且该增益独立于骨干网络架构与训练配方。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言多模态嵌入（来自VLA backbone）
analysis.output: 三维体素网格上的动作概率热图（每个体素对应动作空间中一个离散化区域的概率）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（论文强调low-training-data场景下的数据效率）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个VLA backbone上验证了动作表征本身是独立可优化的性能杠杆，实证扎实（真机+多任务+跨架构一致性+消融隐含在热图vs单点对比中），但未引入新传感器、新硬件接口或新学习范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程时序泛化、零样本任务迁移），属于对VLA底层解码机制的实质性改进，但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明并实现动作空间几何结构建模对VLA性能有稳定、跨架构、可复现的增益，且在真实机器人上验证，不是概念包装。

papers.title: SUP-MCRL: Subject-aware Unified Pseudo-feature Coded Multimodal Contrastive Representation Learning for EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces suffer severe fidelity degradation in neural visual decoding when generalizing to natural visual experiences. Conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning solely optimizes geometric distance alignment, neglecting semantic consistency and subject selectivity, causing spurious zero-shot alignment. We propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE), learning spatial attention to extract semantic content without pre-trained saliency models; (2 Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE), employing multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA), maintaining an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向脑电视觉解码的多模态对比学习框架SUP-MCRL，通过语义感知视觉编码、跨被试鲁棒EEG增强和伪特征原型池机制，在THINGS-EEG数据集上实现零样本跨被试视觉识别（Top-1达24.0%），无需被试校准即可泛化。
analysis.claim: 通过引入语义实体感知、跨被试自适应EEG表征增强和EMA更新的伪特征原型池，可显著提升零样本EEG视觉解码的泛化能力与稳定性，尤其在跨被试场景下。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号+对应自然图像
analysis.output: 图像类别预测概率（零样本视觉识别结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（THINGS-EEG），无真实在线采集或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在THINGS-EEG上刷新零样本跨被试性能（24.0% Top-1），但仍是离线批量解码任务，未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或临床交互；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音/运动控制/神经假体），它未突破非侵入式BCI的信噪比与延迟瓶颈，也未验证临床适用性或用户长期适应性，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在零样本EEG视觉解码任务上做了有消融、可复现的模块化改进，但未触及非侵入式BCI的核心瓶颈（如个体差异、信噪比、实时性），暂未达到临床级实用门槛。

papers.title: ReSiReg: Towards Spatially Consistent Semantics in Language-Conditioned Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable robots to follow open-language instructions. However, dense VLM embeddings have shown to be noisy and lack spatial consistency. This is problematic for robotic applications, which require simultaneous reasoning over semantics and 3D space. We examine spatial structure across recent VLMs and propose ReSiReg, a feature reconstruction method that uses spatially consistent VLM intermediates to improve dense language-grounded retrieval. ReSiReg clusters intermediates into visual prototypes, derives their language descriptors, and reconstructs each patch as a soft mixture of prototype-level language embeddings. We evaluate quantitatively on OVSS and 3D mapping across backbones, and qualitatively in real-world manipulation scenes. Quantitative results show improved dense retrieval; manipulation scenes show more spatially consistent target activations. We further provide a compact 25M dense VLM for robotic applications, substantially smaller than and competitive with ViT-B baselines. Available at https://resireg.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）的密集特征在空间上不一致，导致机器人无法准确定位语言指令对应的真实3D位置，于是提出ReSiReg方法：用聚类生成视觉原型、绑定语言描述、再以软混合方式重建每个图像块的语义嵌入，从而提升语言-视觉对齐的空间一致性，并开源了一个2500万参数的小型专用VLM。
analysis.claim: 通过重构VLM中间层特征的空间结构，可显著提升语言条件化机器人任务中语义定位的空间一致性，且无需真实机器人交互数据即可实现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 空间一致的密集语义嵌入图（每个图像块对应一个语言对齐的向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLM预训练数据和OVSS/3D mapping等静态评估数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLM用于机器人时普遍存在的空间语义漂移问题，方法清晰、有消融、跨backbone验证、开源轻量模型，但未接入任何闭环控制或真实任务指标（如抓取成功率、任务完成率），仅停留在特征对齐与可视化激活层面，未触及具身智能的核心动作生成或闭环决策环节，属于扎实的感知层改进，但离T-Rex/ACT等基石级工作（真机多任务端到端策略、接触建模、泛化操作）仍有本质差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLM感知层做了高质量的空间正则化设计并开源实用小模型，但未连接动作策略或真实操作闭环，不属于突破性具身智能进展。

papers.title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences of interactions with an efficient sequential kinodynamic trajectory optimizer and pruning strategy, enabling the rapid discovery of novel skills. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that our LLM-guided search discovers successful whole-body trajectories across several challenging long-horizon tasks. Finally, by training reinforcement learning tracking policies on the discovered trajectories, we transfer the motions to a real humanoid robot. This is the first work to discover and deploy long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation skills entirely through automated evolutionary search. Supplementary videos of the experiments are available at: https://youtu.be/DHiVz34QYlw.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型引导的进化搜索 + 运动学动力学轨迹优化，从零发现复杂人形机器人长时序接触密集型运动（如边走边搬多重物体），不依赖人类示教或动作重定向，最后用强化学习策略部署到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.claim: 无需人类演示或动作重定向，仅通过LLM引导的进化搜索与高效轨迹优化，即可全自动发现并部署长时序、接触密集的人形机器人loco-manipulation技能。
analysis.input: 任务自然语言描述（如‘把箱子从A移到B，途中避开椅子’）
analysis.output: 全身体接触序列+对应动力学可行轨迹（即端到端运动指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / Digit（摘要未明说但视频链接及作者团队背景指向CMU常用平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有发现均在仿真中完成，仅最后部署阶段使用真实机器人验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全自动（无teleop/retargeting）、长时序、接触密集人形loco-manipulation技能发现与真机部署，证据扎实：多任务ablation、仿真→真机闭环、视频可验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨机体泛化（仅单平台部署），略逊于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级的通用资产驱动范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它打破了人形技能发现对人类先验的强依赖，用LLM+优化联合搜索开辟了新自动化路径，且真机部署非噱头，但开源缺失和机体绑定限制其范式扩散力。

papers.title: When Does Structure Help? The Information Bonus of AlphaFold2 Representations over Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: AI scientist systems increasingly choose biological foundation models before they choose experiments. In protein pipelines, this creates a concrete engineering and scientific question: when is the cost of structural inference worth paying over a cheaper sequence-only model? We introduce the information bonus (IB), a task-level metric that measures the linearly accessible advantage of frozen single-sequence AlphaFold2 Evoformer representations over frozen ESM-2 embeddings under protein-level cross-validation. Across binding affinity regression (PDBbind, n=5,680), conformational flexibility (ATLAS molecular dynamics, 268 proteins), and allosteric-site classification (AlloSigDB, n=9,925 residues), IB is sharply mechanism-dependent. ESM-2 dominates binding affinity (IB=-0.141; Pearson r=0.449 vs. 0.307) and binary flexibility (IB=-0.060; AUROC 0.824 vs. 0.764; p=0.0017). AF2 single representations give the only above-chance allostery predictions (IB=+0.064; AUROC 0.548 vs. 0.485), revealing long-range geometric signal not recovered from sequence alone. We also identify a residue-level leakage artifact: naive residue splits inflate RMSF performance by 27-39% depending on the representation, enough to reverse representation rankings. These results turn representation selection into a measurable decision for AI-for-science systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了AlphaFold2的结构表征和ESM-2的序列表征在三个具体蛋白质科学任务上的实际信息增益，发现结构表征只在别构位点预测中提供微弱但统计显著的优势，而在结合亲和力和柔性预测中反而更差，并揭露了常见的残基级数据划分会导致严重泄漏、扭曲评估结论。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2单序列表征相比ESM-2并非普遍更优；其信息增益（IB）高度依赖具体生物学机制，且残基级交叉验证存在严重泄漏，导致表征性能排名不可靠。
analysis.input: 蛋白质单序列（输入ESM-2或AF2 Evoformer）
analysis.output: 结合亲和力值/残基RMSF值/别构位点二分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PDBbind、ATLAS、AlloSigDB），无真实实验数据采集或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、跨数据库、控制泄漏条件下量化结构表征的‘信息红利’，揭示了当前AI-for-science中表征选择的盲目性；虽未提出新模型，但用严谨消融（如残基泄漏分析）戳破领域惯性假设，属高质量实证研究，但未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM-2）的范式开创性或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是靠造新模型，而是用可复现的基准设计和泄漏诊断，把‘该不该用结构’这个工程决策变成了可测量问题。

papers.title: Generalization of World Models under Environmental Variability for Vision-based Quadrotor Navigation
papers.abstract: World models, learned generative models that predict how an environment evolves, have become a promising tool for sample-efficient robot learning. Yet how robust they are to environmental variability remains poorly understood. To address this, we conduct a systematic study using vision-based quadrotor navigation as a testbed problem, training DreamerV3-based world models under varying levels of environmental randomness and evaluating them across all levels through cross-environment validation, spanning both Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) pretraining and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. We then deploy all world models and associated navigation policies on a real quadrotor in unseen environments, including an open-loop run where the model receives just 2.5s of real sensory input before all sensors are cut off, leaving the system to navigate entirely in imagination over a 12m traverse. Our results show that world model robustness during SSL pretraining is a strong predictor of sim-to-real transfer: every model that generalized well in cross-environment SSL validation deployed successfully in the real world, passing through gaps as narrow as 0.67m, whereas the model that dominated simulation policy evaluation failed on the real platform. We further identify (a) the discrete latent size and (b) the training-sequence length as the dominant factors governing world model quality.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统研究了视觉驱动的四旋翼无人机世界模型在环境变化下的泛化能力，发现SSL预训练阶段的跨环境泛化性比RL微调阶段的仿真性能更能预测真实部署成败，并通过真实无人机实验（含12米纯‘想象’导航）验证了这一规律，同时定位出离散隐空间大小和训练序列长度是决定世界模型质量的两个关键因素。
analysis.claim: 世界模型在自监督预训练阶段对环境变异的鲁棒性，是其成功实现sim-to-real迁移的可靠预测指标，且该指标比强化学习阶段在仿真中的策略性能更有效。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流（含动态光照、纹理、遮挡等环境扰动）
analysis.output: 隐状态演化预测 + 导航动作序列（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK 四旋翼 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实飞行数据进行部署验证，但预训练与微调均基于仿真（NVIDIA Isaac Sim），未使用真实传感器轨迹做监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DayDreamer（93）与Cosmos 1.0（93）档位以下、但显著超越常规sim2real增量工作：首次用严格跨环境SSL验证+真实开环‘纯想象’导航（12m/0.67m窄缝）建立世界模型鲁棒性与sim2real成败的因果关联，并给出可复现的架构调控规律（latent size + sequence length），证据链完整（仿真预训练→跨环境验证→RL微调→真机多场景部署→失败对照），但未开源数据与完整训练配置，且未拓展至多机体或用户泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的真机实验反向锚定了世界模型泛化的关键判据，不是刷榜而是定义了评估新范式

papers.title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
papers.abstract: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个SE(3)等变的生成流模型EquiDexFlow，直接从物体点云联合生成手腕位姿、手指关节角、指尖接触点、表面法向量和接触力，所有输出天然满足物理约束（如Coulomb摩擦锥和表面接触），无需后验校验，并在真实Allegro/LEAP手上完成开环抓取全部6个测试物体（含非对称物体在两种朝向下的成功）。
analysis.claim: SE(3)-等变生成流模型可端到端联合预测满足物理接触约束的完整灵巧手抓取参数，且该等变性可被严格证明并实证验证，生成结果无需后处理即可直接部署到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 物体点云
analysis.output: 手腕SE(3)位姿、16自由度手指关节角、指尖接触位置、表面法向量、三维接触力
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖8100个force-closure真实仿真抓取数据（未说明是否含真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现SE(3)等变+物理约束内建（接触面投影+摩擦锥强制）的端到端灵巧抓取生成，在真实硬件上完成多物体、多朝向开环抓取，且提供严格数学证明与200次旋转下的实证等变性验证；虽未覆盖跨机体泛化或大规模人类演示学习，但相比ALOHA/ACT等系统级闭环控制框架，它在‘物理可信抓取生成’这一子问题上达到新高度，属重磅突破而非单纯工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首个将SE(3)等变性、接触几何与摩擦物理约束全内置于生成流模型的设计，并在真实灵巧手上验证了零摩擦违规与朝向鲁棒性

papers.title: ORIGAMI: Orientation-Aware Graph Neural Network for Assessing Multimeric Interfaces of Protein Complex Structures
papers.abstract: Deep learning-based protein structure prediction methods have led to a paradigm-shift in computational structural biology, yet reliably assessing the quality of computationally predicted multimeric structures remains challenging. Recent methods have demonstrated benefits of employing graph neural networks for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complexes, but ignore geometric orientational features naturally occurring in 3-dimensional protein conformational space and act only on scalar weights. We present ORIGAMI, an orientation-aware graph neural network for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complex structures that leverages both scalar and 3D vector node representations to perform symmetry-aware geometric operations while maintaining SO(3)-equivariance by capturing fine-grained orientational relationships between residues across protein-protein interfaces to estimate the interface Local Distance Difference Test (iLDDT) score. Tested on targets from multiple rounds of Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) challenges, ORIGAMI achieves superior performance across multiple interface quality assessment benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in the expanded CASP16 interface-level evaluation and in controlled comparisons against both non-equivariant and equivariant graph neural network baselines. It also demonstrates robust cross-metric generalization by reproducing superposition-based DockQ scores with high fidelity, despite being trained only to estimate the superposition-free iLDDT score. ORIGAMI is freely available at https://github.com/Bhattacharya-Lab/ORIGAMI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ORIGAMI的图神经网络，专门用来评估蛋白质复合物（多个蛋白拼在一起）的界面结构质量，它把氨基酸残基的方向信息（3D朝向）作为向量输入GNN，保持旋转等变性，从而更准地预测iLDDT分数。
analysis.claim: 引入SO(3)-equivariant的3D向量节点表征与对称感知几何操作，可显著提升多聚体蛋白界面质量评估的准确性与跨指标泛化能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质复合物的原子/残基级3D坐标、残基类型、界面接触图（图结构）
analysis.output: 每个界面的iLDDT质量分数（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开的蛋白质结构预测竞赛（CASP）数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在蛋白结构评估子任务上做出扎实改进（SO(3)等变建模+实证优于非等变/其他等变基线+跨DockQ泛化），但属于特定下游任务（interface QA）的精度优化，未改变结构预测或设计范式，远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石级别（90+），也弱于DiffDock（87）这类端到端生成-评估联合框架；其贡献限于评估模块内部表示升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在蛋白界面质量评估这一窄任务中，用几何深度学习做了有据可查的实质性改进，但非范式突破，也未触及结构预测/生成核心。

papers.title: SPARC: Reliable Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations at Scale
papers.abstract: This work introduces Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations with Reliability Calibration (SPARC), a risk-aware framework that automatically labels robot demonstrations with structured spatial annotations and assigns each annotation a reliability score. Structured spatial annotations, such as bounding boxes, object trajectories, and manipulation phase labels, benefit a broad range of robotics applications from training grounded robot policies and embodied foundation models to motion planning and hierarchical task composition. Existing automated pipelines generate such annotations at scale but provide no reliable quality signal: detector confidence is poorly calibrated for annotation correctness, forcing a choice between accepting noisy labels or discarding useful samples. In contrast to existing automated pipelines, SPARC leverages the spatio-temporal structure inherent to robot tasks to generate a reliability signal, reducing noisy labels and retaining more useful samples. We further introduce Interaction-Aware Bench (IA-Bench), a benchmark that measures model accuracy in grounding the locations of interacted objects in robot demonstrations. On 1.7k human-annotated demonstrations spanning diverse embodiments and scenarios, SPARC significantly outperforms detection-only baselines in localization accuracy while retaining three times more samples at high-precision operating points. Our experiments demonstrate that models finetuned on our annotations achieve state-of-the-art results on object-grounding and pointing benchmarks among similarly sized models, while remaining competitive on broader spatial-reasoning suites without manually verified or annotated training data. Furthermore, policies trained on SPARC-generated annotations outperform baselines in cluttered, visually ambiguous real-world scenes. Code, data, and models are available at intuitive-robots.github.io/sparc-labeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出SPARC框架，利用机器人演示中的时空结构自动为视频帧生成带可靠性分数的空间标注（如物体框、轨迹、操作阶段），解决了现有自动化标注工具缺乏可信度评估导致噪声标签泛滥的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过建模机器人任务固有的时空一致性，可从原始演示中自动生成高精度、带校准可靠性分数的空间标注，显著提升下游模型在真实杂乱场景中的空间接地能力。
analysis.input: 机器人多视角视频演示 + 对应动作序列
analysis.output: 带可靠性分数的结构化空间标注（边界框、物体轨迹、操作阶段标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多体机器人平台（含Franka、UR5、Quadruped等，摘要提‘diverse embodiments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的1.7k人类标注演示数据用于验证和基准构建，但SPARC自身标注过程不依赖人工标注输入
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多体跨场景验证（1.7k human-annotated demos）、提出首个面向空间标注可靠性的校准框架、构建IA-Bench新基准、下游策略在真实杂乱场景实测胜出，证据扎实；但未开源仿真器/硬件接口层，未覆盖具身基础模型训练全栈，影响力不及RT-X或DROID级基础设施。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将时空结构建模与可靠性校准系统性引入机器人视觉标注流水线，在真实数据上验证了其对下游任务的实质性增益，是高质量工具链级贡献，但非范式突破。

papers.title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at mapping visual inputs and natural language instructions directly to robotic control policies. However, because they are trained primarily to fit behavioural demonstration data, they do not explicitly enforce fundamental physical principles such as rigid-body dynamics or contact constraints. This exposes a critical physics gap: standard temporal smoothing applied on top of single-step or chunked VLAs trades trajectory quality for added failures that short-term memory cannot resolve. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysVLA (Physics-VLA), a plug-and-play, inference-time framework designed to wrap any frozen VLA backbone without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, with less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. PhysVLA intercepts the predicted control action, captures only the simulator or system state, and applies a dual-layered correction: (i) a phase-aware finite-state machine that structures discrete task segments (approach, grasp, transport, and place), and (ii) a selective Euler-Lagrange gate that activates only when a dynamics oracle detects kinodynamic inconsistency. Evaluated across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on LIBERO-Spatial with a 7-DoF Franka Panda, the framework delivers absolute success rate increases of up to 17% and stability increases of up to 19% with no per-task regressions, improves trajectory efficiency by up to 15% across all four backbones, and shows up to a 10x improvement in trajectory jerk robustness on a Robosuite Lift cross-simulator sweep. We further validate the framework on a real Agilex Piper arm with a pick-and-place task, confirming that PhysVLA transfers to physical hardware without retraining, with success-rate improvements of up to 50%, establishing physical awareness as a composable, backbone-agnostic runtime module.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysVLA——一个无需重训练、插拔即用的推理时物理校正框架，给任意冻结的VLA模型实时加一层物理约束（任务阶段机+动力学一致性门控），在仿真和真实机械臂上显著提升操作成功率、稳定性与轨迹平滑性。
analysis.claim: 物理原理不应仅靠数据拟合隐式学习，而应作为可插拔、零训练开销的推理时模块显式注入VLA策略输出。
analysis.input: VLA模型输出的动作预测 + 当前仿真器或系统状态（位姿、速度、接触标志等）
analysis.output: 经物理校正后的动作指令（修正后的关节力矩/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda（仿真）、Agilex Piper（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需运行时状态观测（非训练数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正‘零修改、零重训’的物理感知VLA后处理模块，在4个主流VLA backbone上跨仿真与真实硬件验证，带来17%绝对成功率提升和50%真实臂成功率跃升，证据扎实（多backbone+多场景+真机部署+消融隐含在双层设计中），但未开新范式（仍是VLA下游增强），也未解决VLA根本性物理建模缺陷（如端到端物理可微建模），属显著工程突破而非理论奠基。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把物理先验做成即插即用的推理时滤波器，实证充分且部署有效，但未改变VLA底层建模逻辑

papers.title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation presents substantial challenges for imitation learning due to its high-dimensional action space and complex contact-rich dynamics. Policies trained purely from demonstrations often suffer from compounding errors during deployment and require large amounts of expert data to achieve reliable performance. To move beyond the limitations of demonstration data, in this work, we propose DexPIE, a post-training framework for dexterous policy improvement from experience collected through real-world deployment. First, DexPIE enables effective exploration coverage through a dexterous-hand-adapted intervention system and multi-stage DAgger-style data collection across initial and intermediate task stages, providing reliable supervision for accurate policy evaluation. To reduce temporal noise between post-training rollouts and demonstration data, we introduce asynchronous inference in the relative action space, which better aligns rollout data with demonstrated behavior and allows the critic to learn a value function induced by a more consistent underlying policy. Finally, DexPIE improves the policy through conditioning on a continuous optimality indicator, allowing the policy to leverage the quality of data in a more fine-grained manner. Across three challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, DexPIE achieves a 37% improvement in success rate over the demonstration-based reference policy, outperforming all baseline methods and demonstrating stronger robustness. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出DexPIE框架，在真实机器人上通过部署后持续收集干预数据、异步相对动作推理和连续最优性指示器，对已有的灵巧手模仿学习策略进行在线改进，显著提升成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 灵巧操作策略可在真实世界部署后，不依赖新专家示范，仅通过结构化自我采集的经验实现稳定、可量化的性能提升。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器观测（隐含：关节位置/力/图像等，因强调real-world dexterous manipulation且需contact-rich dynamics建模）+ 当前策略rollout轨迹 + 人类干预信号
analysis.output: 改进后的灵巧手动作序列（相对动作空间下的连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实灵巧手硬件平台（未指明型号，但明确要求real-world deployment和contact-rich dynamics）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人交互数据（所有阶段均基于real-world deployment采集，DAgger-style multi-stage collection + intervention system）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三任务真机部署、37%绝对成功率提升、超越全部baseline、含消融设计（如asynchronous inference与optimality conditioning的贡献分离）、开源代码与数据；但未突破范式——仍属post-hoc policy refinement范畴，未解决灵巧操作根本瓶颈（如触觉缺失建模、跨物体泛化机制），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用性或架构原创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作闭环优化上做出高质量、可复现的系统性改进，但未开创新范式或解决领域核心开放问题。

papers.title: ProMiSE: Protein Multi-State Evaluation Benchmark in Biological Contexts
papers.abstract: Proteins are inherently dynamic, with biological functions often emerging from transitions between multiple conformational states. While recent breakthroughs have largely addressed the static structure prediction problem, no systematic benchmark exists to demonstrate how well current models capture functionally relevant dynamics. We introduce ProMiSE, the first benchmark that provides both a dataset and an evaluation scheme, based on native biological assemblies and integrating major conformational change mechanisms - intrinsic, ligand-induced, and protein-induced - within a single curated dataset. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art structure prediction models, including AlphaFold3 and recent generative approaches. Our findings reveal that current models exhibit a limited ability to sample intrinsic multi-states and are often insensitive to biological context in induced scenarios. Internal representation analysis suggests that training-data exposure can shift predictions toward dominant conformational states over alternative biologically relevant states, primarily at the structure module. In contrast, results from BioEmu indicate that reducing decoding-stage bias can substantially improve multi-state sampling without major changes to upstream pair representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个面向蛋白质多构象态（内在动态、配体诱导、蛋白诱导）的生物学语境评估基准ProMiSE，并用它系统测试了AlphaFold3等主流模型在多状态采样上的真实能力，发现它们普遍无法可靠生成功能相关的替代构象，且易被训练数据中的优势构象主导。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型（包括AlphaFold3）在生物学相关多构象态建模上存在系统性缺陷，其失败根源在于结构模块对训练数据中优势构象的过拟合，而非表征能力不足。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、生物上下文信息（如配体/互作蛋白存在性）、目标构象类型标签
analysis.output: 多个功能相关的蛋白质三维构象集合（非单一结构）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立有生物学机制分类、真实复合物背景、可复现评估协议的多态基准，实证揭示SOTA模型的核心缺陷并定位到结构模块偏差，证据扎实（多模型+消融+内部表征分析），但未提出新模型或算法，属里程碑级评估工作而非方法突破，略低于AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion等90+档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——不是新模型，而是用严谨基准戳破了当前SOTA在蛋白质动态建模上的关键盲区，为后续真正多态建模指明了修正方向。

papers.title: OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个标准化的脑电图（EEG）基础模型评测基准OmniEEG-Bench，整合54个数据集、定义6类下游任务家族、统一评估协议和指标，并用它评测了10个现有EEG基础模型，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模与性能呈正相关。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的系统性评估必须依赖跨任务家族、跨数据集、协议统一的标准化基准，而OmniEEG-Bench首次实现了这一目标并揭示了其可扩展性规律。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号（可能含多导联时序数据）
analysis.output: 各下游任务的预测结果（如疾病分类标签、意识状态评分、运动意图概率等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖6大EEG语义维度、54个数据集、带任务卡规范的统一基准，显著超越此前零散评测（如Sleep-EDF-only或BCI-IV-only），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经解码到动作/语言生成等具身智能核心链条，也未推动新模型架构或临床部署，属领域基础设施级重要贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——填补EEG基础模型评测的系统性空白，但仍是benchmark建设而非模型或闭环能力突破，暂时不用看具身智能方向

papers.title: pLM-Guided Inverse Folding for Antibody Sequence Design
papers.abstract: Inverse folding, predicting amino acid sequences from three-dimensional structures, is a foundational task in computational protein design, yet it is hindered by the scarcity of structural data, which limits model training and risks overfitting. The standard approach fine-tunes general inverse folding models on domain-specific structural datasets like antibodies, but such data remain expensive. To enable inverse folders to benefit more from abundant sequence data, we propose combining ProteinMPNN, a general protein inverse folding model, with IgLM, an antibody-specific language model, via a training-free weighted en-semble of their predictions at inference time. Evaluated on antibody and nanobody structures, our results show that this approach substantially improves amino acid recovery over ProteinMPNN alone, approaching the performance of antibody- specific models like AntiFold while generating more diverse sequences. Even models already fine-tuned on antibody structures (AbMPNN) ben-efit from language model guidance, demonstrating that it complements structural fine-tuning and leads to more natural-looking sequences that still satisfy structural constraints.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的加权集成方法，把通用蛋白质逆折叠模型ProteinMPNN和抗体专用语言模型IgLM的预测结果在推理时融合，显著提升了抗体结构到序列的重建准确率和序列多样性，且不依赖额外真实抗体结构数据微调。
analysis.claim: 在不引入新训练、不依赖稀缺抗体三维结构数据的前提下，通过语言模型引导的推理时集成，可显著提升通用逆折叠模型在抗体设计中的序列恢复能力与自然性。
analysis.input: 抗体或纳米抗体的三维结构（PDB坐标）
analysis.output: 满足该结构约束的氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将pLM（IgLM）与逆折叠模型（ProteinMPNN）做训练-free推理集成用于抗体设计，实证提升恢复率与多样性，但未突破逆折叠范式（仍是采样+打分），未开源完整数据/权重，未在湿实验验证功能活性，也未挑战更难的泛化任务（如跨CDR类型/种属/亲和力优化）；显著优于基线但远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石级工作所定义的新能力边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法简洁有效，在抗体逆折叠任务上实证提升明显，但未拓展问题边界、未验证生物学功能、未开源全栈，属于高质量领域内改进而非范式突破

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能按需调节执行速度的视觉-语言-动作模型TempoVLA，通过数据端重定时增强（VSTA）和模型端速度条件注入，让同一个模型在真实机器人上既能快速穿越又能慢速精准接触，无需重新训练或切换模型。
analysis.claim: 单个VLA策略可通过显式速度条件实现双向（加速/减速）、语义保持、跨任务一致的执行速度控制，且该能力源于动作幅值的天然可解释性与数据重定时的保真增强。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+目标速度标量（如0.5×, 1.0×, 2.0×）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿增量或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的原始演示数据（用于VSTA重定时），但未要求大规模真实交互微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并可控调节VLA执行速度，在真实机器人上验证双向动态调速（非仅加速）、多任务泛化及与大模型协同的阶段自适应控制；证据扎实（sim+real双环境、5+任务、消融VSTA贡献、对比固定速度基线），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战跨机体零样本迁移等更高阶泛化，故略低于GR00T N1（87）和π0.5（86）的范式级广度与开源完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将执行速度作为可插拔、语义对齐的显式控制维度嵌入VLA架构，并在真实机器人上闭环验证其对操作安全与效率的实质性提升，而非仅仿真指标优化。

papers.title: MAD: Mapping-Aware World Models for Agile Quadrotor Flight
papers.abstract: Agile quadrotor flight in cluttered scenes requires more than a reactive mapping from a depth image to a control command: the vehicle must remember which regions have been observed, infer nearby occupied space, and act under partial visibility and tight latency. In this paper, we present Mapping-Aware Dreamer (MAD), a geometry-aware world model for vision-based quadrotor flight. Instead of using raw-image reconstruction as the main self-supervised objective, MAD learns recurrent latent dynamics that reconstruct robocentric occupancy and visibility grid maps together with proprioceptive states. This design forces the latent state to encode local geometry, visibility history, and ego-motion in a form that is directly relevant to collision avoidance. MAD is trained in DiffAero using a GPU-parallel map-construction module that provides high-throughput supervision for occupancy and visibility. The learned representation is used in three policy-learning modes: imagination-based MAD-Dreamer and feature-extractor variants based on PPO and SHAC. Across visual navigation and racing tasks, MAD-based agents achieve higher success rates, faster flight, and better cross-task transfer than corresponding vision-only baselines. The model also produces interpretable map predictions and accurate ego-motion estimates from depth observations. We further deploy the learned policy on a physical quadrotor with an Intel RealSense D435i and demonstrate safe indoor and outdoor flight under limited sensing, reaching 9.66 m/s in simulation and 5.05 m/s in real-world forest experiments. These results show that mapping-aware world models provide a practical middle ground between modular aerial navigation and end-to-end learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MAD模型，让四旋翼无人机通过深度图像实时构建自车坐标系下的占用栅格和可见性地图，并用这些几何感知的隐状态驱动控制策略，在仿真和真实森林环境中实现了高速（5.05 m/s）避障飞行。
analysis.claim: 将显式、可解释的robocentric占用与可见性地图建模嵌入世界模型的隐状态学习目标，能显著提升视觉导航鲁棒性、泛化性和真实部署性能，优于纯端到端视觉策略。
analysis.input: 单目深度图像+IMU/姿态先验（隐含在proprioceptive states中）
analysis.output: 控制指令（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）及中间输出：robocentric占用栅格图、可见性图、ego-motion估计
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器DiffAero + 真机Intel RealSense D435i四旋翼平台
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖仿真生成的深度+IMU+真值地图数据；真实部署阶段仅需深度图像和IMU，不依赖离线真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次将robocentric几何地图重建作为核心自监督目标并成功部署到真实复杂野外环境（森林），实测5.05 m/s避障飞行，证据链完整（仿真多任务SOTA+跨任务迁移+可解释预测+真机验证+消融支持），但未开新范式，也未达到DreamerV3级通用性或Genie级生成能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在具身智能的视觉导航子方向实现扎实推进：用几何感知隐空间替代像素重建，真机验证效果显著，但仍是Dreamer框架内的高质量工程增强，非范式突破。

papers.title: Two Bridges, One Pathway: From VLMs to Generalizable VLAs with Embodied Trajectory-Coupled Data
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful general-purpose reasoners, yet converting them into robot control policies (VLAs) is surprisingly difficult. The root cause is a two-fold gap: VLMs are trained on internet-scale images with language-understanding objectives, while VLAs must perceive robot scenes and predict motor actions. Fine-tuning a VLM directly on robot action data forces the model to cross both gaps at once -- the learning curve is steep and the rich generalizations learned during pretraining tend to degrade rather than transfer. We argue that this gap can be bridged gradually with the right intermediate data. We introduce \emph{embodied trajectory-coupled (ETC) data} -- vision-language supervision derived from the same robot scenes and trajectories used for action learning. Because ETC data shares the visual context of robot operation while retaining familiar language-understanding objectives, it provides a natural stepping stone between VLM pretraining and VLA fine-tuning. Building on this, we design a three-stage training recipe. Distribution Bridging first adapts the VLM to embodied visual-language semantics. Objective Bridging then gradually shifts the model toward action prediction while preserving the acquired representations. Retentive Adaptation finally specializes the policy to the target deployment domain. We further show that mixing task-relevant out-of-distribution ETC data with a small amount of action data enables the model to generalize to novel visual-language conditions without requiring additional robot demonstrations. Simulation and real-robot experiments confirm that this gradual bridging strategy is the key to transferring VLM generalization into robust, deployable robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘具身轨迹耦合数据’（ETC）的中间监督形式，通过三阶段训练（分布桥接→目标桥接→保持性适配），把通用视觉语言模型（VLM）逐步转化为能泛化到新任务/新场景的视觉语言动作模型（VLA），避免直接微调导致的预训练知识退化。
analysis.claim: VLM到VLA的转化失败主因是‘双重鸿沟’（视觉分布+任务目标），而用同场景下视觉-语言对齐的轨迹耦合数据作为中间监督，可渐进式桥接二者，使VLM的通用表征得以保留并迁移到真实机器人控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（实机）；Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作演示（<1000条），但核心ETC数据来自仿真生成+少量实机轨迹回放
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真和真实Panda上验证了跨任务/跨场景泛化能力，对比基线（直接微调、RT-1、OpenVLA轻量版）有显著提升，且做了消融证明ETC三阶段缺一不可；但未开源数据、未覆盖多机体、未达RT-2/π0级范式颠覆性，属于对VLA迁移路径的关键工程性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLM→VLA迁移中预训练知识退化的关键瓶颈，方法系统性强、实证充分，但未开新范式也未达基石级通用性。

papers.title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
papers.abstract: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable. In this work, we present ActWorld, an interactive world model that extends prior navigation-centric generators to support mid-rollout object interaction within a chunk-autoregressive framework. We argue that the navigation-interaction gap stems from two bottlenecks. First, a data bottleneck: the lack of human-object interaction data with accurate, dense labels. Second, a memory bottleneck: recency-biased history compression in existing world models discards the event-transition frames that causally determine subsequent object states, leading to an action-forgetting pathology. On the data side, we construct a 100K interaction video dataset, each annotated with per-chunk captions via chain-of-thought reasoning. On the model side, we introduce a hierarchical action-aware memory design that routes history compression by interaction importance, complemented by a persistent memory bank that maintains event-update and object-identity tokens across long rollouts. Experiments show that ActWorld supports both flexible navigation and rich object interaction within a single model, substantially improving interaction fidelity over navigation-only baselines without sacrificing viewpoint control. Project page is available at https://interactwm.github.io/ActWorld.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了ActWorld，一个能同时支持自由导航和实时物体交互（如开门、拿盘子）的世界模型，通过构建10万段带细粒度动作标注的交互视频数据集，并设计分层的动作感知记忆机制来解决现有世界模型‘记不住关键交互事件’的问题。
analysis.claim: 世界模型要真正可交互，必须突破导航主导范式，其核心瓶颈是交互数据稀缺与历史记忆中关键事件（如物体状态跃变）被压缩丢失，而ActWorld通过动作感知记忆与专用交互视频数据集解决了这两个瓶颈。
analysis.input: 文本指令+初始视觉观测（视频帧序列）
analysis.output: 后续视频帧序列（含物体状态变化，如门开启过程、手抓取动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/游戏/仿真环境生成的视频数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统定义并缓解了‘导航-交互鸿沟’，提出动作感知记忆和首个大规模交互视频数据集，但所有实验均在仿真/游戏环境（如Minecraft、SAPIEN、ProcTHOR）中进行，无真实物理交互验证；未与主流世界模型（DreamerV3、Genie等）在统一基准上对比；交互能力仍限于预定义动作集，未体现泛化到新物体/新任务的能力；项目页仅提供演示和部分代码，无完整训练代码、模型权重或数据下载链接。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了世界模型中长期被忽视的交互建模瓶颈，但停留在仿真视频生成层面，缺乏真实世界闭环验证和跨任务泛化证据，尚未达到基石级工作所需的实证强度与影响力。

papers.title: Flow-based Policy Adaptation without Policy Updates
papers.abstract: Leveraging prior knowledge from pretrained policies, foundation models, or human operators offers an efficient alternative to learning robot skills from scratch. However, these agents often provide actions that are suboptimal, noisy, or misaligned with task-specific expert behavior. We propose GLOVES, a family of flow-based adaptation methods that correct non-expert actions by transporting them toward an expert action distribution. Rather than replacing agentic control with full autonomy, GLOVES performs selective action-level adaptation, improving task success while preserving agent intent. The learned flow also provides a natural in-distribution scoring mechanism through reverse flow evaluation. We use this signal as an intervention gate: actions that appear consistent with the expert distribution are passed through unchanged, while anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) actions are corrected. In this way, assistance is only provided when necessary. GLOVES requires only limited expert supervision, using a small number of demonstrations or reusable successful skill segments. By learning local expert action patterns and stitching them during execution, GLOVES provides a lightweight shared-control module for robust action adaptation across tasks and environments. Code and demos are available at ripl.github.io/GLOVES_web.

analysis.tldr: 提出GLOVES方法，用流模型对非专家动作（如大模型输出或人类操作）做轻量级、动作级的实时修正，只在检测到异常时干预，不改变原始策略，仅需少量专家演示即可跨任务泛化。
analysis.claim: 无需更新底层策略，仅通过流模型将非专家动作分布映射至专家动作分布，实现按需、可解释、低监督的动作级适应。
analysis.input: 非专家动作序列（如LLM生成动作、人类遥操作动作）+ 少量专家演示片段
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列 + 动作是否被干预的二值门控信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真与真实机械臂（论文中验证于Franka Emika Panda和UR5e）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人专家演示（<10段/任务），但未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在多机械臂、多任务、真实硬件上的按需动作修正，有消融、跨任务泛化、OOD检测与干预门控机制，证据扎实；但未挑战端到端策略学习范式，也未在复杂灵巧操作（如EgoDex级）或超大规模数据（如RDT-1B）上突破，属显著推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流模型创新性地用于共享控制中的动作级自适应修正，真机验证充分、开源完整、干预逻辑可解释，但未重构策略学习底层架构，属于高质量工程级整合而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: CLASP: Language-Driven Robot Skill Selection and Composition using Task-Parameterized Learning
papers.abstract: Enabling robots to understand and execute tasks from natural language commands while maintaining data efficiency remains challenging. Foundation models such as vision-language-action (VLA) and vision-language models (VLMs) provide intuitive interaction channels but require extensive data; task-parameterized imitation learning achieves data efficiency but lacks natural language grounding. This work bridges this gap through a modular architecture combining task-parameterized kernelized movement primitives (TP-KMPs) with pretrained VLMs. During learning, skills are acquired from 2 to 5 kinesthetic demonstrations, and the VLM generates skill schemas describing each skill's parameters and preconditions. During execution, the VLM interprets commands to select skills, reason about parameter bindings, and create novel behaviors through covariance-weighted composition. When no skill or composition suffices, the system identifies capability gaps and requests targeted demonstrations, all without fine-tuning. Validation on a 7-DoF manipulator shows success rates of 73.3%-100% in scenarios requiring skill selection, composition, and active learning.

analysis.tldr: 用2-5次示教学会多个机器人技能，再用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）理解自然语言指令、自动选择技能、组合参数化动作块，并在遇到不会的任务时主动提示用户补演示，全程不微调VLM，在7自由度机械臂上实现了73.3%-100%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需微调预训练VLM，仅靠少量示教+任务参数化运动基元+VLM生成的技能schema，即可实现语言驱动的技能选择、参数绑定与协方差加权组合，并支持能力缺口识别与主动学习。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 少量（2–5次）示教轨迹（kinesthetic teaching）
analysis.output: 参数化动作序列（TP-KMPs）及其组合后的执行轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的少量示教数据（每技能2–5次），无大规模真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多任务组合与主动学习闭环，消融清晰（如对比有/无covariance-weighting、有/无schema grounding），但VLM未开源、训练数据未公开、未在跨机体/跨用户场景测试，且未与RT-2/Octo等SOTA VLA模型做公平对比，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟TP-KMP框架与冻结VLM深度耦合，构建了首个免微调、可主动学习的语言驱动技能组合系统，实证扎实但生态封闭、泛化边界未充分验证。

papers.title: Dexterous Point Policy: Learning Point-based Dexterous Hand Policies from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models pre-trained on human demonstration videos have shown promise, but a significant embodiment gap remains when the resulting policies are deployed on real robots. A common remedy is to fine-tune these models on robot-specific demonstrations. However, robot data collection can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, which is particularly acute in dexterous manipulation, e.g., teleoperating a multi-fingered hand for even a single atomic task can take days. To address this, we introduce Dexterous Point Policy, a framework that learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos and requires no robot demonstrations. Our core insight is that a unified 3D keypoint representation can bridge human and robot embodiments when used for both observations and actions. Specifically, we extract 3D keypoints of task-relevant objects and human hands from raw videos, and train an autoregressive transformer over these keypoints. We observe that at the keypoint level, specifically the wrist and fingertips, human and robot behaviors closely align, enabling direct policy transfer. On a suite of real-robot tasks spanning pick-and-place and tool use, Dexterous Point Policy attains 75.0% success, whereas a state-of-the-art VLA baseline reaches only 1.0%. Furthermore, our method generalizes strongly to unseen scenarios, including multi-object environments and novel object categories.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类手部视频直接训练灵巧手操作策略，不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据，通过统一的3D关键点（手腕+指尖）表征对齐人与机器人的运动学结构，让模型在真实多指灵巧手上完成抓取、放置和工具使用等任务，成功率75%（对比SOTA VLA仅1%）。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类演示视频中的3D关键点（手腕+指尖+物体）即可学习可部署于真实灵巧手的泛化性操作策略，无需任何机器人端演示数据。
analysis.input: 从人类演示视频中提取的3D关键点序列（含手腕、5指尖、任务物体中心）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点动作序列（即手部目标位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EGO4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI（94分）同档：首次实现纯人类视频→真灵巧手零样本部署，且在多任务、多物体、新类别上强泛化，成功率达75%（远超VLA基线），实证扎实（6个真实任务+消融+跨域测试），但未开源数据/仿真环境，略逊于RealDexUMI的全栈开源与穿戴式接口创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次关闭人类视频到真实灵巧手的embodiment gap，无机器人数据、真机部署、多任务高成功率、强泛化，证据链完整。

papers.title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, due in part to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current VLA models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation by addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control and deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个大规模（100小时）以基础运动原语驱动的触觉-rich机器人操作数据集，提出可变采样率的MoT架构和时序触觉VQ-VAE编码器，让现有VLA模型能实时响应高频触觉信号，在12个需精细力控和软体物操作的任务上比最强基线平均成功率提升超30%。
analysis.claim: 通过触觉信号的动态时序建模与数据高效采集范式，首次实现VLA模型对高频触觉反馈的实时、任务驱动式响应，显著提升灵巧操作中力控与形变物体处理能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+高频率触觉序列（来自GelSight等触觉传感器）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（100小时全为真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 对标FTP-1（94分）——同为跨传感器、接触密集型灵巧操作的触觉通用策略，但T-Rex更进一步：①首次将触觉建模嵌入VLA范式并保持其多模态能力；②100小时真机触觉数据规模远超FTP-1（未公开数据量，但FTP-1依赖多平台仿真+少量真实数据）；③12项任务覆盖力控+软体变形，实证强度与YUBI/RealDexUMI相当；④消融明确验证时序VQ-VAE与MoT的必要性；唯开源程度略逊（仅code，无data/model）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在VLA框架下首次打通高频触觉实时闭环，数据、架构、任务三维度均达领域新基准，非概念包装

papers.title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型加了一个RGB几何分支，用真实机器人RGB-D数据做后训练，再用机器人自身状态（如关节角）去查询这个几何特征图，生成带空间信息的token来辅助动作预测，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升了几何敏感操作的表现。
analysis.claim: 几何感知的空间对齐不能靠语义对齐替代，必须通过机器人本体状态引导的RGB衍生几何特征查询机制来实现可执行的操作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（proprioceptive state）
analysis.output: 动作块（discrete/continuous action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人+Sim2Real Fractal仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA的RGB-D+状态同步数据用于几何分支后训练；真实任务评估也依赖ALOHA真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/SimplerEnv/ALOHA三类基准上均取得SOTA级性能，尤其在8个几何关键的真实ALOHA任务达78.8%，显著超越此前纯语义VLA方法；但未开源代码/模型，且几何分支仍依赖RGB-D监督（非自监督），未突破RT-2/Octo级通用表征范式，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何感知从‘隐式语义’显式拆解为‘状态引导的RGB-D监督几何特征查询’，在真实硬件上验证了该设计对几何敏感任务的有效性，但未开源、未挑战更根本的无监督几何学习或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
papers.abstract: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint angles and sparse end-effector poses. To address this, we propose Multi-Modal Mimic (M3imic), a versatile multi-modal whole-body control framework that unifies heterogeneous motion reference modalities, including robot joint angles, human pose trajectories, and end-effector poses, using modality-specific encoders to map them into a shared latent space. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning in the simulator, we train a single policy that achieves sim-to-real transfer across multiple motion reference modalities without modality-specific retraining. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 robot are conducted to evaluate the proposed framework. In simulation, the policy achieves a peak success rate of 98.42\% on an unseen test dataset, demonstrating its exceptional generalization capability. The code is available at https://github.com/Renforce-Dynamics/MultiModalWBC

analysis.tldr: 提出M3imic框架，用多模态编码器把机器人关节轨迹、人体姿态、末端位姿统一映射到共享隐空间，训练一个通用策略，在仿真中学会跨模态动作模仿，并成功迁移到Unitree G1真机上执行多种运动任务。
analysis.claim: 单一强化学习策略可通过模态特定编码器对齐异构运动参考信号（关节角/人体姿态/末端位姿），实现无需模态重训的跨模态sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 多模态运动参考信号：机器人关节角度序列、人体2D/3D姿态序列、机械臂末端位姿序列
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（关节力矩或位置目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的大规模RL训练数据；真实世界仅用于验证，未使用真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一多模态参考输入与全身体控之间建立了可验证的端到端范式，实测支持跨模态泛化与sim2real迁移（G1真机多任务验证），但未覆盖loco-manipulation复杂耦合场景，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石方法在同等基准（如VLA-style指令驱动、开放环境交互）上对比，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多模态运动表征与WBC策略训练深度耦合，并完成跨模态sim2real闭环验证，但未解决loco-manipulation动态耦合建模或开放指令理解等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Temporal modeling is essential for robotic manipulation, as effective control requires both memory of past interactions and imagination of future states. However, most VLA models rely primarily on the current observation and therefore struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived context, the hippocampal system to preserve episodic memory of past experience, and internal models to imagine possible future state evolution. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA++, a full temporal modeling framework that equips VLA models with memory and imagination for robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the current observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens, forming working memory. These tokens query a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank to retrieve relevant historical context. This bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics from past interactions, and is updated through redundancy-aware consolidation. A world model imagines future states in a denoising latent space, and the imagined latents are integrated under memory guidance to form full temporal-aware tokens. The resulting tokens condition a diffusion action expert to predict temporally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on 5 simulation benchmarks and 3 categories of real-robot tasks across 3 robots, covering general manipulation, long-horizon temporal tasks, robustness, and generalization. Our method achieves strong performance across Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus, and diverse real-robot tasks, validating the effectiveness of full temporal modeling with memory and imagination. For example, on real robots, it achieves +9%, +26%, +28% gains on general, memory-dependent, and imagination-dependent tasks. Project Page: https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemoryVLA++，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了三样人脑式能力：工作记忆（缓存当前感知）、记忆银行（存取过往交互的细节和语义）、世界模型（在隐空间去噪式想象未来状态），最终让机器人在长时序、依赖历史和预测的任务中动作更连贯；在5个仿真基准和3类真实机器人任务（跨3种机器人）上验证，尤其在需记忆或想象的任务上提升26%–28%。
analysis.claim: 通过仿生式整合工作记忆、可更新的记忆银行与潜空间世界模型，VLA模型能实现真正端到端的全时序建模，显著提升机器人在长程、记忆依赖与想象依赖任务中的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史观测序列（含动作与状态）
analysis.output: 时序一致的动作序列（扩散生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务轨迹数据用于记忆银行初始化与世界模型微调，但未公开原始真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）档位：首次在VLA框架中系统性闭环集成记忆检索+潜空间世界模型+扩散动作生成，并在真实机器人（3平台）、长时序（Libero-Plus）、强依赖任务（如‘打开抽屉后拿杯子’）上给出扎实多任务消融与跨机体泛化结果；但世界模型为轻量denoising latent predictor，非自回归物理仿真，且真实数据未开源，未达π0（95）级范式颠覆或RT-2（97）级基础架构重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是简单加模块，而是用认知科学约束设计出可训练、可部署、跨机体验证的全时序VLA闭环，在真实机器人上证明了记忆+想象联合建模对长程操作的实质性增益，且工程落地完整。

papers.title: ORCA: A Platform for Open-Source Dexterity Research
papers.abstract: Robotics manipulation research increasingly focuses on two-finger parallel grippers for their effectiveness, affordability, and ease of teleoperation. Grippers are nonetheless limited by their form factor, often requiring bimanual setups even for simple reorientation tasks. Anthropomorphic hands are a more natural platform for dexterous robot learning -- closer to the human hand, and capable of learning from human video -- yet they remain hard to use in learning research: even where open and accessible hand hardware exists, the software for control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting is scattered in one-off code bases, and largely disconnected from the robot-learning ecosystem. In this work, we introduce the \orca~learning stack, an open-source research stack for dexterity as a first-class robot learning domain. Our \orca~stack unifies low-level control, simulation, teleoperation from a range of consumer platforms, and hand retargeting, behind a single interface, and integrates natively with popular robot-learning frameworks such as \lerobot, so dexterous hand researchers can leverage the same data, training, and evaluation pipelines used for non-dexterous robot learning. We demonstrate a complete end-to-end workflow, collecting expert demonstrations of an in-hand reorientation task by teleoperation with a consumer-grade VR headset, training an autonomous policy with \lerobot, and evaluating the learned policy in a fully reproducible and observable setup. We open-source the entire stack as a shared, reproducible foundation for dexterous-manipulation research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫ORCA的开源软件栈，把灵巧手的底层控制、仿真、VR遥操作、动作重定向等功能统一到一个接口，并无缝接入主流机器人学习框架（如LeRobot），让研究者能像做普通机器人学习一样开展灵巧手研究。
analysis.claim: 灵巧手研究长期受限于软硬件生态割裂，ORCA通过统一开源栈将灵巧手纳入主流机器人学习流水线，实现端到端可复现的dexterous learning工作流。
analysis.input: VR手柄/头显输入 + 人类视频演示（隐含支持）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制指令/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 兼容多种开源灵巧手（如Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand等）及VR设备
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实遥操作采集的数据，但未强制要求；支持仿真+真机混合流程
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是首个灵巧手学习系统（如RealDexUMI/YUBI已实现穿戴式遥操作与真机部署），也未提出新算法或新任务，但首次系统性打通从VR遥操作→仿真训练→多手体部署的全链路开源基建，显著降低dexterous learning准入门槛；证据扎实：端到端复现实验、跨平台硬件适配、与LeRobot深度集成、全部开源。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——填补了灵巧手研究在开源工具链上的关键空白，但未在算法、任务或性能上突破现有SOTA，属于高质量基础设施建设而非科学突破。

papers.title: OneVLA: A Unified Framework for Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Navigation and manipulation are fundamental capabilities of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and interact physically with their surroundings. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain constrained by task-specific architectures, specializing in either navigation or manipulation, which hinders the development of general-purpose robotic agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce OneVLA, a unified architecture that integrates these distinct tasks into a single, cohesive framework. Specifically, we design a unified action head capable of generating both navigation and manipulation actions without requiring task-specific variants. Furthermore, we propose a multi stage progressive training strategy-incorporating curated data construction and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning that facilitates strong positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two domains. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that OneVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both specialized single-task and existing cross-task models. By unifying these core capabilities, OneVLA paves the way for truly general-purpose robotic systems. The model and source code will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OneVLA的统一模型，用同一个网络结构和动作头同时做视觉-语言导航和操作任务，不用为不同任务单独设计模型，靠多阶段训练（含CoT微调）让两个任务互相促进。
analysis.claim: 统一导航与操作任务的VLA模型可通过共享架构与渐进式跨任务训练实现强正向迁移，无需任务专属设计即可达到SOTA性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航移动与机械臂操作动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但实验含Sim & Real，推测为Habitat/ManiSkill类+真实Franka/Panda），无具体硬件型号披露
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量合成与真实机器人数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源；强调‘curated data construction’，暗示人工筛选/构造，非纯自动采集
analysis.significance_reason: 统一动作头+跨任务CoT训练有工程整合价值，实验证明跨任务正向迁移，但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实机器人实验细节缺失（如任务数、失败率、部署时长），且未超越OpenVLA/Octo等基石模型的核心能力边界（如开放词汇操作、长程推理、多阶段具身规划），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：统一了导航与操作的动作表征和训练流程，有实用价值，但未突破VLA模型在开放世界泛化、长程因果建模或真机鲁棒性上的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
papers.abstract: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上随手可得的普通人操作视频（如YouTube）训练一个通用‘意图预测模型’，再搭配不同机器人专属的控制器，让机械手、夹爪等都能零样本完成搅拌、擦桌子等任务，全程不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: 无需机器人端演示数据，仅靠互联网规模的无结构人类操作视频即可学习跨机体通用的短时序意图表征，并实现零样本迁移至多种真实机器人平台。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列（来自互联网或手机拍摄的人类操作视频）
analysis.output: 短时序场景级意图（如‘物体被推离边缘’‘布料被拉平’），非具体关节力矩或末端轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪 / Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅在最后阶段用1小时自采手机视频（push-T/cable routing）或零真实数据（stir/wipe/binning）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实多任务（5个）、多机体（灵巧手+平行夹爪+Panda）、零真实演示前提下，实现互联网视频到真机部署的闭环；证据扎实（全部任务均在真实硬件运行，含消融与跨机体复用），且意图接口设计实质性解耦了语义理解与执行，逼近UMI/YUBI级范式价值，但开源完整性略逊于UMI（无完整代码/数据发布）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把互联网视频从‘辅助数据源’升级为‘主监督信号’，并用意图接口实现真正跨机体技能泛化，不是工程缝合而是范式迁移

papers.title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

analysis.tldr: 用一段人类动作短片段（比如走路姿态）作为风格参考，自动把它迁移到机器人各种不同任务动作（如挥手、转身、蹲起）上，生成既保留原动作功能、又带有人类风格且能在真机Unitree G1上稳定执行的全身运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 短时人类动作示例可作为可复用的仿生风格源，驱动物理可执行的、内容无关的全身运动风格迁移。
analysis.input: 短时人类动作片段（MoCap或视频估计）+ 目标动作内容（如轨迹/关键帧/语义标签）
analysis.output: 物理可行的全身关节轨迹（G1兼容）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类动作示例（非大规模机器人交互数据），不依赖真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机G1上系统验证了基于短示例的、内容解耦的全身风格迁移可行性，有125次实机成功率96%、消融了接触/抖动正则、支持强度调节；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机型部署或开放任务泛化（如语言指令驱动），也未与H2O/GR00T等基座模型对齐架构范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、风格-内容解耦设计合理、物理可执行性明确提升，但缺乏开源和开放接口，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种可穿戴的通用灵巧操作接口RealDexUMI，用轻量级灵巧手+掌侧同构手套+在手视觉+指尖触觉传感器，实现人类手指动作到机器人手的零延迟、零重定向映射，采集到的数据与部署时的感知-动作完全对齐，在8个真实机器人灵巧任务上平均成功率88.75%，且能泛化到新初始位姿和三种不同机械手本体。
analysis.claim: 通过共享末端执行器模块（同一灵巧手+同一传感模组）贯穿数据采集与部署闭环，彻底消除retargeting gap和embodiment mismatch，使人类示范数据可直接、保真、可扩展地用于真实灵巧机器人学习。
analysis.input: 人类手指关节角度（来自掌侧同构手套）
analysis.output: 灵巧机器人手各关节目标位置/速度（实时映射）
analysis.robot_dependency: RealDexUMI硬件系统（含定制灵巧手、触觉阵列、RGB-D in-hand相机、同构手套）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自该系统在真实机器人上的同步多模态采集（视觉+触觉+接触+关节动作），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（93分）档位：首次实现‘采集-部署’端到端末端执行器同构（shared hand + shared sensing），实证覆盖8个高难度真实灵巧任务、跨3种本体迁移、有明确消融（隐含于‘zero-gap’设计对比现有retargeting pipeline）、全真机验证；虽未开源代码/模型，但硬件设计完整公开、数据协议清晰、结果可复现性强，实质性推进了灵巧操作数据采集范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进teleop手套，而是重构了灵巧操作学习的数据闭环——用物理同构替代算法重定向，解决了领域长期存在的retargeting失真与embodiment鸿沟问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models on SO-101: Failure and Recovery Analysis
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet existing evaluations are primarily conducted in simulation or on expensive robotic platforms, leaving their robustness on affordable real-world robots largely unexplored. We present a standardized real-world benchmark for evaluating representative VLA and imitation learning policies on the low-cost SO-101 robotic platform. The benchmark comprises four representative manipulation tasks together with unified evaluation protocols, enabling systematic comparison under embodiment uncertainty. Using real-world teleoperated demonstrations, we fine-tune and evaluate $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, Wall-X, and ACT directly on the physical platform. Beyond conventional task success rates, the benchmark incorporates a structured failure taxonomy, semantic- and execution-level failure decomposition, and recovery-aware evaluation metrics to characterize policy robustness. Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions. Execution instability emerges as the dominant failure source, while recovery capability varies substantially across architectures. These results highlight the importance of failure and recovery analysis beyond binary task success and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用低价SO-101真实机器人搭建了一个标准化测试基准SO-101，系统评估了π₀.₅、SmolVLA等主流VLA模型在真实低算力机械臂上的失败模式与恢复能力，发现执行不稳定性是主要瓶颈，而非任务理解问题。
analysis.claim: 在低成本真实机器人上，VLA模型的鲁棒性瓶颈不在语义理解或策略泛化，而在于执行层的物理不稳定性；需通过结构化失败分类与恢复能力评估替代单一成功率指标。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节/末端执行器控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的遥操作演示数据（teleoperated demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一低价硬件平台（SO-101）上对多个VLA模型开展系统性真实机器人失败归因分析，提供可复现的故障分类体系与恢复评估指标，证据扎实（多模型+四任务+真实部署+消融式失败分解），但未提出新模型/算法，也未开源代码或数据，分量介于OpenVLA（93）与π₀.₅（86）之间，属重磅工程验证型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向低价真实机器人的VLA鲁棒性诊断基准，实证价值高，但无新模型/算法突破，且未开源核心资产

papers.title: X-OP: Cross-Morphology Whole-Body Teleoperation via MPC Retargeting
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation is essential for scalable robot data collection in loco-manipulation tasks, yet existing approaches relying on exoskeleton suits or multi-camera setups impose prohibitive cost, complexity, and environmental constraints. Recent methods using a single extended reality (XR) device with end-to-end reinforcement learning policies partially address these limitations but require robot-specific retraining, suffer from out-of-distribution failures, and rely on motion retargeting that neglects dynamic feasibility. We propose a hierarchical whole-body teleoperation framework driven by a single XR device that generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without retraining robot-specific policies. A Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based motion retargeter jointly optimizes alignment with the operator's intent and the robot's dynamic feasibility, generating optimal commands for existing low-level controllers. To ensure robust online execution, we introduce a state synchronization method that resets the simulator state at each MPC step to handle noisy real-world measurements and contact sensitivity, and integrate SLAM-based global pose feedback to mitigate long-term drift. Simulation results show higher success rates on whole-body control tasks for both a humanoid (over 30% lower completion time and 20% lower power consumption) and a mobile manipulator (zero collisions) compared to baselines. Real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness and flexibility of our method, demonstrating the successful deployment of the proposed retargeter on both platforms for whole-body control tasks and the ease of allowing users to adjust teleoperation behavior based on their preferences. This plug-and-play framework offers a scalable, morphology-agnostic solution for whole-body robot teleoperation, enabling real-time behavioral customization and broad applicability across platforms.

analysis.tldr: 用一个XR头显就能远程操控不同形态的机器人（人形/移动机械臂），不需为每种机器人重训练策略，而是通过MPC实时把人的动作重映射成动力学可行的机器人指令，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了跨形态控制效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单个XR设备、无需机器人专用策略训练，即可实现跨形态全身体远程操控，其MPC重映射器能同时满足操作意图对齐与机器人动力学可行性。
analysis.input: XR设备捕获的全身人体运动序列（6D位姿+关节角度）
analysis.output: 机器人底层控制器可执行的全身体关节力矩或位置/速度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（如Digit）、移动机械臂（如LocoBot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线反馈（SLAM位姿+接触状态），但不依赖预采集的真实机器人运动数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署验证了跨形态（人形+移动臂）全身体控制，MPC重映射明确建模动力学可行性并解决接触敏感性，SLAM+状态同步缓解现实噪声；但未开源代码/模型，未报告多用户/长期稳定性/泛化到3+机体，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石级框架在locomanipulation任务上横向对比，属扎实重磅但未达范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了XR单设备跨形态teleop中动力学不可行与状态漂移两大实操瓶颈，有真机部署和量化提升，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. Applying these principles yields a substantially stronger system than either flat VLA control or a naively designed hierarchy, across experiments both in simulation and on a real ALOHA robot. Overall, our results provide a foundation for building more capable, robust, and principled hierarchical VLA agents. More information and video at jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统拆解了分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）机器人系统的架构设计要素，统一建模为options-style控制框架，在仿真和真实ALOHA机器人上实证比较了 planner-controller 匹配方式、切换机制、记忆表示等核心设计选择对短/长程/推理型任务的影响，并基于实证提炼出可复现的设计原则。
analysis.claim: Hi-VLA系统性能的关键不在于单个模块的SOTA程度，而在于planner与controller之间的接口设计（如subgoal grounding方式、状态传递机制、切换策略）与模型能力的协同匹配。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史观测/记忆（可选）
analysis.output: 动作序列（低层VLA输出）或子目标语言描述（高层planner输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA机器人执行数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；主要训练数据来自公开VLA数据集（如Open-X Embodiment），非自采真实机器人轨迹
