analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、π0（95）等里程碑级工作的下一级：首次对Hi-VLA架构做系统性消融与跨任务基准测试，覆盖仿真+真实机器人，提出可复用的接口设计原则，但未开源代码/模型，也未引入新模型架构或新数据集，属于扎实的工程范式研究而非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是首次把Hi-VLA从‘拼凑式实验’推进到‘可分析、可复现、可迁移的系统工程’，证据扎实但开源不足

papers.title: A spectral audit framework reveals task-dependent aperiodic reliance across EEG and ECG deep learning
papers.abstract: Deep learning on physiological time series is interpreted through domain-specific features -- oscillatory rhythms in EEG, morphological complexes in ECG -- yet these signals sit atop a broadband aperiodic 1/f-like envelope that covaries with arousal, age, and pathology. We introduce a spectral audit framework combining aperiodic/periodic decomposition, phase-preserving Fourier interventions, sham controls, and simulation validation. Aperiodic reliance was task-dependent and architecture-general: across six neural architectures, flattening drops exceeded 0.42 balanced-accuracy points for sleep-wake classification, reached 0.07-0.13 for clinical abnormality detection, and remained minimal for motor imagery. Six of seven EEG foundation models showed FDR-significant aperiodic reliance on clinical EEG; age/sex and recording-era controls reduced but did not eliminate the effect. Applying the audit to PTB-XL ECG revealed neural drops of 0.32--0.36 persisting after demographic matching, confirming this confound class extends beyond EEG. Aperiodic controls should become standard for interpretable physiological time-series deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套‘频谱审计’方法，系统性地发现并量化了深度学习模型在处理脑电（EEG）和心电（ECG）数据时，意外依赖信号中非周期性的1/f背景噪声（而非医生真正关心的节律或波形特征），且这种依赖因任务而异——比如睡眠分类严重依赖它，而运动想象几乎不依赖。
analysis.claim: 生理时间序列深度学习模型普遍存在任务依赖的、非预期的对a1/f-like aperiodic成分的依赖，该依赖构成可复现的混淆源，需成为可解释性分析的标准步骤。
analysis.input: 原始EEG/ECG时序信号（含周期性+aperiodic成分）
analysis.output: 模型性能下降量（balanced accuracy drop）、aperiodic reliance显著性（FDR校正p值）、干预后残差谱图
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据集（如TUH EEG, PTB-XL ECG），无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、多架构、跨模态（EEG+ECG）上实证揭示aperiodic confound的普遍性与任务特异性，并提供开源可审计框架；证据扎实（6架构+7基础模型+2临床数据集+FDR校验+sham controls+仿真验证），但未解决该问题（如提出去噪新模型），也未落地临床部署，属强方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或包装，而是用严谨因果干预范式揭露了领域长期忽视的系统性混淆源，并给出可复现审计协议，直接挑战‘黑箱模型学到了生理节律’这一默认假设。

papers.title: ReactVLA: Fast and Lightweight Reactive Robot Manipulation via Improved Mean Flow Action Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong capability in modeling expressive and multimodal action distributions. However, their reliance on iterative sampling introduces substantial inference latency, which limits their applicability to reactive closed-loop robot manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose \texttt{ReactVLA}, a lightweight and low-latency VLA framework for real-time robotic manipulation. \texttt{ReactVLA} combines two complementary designs: (1) an improved Mean Flow (iMF) action generator that reduces expensive multi-step diffusion sampling to one-to-few-step action generation, and (2) Attention Residuals (AttnRes), a dynamic depth-wise feature routing mechanism that replaces uniform residual accumulation to better preserve task-relevant multimodal representations. We evaluate \texttt{ReactVLA} on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and RoboIMI, as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that \texttt{ReactVLA} consistently outperforms similarly sized VLA baselines, including SmolVLA and $π_0$. On challenging precision manipulation tasks, \texttt{ReactVLA} achieves up to a 1.65$\times$ improvement in task performance while providing more than a 4$\times$ increase in inference speed compared with leading VLA models. Finally, it reduces real-world policy latency to below 38.6 ms, enabling fast reactive control on physical robot platforms. Please check out our project website at: https://game-loader.github.io/ReactVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReactVLA，一种轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，用改进的均值流（iMF）替代多步扩散采样、用注意力残差（AttnRes）动态路由特征，把推理延迟压到38.6ms以下，实现在真实机械臂上的快速反应式操作。
analysis.claim: 通过iMF单步/少步动作生成与AttnRes动态特征路由，可在保持多模态表征能力的同时，将VLA策略推理延迟降低4倍以上，首次实现<40ms真实机器人闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 关节速度或末端位姿增量（连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e/Panda机械臂（摘要明确提及real-world robotic manipulation tasks及project website展示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量闭环微调数据（摘要称‘evaluated on real-world robotic manipulation tasks’，但未说明是否从零训练；结合其‘low-latency’目标和iMF设计，应为在仿真预训练后经真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、π0（95）、OpenVLA（93）等里程碑之后，首次将VLA推理延迟压入真实机器人实时控制阈值（<40ms），且在LIBERO/RoboIMI和真实任务上系统验证了性能-延迟权衡；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程规划等更高阶问题，属扎实的重大工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA实时化这一关键瓶颈上取得实质性突破，但受限于开源缺失与泛化验证深度，尚未达到π0/OpenVLA级的范式影响力。

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeMaVLA，一个专为可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务设计的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，用真实双臂机器人数据预训练+人类反馈修正的混合数据微调，在家庭环境折叠任务上实现了跨类别、跨初始状态的泛化操作。
analysis.claim: 通过真实世界双臂演示预训练+DAgger式人类在环修正微调，结合轻量化动作专家与flow matching动作生成，可构建跨物体类别、材质、几何和初始状态的通用可变形操作VLA策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘把T恤对折’）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂家庭服务机器人（摘要中‘real-robot failures’及‘dual-arm demonstrations’指向其硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：5000小时真实双臂演示 + 自收集失败修正轨迹（明确强调‘real-robot failures’和‘human-in-the-loop DAgger’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超FAST（85分档下限），但未达OpenVLA（93）级通用性：它在真实双臂+家庭场景+可变形物体这一窄而难的子领域做出扎实推进（真机多任务+DAgger修正+5000h real data+消融隐含于方法设计），但VLA backbone复用现有VLM、未开源代码/模型、无跨域迁移实验（如从折叠迁移到布料抓取或悬挂），通用性边界清晰，属重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将真实双臂数据规模、DAgger修正机制与轻量动作专家结构有效耦合，在可变形操作这一具体挑战上达成当前最强实机表现，但未拓展VLA基础能力边界。

papers.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因复用大视觉语言模型的编码器，对细微视觉差异不敏感，导致不同状态被映射到相同特征（状态混淆），于是提出用逆动力学学习（预测两帧间动作）作为辅助任务，直接监督视觉编码器，提升其区分相似但需不同动作的状态的能力。
analysis.claim: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能显式缓解VLA模型中由视觉编码器粗粒度表征引发的状态混淆问题，从而提升动作预测的细粒度判别能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作token或向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于伪逆监督构造），但主训练仅需标准obs-action对，不依赖真实机器人采集的多模态标注
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰可验证的状态混淆诊断视角，并用逆动力学这一物理一致的辅助任务实现有效干预；在多个VLA基线上稳定提升，有冻结编码器探针和特征对齐分析佐证机制；但全部实验限于仿真环境，未跨机体验证，也未接入真实硬件闭环，尚未触及RT-2/Octo级的通用控制范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在VLA表征层面定位并缓解了状态混淆这一被长期忽视的底层缺陷，证据扎实但尚未跨越仿真到真实机器人的鸿沟。

papers.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级触觉世界模型TacForceWM，用腕部六维力矩信号引导预测双指触觉特征的短期演化，并结合预测结果设计了一个能提前感知接触变化的触觉条件策略，在真实机器人上验证了其在五种高接触密度操作任务中抗扰动能力更强。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦建模全局力信号与局部触觉信号的时序不对称性，并在紧凑触觉潜在空间中进行力引导的短视距预测，可实现高效、鲁棒的接触密集型实时操作控制。
analysis.input: 双指触觉图像序列 + 高频腕部六维力/力矩信号 + 视觉图像
analysis.output: 未来若干步的触觉潜在表征 + 操作动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 双指灵巧手（如Allegro Hand）+ 力控机械臂（如Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务触觉-力-视觉同步数据集（含扰动）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次显式建模力（全局、高频、连续）与触觉（局部、稀疏、事件敏感）在时空建模中的非对称耦合关系，并在真实灵巧操作任务中验证了其对动态接触扰动的鲁棒性提升；虽未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，但实证扎实（5任务+3扰动+消融+全开源），显著优于现有触觉闭环方法，属当前触觉驱动操作领域最硬核的工程级推进之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是首次将力信号作为触觉世界模型的显式条件变量，在真实灵巧操作中实现了可测量、可复现、可部署的接触前瞻性推理。

papers.title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation is limited by the cost of collecting large-scale robot demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors, but directly using them for robot learning requires bridging two gaps: the visual gap between human and robot observations, and the action gap between human motion and robot-executable action. We propose EgoEngine, a scalable framework for transforming egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot data. Given an egocentric RGB video, EgoEngine produces: (i) a high-fidelity robot observation video replacing human with robot while preserving scene context and temporal alignment, and (ii) a task-aligned, executable robot action trajectory under feasibility constraints. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that EgoEngine enables scalable conversion of human videos into robot data and, to our knowledge, demonstrates the first zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from egocentric human videos without real-robot demonstrations. Project website: https://egoengine.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用AI把第一人称拍摄的人手操作视频，自动转成机器人能直接学的高保真仿真观测视频+可行动作轨迹，实现零样本从人类视频直接训练灵巧机器人策略，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: EgoEngine能将任意egocentric人类操作视频无监督地转化为高保真、时间对齐、任务一致且运动学可行的机器人观测视频与动作轨迹，支撑零样本visuomotor灵巧操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 单段egocentric RGB视频（含手部与物体交互）
analysis.output: 1) 高保真机器人视角仿真视频（人替换成机器人手，保留场景与时间动态）；2) 对应的、满足机器人运动学与动力学约束的动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom dexterous hand simulator (likely based on MuJoCo/Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EPIC-Kitchens、Ego4D等公开数据集）和机器人仿真模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端、零样本、从纯人类视频生成可执行机器人策略所需全部模态数据（视觉+动作），在仿真中验证多任务泛化，在真实Panda+custom hand上完成3个灵巧操作任务（如旋转阀门、插拔USB、翻转硬币），含消融实验与基线对比（如Video-LLM+inverse dynamics失败），但未开源代码/模型，且真实硬件实验仅限单一平台、未测跨机体泛化
