papers.title: EgoInfinity: A Web-Scale 4D Hand-Object Interaction Data Engine for Any-View Robot Retargeting and Video-to-Action Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Internet videos constitute the largest reservoir of embodied human manipulation knowledge, yet converting arbitrary RGB footage into actionable robot training data remains a major bottleneck. Existing lab- or factory-collected datasets are narrow in scale and diversity, limiting open-world robot learning. Instead of proposing a static dataset, we introduce EgoInfinity, a universal 4D hand-object interaction data engine that enables web-scale data generation for robot retargeting and learning. EgoInfinity is a modular engine integrating perception, segmentation, reconstruction, interaction-aware refinement, and retargeting to automate this traditionally unscalable video-to-action problem without human-in-the-loop annotation. Its modular design lets the engine continuously benefit from advances in any incorporated component. With EgoInfinity, in-the-wild human manipulation videos are lifted into agent-agnostic, metric 4D hand-object representations, including hand trajectories, 6-DoF object poses, and contact-relevant states. Rather than naively connecting standalone components, EgoInfinity combines cross-module metric calibration with interaction-aware refinement to improve physical reliability, reducing drift and contact inconsistencies common in pure visual reconstruction. We further propose a novel motion retargeter that compiles the recovered 3D hand motions into executable joint trajectories for diverse robot morphologies, enabling video-to-action retargeting on any robot from arbitrary viewpoints and shot sizes (e.g., the human body is only partially visible). We validate EgoInfinity across perception fidelity, kinematic feasibility, contact consistency, cross-embodiment generalization, and real-robot skill acquisition (e.g., grasping, cutting, wiping, and pouring), demonstrating a scalable bridge from internet videos to executable robot behavior for open-world robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用一个全自动的模块化引擎，把网上任意角度拍摄的人类操作视频（比如YouTube上的做饭、清洁视频）直接转成带物理合理性的4D手-物交互数据（手轨迹+物体6D位姿+接触状态），再适配到各种机器人身体上生成可执行动作，全程无需人工标注。
analysis.claim: 通过端到端可演化的模块化数据引擎EgoInfinity，首次实现从任意互联网视频到多形态机器人可执行动作的全自动、物理可靠的视频到动作（video-to-action）闭环，且不依赖人工标注或特定采集设置。
analysis.input: 任意视角/分辨率/遮挡程度的单目RGB视频（含人类手部操作）
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的关节轨迹（适配多种机械手形态）+ 4D手-物交互表示（手部3D轨迹、物体6D位姿、接触状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；仅依赖互联网视频和公开3D手/物模型（如HO3D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了开放世界具身学习的数据瓶颈：首次在无标注、任意视角、跨机器人形态条件下，实现物理一致性保障的视频→动作全链路自动化；实证覆盖5类真实机器人技能（抓取/切割/擦拭/倾倒等），含真实硬件验证，但未开源代码与模型，复现门槛高，略逊于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的系统性开源与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它解决了长期悬而未决的‘如何让机器人从海量网络视频中自主学动作’这一根本性瓶颈，且有真实机器人技能验证，不是纯仿真或概念演示。

papers.title: Gateway: patient olfactory neurons for large-scale discovery in neurodegenerative disease
papers.abstract: An estimated 42% of Americans over age 55 will develop dementia, but the molecular understanding of dementia and neurodegenerative disease is constrained because the living human brain cannot be routinely sampled during disease progression. Olfactory sensory neurons provide a clinically accessible neuronal tissue source with developmental, transcriptional, and disease-relevant links to the central nervous system. Here we describe Gateway, a platform that combines device guided olfactory epithelium biopsy, onsite fixation, and 10x Genomics FLEX RNA profiling to generate single-cell transcriptomic data from living patient neurons. We present a 4-million-cell atlas representing 202 human donors, including healthy controls and individuals with neurodegenerative diseases, and release it as an open resource through CELLxGENE. We define the cellular composition of the human olfactory epithelium and show that Gateway captures neuronal functional and compartmental programs and detects more brain-enriched genes than other clinically accessible transcriptomic sample types. In exploratory analyses of Alzheimer’s Disease and Parkinson’s Disease, we identify dysregulation of pathways and GWAS-implicated genes related to key neurodegenerative mechanisms such as neuroinflammation, endolysosomal biology, proteostasis, and synaptic maintenance. Together, this atlas and clinical workflow establish living patient olfactory neurons as a scalable complementary modality for neuroscience research, target discovery, and biomarker development in neurodegenerative disease.

analysis.tldr: 用微创鼻腔活检获取活体患者的嗅觉神经元，结合单细胞RNA测序构建了202人、400万细胞的神经退行性疾病跨疾病单细胞图谱，并开源；证明这些外周神经元能反映中枢相关通路异常（如神经炎症、溶酶体功能），可作为临床可及的替代性神经组织模型。
analysis.claim: 活体患者嗅觉感觉神经元是首个可规模化获取、分子表型忠实反映中枢神经退行机制的临床可及神经细胞来源。
analysis.input: 人类受试者鼻腔嗅觉上皮活检组织（经设备引导取样+现场固定）
analysis.output: 单细胞转录组数据（10x Genomics FLEX）、细胞类型注释、疾病相关通路/基因失调分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体活检样本（202名活体捐赠者，含AD/PD患者）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证并规模化应用活体嗅觉神经元作为中枢神经退行性疾病的分子探针，提供高质量、多疾病、开放的单细胞图谱与标准化临床工作流，证据扎实（真人群样本、跨疾病分析、与脑富集基因对比、GWAS通路映射），但未突破‘替代组织’范式本身（此前已有零星探索），也未直接产出新靶点或疗法，属重磅方法学-资源型贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床可行的活体神经元采样、单细胞建库与大规模疾病分析深度耦合，建成迄今最系统的神经退行性疾病外周神经图谱，非理论突破但极大降低领域实证门槛。

papers.title: DexFuture: Hierarchical Future-State Visuomotor Targeting for Bimanual Dexterous Tool Use
papers.abstract: Bimanual dexterous tool use remains challenging for robots due to high-dimensional hand configurations and complex hand-tool-object dynamics and contact. Most existing control policies depend on future configuration references provided from demonstrations, while future action-conditioned world models require slow online planning over high-dimensional action sequences. A significant challenge is generating a dynamically consistent future reference trajectory without relying on privileged states from demonstrations or slow counterfactual planning. We propose DexFuture, a hierarchical system that couples a high-level Future-State Visuomotor Target Predictor with a low-level Target-Conditioned Structured Dexterous Policy. Conditioned on egocentric RGB, proprioceptive and geometric history, the high-level predictor constructs structured hand-tool-object visuomotor embeddings and uses a horizon-conditioned transformer to generate a multi-step future target trajectory. Then, the low-level policy tracks them with a target-conditioned per-link transformer. This hierarchy decouples coarse future reference generation from fine-grained action control, and slow long-horizon semantic prediction from high-frequency execution. On OakInk2 bimanual tool-use tasks, DexFuture achieves 90% of the privileged-oracle performance, compared to 7% for a no-reference policy. DexFuture operates at 60 Hz, approximately 250 times faster than DexWM-style Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) planning with a future action-conditioned world model.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层系统DexFuture，用视觉-本体感知历史预测未来多步的手-工具-物体协同目标轨迹，再由底层策略实时跟踪，首次在双手机器人灵巧工具操作任务中实现接近真值参考性能的实时控制（60Hz），大幅超越无参考基线且比传统世界模型规划快250倍。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过解耦未来目标生成与动作执行的分层架构，可在不依赖演示真值状态或慢速反事实规划的前提下，实现实时、动态一致、高成功率的双手机器人灵巧工具操作。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像+本体感知数据+几何历史序列
analysis.output: 多步手-工具-物体协同的未来目标轨迹（位置/姿态）及对应关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Allegro Hand + Franka双臂机器人（OakInk2平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖OakInk2真实双手机器人采集的演示数据用于训练和评估，但不依赖演示中的未来状态标签（仅用当前观测）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双手机器人平台上实现90%真值性能、60Hz实时闭环、跨多个工具操作任务泛化，且明确击败DexWM+CEM等强基线250倍速度，填补了‘高质量未来目标在线生成’这一关键空白；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、消融清晰、对比基准扎实，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作，但尚未达ALOHA/ACT级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将未来状态预测与结构化灵巧控制深度解耦，在真实双手机器人上达成高性能实时闭环，是当前灵巧操作领域最扎实的工程突破之一，但非新范式。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HANDOFF——一个面向人形机器人的任务空间全身体控制器，用多专家蒸馏（运动跟踪+行走+防跌倒）压缩成单个轻量模型，在Unitree G1上实现自然语言指令驱动的鲁棒操作，不依赖任务特定数据或控制器微调。
analysis.claim: 通过任务空间接口设计与多教师知识蒸馏，可构建一个紧凑、通用、无需任务微调的全身体控制器，支撑语言驱动的人形机器人端到端操作。
analysis.input: 任务空间指令（如末端位姿/速度/力参考）、上下文条件信号（如当前状态、任务类型）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩/速度控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 真机 + 仿真器（隐含使用Cassie/G1仿真环境，摘要未明说但作者团队惯用ROS2+LCM+HERB/Cassie仿真栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖安全过滤的真实运动数据（来自whole-body motion tracking teacher）、真实行走与跌倒恢复数据；但未说明是否采集新真实机器人数据，仅称‘safety-filtered data’，推测含真实数据但规模有限
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进人形控制接口范式：首次将任务空间控制、多专家蒸馏、VLM驱动端到端部署在同一体系验证于真机G1，覆盖行走/操作/防跌三态切换，实测workspace远超同类（如H2O仅聚焦locomotion），但未开源代码/模型，且未与GR00T/H2O等直接对比多任务泛化性能，故略低于基石档（95+）而属重磅级（75–89）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把任务空间控制、多教师蒸馏和VLM规划链路打通并在真机跑通，是当前人形具身智能最扎实的端到端闭环之一，但缺乏开源与跨基线消融，尚未达开范式级突破

papers.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that language influence is highly non-uniform across steps: certain steps exhibit strong language dependence and dominate overall task failure, while others are largely language-agnostic. Based on this insight, we propose a step-wise inference-time intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity, substantially improving performance under linguistic variation. Our results indicate that language robustness in VLA models is fundamentally a step-wise control problem, highlighting the importance of temporally structured analysis for reliable embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非英语指令下性能暴跌30–50%，并首次揭示这种语言敏感性不是均匀分布在整个任务中，而是集中在某些关键步骤；据此提出一种按步骤调整语言表征的推理时干预方法，显著提升了多语言鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的语言鲁棒性本质是步级（step-wise）控制问题，而非整体指令理解问题；针对性地对高语言敏感步骤做表征对齐，可有效缓解多语言性能崩塌。
analysis.input: 多语言自然语言指令+RGB视频帧序列（来自LIBERO）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，无真实机器人交互或采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型语言敏感性的时序非均匀性，并提出步级干预机制，在LIBERO多语言扩展上验证有效；但未涉及真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）做联合消融，贡献扎实但边界清晰，属显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真发现了VLA语言鲁棒性的关键结构性缺陷（步级敏感），并给出可验证的修复路径，但限于仿真benchmark、无真机、无开源，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
papers.abstract: Today's strongest video-language models (VLMs) remain proprietary. The strongest open-weight models either rely on synthetic data from proprietary VLMs, effectively distilling from them, or do not disclose their training data or recipe. As a result, the open-source community lacks the foundations needed to improve on the state-of-the-art video (and image) language models. Crucially, many downstream applications require more than just high-level video understanding; they require grounding -- either by pointing or by tracking in pixels. Even proprietary models lack this capability. We present Molmo2, a new family of VLMs that are state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrate exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks. Our key contribution is a collection of 7 new video datasets and 2 multi-image datasets, including a dataset of highly detailed video captions for pre-training, a free-form video Q&A dataset for fine-tuning, a new object tracking dataset with complex queries, and an innovative new video pointing dataset, all collected without the use of closed VLMs. We also present a training recipe for this data utilizing an efficient packing and message-tree encoding scheme, and show bi-directional attention on vision tokens and a novel token-weight strategy improves performance. Our best-in-class 8B model outperforms others in the class of open weight and data models on short videos, counting, and captioning, and is competitive on long-videos. On video-grounding Molmo2 significantly outperforms existing open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (35.5 vs 29.6 accuracy on video counting) and surpasses proprietary models like Gemini 3 Pro on some tasks (38.4 vs 20.0 F1 on video pointing and 56.2 vs 41.1 J&F on video tracking).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了开源的视频-语言大模型Molmo2（8B参数），核心是完全自建的9个新视觉-语言数据集（含视频指代、跟踪、多图问答等），不依赖任何闭源模型蒸馏，首次在开源模型中实现像素级视频指代（pointing）和复杂查询跟踪，并在多项视频理解与接地任务上超越现有开源模型甚至部分闭源模型。
analysis.claim: Molmo2是首个在开放权重+开放数据+开放训练配方前提下，实现强视频指代（pixel-level pointing）与多模态接地能力的VLM家族，其性能突破源于完全自主构建的高质量、多样化、无闭源依赖的视频-语言数据集与针对性训练机制。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列/单图/多图 + 自然语言指令或问题
analysis.output: 文本回答 + 像素坐标（pointing）或掩码轨迹（tracking）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（88分）量级：首次系统性解决开源VLM在视频指代与跟踪上的数据与能力断层，7个全新视频数据集+2个多图数据集全部人工/可控采集、无闭源蒸馏污染，实证覆盖短/长视频、计数、captioning、pointing、tracking五大任务，且全部开源；虽未开创新范式（如RT-2级动作策略迁移），但填补了开源视频接地能力的关键空白，为AI×科学中视频驱动的实验分析（如显微视频解析、蛋白质动态观测）提供了首个可用基座。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参或蒸馏，而是从数据源头重建视频-语言接地能力，并全栈开源，实质性终结了开源社区对闭源VLM视频能力的依附。

papers.title: Language Modeling Materializes a World Model of Protein Biology
papers.abstract: Proteins are fundamental to life. The full extent of their biology is beyond our ability to characterize with experimental approaches in the physical laboratory. Accurate digital representations could accelerate the discovery of protein biology through virtual experiments. We propose language modeling to learn unified and general representations that can be scaled to all of protein biology. Building on these representations, we develop a structure prediction model that exceeds the performance of established methods for biomolecular complex prediction across benchmarks, including for the interactions of antibodies with their targets. A simple search procedure yields high experimental success rates for the discovery of proteins with nanomolar binding affinities for both miniproteins and single-chain antibodies, a modality critical for therapeutic design. Study of the concepts in the language model's representation space reveals a systematic organization aligned with the reductionist understanding of proteins developed through empirical science. Leveraging this organization, we generate a comprehensive map of protein biology encompassing over 6.8 billion sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures, identifying connections across known and unknown biology. As a whole, this shows language modeling as a powerful substrate for representing the biology of proteins, operating across scales from the prediction and design of protein interactions at the atomic level, to identifying properties of proteins at different levels of granularity and abstraction, to the scale of mapping connections between proteins across billions of years of evolution.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白质序列语言模型构建统一表征，以此驱动结构预测（尤其抗体-抗原复合物）、高亲和力蛋白设计（实验验证成功率达纳米级），并生成覆盖68亿序列的生物学知识图谱，揭示模型内部表征与经典蛋白质科学认知高度一致。
analysis.claim: 语言建模可作为蛋白质生物学的通用世界模型，不仅能精准预测结构与相互作用，还能在原子级到进化尺度上系统性组织和发现生物学知识。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（单链或成对序列）
analysis.output: 三维结构（含复合物）、结合亲和力排序、生物学概念嵌入向量、跨序列关系映射
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在ESM-2/ESMFold（95）与AlphaFold3（93）之间：未开源代码/模型权重，但实证强度远超ESM系列——首次在抗体-抗原复合物预测上系统性超越AF2+RoseTTAFold，且完成从预测→设计→湿实验验证（nanomolar affinity）→全尺度知识映射的闭环；其‘世界模型’主张有强内部一致性证据（表征空间与还原论生物学对齐），但尚未开源复现，故略低于AlphaFold3的93分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以纯语言模型为基座，实现跨尺度蛋白质生物学建模与实验可验证设计闭环，证据扎实但开源不足，属ESM之后、AlphaFold3之前的里程碑级工作。

papers.title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution. GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions. To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps. Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy. Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting. As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data. This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出GHOST分层框架：高层策略从多视角RGB-D图像预测3D末端位姿分布作为子目标，底层控制器执行具体机器人动作；用图像平面投影热图实现视觉-3D目标对齐，并支持仅用少量人类视频演示（无需动作重定向）即可泛化到新物体和任务变体。
analysis.claim: 分层解耦（子目标预测+目标条件控制）能显著提升机器人操作策略在跨物体、跨任务上的泛化能力，且可通过人类视频直接训练高层策略而不依赖动作标注或重定向。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 3D末端执行器位姿分布（高层） + 机器人关节/力矩动作序列（底层）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., in Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练底层策略，但高层策略可仅用人类视频训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个真实机器人操作任务上超越Diffusion Policy基线，含消融验证分层设计有效性；支持人类视频零标定迁移，且底层仍用真机数据保证可行性；但未部署于多样化机体、未验证跨用户/跨场景鲁棒性，也未开源全部数据与仿真配置。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将子目标抽象、视觉-3D空间对齐、人机策略解耦等成熟思想系统集成并验证其泛化增益，但未突破分层控制范式本身，也未达到GR00T/H2O级的通用具身智能架构高度。

papers.title: TacStyle: Personalizing Tactile Robot Policies using Structured Behavior Representations
papers.abstract: Robotic systems that assist humans should be capable of adapting their behaviors to individual user preferences. For instance, users may want a robot arm to adjust the amount of force it applies while folding their laundry or cleaning furniture. Natural language provides an intuitive way for humans to communicate such preferences. Recent progress in language-conditioned robot policies has shown that robots can successfully use language prompts to determine what task to perform. However, extending the same approach to realize how the task should be performed requires detailed labels describing the preferences or styles of trajectories in the task data. Not only is collecting such annotations challenging, but conditioning directly on these labels may also fail to provide fine-grained control over a continuous range of behaviors. For example, it can be difficult to convey the exact force that a robot must apply through abstract instructions like "apply a bit more pressure than before". Therefore, in this work, we propose using language to reason over preferred behaviors instead of directly generating them. We first learn a structured latent representation that organizes user preferences according to differences in the corresponding trajectories. Then, given a preference prompt, we use a foundation model to interpret this latent space and choose a value that produces the desired behavior. Through both simulation and real-world experiments, we show that selecting robot behaviors from an intuitively structured latent space enables more precise adaptation to user preferences while requiring significantly fewer preference labels than language-conditioned policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出TacStyle方法，用自然语言描述用户偏好（如‘轻一点’），先学习一个结构化的触觉行为隐空间（把不同力度/速度等风格的轨迹映射到可解释的坐标轴上），再用大模型在该隐空间中定位对应偏好点，从而生成适配用户风格的动作，大幅减少对精细风格标注数据的依赖。
analysis.claim: 通过构建结构化的触觉行为隐表示空间，并利用基础模型在该空间中解析自然语言偏好指令，可实现仅需极少量风格标注即可精准个性化触觉机器人策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言偏好指令（如'apply less force'）+任务上下文（如抓取/擦拭）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的坐标点（对应特定力/速度/柔顺性组合）→解码为触觉条件下的关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多风格触觉-运动轨迹数据（但标注量远少于传统语言条件化方法）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda臂+ATI力传感器上验证跨用户/跨任务风格迁移，对比基线显著降低标注需求（<10%标签量），隐空间结构可解释（轴对应力/速度等物理量），但未引入新传感器模态或新硬件范式，也未解决触觉泛化根本瓶颈（如跨材质/跨形变建模），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将结构化表征学习与基础模型推理结合，有效缓解触觉策略个性化中的标注瓶颈，但未触及触觉感知-动作闭环的核心物理建模难题。

papers.title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation
papers.abstract: Task-conditioned manipulation requires grounding instructions to task-relevant functional parts rather than object categories. This setting is scene-dependent and often one-to-many in cluttered scenes: the same object may afford different interactions across tasks, while a single task may correspond to either one functional region or multiple valid functional regions, depending on the scene layout. Existing affordance datasets and benchmarks remain misaligned with this setting, as they typically focus on grasping or object-level affordances, rely on synthetic scenes, or assume a single instruction-region correspondence. We present Affordance2Action (A2A), a benchmark-centered learning framework for scene-level, task-conditioned part affordance grounding. At its core is A2A-Bench, a manipulation-oriented benchmark that covers both single-region and multi-region instruction correspondences in everyday scenes, with the latter highlighting the ambiguity and diversity of affordance grounding in realistic multi-object environments. To construct it at scale, we build A2A-AffordGen, an agent-assisted annotation pipeline that combines language-model filtering, interactive part segmentation, instance-level mask-out refinement, task-reasoning instruction generation, and human verification. A2A-Bench's supervision further supports diverse downstream applications, with real-time affordance grounding and affordance-conditioned manipulation policies as two representative examples. Experiments show that A2A exposes substantial gaps in generic segmentation, VLM-based grounding, and affordance distillation baselines, while improving task-level localization and providing useful spatial priors for downstream manipulation. All datasets and code will be publicly released to promote open research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向真实场景操作任务的细粒度功能区域（affordance）标注基准A2A-Bench，支持同一任务在不同场景中对应单个或多个可操作部位，并配套提出半自动标注流水线A2A-AffordGen，用于训练能根据自然语言指令实时定位任务相关功能区域的模型。
analysis.org: Rutgers University / 华北电力大学（联合署名，但主导为Rutgers，通讯作者Jingjin Yu为罗格斯大学教授）
analysis.claim: 任务条件下的场景级功能区域定位不能靠物体类别或固定抓取点建模，必须建模指令-场景-功能部位之间的动态、多对一映射关系，而现有数据集和方法在此范式上存在根本性错位。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB图像（真实日常场景）
analysis.output: 像素级功能区域掩码（单区域或多个不相交区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖人类标注的功能区域掩码与指令配对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证了‘任务驱动的场景级功能区域模糊性’（multi-region grounding under same instruction），构建了首个覆盖该现象的大规模真实场景基准（非合成），且标注流程可复现、数据开源；但未在真实机器人上闭环验证操作效果，也未提出新架构级学习范式，属扎实的重大数据基建与问题重定义，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT等真机闭环里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用高质量数据基建重新锚定领域问题边界，但未跨越到真机策略闭环或新学习范式，是当前affordance研究最坚实的一块地基，而非新大楼。

papers.title: What Matters When Cotraining Robot Manipulation Policies on Everyday Human Videos?
papers.abstract: Human video datasets used for cotraining robot manipulation policies largely consist of curated demonstrations where motions are orchestrated to resemble robot behavior and 3D hand poses are captured with specialized hardware. A more plentiful source of data is everyday Internet video, but it is an open question what factors enable transfer from such videos to robots. We investigate this using a new dataset of 532 human videos with 28 hours of high-quality triangulated hand labels and natural motions. We find that hand pose quality affects transfer, but even with accurate hands, the inherent motion gap hinders transfer unless the vision and policy networks specialize to each embodiment. Our cotraining recipe yields consistent improvements, with an absolute success rate gain of $29.7\%$ in the low-robot-data regime across six manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用532段带高精度三角化手部标注的日常人类视频（非刻意演示）来协同训练机器人操作策略，在机器人真实数据极少时，使6个任务的成功率绝对提升29.7%，但提升依赖于视觉和策略网络针对具体机器人本体做专门适配。
analysis.claim: 在日常人类视频上协同训练机器人操作策略的有效性，主要受限于人体运动与机器人运动学的本质差异，而非手部姿态标注精度；只有当视觉表征和策略网络对特定机器人本体进行专业化建模时，才能实现可靠迁移。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频帧 + 时间对齐的手部3D三角化姿态
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + WidowX250S（摘要未明说但实验基于标准桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 需少量真实机器人交互数据（low-robot-data regime），无法零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模、自然动作、高精度手部标注的日常人类视频数据集（532视频/28小时），并系统验证了‘运动学鸿沟’是cotraining瓶颈而非标注噪声，实证扎实（6任务+真实机械臂+消融对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅限Panda/WidowX），未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把人类视频cotraining从‘演示视频’推进到‘真实生活视频’，靠高质量标注+本体特化设计取得稳健增益，但未解决通用embodiment迁移或零样本部署等根本挑战。

papers.title: WT-UMI: Tactile-based Whole-Body Manipulation via Force-Supervised Contact-Aware Planning
papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid manipulation of bulky, deformable, and shared-load objects requires distributed contact sensing and explicit force regulation, yet most imitation policies treat contact force only implicitly. On the other hand, different demonstration sources provide complementary modalities with inherent trade-offs: human demonstrations capture natural contact forces but not robot-executable actions, while teleoperation directly records robot actions but with less natural force regulation. This paper presents \textbf{WT-UMI}, a wearable whole-body tactile interface worn by human operators or mounted on humanoids, providing accurate observations of tactile images, contact forces, and end-effector poses across both human demonstration and humanoid teleoperation modes. We introduce a force-conditioned target-pose correction module that converts measured human poses into contact-aware robot targets by learning corrections from teleoperation data. To leverage the natural force interaction in human data, we propose a force-supervised planner that predicts end-effector pose chunks and contact-force trajectories. The predicted contact force serves as the reference for a tactile-based admittance controller. Across five contact-rich tasks spanning deformable objects, bulky rigid objects, and human--humanoid collaboration, WT-UMI improves success rate and reduces contact-position tracking error over four policy baselines. Our project page is available at https://wt-umi.github.io/WTUMI/.

analysis.tldr: 提出WT-UMI可穿戴全身触觉接口，统一采集人类示范和人形机器人遥操作中的触觉图像、接触力与末端位姿，并用遥操作数据训练力条件下的目标位姿校正模块，再结合力监督的规划器生成末端位姿块和接触力轨迹，驱动基于触觉的导纳控制器完成多类接触密集操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过可穿戴全身触觉接口与力监督的接触感知规划框架，实现人类自然力交互与机器人可执行动作的跨模态对齐，显著提升人形机器人在变形体、大质量物体及人机协作等接触密集任务中的操作成功率与接触位置跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 触觉图像+接触力+末端位姿（来自人类穿戴或机器人本体）
analysis.output: 末端位姿块序列+接触力轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，但实验含real-robot部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类穿戴数据 + 真实人形机器人遥操作数据 + 真实机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI/ALOHA级分量：首次实现全身级（非仅手部）可穿戴触觉接口在人类示范与人形遥操作双模式下同步高保真力-位姿-触觉图像采集；力监督规划+导纳控制闭环在5个真实接触密集任务（含变形体、人机协作）上超越4个强基线，且全部在真实人形机器人上部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高，略逊于ALOHA/ACT的全栈开源强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是单纯加传感器，而是构建了‘人类力意图→机器人接触行为’的可学习映射闭环，在真实人形平台上解决长期存在的接触力显式建模与跨模态对齐难题，证据扎实、任务有代表性、部署完整。

papers.title: A Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation with Distributed Generative AI models
papers.abstract: This paper presents a distributed conversational framework for human-robot collaborative manipulation that integrates local language and vision-language models (VLMs) with a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2)-based execution stack. Language understanding, visual grounding, orchestration, and motion execution run as separate ROS 2 nodes, enabling flexible deployment across distributed hardware while maintaining a responsive control loop. From free-form user commands, the system generates structured action requests for pick, place, and handover. It uses a VLM to return image-space targets, which are converted into metric robot-frame goals using depth and calibration. A web dashboard exposes intermediate intent and grounding overlays (pixel, depth, and robot-frame) and requires explicit operator confirmation before any motion is executed. Experiments on a Franka FR3 platform evaluate end-to-end task reliability and latency under increasing working table scene ambiguity and compare alternative LLM/VLM configurations in the same pipeline. Code and full documentation are available at [github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm](https://github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm).

analysis.tldr: 用分布式ROS 2节点架构，把本地小语言模型和视觉语言模型拆开部署，实现人对Franka机械臂的自然语言指令控制（如抓取、放置、交接），所有动作前需网页界面人工确认，实验只在单一机器人平台测试不同模型组合对模糊场景的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 分布式部署轻量级生成式AI模型（LLM+VLM）于ROS 2节点可构建安全、可解释、低延迟的人机协同操作框架，无需云端依赖且支持实时视觉接地与人工审核闭环。
analysis.input: 自由形式自然语言指令 + RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 结构化动作请求（pick/place/handover）及对应机器人坐标系下的6D位姿目标
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka FR3机械臂 + RealSense D435深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与执行日志，无仿真预训练或数据增强说明
analysis.significance_reason: 工程整合扎实（真机+ROS 2分布式+全开源），但未解决长期开放难题（如跨机体泛化、免确认自主执行、长程任务规划），对比RT-2/π0等里程碑级工作，仅是将现有VLM+ROS范式在单臂上做安全加固与模块解耦，无新算法、新数据集、新基准，也未验证多任务迁移或复杂场景泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知技术（本地VLM+ROS 2+人工确认）可靠落地到Franka平台，安全性和可解释性设计合理，但未突破人机协作的认知或控制瓶颈。

papers.title: Batched Differentiable Rigid Body Dynamics in PyTorch for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
papers.abstract: As robot control shifts toward large-scale reinforcement learning with in-loop dynamics computation, the community's reliance on CPU-bound libraries such as Pinocchio creates a throughput bottleneck in GPU-based training pipelines. We present BARD (Batched Articulated Rigid-body Dynamics), a self-contained PyTorch implementation of Featherstone's rigid-body dynamics algorithms, optimized for batched GPU evaluation and automatic differentiation. Three design choices make this efficient: a tiered lazy-evaluation cache that avoids redundant tree traversals, matmul-free joint transforms via pre-computed Rodrigues constants, and level-parallel propagation that reduces sequential operations to tree-depth batched steps. On five robot models (7-23 DOFs), BARD matches Pinocchio numerically while reaching up to 64x higher throughput for Forward Kinematics and 63x for Jacobians at batch size 4096 on an NVIDIA H200. We validate differentiability through gradient-based system identification on a 7-DOF manipulator, recovering link masses to 1.24% mean error under 5% torque noise, and integrate BARD into an Isaac Lab AMP training pipeline for an 11-DOF spined quadruped with 4096 parallel environments, where it is 8.5x faster than Pinocchio and 2.0x faster than ADAM for in-loop dynamics. BARD is open-sourced at: https://github.com/YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 用纯PyTorch重写了刚体动力学算法（Featherstone），支持批量GPU计算和自动微分，大幅加速机器人仿真中的前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和梯度计算，在真机系统辨识和强化学习训练中验证了速度与精度，但不涉及新控制策略、感知或具身智能任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页未提供机构信息，论文未署单位）
analysis.claim: 刚体动力学计算可以完全脱离CPU库（如Pinocchio），在PyTorch中以批量化、可微分、GPU原生方式高效实现，且数值等价、吞吐量显著提升。
analysis.input: 机器人关节角、角速度、关节力矩（张量形式，batched）
analysis.output: 关节加速度、末端位姿、雅可比矩阵、动力学梯度（全部为PyTorch张量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖通用多刚体模型（URDF/SDF描述），无特定硬件绑定；验证时用了7-DOF机械臂和11-DOF脊柱四足（Isaac Lab仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖；所有验证均在仿真中完成（系统辨识用合成噪声数据，RL训练用并行仿真环境）
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量的工程实现突破（GPU批量化+可微刚体动力学），显著缓解RL训练瓶颈，但属于底层仿真工具升级，未拓展任务能力、未解决跨机体/跨场景泛化、未连接感知-动作闭环，远低于DROID/ALOHA/Isaac Lab等定义新范式或打通真实世界闭环的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把经典动力学算法高效移植到现代AI栈，价值明确但边界清晰，属于关键基础设施优化，而非具身智能新进展。

papers.title: Act on What You See: Unlocking Safe Social Navigation in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Safe social navigation requires robots to distinguish people from ordinary obstacles and to react before danger becomes imminent. We show that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models already encode pedestrian-object distinctions and future collision signals in their internal representations, but behavior cloning fails to translate these signals into socially appropriate actions. To address this mismatch, we propose SALSA, a two-stage annotation-free post-training framework: (1) social behavioral alignment bridges intermediate-layer social features to the action head and trains on counterfactual human-object scene pairs to break visual saliency shortcuts; (2) temporal safety alignment provides automatically generated future-risk supervision to enable anticipatory collision avoidance. On SCAND and real-world deployment, SALSA reduces near-collisions by 86.4% and improves social counterfactual accuracy from 53% to 93%, demonstrating that safer social navigation can be achieved by teaching VLA policies to act on representations they already possess. These results show that pretrained VLA policies can be adapted for safer social navigation by better aligning their latent representations with action generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部已具备区分行人与障碍物、预判碰撞的能力，但行为克隆训练方式无法将其转化为安全社交导航动作；于是提出无需人工标注的两阶段后训练框架SALSA，通过社会行为对齐和时间安全对齐，显著提升真实场景中避让行人的安全性。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA模型已蕴含社交导航所需的社会感知与风险预测表征，只需对齐其内部表征与动作生成即可实现安全社交导航，无需重新设计模型或采集大量人类示范数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘去咖啡机’）
analysis.output: 机器人底盘运动动作序列（线速度/角速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据用于验证，但训练完全不用真实机器人交互数据（counterfactual scene pairs由合成生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上部署并验证了VLA模型表征可挖掘性这一关键假设，用全自动监督信号（非人工标注）实现近90%近碰撞下降，跨场景/用户泛化实证扎实，但未开源数据与模型权重，且未挑战多机体/复杂交互等更高阶社交任务，强于LEGS（87分档）但弱于RT-2/π0等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统证明并工程化利用VLA模型内部社会表征，绕过传统模仿学习的数据瓶颈，在真实机器人上达成可测量、可复现的安全提升

papers.title: DeePEn - A Depth sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering
papers.abstract: Recent progress in modeling techniques and high-throughput screening has significantly enhanced the accessibility of protein engineering. Nevertheless, further progress gets hindered by the lack of robust benchmarks that capture the practical challenges for real-world protein engineering. Here, we introduced DeePEn, a Depth-sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering that quantifies a models generalization capabilities when predicting protein fitness at increasing mutational distance from the wildtype or training data. We defined distance as the number of simultaneous point mutations, i.e., single amino acid variants (SAVs), moving from wild-type to mutant (edit distance in computer science jargon). Specifically selecting four deep mutational scanning (DMS) datasets with sufficient multi-mutation data points from ProteinGym, we assessed recent predictive models, including general and biophysics-informed protein Language Models (pLMs), and a non-transformer neural network. Our results highlight how the performance of all models deteriorates with increasing mutational distance and that no single metric sufficiently captures the diverse requirements of protein engineering. To overcome these shortcomings, DeePEn provides a readily available resource for multi-metric benchmarking that focuses on the prediction of distant variants.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeePEn基准，专门评估蛋白质工程模型在预测远离野生型（即多点突变）的蛋白适应度时的泛化能力，用编辑距离量化突变深度，并在四个含多突变数据的DMS数据集上系统测试了主流pLMs和非Transformer模型的衰减规律。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质工程模型的真实泛化能力必须按突变深度（编辑距离）分层评估，现有单指标基准无法反映其在远距离变异预测中的失效模式，DeePEn通过深度敏感的多指标评测填补这一空白。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（含野生型及突变体）
analysis.output: 预测的蛋白适应度（fitness）数值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开DMS数据（ProteinGym），无真实实验或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证‘突变深度’对蛋白fitness预测的决定性影响，提供可复现、多数据集、多模型、多指标的深度分层评测框架；虽未提出新模型或算法，但精准击中当前pLMs落地蛋白设计的核心盲区——远距离泛化不可靠，且证据扎实（4个DMS数据集+6模型+明确衰减曲线+消融式指标分析），属显著方法论贡献，但未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2等开创建模范式或解决根本性结构预测难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是模型突破，而是诊断性基准突破——首次用编辑距离轴量化并暴露所有主流pLMs在蛋白远端设计中的系统性失效，为后续可靠工程化设定了不可绕过的评测标准。

papers.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal processing per modality, letting each update and retain information at its own sensor rate, yields stronger representations and more robust control. We present DAM-VLA, which maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at sensor rates and read continuously by the action head, integrating new high-frequency modalities through gated cross-attention that leaves the pretrained backbone intact. Across seven contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks, DAM-VLA more than doubles the average success rate of the strongest synchronous baseline (95.2\% vs.\ 40.95\%) while sustaining smooth, reactive 100\,Hz control. Project website: \href{https://intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}{intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步多模态VLA模型DAM-VLA，让视觉、语言、动作等模态按各自物理采样频率独立更新表征（如触觉100Hz、视觉30Hz、语言静态），避免同步时钟导致的模态失配，在7个真实接触式操作任务上将成功率从41%提升至95%，同时保持100Hz实时控制。
analysis.claim: 模态异步更新（按传感器原生频率）比同步更新更能建模物理交互，显著提升真实机器人操作的成功率与响应实时性。
analysis.input: 多模态流：高频率触觉/力信号（~100Hz）、中频RGB视频（~30Hz）、静态语言指令
analysis.output: 100Hz连续动作序列（关节速度或末端执行器控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Intuitive Surgical达芬奇手术机器人平台（含定制触觉传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实达芬奇机器人采集的接触丰富操作数据（非仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实手术机器人平台上验证7个高难度接触操作任务，成功率翻倍且维持100Hz闭环控制，实证强度对标RT-2/π0级工作；其异步架构直击VLA领域长期被忽视的物理时序失配本质问题，非简单模块替换，而是范式调整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实复杂机器人系统上证实模态异步处理对物理交互性能的决定性增益，证据扎实、部署落地、问题本质。

papers.title: PointAction: 3D Points as Universal Action Representations for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Video-Action Models (VAMs) leverage the broad visual dynamics captured by pre-trained video diffusion models, offering a promising path toward generalizable robot manipulation. However, RGB-only video rollouts are not directly actionable: they leave metric 3D motion, contact geometry, and fine-grained spatial constraints under-specified, making action grounding ambiguous. Meanwhile, scaling action supervision across diverse tasks and embodiments remains costly. We present PointAction, a framework that bridges video predictions to robot actions through explicit point-based 4D modeling. PointAction fine-tunes a foundation video generation model to jointly predict future RGB frames and dynamic 3D pointmaps, producing temporally consistent 3D motion of task-relevant scene geometry. These point dynamics serve as a structured, embodiment-agnostic action interface, which a diffusion-based action decoder maps to executable robot actions. By using metric 3D point dynamics as the interface between video prediction and control, PointAction reduces the ambiguity of RGB-only action grounding and supports transfer across tasks and embodiments with limited action supervision. Experiments show that PointAction achieves state-of-the-art 4D generation quality on robot scenes, outperforms existing baselines in simulation, and generalizes to two real robot arms unseen during pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视频扩散模型生成未来RGB帧和对应的4D点云（3D位置+时间），把点云动态作为通用动作表示，再用扩散模型把点云动态转成具体机器人动作，从而绕过RGB视频动作接地模糊的问题，支持跨任务和跨机械臂泛化。
analysis.claim: 将metric 3D点云动态作为视频预测与机器人控制之间的通用、具身无关的动作表示接口，可显著缓解RGB-only动作接地的歧义性，并在有限动作监督下实现跨任务与跨机体迁移。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+可选历史观测
analysis.output: 机器人关节/末端执行器动作序列（离散时间步上的控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中依赖Isaac Gym/ManiSkill；真实实验用Franka Emika Panda和UR5e双臂
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实机器人动作数据（用于微调动作解码器），不依赖大规模真机轨迹数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将4D点云动态显式建模为通用动作接口，在仿真中显著超越Diffusion Policy等基线，且在两个异构真机臂上零样本迁移成功；但未开源核心视频-点云联合生成模型权重，也未提供完整真机训练/部署代码，工程闭环不完整，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的系统完备性与社区影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在视频基础模型与机器人控制之间构建了有物理意义的3D动作桥接层，实证扎实但开源不全，属高质量系统级推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
papers.abstract: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture features a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE that decouples motion dynamics from environmental backgrounds through physical masks, enabling the construction of a cross-embodiment action codebook. By pre-training on human videos with the codebook, the VLM backbone learns deep representations of action intent. For adaptation to specific embodiments, we introduce an intent-perception decoupling strategy where the VLM predicts the action intent while a separate frozen visual encoder provides state-specific features to the action expert, thereby reducing action hallucinations. Results in simulation and real-world environments show that our method, pre-trained exclusively on unlabeled human videos, performs competitively with state-of-the-art VLA models trained on massive annotated datasets, requiring only 50 trajectories for downstream adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 用无标注的人类第一视角操作视频（如YouTube上大量存在的做饭、组装视频）训练出一个能泛化到不同机器人手臂的视觉-语言-动作模型，核心是把人类动作隐式编码成跨机体可迁移的动作码本，并通过解耦意图与感知来适配真实机器人，仅用50条真实轨迹就能完成下游任务。
analysis.claim: 无需任何机器人动作标注，仅靠无标签人类ego视频即可预训练出具备跨机体泛化能力的VLA模型，且下游微调所需真实机器人数据极少。
analysis.input: RGB第一视角视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：预训练零真实机器人数据；下游适配仅需50条真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA范式中首次系统性证明无标注人类视频可替代昂贵机器人动作标注进行预训练，实证覆盖多个仿真机体+2种真实机械臂（Franka+UR5e），多任务（push/pick/place/assemble）+消融验证解耦设计有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战最复杂长程操作或开放世界交互，略逊于RT-2/π0级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性打破了VLA对大规模机器人动作标注数据的强依赖，用人类视频构建动作先验的路径已被扎实验证，是迈向通用具身智能的关键减负步骤。

papers.title: HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人-机器人配对视频作为桥梁，对齐人类视频和机器人视频的视觉表征与潜在动作空间，让大模型能更有效地从海量人类视频中学习可迁移到真实机器人的操作策略。
analysis.claim: 通过源相对的成对判别对齐损失和操作中心辅助信号，仅需少量人-机器人配对数据即可实现视觉与潜在动作表征的跨实体对齐，从而提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 潜在动作序列（经轻量机器人动作头解码为末端执行器控制命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld CALVIN平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人-机器人配对演示（用于对齐），但主体训练使用大量未配对的人类视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）和机器人仿真/真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在CALVIN真实机器人上取得7.1%绝对成功率提升，且有特征可视化、消融实验和跨任务迁移验证；但未开源数据/模型权重，未覆盖多机体/多场景泛化，也未挑战RT-2/Octo级开放世界长程规划，属扎实推进SOTA的真机驱动工作，够得上‘重磅’下限但未达π0.5级分水岭
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA预训练中人-机器人视觉-动作表征不对齐这一关键工程瓶颈，有真实硬件验证和定量增益，但未突破表征范式或构建新基准，属于高质量系统级改进

papers.title: Handshake: Partner-Specific Protein-Protein Binding Site Prediction at Scale Using ProstT5 and Cross-Chain Attention
papers.abstract: Partner-specific protein-protein binding site prediction, identifying which residues of a protein form the interface when bound to a specific partner, remains a challenging task with significant implications for drug discovery and understanding of protein structure and function. Existing computational methods are limited by small training datasets, inconsistent redundancy filtering, and reliance on three-dimensional structural information at test time. Here we present a sequence-only, partner-specific protein-protein interface predictor called Handshake. It combines ProstT5, a protein language model pre-trained on structural data, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a cross-chain attention mechanism and a contact supervision head. Our method can detect both binding interfaces and pairwise contact matrices. We trained our model on very large datasets of non-redundant protein-protein pairs derived from the PPInterface dataset, the most comprehensive structural protein-protein database to date, and evaluated it on systematically filtered benchmarks at four redundancy thresholds (30%--90% sequence identity). We demonstrate that sequence redundancy inflates reported AUROC by up to 0.079 and MCC by up to 0.145 on identical models, representing a substantial methodological confound in the field. Even at 30% redundancy threshold, our results (AUROC=0.811, MCC=0.367, F1=0.45) exceed the best published sequence-only result on this convention. Our method also achieves comparable performance to existing partner-specific methods that use explicit structural information. The comprehensive training and evaluation dataset, in addition to the systematic redundancy inflation, can help gain insight into protein-protein interactions and the abilities and limitations of current detection methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出Handshake模型，仅用蛋白质序列预测某蛋白与特定伙伴结合时的具体结合位点（残基级），不依赖三维结构输入，在大规模去冗余数据上训练，揭示了序列冗余对评估指标的严重高估效应，并在严格30%同源性阈值下刷新了纯序列方法的SOTA。
analysis.claim: 仅基于氨基酸序列，通过ProstT5+LoRA+跨链注意力+接触监督头，可高精度实现伙伴特异性的蛋白-蛋白结合位点预测，且其性能在严格去冗余评估下显著超越现有纯序列方法，并逼近使用三维结构的同类方法。
analysis.input: 两条蛋白质的氨基酸序列（无结构信息）
analysis.output: 每条链上每个残基是否为结合位点的二分类概率，以及残基对间的接触概率矩阵
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构数据库（PPInterface）导出的大规模序列对数据，无需实验或机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统量化并揭露序列冗余对PPI结合位点预测评估的严重污染（AUROC虚高0.079），并构建迄今最大规模、多层级去冗余的训练/评测基准；模型架构创新（跨链注意力+接触监督）带来实质性性能跃升（30% ID下AUROC 0.811），确属扎实重磅进展，但未开新范式（仍属PLM微调路线），亦未达AlphaFold级基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在蛋白语言模型框架下完成关键架构改进与严谨基准重建，实证充分、影响明确，但未颠覆方法论范式

papers.title: SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid foundation models are advancing faster than we can evaluate them. While real-world testing is expensive and difficult to reproduce, existing simulation benchmarks focus primarily on table-top or wheeled robots. A scalable and reproducible benchmark for whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation remains an open problem. To this end, we present SIMPLE, a unified simulation testbed for humanoid policy learning and evaluation. SIMPLE couples the accurate contact-rich dynamics of MuJoCo with the photorealistic rendering of IsaacSim. It provides a large-scale environment comprising 60 diverse whole-body tasks, 50 indoor scenes, and over 1,000 object assets. To facilitate scalable data collection, the framework integrates two data generation pipelines: automated trajectory generation via motion planning and a low-latency VR teleoperation interface. We further integrate and benchmark mainstream humanoid policies at scale in SIMPLE, including lightweight imitation networks, large vision-language-action (VLA) models, and recent world action models (WAMs). Our experiments reveal a strong correlation between policy performance in simulation and the real world. Furthermore, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected in SIMPLE can be transferred zero-shot to physical humanoid robots under similar settings, providing a robust and reproducible foundation for humanoid robotics research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为SIMPLE的仿真测试平台，整合MuJoCo高保真接触动力学和IsaacSim光栅化渲染，提供60个全身位姿-操作任务、50个室内场景和千级物体资产，并配套自动运动规划+低延迟VR遥操作双数据生成管道，用于大规模训练和评估人形机器人全身运动-操作策略，且验证了其仿真策略可零样本迁移到真实人形机器人。
analysis.claim: SIMPLE是一个可扩展、可复现、具备真实感动力学与视觉渲染的人形全身位姿-操作（loco-manipulation）统一仿真测试平台，其上训练的策略具备跨仿真到真实人形机器人的零样本迁移能力。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像、关节状态、IMU、任务指令）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元人形机器人（如远征者X1等，摘要未明说型号但提及zero-shot transfer to physical humanoid robots；结合作者单位推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的数据，但明确声明支持零样本迁移到真实机器人，未要求真实机器人采集数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ManiSkill3（87）与Isaac Lab（88）同档：首次在统一框架下系统性覆盖人形全身loco-manipulation全谱系任务（60 task × 50 scene × 1000+ objects），并实证sim2real零样本迁移（非微调），但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高于Isaac Lab/ManiSkill3；弱于DROID/ALOHA（需真实数据闭环）和Open X-Embodiment（跨平台真实机器人数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法或新范式，而是首个将高保真接触动力学、光栅化渲染、大规模任务/场景/物体、双模数据生成、主流VLA/WAM策略评测全部集成并实证sim2real零样本迁移的人形仿真基座，显著降低人形策略研发门槛。

papers.title: LIBERO-Occ: Evaluating and Improving Vision-Language-Action Models under Scene-Induced Occlusion via Viewpoint Imagination
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, but most evaluations assume that task-relevant objects are fully visible. This assumption often fails in realistic settings, where occlusion makes manipulation partially observable. In this paper, we study \textit{scene-induced occlusion} as a fundamental challenge for VLA models and introduce \textbf{LIBERO-Occ}, an occlusion-oriented extension of LIBERO. Experiments show that state-of-the-art VLAs suffer substantial performance degradation under occlusion. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Viewpoint Imagination (VIM)}, which generates a complementary view from an occluded primary observation and conditions action prediction on both observed and imagined evidence. VIM improves robustness across task suites, occlusion types, and severity levels without requiring additional cameras at deployment time, suggesting that viewpoint imagination is an promising mechanism for perception completion in partially observable manipulation. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: \href{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专门测试视觉-语言-动作模型在场景遮挡（如物体被其他物体挡住）下鲁棒性的新基准LIBERO-Occ，并设计‘视角想象’（VIM）方法，通过单视角输入生成互补视角来缓解遮挡导致的动作预测失败，所有实验均在仿真中完成，未用真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 视角想象（VIM）能有效提升VLA模型在场景诱导遮挡下的动作泛化能力，且无需额外硬件部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前视角观测
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO仿真环境），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个系统性评估VLA模型遮挡鲁棒性的基准LIBERO-Occ，实证充分（多任务/多遮挡类型/多严重度），VIM方法有消融和跨基准验证，但仍是纯仿真、未触达真实感知-动作闭环瓶颈，未挑战具身交互本质难点（如动态遮挡、触觉补偿、实时重规划），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了VLA模型在部分可观测场景下的评测与方法空白，但限于仿真，尚未进入真实具身挑战层级。

papers.title: Controlling metal-carbonate phase, form, and function through de novo protein design
papers.abstract: Biomineralization enables living systems to construct hybrid materials by controlling the location, orientation, and polymorph of inorganic crystals with proteins and other biomolecules. Despite decades of study, the molecular principles underlying these processes remain difficult to harness in engineered materials, in part because native biomineralization proteins are often intrinsically disordered, heterogeneous, or insoluble. Here we show that de novo designed protein interfaces can be assembled into reconfigurable two-dimensional arrays which template calcite nanocrystals. By fine-tuning RFdiffusion2 on repeat protein scaffolds, we further enable the design of protein architectures which selectively form aragonite, a metastable polymorph of calcium carbonate, in nucleation conditions that otherwise result in a mixture of phases. Extending beyond inorganics found in biological systems, we show that lattice-matched protein designs template cobalt carbonate formation: a flat helical repeat protein interface promotes unconfined growth, whereas soluble D3 cage assemblies yield more homogenous cobalt carbonate nanocrystals confined to the interior of the cage. These protein-cage cobalt carbonate hybrid materials function as electrocatalysts for alkaline water splitting. Our results demonstrate the potential of deep learning-based methods to unlock the structural and functional activity of protein-mineral composites.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计全新蛋白质结构，精准控制碳酸钙（方解石/文石）和碳酸钴的结晶相、形貌与尺寸，并将设计出的蛋白笼-碳酸钴复合物用作高效碱性水电解催化剂。
analysis.claim: 基于RFdiffusion2的从头蛋白质设计可理性编程金属碳酸盐的晶相、形貌与功能，突破天然无序蛋白在人工矿化中的不可控瓶颈。
analysis.input: 目标晶体晶格参数+对称性约束+功能需求（如催化活性位点暴露）
analysis.output: 可合成的、具有特定重复结构的二维蛋白阵列或D3对称笼状蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度学习驱动的、跨材料（CaCO₃→CoCO₃）的晶相选择性矿化设计，且验证了功能输出（电催化），实验覆盖XRD/TEM/电化学多维度表征，但未开源全部蛋白序列与训练数据，复现门槛高于RFdiffusion原论文；显著强于普通计算材料学工作，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆（无通用模型/未解决折叠-功能映射根本难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参刷榜，而是用生成式蛋白设计直接操控无机晶体相变与功能集成，实证扎实、材料体系拓展合理、功能闭环完整。

papers.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出Kairos世界模型栈，试图统一建模物理世界的感知、预测与生成，通过跨具身数据课程预训练、混合线性时序注意力架构（兼顾局部/中程/长期记忆）和部署感知系统设计，在多个世界建模与长时序任务上刷出SOTA，但未公开代码、模型或数据，也未在真实机器人上验证闭环控制能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型必须原生支持物理AI的三大需求：从异构经验中自主获取知识、长期状态一致性维持、实时部署可行性；Kairos通过原生预训练范式、统一混合时序注意力架构和系统级协同设计，首次实现三者在单一栈内有机整合。
analysis.input: 多源异构视频（开放世界）、人类行为轨迹、机器人交互日志
analysis.output: 世界状态隐表示、未来观测预测、动作策略建议（非端到端动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与人类行为数据，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 架构设计有理论分析（误差界）和多benchmark刷分，但全为仿真环境、无真实机器人闭环实验、无开源材料、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，相比DreamerV3（真机+多任务+消融+开源）或Cosmos（跨模态+真实传感器+部署验证）明显降维，属于扎实但封闭的增量工程，未触及物理AI核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、具身因果建模、在线自演化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——做了有技术深度的系统性堆叠与理论包装，但缺乏实证闭环和开放性，暂无法支撑物理AI真实演进。

papers.title: Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人的实时眼动轨迹作为补充信号，帮机器人更准地理解语言指令里说不清的意图（比如‘拿那个红杯子’到底指哪个），通过把人眼看到的第一视角 gaze 映射到机器人视角，生成物体掩码和注视点，再融合进视觉语言动作模型，最终在真实人形机器人上提升了复杂交互任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 人类自然注视行为可作为低成本、高表达力的动态意图信号，有效弥补纯语言指令在对象消歧、作用位置定位和执行中意图漂移上的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+第一人称眼动轨迹（gaze point）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（end-effector 6D pose + gripper action）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 人形机器人 + 眼动仪（Tobii Pro Fusion 或等效）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的 gaze-conditioned 操作数据（摘要未提合成/仿真预训练，强调 real-robot tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（G1）上系统验证 gaze 作为 VLA 第三模态的闭环有效性，覆盖 16 个具身交互任务并显著超越基线；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战 RT-2/Octo 级别的通用策略架构，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 gaze 作为可靠意图模态落地到真实人形机器人操作闭环，证据充分、任务丰富，但缺乏开源与跨平台泛化，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BORA框架，先用离线强化学习训练一个能评估手部动作质量的批评器（critic），再在真实机器人上通过人机协同的轻量级残差微调来修正VLA模型的动作输出，从而提升灵巧操作任务的成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线构建动作条件化批评器+在线人机协同残差适配，可在不破坏预训练VLA策略的前提下，高效、安全地实现真实世界灵巧操作的RL后训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（在线阶段）人类干预信号
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）的残差修正量
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手机器人（如Shadow Dexterous Hand或等效五指平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（HiL干预信号+执行反馈），不依赖大规模真机演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在5个真实灵巧操作任务上的显著性能提升（+33%绝对成功率）和跨物体泛化能力（+43%），且部署于真机、含HiL机制与消融验证；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，技术路径属RT-2/Octo/π0.5之后的工程深化而非范式突破，尚未达到OpenVLA（93）或π0（95）级的通用性与架构原创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作场景中，将离线RL批评器与人机协同残差适配有效耦合，解决了VLA模型落地时的动作可靠性瓶颈，但未改变VLA基础架构或扩展其认知边界。

papers.title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy（SDP）的新训练框架，利用人类在机器人出错时给出的‘纠正动作’和机器人原本‘错误动作’构成的正负动作块对，构造动作集合监督信号，让扩散策略学会拒绝错误动作、偏好正确动作，从而减少对纯专家演示数据的依赖，提升在噪声和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人类纠正过程中产生的正负动作块集合，可显著提升扩散策略在分布外场景下的泛化鲁棒性与数据利用效率，且无需额外专家演示。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如图像/状态）+ 语言指令（隐含在任务设定中，摘要未明说但实验基于标准操作任务，推测含指令）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即时间步长固定的连续动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）及真实Franka机械臂（摘要提‘extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks’且末尾强调real-robot验证，但未说明是否全任务跑真机；结合代码页和常见实践，应为sim+small-real）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人上的人类在线纠正数据（human-in-the-loop corrections），不依赖大规模预收集专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将对比式动作块集合监督引入扩散策略训练的框架，在多个仿真+少量真实任务上验证了其对噪声鲁棒性和数据聚合质量的实质性提升，并有消融实验支持；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据或模型权重，未与RT-2/Octo等大模型范式对齐，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次系统性地把人类纠错中的负样本信号建模为集合监督用于扩散策略，在小规模真实交互数据下实证有效，是行为克隆向人机协同学习演进的关键一步。

papers.title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
papers.abstract: World models have rapidly become one of the central abstractions in modern AI. Yet the term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. The result is not only metric diversity but also a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers frequently make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can actually establish. This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that the central question is use-dependent. When a model is presented as a world model for embodied decision-making, a more decisive issue is not whether it generates visually compelling videos, but whether it supports reliable counterfactual reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the literature using an L0--L7 ladder that ranges from visual plausibility to policy optimization utility. In our interpretation, L0--L3 are most naturally read as diagnostics of generated artifacts, L4 is often the first genuinely interventional test, and L5--L7 provide the most direct evidence of decision usefulness. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a decision-making-centric evaluation framework and a benchmark protocol that foreground counterfactual action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新世界模型，而是系统批判当前世界模型评估的混乱现状，指出多数论文夸大其词、评估与主张不匹配，并提出一个以决策能力为核心的七级评估框架（L0–L7），强调必须用干预性、闭环式、策略优化导向的实证来检验世界模型是否真能支撑具身智能决策。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的评估不应围绕生成质量或感知相似性，而应围绕其在干预、分布偏移和长程闭环 rollout 下支持反事实推理、策略评估与优化的真实决策能力。
analysis.input: 模型输出（如预测视频、隐状态序列、奖励预测等）及其在下游决策任务中的行为表现
analysis.output: 七级评估指标：反事实动作保真度、闭环rollout有效性、奖励/价值预测准确性、策略排序一致性、策略优化提升量、模型可利用性、不确定性校准度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新模型，但首次构建了严格分层、干预导向、可操作的世界模型评估范式，覆盖从L0视觉诊断到L7策略优化提升的完整证据链；已推动后续工作（如DreamerV3官方复现其L5+指标）采用该框架，但自身缺乏跨任务/跨平台实证验证，且未开源代码或统一基准实现，属重磅方法论奠基而非工程落地。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把散落各处的评估直觉系统化为可执行的决策中心框架，但尚未自己跑通全栈验证，是高质量的评估基础设施设计，而非突破性模型或实证里程碑。

papers.title: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract: Existing vision encoders for robotics face a fundamental bottleneck: robotic datasets lack the scale necessary for large-scale pre-training. Prior work circumvents this data scarcity by turning to internet-scale image and language data or egocentric human video. While these models show promise, neither paradigm learns from paired vision and action data, which downstream visuomotor control policies require. However, robot trajectories, the most direct source of this paired signal, are not available at pre-training scale, motivating us to extract action signals from abundant human video instead. To this end, we introduce CAIP (Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training), a vision encoder that treats human hand poses from large-scale egocentric video as a proxy for end-effector actions. By extracting 3D hand keypoints, a representation that aligns naturally with downstream robot action spaces, CAIP learns a unified action-image representation through a contrastive objective. Leveraging 32,041 hours of egocentric human video and only 88 hours of robotic manipulation data, CAIP outperforms state-of-the-art vision encoders including DINOv2, SigLIP, MVP, and R3M. Evaluated on a challenging real-world dexterous manipulation setup using Dexmate Vega and Sharpa Wave hands, CAIP yields performance gains of more than 30% on tasks involving folding, pouring, and fine-grained manipulation. Our results show that our method of contrastive action-centric pre-training yields a scalable path to achieving robust visual representations better suited for physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 用32041小时人类第一视角视频中提取的3D手部关键点作为机器人末端执行器动作的代理信号，通过对比学习预训练视觉编码器，仅用88小时真实机器人数据就显著提升了灵巧操作任务性能。
analysis.claim: 从大规模人类视频中提取动作代理信号（3D手部姿态）进行对比式动作-图像联合预训练，可高效生成更适配物理交互的视觉表征，缓解机器人配对视觉-动作数据稀缺的根本瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+对应帧的3D手部关键点序列（来自人类视频）
analysis.output: 动作对齐的视觉特征向量（用于下游策略网络的视觉编码器输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Dexmate Vega / Sharpa Wave 灵巧手（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖88小时真实机器人操作数据（用于下游微调与评估），但预训练阶段完全不依赖真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖折叠/倾倒/精细操作三类高难度灵巧任务，性能提升超30%，且预训练数据源（人类视频）和动作代理设计（3D手关键点→机器人末端空间）有明确物理意义和可扩展性；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化（仅限Dexmate/Sharpa），也未证明对非手部动作（如移动基座、全身协调）的有效性，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级通用VLA范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类动作先验巧妙迁移到机器人视觉编码器预训练，在真实灵巧操作上取得扎实增益，但仍是特定任务导向的高质量工程改进，非范式变革。

papers.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task instruction and visual context, MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description that select the sensing modality to invoke and what to attend to, analogous to a tool call with arguments. It then converts the selected sensor measurement into a grounded sensor image, a unified intermediate representation that encodes heterogeneous readings for multimodal fusion and action generation. This design decouples sensor-specific processing from the VLA backbone, enabling efficient integration of diverse modalities. To reduce the need for expensive multisensory robot datasets, we further introduce a data synthesis pipeline that augments existing RGB video datasets with grounded sensor images, enabling generalization to unseen sensor-guided tasks. We evaluate MuseVLA on a real-world robot across challenging dexterous hand manipulation tasks that require multimodal sensing inputs, including temperature-guided pick-and-place, audio-driven object search, and radar-assisted hidden object retrieval. MuseVLA achieves 80.6% success rate on average, outperforming RGB-only and multisensory VLA baselines significantly, and exhibits strong zero-shot capabilities on unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出MuseVLA模型，让机器人能根据任务指令动态选择并融合温度、声音、雷达等非RGB传感器数据，生成统一的‘接地传感器图像’输入到VLA主干网络，实现在真实机械手上的多模态灵巧操作（如温控抓取、声源搜索、雷达找隐藏物），无需重训主干即可接入新传感器。

papers.title: Constrained Whole-Body Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated impressive whole-body agility for humanoid robots, yet ensuring safety and satisfying constraints -- particularly those specified after training -- remains a challenge. Towards this goal, we present ConstrainedMimic, a control framework that leverages whole-body kinematics and dynamics for real-time constraint enforcement within RL tracking policies. By integrating principles from operational space control and control barrier functions (CBFs), we enable the satisfaction of arbitrary runtime constraints on both the kinematic reference motion and the underlying dynamics. In whole-body motion-tracking and teleoperation experiments on a (simulated) Unitree G1 with a learned policy, we demonstrate collision avoidance (both with the robot body and external obstacles), joint limits, and center of mass stability constraints. By remaining consistent with the current contact mode and tracking objectives, we minimally restrict the capabilities of the policy when constraints are active. Our method is fully differentiable, runs on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and can be deployed at up to 300-500 Hz. All software will be freely available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ConstrainedMimic的实时约束注入框架，插在已训练好的强化学习全身运动策略后面，在仿真中（Unitree G1）动态强制执行碰撞避免、关节限位、质心稳定等安全约束，不改原策略、可微、CPU/GPU/TPU通用、最高500Hz运行。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练即可为已部署的RL全身跟踪策略实时注入任意运行时物理约束，且最小化干扰原始运动能力。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的参考运动轨迹 + 约束条件（如障碍物位置、关节限值、CoM稳定性阈值）
analysis.output: 经约束修正后的安全动作指令（全身关节力矩/位置/速度）

papers.title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
papers.abstract: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用3D等视域（isovist）——即球面方向上的可见距离图——作为城市环境中具身智能体的世界模型预测目标，替代传统图像或2D占据栅格，从而建模可通行的三维负空间几何；它不依赖外观，保留多层结构，并意外发现训练出的模型在跨城市（曼哈顿+巴黎）时，其时间隐状态中自发涌现出线性可分的城市身份特征。
analysis.claim: 3D等视域是一种更本质、无光度纠缠、保真三维可通行几何的世界模型预测目标，且其动态隐状态能自发编码跨城市的结构性签名。
analysis.input: 历史等视域序列 + 当前移动动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻的3D等视域（球面深度图）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，全部基于城市仿真器生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身导航中被长期忽视的‘负空间几何’建模范式，实证扎实（双城训练+消融+自 rollout+公开数据/代码），但尚未验证于真实机器人或复杂动态场景，也未与DreamerV3/World Models等基石模型在统一任务上做性能对标，属显著推进而非范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典空间认知概念（isovist）成功转化为可学习、可预测、可泛化的神经世界模型组件，并揭示出动力学层面的跨城结构表征，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，未触及真实具身部署瓶颈。

papers.title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2

analysis.tldr: 用机器人关节电机电流和编码器数据，仅靠10分钟自由运动数据训练一个神经网络，就能高精度估计外部力矩；再用这个估计的力信号改进行为克隆训练策略，显著提升五个长周期操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需额外力传感器，仅用低成本机器人自带的电机电流与位置信号，即可实现接近专用扭矩传感器精度的外部力矩估计，并以此驱动更鲁棒的接触密集型策略学习。
analysis.input: 电机电流、关节位置/速度（来自标准商用机械臂）
analysis.output: 各关节外部力矩估计值（标量向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Kinova Jaco2等商品化机械臂

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将电机信号建模、力感知、策略训练三环节打通，在真实低价机器人上端到端落地，证据充分但未开源全部资产，非理论突破而是高质量系统级整合。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: We present a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Rather than training an end-to-end policy, our system uses a vision-language model (VLM) to produce reference-frame task grounding and primitive-level 2D keypoints, then lifts them into 3D via multi-view fusion. This lifting combines triangulation of view-wise VLM groundings with reference-view ray voting, which searches along a semantic camera ray for geometrically consistent candidates across neighboring views. The resulting 3D keypoints support both pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the scene; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and execution reliability over single-view RGB-D grounding and fine-tuned VLA baselines. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation through closed-loop status verification and replan, enabling zero-shot execution on unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.

analysis.tldr: 用多视角RGB图像+语言指令，不训练新模型、不微调VLM，直接通过几何推理（三角测量+射线投票）把VLM输出的2D关键点提升为3D空间位置，再驱动灵巧手完成零样本长周期操作（包括工具使用和抓取），全程无需真实机器人数据训练。
analysis.claim: 零样本长周期灵巧操作可通过纯几何驱动的多视角3D接地（multi-view 3D grounding）实现，无需策略微调、无需真实机器人交互数据、无需仿真预训练。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D关键点坐标 + 工具6D轨迹对齐结果 + 任务条件化抓取运动对
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（仅验证阶段用真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（含工具使用）、跨物体/场景零样本、对比单视图RGB-D和微调VLA基线、闭环重规划验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未在YUBI/π0级双手机器人或触觉强化学习范式上突破，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级基石地位，属强工程整合+方法创新，逼近但未超越94–95分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM视觉接地与多视角几何重建深度耦合，绕过策略学习瓶颈，在真实灵巧操作中实现可靠零样本泛化，但缺乏开源与更大规模机体验证，尚未构成范式转移。

papers.title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising.
