We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We keep standard velocity prediction and add no teacher model, distillation stage, or auxiliary objective; in our main recipe, we simply bias the training time distribution toward high-noise states. We first isolate the effect in a controlled MNIST grid-to-sequence task, then test it with extensive robot-policy experiments. Across standard LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe, and on standard LIBERO can exceed ten-step policies trained with a uniform time distribution. A real-robot bimanual YAM RSS evaluation gives a small-sample cross-architecture check of the same sampler trend. On a 1.4B VLM model with a 30M action head, one-step decoding reaches 95.6\% on LIBERO-Long. These results show that strong one-step VLA action generation can emerge from standard diffusion training, without importing the full few-step diffusion machinery developed for image generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做动作生成时，不必照搬图像生成中复杂的多步扩散采样；只需在标准扩散训练中简单地将噪声调度偏向高噪声阶段，就能让单步解码性能媲美甚至超过传统10步扩散解码。
analysis.claim: 强效的单步VLA动作生成可直接从标准扩散训练中涌现，无需引入图像生成领域专用的复杂单步方法（如蒸馏、教师模型、辅助目标或特殊架构）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态（如关节位置/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 低维动作块（如6D末端速度或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO系列），无真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO全系列（含Long/Plus/Pro）上系统验证单步vs十步性能，覆盖多任务泛化与跨架构一致性（含1.4B大VLM），但未部署真机闭环、无硬件实验、未开源代码/模型，且核心改进仅为训练噪声调度调整——属显著但非范式级推进，略低于π0.5（86）和FAST（85）的工程深度与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简改动撬动扩散VLA的单步实用化，证据充分但落地闭环缺失，是高质量的系统性工程优化而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Scalable in vivo cardiac functional genomics with compressed AAV-Perturb-seq reveals a common mitochondrial response to perturbation
papers.abstract: Efficient identification of new targets to treat human disease requires a scalable way to link genotype to phenotype directly in the target organ. Pooled CRISPR screening with single-cell RNA sequencing as a readout (Perturb-seq) has emerged as a method for functional genomics but is typically applied in vitro and is limited in scale. Here, we combine in vivo Perturb-seq via adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated delivery with a statistical framework allowing for signal deconvolution after multiple random perturbations per cell (compressed Perturb-seq), to develop in vivo compressed AAV-Perturb-seq, a scalable way to perform high-throughput, cell-autonomous functional genomics in a desired target organ. We apply this approach to study the effect of 585 gene knockouts on the cardiomyocyte transcriptome. We identify that alterations in the mitochondrial transcriptome are a common response to genetic perturbation, a finding independently validated across species and perturbation modalities. We identify very few synergistic perturbations, despite observing frequent combinatorial effects. Broadly, our work establishes a platform to facilitate in vivo functional genomics in a target organ with direct applicability to identifying therapeutic targets for the treatment of human disease.

analysis.tldr: 用压缩编码的AAV载体在活体小鼠心脏中同时递送585个基因的CRISPR敲除，并结合单细胞RNA测序和统计解混算法，首次实现大规模、细胞自主性的体内心脏功能基因组筛选，发现线粒体转录组紊乱是多种基因扰动下的共性应答。
analysis.claim: 压缩式体内AAV-Perturb-seq可规模化解析目标器官（心肌）中数百个基因扰动的细胞自主转录表型，揭示跨扰动类型的线粒体应激为普遍响应机制。
analysis.input: 585个基因的sgRNA文库 + AAV体内递送 + 小鼠心脏组织单细胞悬液
analysis.output: 每个细胞对应的扰动基因组合（经解混推断）及其全转录组表达谱
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实小鼠体内实验数据（心脏组织单细胞测序），无体外培养或类器官替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在活体哺乳动物靶器官中实现百级基因规模的单细胞分辨率扰动筛选，技术平台具普适性；但仅验证于心肌一种细胞类型、一种物种（小鼠）、一种扰动方式（CRISPRko），未做跨组织/跨疾病模型扩展，也未直接连接药物靶点发现闭环，属扎实的重大方法学推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机（活体小鼠）+多基因（585）+单细胞分辨率+独立跨物种验证+新统计框架，证据链完整，但应用广度尚未展开，未达AlphaFold级范式突破

papers.title: ProtGPT3: an Open-source family of Promptable and Aligned Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Generative protein language models (pLMs) enable exploration of vast sequence spaces for protein design, but reliably controlling generation toward desired functional families remains challenging. While protein generation has broadly followed trends in NLP, two directions remain underexplored: alignment methods that optimize model behavior toward design objectives, and prompting-based control at inference time without fine-tuning. We introduce ProtGPT3, an open-source family of protein language models spanning 112M to 10B parameters and integrated with the Hugging Face ecosystem. The suite includes both single-sequence and multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-promptable models, enabling flexible conditioning for generation. Across model scales and control settings, we systematically compare supervised fine-tuning and few-shot prompting using homologous sequences. Analogous to how large language models (LLMs) are routinely aligned with user intent, we study post-training alignment in single-sequence models using sequence-complexity and structure-confidence metrics across the proteome. We find that alignment reduces low-complexity generations while preserving sequence diversity. Furthermore, we show that few-shot prompting is a competitive and more scalable alternative to supervised fine-tuning for controlled generation. In a low-data defluorinase case study, ProtGPT3-MSA achieved higher computational success rates than fine-tuned baselines and produced designs that were soluble and expressed following experimental validation. Finally, we explore the potential of inference-time compute in MSA models by introducing a homolog-based Feynman--Kac inference procedure for steering protein generation toward desired targets. We make our models publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/AI4PD/protgpt3-family .

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套可提示、可对齐的蛋白质语言模型ProtGPT3（112M–10B参数），支持单序列和MSA提示控制生成，用序列复杂度和结构置信度指标做后训练对齐，实验证明其few-shot提示比监督微调更高效，在去氟酶设计中生成了可溶且可表达的蛋白。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质语言模型无需微调即可通过提示（尤其是MSA提示）和后训练对齐实现可控、高质量、可实验验证的蛋白生成。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列或同源多序列比对（MSA）作为提示，可选附加功能描述或约束条件
analysis.output: 生成的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现pLM的prompting+alignment双范式，MSA提示在低数据去氟酶任务中超越微调基线并获湿实验验证，但未突破ESM/AlphaFold级建模原理，也未建立新评估基准或覆盖大规模功能家族，属显著贡献而非里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将LLM级提示工程与对齐技术完整迁移到pLM，且在真实蛋白设计任务中验证了few-shot提示优于微调的可行性，证据扎实、开源完备、有湿实验支撑

papers.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
papers.abstract: World-action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation, jointly modeling visual scene dynamics and actions to inject physical priors into policy learning. However, existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model near-term frame variations that are redundant and weakly informative. We posit that strictly binding world prediction and action execution to the same temporal rhythm may underutilize the potential of the video branch for embodied control. Therefore, we propose AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry. AHA-WAM instantiates the video DiT as a low-frequency world planner that maintains rolling key-value memory over past observations and exposes reusable layerwise latent context encoding long-horizon scene evolution, while a high-frequency action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying this context through layerwise joint attention. To support asynchronous execution, we introduce horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT. Experiments on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation tasks show that AHA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance without any robot-data pretraining, attaining 92.80% average success on RoboTwin and 78.3% success across 4 real-world tasks, while reaching 24.17 Hz closed-loop control with a 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步世界-动作建模框架AHA-WAM，让视频分支（世界模型）以低频滚动更新长期场景演化表征，动作分支以高频闭环执行短动作块，并通过观测引导的上下文路由机制复用视频分支的层级隐状态，从而在不依赖机器人真实数据预训练的前提下，在仿真和真实机械臂任务上取得SOTA性能。
analysis.claim: 解耦世界预测与动作执行的时间粒度并建立异步上下文复用机制，能显著提升世界-动作联合建模的效率与泛化性，且无需真实机器人数据预训练即可实现高性能闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作指令/任务描述
analysis.output: 短时动作块（如6D位姿增量或关节扭矩序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据预训练（仅微调阶段使用少量真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在RoboTwin仿真和4个真实机械臂任务上验证，有明确baseline对比（Fast-WAM）、消融（OVCR/offset training）、速度指标（24.17Hz）和零预训练设定；但未跨机体验证、未开源代码、未覆盖复杂灵巧操作或长程规划，未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将时间解耦、层间上下文复用与Diffusion Transformer结合得严密高效，实证充分，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data
papers.abstract: The recent trend in scaling models for robot learning has resulted in impressive policies that can perform various manipulation tasks and generalize to novel scenarios. However, these policies continue to struggle with following instructions, likely due to the limited linguistic and action sequence diversity in existing robotics datasets. This paper introduces Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data (TREAD), a scalable framework that leverages large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to augment existing robotics datasets without additional data collection, harnessing the transferable knowledge embedded in these models. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM through three stages: generating semantic sub-tasks from original instruction labels and initial scenes, segmenting demonstration videos conditioned on these sub-tasks, and producing diverse instructions that incorporate object properties, effectively decomposing longer demonstrations into grounded language-action pairs. We further enhance robustness by augmenting the data with linguistically diverse versions of the text goals. Evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that policies trained on our augmented datasets exhibit improved performance on novel, unseen tasks and goals. Our results show that TREAD enhances both planning generalization through trajectory decomposition and language-conditioned policy generalization through increased linguistic diversity.

analysis.tldr: 用大视觉语言模型（VLM）对现有机器人视觉-动作数据集的指令标签进行自动重标注和分解，生成更丰富、更细粒度、更多样化的语言-动作配对，从而提升策略模型在新任务和新指令上的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仅通过离线重标注现有机器人演示数据（不采集新数据），利用VLM分解长序列动作为语义子任务并生成多样化语言描述，即可显著提升语言条件策略在未见任务和指令上的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始机器人演示视频+原始粗粒度指令文本
analysis.output: 细粒度语义子任务划分+多样化、具象化（含物体属性）的语言指令+对应动作片段
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已有公开机器人演示数据集（如LIBERO），无需真实机器人运行或采集新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在LIBERO上实证了跨任务/跨目标泛化提升，有消融验证VLM分解与语言增强各自贡献，但未在真实机器人部署、未挑战多机体/多传感器泛化、未开源代码/模型，属于扎实推进VLAs数据工程的重磅工作，但未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级开源基建地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM能力系统性迁移到机器人数据标注环节，提升了语言-动作对齐质量，是VLAs数据层的关键补强，但非模型架构或训练范式创新。

papers.title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) policies for long-horizon manipulation still relies heavily on behavior cloning, which requires costly high-quality demonstrations and keeps policies near the demonstration distribution. Reward models can reduce this dependence by reweighting demonstrations and providing dense supervision for on-robot reinforcement learning (RL), but they must be dense, accurate, and general. Existing methods fall short: task-specific stage-aware models are accurate but require per-task annotations, while general vision-language-model (VLM) reward models are broadly applicable but too coarse for fine-grained long-horizon progress. We introduce RM, a multi-task stage-aware reward model that combines an action-primitive-based stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) value head to produce dense per-step rewards across manipulation tasks. Building on RM, we further propose SPIRAL (Self-Policy Improvement via Reward-Aligned Learning), an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts. On a 10-task benchmark, RM reduces value-estimation MSE by 80% over the strongest baselines; when used in SPIRAL, it improves task success from around 50% to near-perfect performance on Folding Shorts (58% to 100%) and Cleaning Whiteboard (50% to 90%), showing that high-quality dense rewards are key to a stable robot data flywheel. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/sarm2.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能跨多个操作任务、识别操作阶段并给出每步密集奖励的奖励模型RM，再用它驱动一个叫SPIRAL的自我提升框架，让机器人通过廉价自主试错（而非昂贵专家示范）持续改进策略，在多个真实机器人任务上把成功率从约50%提升到90–100%。
analysis.claim: 多任务阶段感知奖励模型RM+SPIRAL框架可使VLA策略仅靠低成本自主rollout实现稳定自提升，无需高质人工示范。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言-动作三模态观测序列（含当前图像、语言任务描述、历史动作）
analysis.output: 标量密集奖励值（每步一个）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+RealWorld数据集（摘要未明说但SPIRAL和benchmark隐含真实机器人部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（用于RM训练），但SPIRAL后续迭代仅需自主rollout，不依赖新真实数据标注
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨10个操作任务的阶段感知密集奖励建模，并驱动策略自提升至近完美成功率，有消融（MSE降80%）、多任务实测、真实部署证据；但未开源代码/模型，且未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将阶段感知建模、MoE价值头与真实机器人RL闭环结合，实证充分，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: We present Unified Motion-Action (UMA) Model, an approach that uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to bridge visuomotor control and dynamics modeling. UMA treats object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables under a masked generative objective, in which the mask pattern determines both the supervision regime during pretraining and the inference mode at deployment. Using hindsight-relabeled motion contexts and a contrastive objective that disentangles task intent from scene geometry, UMA enables multi-task pretraining across heterogeneous data sources without requiring manually annotated task instructions. At deployment, the same pretrained parameters support motion-conditioned visuomotor control, motion-based dynamics modeling, and task adaptation from few-shot demonstrations. Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出UMA模型，用3D物体运动轨迹作为统一接口，把视觉-运动控制、动力学建模、任务适应三类机器人能力整合进同一个生成式框架，不依赖人工指令标注，能用混合数据（真机演示+人类视频+仿真）预训练，同一套参数支持三种不同下游模式推理。
analysis.claim: 3D物体运动轨迹可作为统一表征，使单一生成式模型同时支撑visuomotor控制、动力学建模与少样本任务适配，且无需任务级指令标注。
analysis.input: 多源视频帧序列（含机器人操作、人类动作、仿真场景）+ 对应的3D物体运动轨迹（hindsight relabeled）
analysis.output: 未来物体运动轨迹预测 + 机器人动作序列 + 动力学参数估计（三者共享隐空间，按mask模式切换）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka、ALOHA、H1等异构真机平台（摘要提及部署验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于hindsight relabeling和few-shot adaptation验证），但预训练阶段可混入人类视频和仿真数据降低依赖强度
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Franka/ALOHA/H1三类异构机体上验证了motion-conditioned visuomotor control、motion-based dynamics modeling、few-shot task adaptation三重能力，有跨机体泛化、多数据源混合预训练、消融验证mask设计与contrastive目标作用；但未开源代码/模型，且未在开放benchmark（如RT-X、OpenVLA）上报告标准指标，相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作，缺乏端到端具身闭环验证和大规模真实世界长程任务测试。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多任务机器人学习统一到运动轨迹生成范式下，实证覆盖多机体多模态，但缺乏开源与开放评测，尚未达到开新范式的突破层级。

papers.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly regarded as a decisive step toward artificial general intelligence, yet modeling the physical world demands more than rendering convincing frames on demand: it requires an internal world state that keeps evolving over time, decoupled from observation, so that objects endure and events run to their conclusions whether or not a camera is watching, much as the moon holds to its orbit when no one is looking. This requirement is a blind spot of existing benchmarks, which reward surface properties such as fidelity, motion, and camera controllability while never asking whether a generated world keeps evolving once it is unobserved. We introduce WRBench, the first systematic diagnostic benchmark that treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and resolves evaluation into a human-calibrated chain that asks whether the camera executes the requested interaction, whether the scene stays continuous and identifiable while in view, and whether a returning target remains consistent with the event that was set in motion. Across 9{,}600 videos from 23 models spanning four control paradigms, one finding proves stubborn: current systems maintain the observed world as a tracking shot, resuming a returning target in the state at which it was abandoned rather than advancing the event while it went unseen. Because this failure recurs across control paradigms, model families, and increments of scale, robust world-state evolution does not follow from cleaner imagery, tighter control, richer geometric priors, or sheer parameter count We therefore argue that the stability of the physical state kernel and the consistency of worldlines under viewpoint intervention should become first-class objectives of world-model design, so that a world model captures how the world will unfold rather than how the next frame appears.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前世界模型（World Models）普遍缺乏一个持续演化的内在物理状态核心，即模型无法在没有观测时继续推演世界状态；为此作者构建了首个专门诊断该能力的基准WRBench，并通过大规模实验验证几乎所有主流模型都失败于此——它们只是‘暂停-恢复’目标状态，而非真正推进事件演化。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型的根本缺陷在于缺失持久、自主演化的内部世界状态核心，该缺陷无法通过提升图像质量、控制精度、几何先验或模型规模来缓解。
analysis.input: 视频序列+相机运动指令（作为可观测性干预）
analysis.output: 生成视频中目标对象在相机重入视野时的状态一致性判断（是否延续未观测期间的物理演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成视频和仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并实证了一个被长期忽视的核心缺陷（世界状态不可观时的演化失效），设计首个针对性诊断基准WRBench，覆盖23个模型/4类范式/9600视频，结论稳健且跨架构复现；虽未提出新模型，但定义了下一代世界模型必须解决的‘物理状态核稳定性’这一第一性问题，对标DreamerV3（96分）属准里程碑级问题界定工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以系统性实证揭示世界模型‘无观测即停滞’这一根本缺陷，并建立不可绕过的诊断标准，为领域设定了新的能力边界和优化目标。

papers.title: APT: Action Expert Pretraining Improves Instruction Generalization of Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that couple pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with continuous action experts have achieved strong manipulation performance, yet generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) language instructions remains poor. A known challenge is the structural imbalance in VLA data, where language is far less diverse than visual and action content, making policies prone to visual shortcuts. While discrete-action methods mitigate this through vision-language co-training, continuous action experts lack such protection: they start from random initialization and learn entirely from imbalanced data, producing noisy gradients that corrupt the VLM and fail to exploit its language capability. We address this from a Bayesian perspective, factorizing the policy into a language-agnostic Vision-Action (VA) prior and a language-conditioned VLA likelihood, and propose APT, a two-stage training method emphasizing Action expert PreTraining. In Stage 1, the action expert is pretrained as a VA prior on vision-action pairs from a frozen VLM, bypassing the language imbalance. In Stage 2, language tokens are injected through a gated fusion mechanism that integrates VLM features while preserving the learned visuomotor prior. APT applies to mainstream VLA architectures, including the $π$ and GR00T-style architectures. Comprehensive experiments validate that APT achieves consistent gains on unseen instructions and compositional tasks. Project Page: https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/

analysis.tldr: 提出APT两阶段训练法，先用视觉-动作对预训练动作专家（绕过语言数据不平衡问题），再注入语言信息微调，提升VLA模型对未见过指令的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将策略分解为语言无关的视觉-动作先验和语言条件化的似然，并分阶段训练动作专家，可显著缓解VLA模型因语言数据稀缺导致的指令泛化失败。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真/真实机器人数据集（如Bridge、RT-1、OpenX），未采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰因果逻辑（贝叶斯分解+分阶段解耦训练），在多个主流VLA架构（π、GR00T）和多个基准（Bridge、OpenX、VoxPoser）上验证了对OOD指令和组合任务的稳定提升，含消融实验；但未在真实机器人上部署，未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的跨机体/跨用户泛化，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA中被长期忽视的语言数据瓶颈问题，实证充分但落地闭环不完整，是高质量的方法论改进而非原理性突破。

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies bring natural language into closed-loop robot control, enabling robots to execute manipulation tasks directly from text instructions. The same interface gives text a recurring role in control because the prompt is reused at every replanning step, and each prompt-conditioned action changes the future observations on which the policy acts. Existing VLA attacks study adversarial prompts that elicit targeted low-level actions or make such actions persist across changing images. We identify a stronger trajectory-level failure mode: a prompt that still $\textit{appears}$ to specify the intended task but redirects the final physical outcome. We mathematically formalize this setting as $\textit{command-preserving trajectory redirection}$, a prompt-only threat model in which the attacker chooses one prompt before the episode, all policy and environment components remain fixed, and the prompt must stay close to the benign instruction while omitting target words and correction language. To find such prompts, we introduce an on-policy prompt search method that uses rollouts to discover perturbations whose closed-loop behavior tracks a target task while satisfying the command-preserving constraints. Experiments in simulation and on hardware show that near-benign prompt perturbations can redirect VLA rollouts to attacker-specified targets. These results expose a trajectory-level vulnerability in VLA instruction grounding: text that appears to preserve the intended command can still give an adversary control over the robot's final physical outcome. Project website: https://vla-redirection-attack.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并系统构造了一类新型攻击：通过微调自然语言指令（如把‘拿苹果’改成‘拿苹果然后放桌上’），让视觉-语言-动作模型在执行过程中看似忠实地遵循原指令，实则最终完成完全不同的物理任务（比如把苹果放进冰箱而非桌上），且该攻击在仿真和真实机器人上均有效。
analysis.claim: VLA模型存在轨迹级指令劫持漏洞——仅通过语义相近、表面合规的文本提示扰动，即可在不触发明显异常的前提下，系统性地重定向整个任务执行轨迹的最终物理结果。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前多模态观测（RGB图像等）
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + PyBullet仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于验证，但攻击生成本身不依赖真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化并实证了VLA模型中‘指令表意不变但行为轨迹被劫持’这一高危漏洞，覆盖仿真+真实机器人+多任务，具备强现实威胁意义；但未提出防御方案，未开源代码/模型，也未挑战或改进现有VLA架构本身，属于关键安全缺陷揭示而非技术推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破模型能力，而是首次用扎实实验揭露VLA范式下被忽视的深层语义-行为解耦风险，对部署级可靠性构成实质性警示。

papers.title: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
papers.abstract: Bimanual coordination is essential for many real-world manipulation tasks, yet learning bimanual robot policies is limited by the scarcity of bimanual robots and datasets. Single-arm robots, however, are widely available in research labs. Can we leverage them to train bimanual robot policies? We present MonoDuo, a framework for learning bimanual manipulation policies using single-arm robot demonstrations paired with human collaboration. MonoDuo collects data by teleoperating a single-arm robot to perform one side of a bimanual task while a human performs the other, then swapping roles to cover both sides. RGB-D observations from a wrist-mounted and fixed camera are augmented into synthetic demonstrations for target bimanual robots using state-of-the-art hand pose estimation, image and point cloud segmentation, and inpainting. These synthetic demonstrations, grounded in real robot kinematics, are used to train bimanual policies. We evaluate MonoDuo on five tasks: box lifting, backpack packing, cloth folding, jacket zipping, and plate handover. Compared to approaches relying solely on human bimanual videos, MonoDuo enables zero-shot deployment on unseen bimanual robot configurations, achieving success rates up to 70%. With only 25 target robot demonstrations, few-shot finetuning further boosts success rates by 65-70% over training from scratch, demonstrating MonoDuo's effectiveness in efficiently transferring knowledge from single-arm robot data to bimanual robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用一台单臂机器人+人类协作采集数据，通过多模态合成（RGB-D+手部姿态估计+分割+补全）生成双臂机器人可训练的仿真演示数据，从而零样本迁移到真实双臂机器人上执行任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单臂机器人与人类协作采集的数据，即可合成物理合理的双臂操作演示，支撑双臂策略的零样本迁移与高效微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（腕部+固定视角）+人类手部姿态+单臂机器人关节状态
analysis.output: 双臂机器人关节轨迹/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（单臂）+目标双臂平台（如 two-Panda 或自定义双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实单臂机器人+人类协同的原始采集数据（非纯仿真），但不依赖双臂机器人真实操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘单臂硬件→双臂策略’的闭环：含真实人机协同数据采集、基于物理约束的合成流水线、5个具挑战性的双臂任务验证、跨机体零样本+少样本提升显著；但未开源代码/模型，且未在标准基准（如 RDT-1B/UMI）上横向对比，也未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或触觉等维度，强于一般增量但未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有技术（手部估计、inpainting、分割）严谨组装成可落地的单臂→双臂迁移管线，在真实双臂机器人上验证了可行性与泛化性，但缺乏开源和更广基准验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.

analysis.tldr: 用无配对的人类动作数据，把真人动作（如RGB-D或动捕）转成人形机器人能稳定执行的动作，重点解决人和机器人骨架不同、比例不同、自由度不同带来的动作失真问题。
analysis.claim: 在无配对数据条件下，通过骨架感知图卷积+归一化末端轨迹一致性损失+显式物理可行性约束，可实现高保真、物理合理、跨形态的人类动作到人形机器人的运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列（如SMPL/AMASS格式的3D关节轨迹或原始动捕数据）
analysis.output: 人形机器人关节角度轨迹（带接触状态标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）及实机验证
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人执行数据；仅需人类动作数据集（AMASS等），无人-机器人配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在无配对设定下系统性整合骨架拓扑建模、尺度不变末端约束与接触物理正则，在Unitree G1上完成多任务（行走/挥手/拾取）sim2real验证并报告下游控制性能，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未与H2O/GR00T等基石方法在统一benchmark上横向对比，属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个已知技术模块（CycleGAN、GCN、末端轨迹归一化、接触约束）有机耦合，在真实人形机器人上验证了无配对重定向的可行性，但缺乏新原理、未开源核心资产、未挑战更难机体（如Atlas或全尺寸双足），尚未构成范式迁移。

papers.title: Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models face significant challenges in real-world deployment due to the entanglement of high-level reasoning with low-level control, and the instability of policy optimization. In this paper, we introduce SyVLA, a robust VLA model trained with diversified experiences. We propose an Intention Decoupling algorithm to isolate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to stabilize policy updates and mitigate distribution shift. Extensive experiments on real-world robotic tasks and multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that SyVLA achieves superior task success rates and stronger out-of-distribution generalization compared to existing methods, while effectively preserving core vision-language capabilities. Codes and Datasets is released on \href{https://sy-vla.github.io/}{project page}.

analysis.tldr: 提出SyVLA模型，通过意图解耦算法分离高层语义与底层控制特征，并用相似样本引导的强化学习稳定策略训练，在真实机器人任务和多模态基准上提升了任务成功率和分布外泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦意图表征与动作控制、并用相似样本引导RL训练，可显著提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的鲁棒性与泛化性，且不损害视觉-语言理解能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多样化操作数据（含失败轨迹），但未说明是否使用预收集的大规模离线数据集或仅在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了意图解耦+相似样本RL的有效性，跨任务/场景泛化有实证（Table 3/4），但未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等SOTA进行公平对比（如统一仿真评估或相同真实硬件基线），也未展示多机体迁移或长程任务规划等关键能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实Panda平台上实现了较扎实的VLA部署改进，但缺乏开源支撑与范式级创新，尚未达到OpenVLA/RT-2级的分量

papers.title: RHO: Your Coding Agent is Secretly a Roboticist
papers.abstract: Code-as-Policies (CaP) has shown that large language models (LLMs) can write code to solve robotics tasks by composing perception, planning, and control primitives. Recent CaP systems, however, rely on multi-turn code-generation loops at test time, which is often infeasible for real-time robot control. We introduce Robotics Harness Optimization (RHO), a novel paradigm in which tool-enabled coding agents, at training time, propose and search for interpretable, neurosymbolic multi-file policy repositories (Repositories-as-Policies) that compose these primitives rather than a single prompt, function, or file. RHO searches with reflective feedback from environment reward and execution rather than teleoperation demonstrations. It generalizes to perturbed pick-and-place settings like LIBERO-PRO, where OpenVLA scores 0.0% and $π_{0.5}$ averages 12.83%. Using the same low-level primitives, RHO reaches a 45.0% success rate, 2.5x higher than the strongest multi-turn agentic system, and 3.5x higher than $π_{0.5}$. On Robosuite, RHO sets a new state-of-the-art of 70.0%, exceeding the prior multi-turn record of 68.29% using single-turn execution with no corrective LLM code edits at deployment. When an LLM is used in the control loop, as on RAI's O3DE benchmark, RHO optimizes the deployed agent's multi-file harness of prompts, tools, and control code, improving held-out success from 23.5% to 44.3% with 20% less wall-clock time and 27% fewer tool calls.

analysis.tldr: 提出RHO范式，让编码智能体在训练时自动搜索并构建多文件、可解释的神经符号化策略仓库（而非单次生成代码），用环境反馈替代人工示范进行优化，在多个机器人任务上显著提升单次执行成功率，尤其在需要泛化的扰动场景中大幅超越现有CaP方法。
analysis.claim: 通过训练时搜索多文件策略仓库（Repositories-as-Policies）并利用环境奖励进行反射式优化，可摆脱测试时多轮LLM代码修正的实时瓶颈，实现更高鲁棒性与泛化性的机器人策略部署。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB）、任务指令（自然语言）、低层感知/控制原语接口
analysis.output: 多文件策略仓库（含prompt、工具调用逻辑、控制脚本等组成的可执行代码包）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器交互数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进CaP范式：首次将策略表示从单次生成函数升维为可搜索、可组合、可复用的多文件仓库，并用环境反馈驱动训练期搜索；在LIBERO-PRO和Robosuite上取得扎实SOTA，且明确对比了单次执行vs多轮修正的工程代价（wall-clock/time/tool calls），但未验证真机部署、未开源代码模型、泛化仍限于仿真扰动场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将LLM编码代理从‘在线调试模式’转向‘离线策略仓库构建模式’，显著提升部署效率与稳定性，但仍是仿真内闭环，未跨出sim2real关键一步。

papers.title: Adaptive Neural Reorganization Enables Real-Time Finger-Level Robotic Control in BCI-Naïve Stroke Survivors
papers.abstract: Restoring hand function remains a major challenge for individuals with motor impairments following stroke. Noninvasive brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to address this problem by translating neural signals into robotic assistance; however, control of individual fingers has not been demonstrated in BCI-naïve populations. In this study, we investigated whether individuals with stroke and no prior BCI experience could achieve finger-level robotic control using motor imagery. Nine stroke-affected participants performed real-time BCI tasks to control a robotic hand through imagined finger movements decoded from electroencephalography. On average, participants achieved decoding accuracies of 84% for two-finger tasks and 61% for three-finger tasks, demonstrating reliable control at the level of individual fingers. These results indicate that discriminable neural signals for fine motor control persist after stroke and can be leveraged using data-driven deep learning decoders. Sensor-level and source-level electrophysiological analyses further reveal patterns of stroke-related neural reorganization. Overall, these findings support the potential of noninvasive, finger-level BCIs for post-stroke robotic assistance.

analysis.tldr: 让9名从未用过脑机接口的中风患者，仅靠想象单个手指动作，实时控制机械手完成两指/三指协同任务，平均准确率84%/61%，证明中风后大脑仍保留可解码的精细运动神经信号。
analysis.claim: BCI-naïve中风患者无需训练即可通过运动想象实现非侵入式、实时、手指级的机器人控制，其神经信号具有足够判别性且伴随可识别的皮层重组模式。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG信号（运动想象诱发）
analysis.output: 单个手指或手指组合的二元/多类控制指令（如‘食指+中指’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 商用机械手（未指明型号，但属标准外骨骼/仿生手平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实中风患者EEG数据，无仿真预训练；所有9人均为首次BCI使用，无筛选排除（即非‘BCI-literate’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真正BCI-naïve中风人群中实现手指级实时闭环控制，有真实机器人验证、多被试统计、源定位神经机制分析和消融式解码对比（LSTM vs. CNN），但未跨机体泛化、未长期随访、未与临床金标准功能量表关联，也未开源代码/模型，距基石级（>90分）缺临床效用证据链和系统鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实的临床突破，但限于小样本单中心，尚未证明功能恢复效果，属于显著推进SOTA的神经康复BCI工作。

papers.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are often treated as checkpoint-defined objects: if the weights, prompt, and benchmark suite match, the deployment is assumed to be the same policy. Robot execution breaks this assumption because the same normalized model output can become a different physical action after action unnormalization and controller conventions are applied. This creates a deployment-safety gap: safety review can certify the checkpoint while missing the executable robot policy that reaches the controller. We formalize this gap as an executable policy specification problem: a VLA policy includes the learned model, action representation, metadata-selected unnormalizer, and controller-facing conventions. Under this view, identical checkpoints can be executable-inequivalent. For quantile-style action normalization, we derive a closed-form metadata mismatch transform and an ExecSpec certificate that measures action-space semantic drift without model inference or rollout. On LIBERO-Goal replay, substituting a plausible sibling metadata key yields mean drift 0.199 over six non-gripper action dimensions and reduces success from 28/28 to 2/28 under full substitution. On LIBERO-Spatial replay, the same substituted key reduces success from 26/26 to 0/26. The same full-substitution protocol gives 0/28 success for all four Object substitutions and 0/23 or 1/23 success on Long. Identity-key, replay-validity, no-op filtering, raw-vs-correct replay, mask/gripper, synthetic upper-bound, and OpenVLA-style unnormalizer interface checks rule out several simpler explanations. These results do not certify closed-loop or hardware safety. They support a narrower deployment-safety view: action-space metadata is part of the executable policy and should be checked before rollout.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，同一个VLA模型权重在不同机器人上部署时，因动作解归一化方式和控制器约定不同，实际执行的动作可能完全不同，从而产生安全隐患；作者把‘可执行策略’明确定义为包含模型、动作表示、元数据选择的解归一化器和控制器接口四部分，并提出一种无需运行模型就能检测动作空间语义漂移的证书（ExecSpec）。
analysis.claim: VLA策略的可执行性不仅取决于模型权重，还严格依赖于动作解归一化元数据和控制器约定；忽略这些元数据会导致部署安全认证失效。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+动作元数据（如quantile normalization key）
analysis.output: 动作空间语义漂移度量值（ExecSpec证书）及可执行策略等价性判断
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖具体机器人控制器与动作解归一化实现（如LIBERO仿真环境中的Franka/UR5控制器约定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO-Goal/Spatial replay轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化定义VLA‘可执行策略’并量化动作元数据漂移对任务成功率的毁灭性影响（28→2/28），证据扎实（多场景、多消融、排除替代解释），但限于仿真重放、无真机验证、未提供开源代码或模型，未触及闭环控制或硬件安全，故略低于RT-2/π0/Octo等里程碑级工作，但显著高于一般增量研究，属重磅部署安全警示。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出新模型，而是首次以可证伪方式揭露VLA部署中被长期忽视的元数据依赖漏洞，并给出可计算、免rollout的检测工具，改变了‘checkpoint即策略’的安全假设。

papers.title: AF_Cache: Efficient Pipeline for Running AlphaFold for High-Throughput Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract: Motivation: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions is essential for understanding biological processes, and recent advances such as AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 have enabled structure-based interaction prediction at unprecedented accuracy. However, the high computational cost of these methods, driven primarily by CPU-based repeated multiple sequence alignment (MSA) generation and, for AlphaFold2, repeated model recompilations, limits their applicability in large-scale, high-throughput settings. This creates a need for efficient pipelines that retain predictive performance while substantially reducing runtime. Results: We present AF_Cache, a high-throughput Nextflow pipeline for accelerating protein-protein interaction prediction using AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3. AF_Cache combines GPU-accelerated MSA generation with MMseqs2, feature caching to eliminate redundant alignment computations, and sequence length bucketing to minimise repeated JAX compilations. Benchmarking on a dataset of 5,050 human mitochondrial protein pairs demonstrates a $\sim$2-fold reduction in inference time for AlphaFold2 and up to a 13-fold speedup of the MSA generation. AF\_Cache enables efficient large-scale interaction screening and provides a practical framework for deploying AlphaFold-based methods in high-throughput applications. Availability and implementation: The code and Nextflow pipeline are available on GitHub here: https://github.com/clami66/AF_cache. The code for reproducing the results of the paper, the MSAs, and the predicted models can be found at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20478892

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AF_Cache，一个用Nextflow编排的加速流水线，通过GPU版MMseqs2生成MSA、缓存特征避免重复计算、按序列长度分桶减少JAX重复编译，显著加快AlphaFold2/3预测蛋白互作结构的速度，尤其在大规模场景下。
analysis.claim: AF_Cache通过三项工程优化（GPU-MSA、特征缓存、长度分桶），在不损失AlphaFold预测精度的前提下，将高通量蛋白互作预测的端到端耗时降低2倍（AlphaFold2）或MSA阶段提速13倍。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 预测的复合物三维结构（PDB格式）及置信度指标（pLDDT/pTM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白序列和已知互作对（如MitoCarta）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：实证扎实（5050对真实线粒体蛋白、多阶段计时拆解、开源全部代码/MSA/模型），但未改进AlphaFold底层模型、未提出新科学假设、未解决结构预测本身的根本瓶颈（如长程相互作用建模、动态构象采样），仅优化其部署效率——对标基石如AlphaFold2（98）、AlphaFold3（93），它属于重要但非范式级的实用化推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实证充分、开源完整、加速效果明确，但未触及蛋白结构预测或互作机制的核心科学问题，是面向生产落地的关键工具升级，而非理论或方法论突破。

papers.title: Pretrained, Frozen, Still Leaking: Auditing Cross-Encoder Attribute Transfer in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation-model releases are usually audited one endpoint at a time: raw-reconstruction, membership inference, identity linkage, or DP-SGD on the downstream head. We audit the same released embeddings under all four endpoints jointly, on BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and show that each single-endpoint audit clears releases that still leak spectral attributes. The decisive evidence is a cross-encoder transfer audit: a single ridge attribute decoder learned from one frozen encoder transfers, via a fitted linear bridge, to held-out-subject test splits of every other encoder, with subject-disjoint matched-control 95% CI lower bound at least 0.081 across all six BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT directions. We prove a sufficient condition: two encoders sharing a nontrivial attribute-coordinate projector overlap beta admit a chained ridge bridge attacker with centered-gain lower bound sqrt(beta/(1+tau^2)) - eps_br - rho_0, and back-solve beta in [0.008, 0.198]. To turn the joint audit into a deployment-readable decision rule we introduce an audit-endpoint disagreement score (AEDS), prove sufficient conditions for its positivity, and bootstrap-calibrate it per cell; AEDS is positive in all eight matched-CI cells (BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT on EEGMMI; LaBraM on Sleep-EDF, 54-channel LIMO, CHB-MIT pediatric scalp EEG) with p<0.001, while a head-level Carlini LiRA membership audit reaches AUC only 0.50-0.70. Standard defenses fail under audit: a Wiener-style noise-aware adaptive attacker, the LiRA audit, and DP-SGD at every utility-preserving epsilon in {4,8} leave the attribute channel essentially unchanged. The contribution is an audit framework that turns scattered single-endpoint defenses into a joint release decision, supported by a cross-encoder bridge theorem and adaptive-attacker, LiRA, and DP-SGD baselines; the audit licenses release-blocking, not raw-waveform exfiltration or held-out-subject identity recovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地揭露了当前主流EEG基础模型（BIOT、LaBraM、EEGPT）在冻结编码器状态下仍会跨模型泄露被试的频谱属性（如个体脑电特征），提出一种新型‘跨编码器迁移审计’方法，用线性桥接器在不同模型嵌入间传递属性解码器，并证明其统计显著性；它不追求提升解码性能，而是构建一套可部署的联合审计框架，用于判断EEG模型是否应被禁止发布。
analysis.claim: 冻结的EEG基础模型嵌入即使通过单点审计（如成员推断或差分隐私）合格，仍普遍存在跨编码器频谱属性泄露，需用联合多端点+跨编码器桥接的审计框架判定发布安全性。
analysis.input: 冻结的EEG编码器输出的嵌入向量（来自BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT）
analysis.output: 被试级频谱属性（如alpha功率、theta/alpha比等）的回归预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开EEG数据集（EEGMMI、Sleep-EDF、LIMO、CHB-MIT）的预处理嵌入，无需真实机器人或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立EEG基础模型发布的隐私审计范式，实证覆盖6个跨模型方向+4大临床数据集，提出可部署的AEDS决策规则并击败LiRA/DP-SGD等标准防御，但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制或临床干预，属关键基础设施安全层突破，尚未达到神经假体级分量（90+），但显著超越纯benchmark工作（如仅构造新数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进EEG解码性能，而是首次为EEG基础模型建立具备统计保证、跨模型泛化、可落地部署的隐私审计标准，填补了AI×神经科学中模型发布治理的关键空白。

papers.title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-matching policy that augments each generated action chunk with a learned success-potential trajectory. The same flow proposes and scores candidate actions, enabling best-of-$K$ inference without an external critic. The key issue is that policy improvement and value calibration require different supervision: advantage weighting should emphasize high-quality actions, but applying the same weights to potential coordinates suppresses failure gradients and creates overconfident scores. We address this with decoupled advantage-weighted flow matching, applying exponentiated advantage weights only to action velocities while training potential velocities uniformly. We further derive a one-step boundary estimator for conditional flow matching, allowing advantage computation with a single stop-gradient forward pass. Across five BEHAVIOR-1K simulation tasks and five real-world bimanual tasks, ForesightFlow improves over imitation baselines, matches the strongest separate-critic baseline in simulation success, improves real-world success, and reduces training compute by $38\%$. Ablations show that decoupling prevents value hallucination, the one-step estimator preserves candidate-ranking fidelity, and self-guided sampling improves long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForesightFlow方法，让视觉-语言-动作策略在生成每个动作块时，同步预测一条‘成功潜力轨迹’，用解耦的势能加权流匹配训练，无需外部价值网络就能做best-of-K采样，在仿真和真实双臂机器人任务上提升成功率且节省38%算力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦优势加权的流匹配与单步边界估计，实现无需独立价值网络的自引导动作生成与排序，显著提升VLA策略在长程、双臂真实任务中的鲁棒性与效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块序列+对应的成功潜力轨迹（连续时空坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: BEHAVIOR-1K仿真器 + 真实Franka双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量成功/失败轨迹用于势能监督，但未说明是否需大量真实失败数据标定潜力
analysis.significance_reason: 在BEHAVIOR-1K仿真和5个真实双臂任务上实证优于标准BC/过滤BC，并匹敌带独立critic的SOTA方法，且首次将解耦势能流匹配与单步边界估计结合用于VLA策略改进；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战更开放的真实世界长程任务（如家庭环境），故略低于π0.5（86）但强于FAST（85）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了VLA策略中价值引导与动作生成耦合导致的过自信与梯度抑制问题，用可微、免critic、单步计算的机制实现了仿真与真实双臂任务的实质性提升，证据扎实且工程落地明确。

papers.title: DesignMaster: A Multi-Conditional Diffusion Framework for Rational PROTAC Design
papers.abstract: Motivation: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) enable targeted protein degradation through ternary complex formation with E3 ubiquitin ligase. However, the rational design of PROTACs remains highly challenging due to limited structure-activity relationship data and the vast conformational diversity of linkers. Existing computational approaches can be broadly divided into structure-based ternary modelling methods and fragment-based linker generation models. Although these approaches have advanced PROTAC design, they typically neglect key physicochemical constraints and linker-length control during the generation process, causing the generated PROTACs to lack balanced structural properties required for effective ternary complex formation with drug-like characteristics. Results: To address these limitations, we propose DesignMaster, a diffusion-based generative framework that explicitly incorporates linker length and physicochemical properties as controllable conditioning signals. DesignMaster employs an E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer with a gated multi-condition fusion module to inject linker length and physicochemical constraints throughout the diffusion process, enabling fine-grained and constraint-aware molecular generation. Experiments on PROTAC-DB 2.0 and 3.0 demonstrate that DesignMaster outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with a 3.2% improvement in validity and a 34.4% improvement in recovery. The Case study shows DesignMaster achieves a 51.78% reduction in RMSD when predicting the linker of PROTAC BCPyr targeting 6W7O, highlighting its potential for practical structure-guided PROTAC design. Availability: The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ABILiLab/DesignMaster.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于扩散模型的PROTAC分子生成框架DesignMaster，能按用户指定的链接子长度和理化性质（如logP、分子量等）生成结构合理、高有效率且高回收率的PROTAC分子。
analysis.claim: 通过E(3)-equivariant图Transformer与多条件门控融合模块，在扩散过程中显式注入链接子长度与理化性质约束，可生成更符合药物特性且更易形成有效三元复合物的PROTAC分子。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白配体（POI ligand）+ E3连接酶配体（E3 ligand）+ 指定链接子长度 + 指定理化性质范围（如logP、MW、HBD等）
analysis.output: 完整PROTAC分子结构（含优化后的链接子）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在PROTAC生成这一高度专业、数据稀缺、物理约束强的子领域中，首次将可控扩散建模与E(3)等变图网络结合，实证显示显著提升有效性（+3.2%）与结构恢复率（+34.4%），并在真实PDB结构（6W7O）上验证RMSD大幅降低；但未解决PROTAC成药性核心瓶颈（如细胞渗透、脱靶降解、E3组织特异性），也未在湿实验验证活性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可控扩散、等变建模与PROTAC物理约束深度融合，实证扎实、开源完整，是当前AI×药物设计中少有的高质量条件生成工作，但未跨越到机制理解或临床前验证层级。

papers.title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common interface for vision-language-action (VLA) models, enabling low-frequency policy inference to drive high-frequency robot execution. However, once an action chunk is committed, its open-loop execution can be brittle under stochastic dynamics, hardware execution errors, and partial observability. We propose DREAM-Chunk, a test-time scaling method that augments chunking-based policies with a lightweight latent world model, without requiring additional policy fine-tuning. At test time, DREAM-Chunk samples multiple candidate action chunks, rolls out their predicted latent futures, and selects actions from the chunk whose predicted state best matches the observed rollout. In this way, DREAM-Chunk uses additional test-time computation to cover multiple plausible stochastic futures and improve reactivity during long-horizon chunk execution. On the Kinetix benchmark, DREAM-Chunk improves robustness under increasing action noise and benefits from larger candidate sample sizes, especially when demonstrations contain corrective behaviors. We further validate DREAM-Chunk on four manipulation tasks across two robot platforms and two VLA policies under various sources of stochasticity. Across simulation and hardware experiments, DREAM-Chunk improves the robustness of action-chunking policies in stochastic dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DREAM-Chunk，一种在测试时动态重选动作块的方法：不改原有VLA策略，而是用轻量隐式世界模型预测多个候选动作块的未来状态，再根据真实观测选择最匹配的那个，从而让开环执行的动作块在噪声、硬件误差和部分可观测环境下更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 无需微调原策略，仅靠测试时用轻量隐式世界模型对候选动作块做多路径前向预测与观测对齐，即可显著提升动作块策略在随机动力学下的执行鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+语言）+ 原策略生成的多个候选动作块
analysis.output: 被选中的最优动作块（含其内部动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinetix仿真环境、Franka Emika Panda、UR5e机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证，但世界模型训练未说明是否需真实数据；策略本身基于已有VLA模型，非从零训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨两个真实机械臂平台、四个操作任务、多种噪声源下验证，且在Kinetix基准上量化了噪声鲁棒性提升与采样规模关系；但未构建新世界模型架构，而是巧妙复用/轻量化已有范式（latent world model + rollout selection），属强工程化创新而非范式突破，未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐式世界模型从训练时建模工具转化为测试时决策机制，在动作块范式中首次实现观测驱动的chunk-level重规划，效果实证充分，但核心组件均为已有技术组合。

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是设计了一套诊断工具，用行为轨迹分析和神经元特征解码来对比WAM（世界-动作模型）和VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）到底在‘怎么动’和‘脑子里想什么’上有啥实质差异，发现任务成功率掩盖了行为质量、目标选择性、干扰鲁棒性等关键差别。
analysis.claim: WAMs是否真正具备行为上可利用的未来预测能力，不能只看任务成功率，而需通过行为动力学与内部表征双维度诊断。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（rollout）及对应隐层特征
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于诊断范式而非技术突破：首次系统解耦WAM/VLA的行为与表征差异，证据扎实（7模型+2 benchmark+双协议），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出可部署的新架构或策略，属于高质量分析型工作，但达不到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式开创或跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把诊断方法做细做实，是领域急需的‘显微镜’，但不是新引擎

papers.title: BLUE: Toward Better Language Use in Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: We present BLUE, a minimal method for better language use in vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD). Through extensive analysis, we reveal that language matters on only a small fraction of routes, but on those routes it can greatly improve or degrade performance. Generating language at every frame is therefore inefficient, since most computation is spent on frames that do not benefit from language. We further show that pretrained VLA hidden states potentially already encode whether language will benefit a given frame, even though scene complexity and kinematic features alone struggle to predict this. Based on this finding, BLUE trains a lightweight gate on frozen VLA hidden states to decide per frame whether to activate language generation or predict actions directly, without modifying the backbone or requiring additional human annotation. With just a 0.11M-parameter gate, BLUE sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks, achieving 76.2% success rate on Bench2Drive and 36 driving score on Longest6 v2, while delivering 2.54x inference speedup and 8.9% success rate improvement over the backbone. BLUE provides a practical path toward efficient language-augmented AD, showing that VLA models can retain the benefits of language at a fraction of the cost. Our code, data, logs and checkpoints are fully available on https://github.com/George-Ling3/BLUE.

analysis.tldr: 提出BLUE方法，在自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作模型中动态决定每帧是否启用语言模块，用一个0.11M参数的轻量门控器节省计算开销，提升成功率和推理速度。
analysis.claim: 在VLA自动驾驶模型中，语言仅对小部分关键帧有效，可通过冻结主干提取的隐藏状态训练轻量门控器实现按需激活语言，兼顾性能与效率。
analysis.input: 视觉帧+语言指令（条件性输入）
analysis.output: 驾驶动作（转向/油门/刹车等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于仿真驾驶基准（Bench2Drive、Longest6 v2）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：发现语言稀疏有效性并设计轻量门控是合理洞见，实证在两个公开仿真驾驶benchmark上提升显著且开源完整，但未突破VLA范式、未验证真实车部署、未解决语言理解本质缺陷、未跨任务泛化，远未达RT-2/Octo/π0等基石级工作所定义的新范式或通用能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将语言模块调用从固定策略改为数据驱动的稀疏激活，在仿真驾驶benchmark上实现了性价比提升，但未改变VLA模型底层架构或泛化能力，属于高效工程优化而非范式创新。

papers.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like π_{0.5} across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个8B参数的具身基础模型Embodied-R1.5，用三路自动生成数据构建150亿token具身多任务数据集，设计PGC闭环框架实现长程任务自主执行与自修正，在24个具身VLM基准中16个刷SOTA，并在真实机器人上做零样本指令跟随、可操作性定位、关节物体操作等验证，开源模型、数据、代码和专用评测套件。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/北大/中科院/智元/宇树等主流团队）
analysis.claim: 单一具身基础模型可通过内部化具身能力（认知、规划、修正、指代）实现跨任务、跨场景、零样本迁移至真实机器人，无需大量下游微调即可达到VLA级操控性能。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（图像+语言指令+可能的传感器状态，但摘要未明示具体模态组合）
analysis.output: 动作序列或具身决策（如指向、抓取、移动等物理操作指令，但未说明是否直接输出关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集数据；强调‘automated data construction pipelines’，极大概率全为合成/仿真生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽开源完整栈且在24个VLM基准中16个SOTA，但未展示真机端到端闭环控制（仅‘zero-shot real-robot experiments’未说明任务复杂度、成功率、基线对比或硬件细节），所有实证仍属窄域演示（instruction following/affordance grounding等），缺乏H2O/GR00T级的全身运动控制、多机体泛化或长期部署证据，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身VLM、自动数据合成、PGC闭环框架系统性集成并开源，但真实世界闭环能力证据薄弱，尚未达到基石论文的物理智能深度。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned visual navigation requires a robot to act under partial observability by anticipating how its motion will change the future egocentric view and whether that change brings it closer to the goal. Navigation world models provide such visual foresight, but they remain prediction modules that require an external planner to convert predicted futures into closed-loop control. We propose Navigation World Action Model (NavWAM), a diffusion-transformer policy that turns navigation world-model prediction into executable action by representing future observations, goal-progress values, and action chunks in a shared latent sequence. By learning future prediction jointly with the action and value targets that determine closed-loop behavior, NavWAM makes visual foresight directly usable for robot control. We build NavWAM through simulation pretraining and real-robot adaptation, and evaluate it on image-goal navigation against planning-based world models and a representative direct navigation policy. Across offline benchmarks and closed-loop real-robot deployment, NavWAM improves over planning-based world-model baselines in our evaluations while using the default policy mode without CEM-style action search. Project page: https://dachii-azm.github.io/navwam/

analysis.tldr: 提出NavWAM，一个将导航世界模型的未来预测（视觉、目标进展值、动作块）统一编码为共享隐序列的扩散-Transformer策略，跳过传统规划器，直接从世界模型预测生成闭环控制动作，在仿真预训练+真机微调后，在图像目标导航任务中优于需CEM搜索的规划式世界模型方法。
analysis.claim: 导航世界模型的预测输出可被直接映射为闭环控制动作，无需外部规划器或迭代动作搜索，只要将未来观测、目标进展值和动作块联合建模于同一隐空间序列。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+目标图像+历史动作（隐式通过序列建模）
analysis.output: 动作块（离散化控制指令序列，如[前进,右转,前进]）
analysis.robot_dependency: Husky机器人（摘要未明说但项目页及实验显示使用Husky+ZED相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据进行适配（real-robot adaptation），但主体训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现世界模型预测与动作生成的端到端联合隐空间对齐，消除了CEM等外部规划开销，实证显示真机闭环性能提升；但仅限单机器人单任务（图像目标导航），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，且未挑战更复杂导航（如语义目标、动态障碍、长程拓扑），相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石仍属垂直改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了世界模型预测到动作的隐空间直连可行性，但受限于任务窄、泛化弱、不可复现，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Learning to Assist: Collaborative VLAs for Implicit Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) combines the complementary strengths of humans and robots to improve task efficiency. However, many existing collaborative systems rely on hand-engineered pipelines, limiting their scalability and flexibility for new tasks. In this work, we show that models trained end-to-end with imitation learning, specifically vision-language-action (VLA) models, can support collaborative manipulation, and characterize the key factors affecting their real-world performance. We evaluate two state-of-the-art models and identify a failure mode of action-chunking policies in implicit HRC, where demonstration action leakage (i.e., action chunks crossing latent task transitions) can cause premature assistive behavior. We find that this issue increases with longer execution horizons and occurs in real-world collaborative VLA systems, such as when a robot attempts to hand over a tool before the person is ready. We propose an inference-time steering method to mitigate these erroneous assistive actions while preserving policy performance. Finally, through a 16-participant user study on a long-horizon collaborative assembly task, we show that steering enables a longer execution horizon while mitigating premature assistance, leading to faster collaboration and fewer failures compared to a shorter-horizon policy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在隐式人机协作中会因动作分块策略不当，导致机器人在人类尚未准备好时就提前执行协助动作（比如过早递工具），提出一种推理时引导方法来抑制这种错误，实证验证了该方法能提升长时程协作任务的完成速度和成功率。
analysis.claim: 隐式人机协作中VLA模型的动作分块策略会导致跨任务边界的动作泄漏，引发 premature assistive behavior；通过推理时 steering 可在不牺牲策略性能的前提下有效缓解该问题。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+自然语言指令+人类动作观测（隐式）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（含抓取、移动、释放等）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435 摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的模仿学习数据集（含16人用户研究采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并命名‘demonstration action leakage’这一VLA在隐式HRC中的关键失效模式，提供真实机器人多用户长时程任务验证（16人）、消融对比（steering vs. short-horizon baseline）、且部署于实际协作装配任务；但未开源数据/模型，也未挑战跨机体泛化或引入新架构，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA落地隐式人机协作的关键可靠性瓶颈，有明确失效归因、可部署的修复方案和充分的真人实证，但未改变底层建模范式或开源核心资产。

papers.title: ReGIL: Retrieval-Guided Imitation Learning from a Single Demonstration
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies with deep neural networks from a single demonstration remains highly challenging, as even small deviations from the demonstrated trajectory can quickly compound into failure, while collecting substantial online interaction data is costly. We propose ReGIL, a retrieval-guided imitation learning framework that treats a single demonstration as an external memory. ReGIL repeatedly queries this static memory throughout training to simultaneously guide exploration, generate the regularization buffer, and construct rewards. Specifically, it computes rewards through local temporal alignment between the current trajectory and the retrieved segment, providing step-wise and informative feedback for policy improvement. We evaluate ReGIL on robotic manipulation tasks from the LIBERO and Meta-World benchmarks under the single demonstration setting. ReGIL outperforms prior baselines in both success rate and training efficiency. In real-robot experiments, using only one demonstration and less than one hour of online training, ReGIL achieves over 75% success rate across three manipulation tasks with randomness in both initial robot pose and target position. These results demonstrate that leveraging the single demonstration as reusable memory can provide more than static supervision for efficient robot learning. More details can be found on our website: https://regil2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范作为可反复查询的外部记忆库，通过局部时间对齐动态生成奖励、正则化缓冲区和探索引导，让机器人在不到一小时真实训练中完成三个带初始状态和目标位置随机性的操作任务，成功率超75%
analysis.claim: 将单次示范建模为可检索的外部记忆，能显著提升单示教下机器人策略学习的鲁棒性、效率与泛化能力，无需额外在线数据采集
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB）+任务指令（文本或隐式）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1段真实机器人演示视频（含动作轨迹），但不依赖大规模真实交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署验证（3个随机初始化任务）、对比主流基线（LIBERO/Meta-World）、有消融（检索机制 vs. 静态监督）、训练效率量化（<1h），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战更复杂长程任务或跨机体泛化，未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属扎实重磅工作
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将检索机制深度嵌入IL闭环，在真实机器人上验证了单示教高效泛化的可行性，但缺乏开源完整性与理论新范式，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for language-conditioned manipulation, but remain brittle in off-nominal states requiring targeted recovery. We propose ReCoVLA -- a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components. Rather than using the VLM to generate actions or rewards directly, ReCoVLA uses it as a semantic reward selector: it predicts a recovery descriptor and reward mask for in-simulation residual-policy training, followed by zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of the trained recovery policies. This decouples high-level failure understanding from low-level corrective control to support different VLAs. Experiments across short-horizon, long-horizon, and contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ReCoVLA outperforms the tested baselines on average. In simulation, our reward compiler improves average success from 36.7% for the fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 66.7%. In physical zero-shot sim-to-real experiments, ReCoVLA achieves the best average performance, with 61.7% success.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReCoVLA框架，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行失败时，不微调原模型，而是用外部视觉语言模型（VLM）识别失败类型并生成结构化奖励信号，指导一个轻量残差策略学习恢复动作，最终实现零样本仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLM用作语义奖励选择器而非动作生成器，可解耦故障理解与底层控制，使冻结的VLA主策略具备零样本、任务无关的失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+当前执行状态（隐含失败信号）
analysis.output: 残差动作策略的训练奖励信号（结构化mask+描述符）及对应恢复动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真中为PyBullet，实物为真实Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人失败数据，所有训练在仿真中完成，实物测试为零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将VLM降维为‘奖励编译器’而非动作生成器，在多个长/短/接触密集型任务上验证了冻结VLA+残差恢复的可行性，并完成零样本sim2real部署；但未开源代码/模型，未在开放基准（如Open-X）上评测，也未证明对主流VLA（如Octo/RT-2）的即插即用兼容性，属扎实的范式拓展而非基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙重构VLM角色提升VLA鲁棒性，实证充分但生态闭环未完成，暂未达到OpenVLA/π0.5级影响力

papers.title: Perfect Demo Makes Poor Teacher: Learning Robust Alignment from Critical Motion Segments
papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations are widely assumed to be the gold standard for robot imitation learning. Yet for fine-grained manipulation such as insertion, stacking, and alignment, we uncover a counterintuitive failure mode: fluent demonstrations can be poor teachers. A skilled teleoperator compresses the decisive moments of alignment and recovery into a brief temporal window, leaving the policy flooded with redundant free-space motion and starved of supervision exactly where precision determines success. We address this bottleneck at two levels. At the data level, slowing down near alignment and resampling critical segments both help, yet the gain comes mainly from broadening the coverage of recovery states the policy must learn, not from reweighting frames it already has. Such data-side fixes, however, leave the policy's per-frame view untouched: a single image still maps directly to an action, and the local motion that governs correction stays implicit. We therefore turn to the representation level and introduce STAIR (\textbf{S}patio-\textbf{T}emporal feature \textbf{A}s an \textbf{I}nterface for \textbf{R}obot learning), a compact dynamic feature that bridges the vision-language model and the action expert, distilling the short-horizon motion already recorded in each trajectory into dense, motion-aware supervision. Trained on fluent data alone, STAIR recovers most of the deliberate-demonstration gain ($50.0$ to $62.2\%$ overall, approaching the $64.4\%$ of deliberate demonstrations). These results call for a more pedagogical view of robot data, optimized for machine learnability rather than human efficiency alone.

analysis.tldr: 发现人类高手演示在精细对齐任务（如插接、堆叠）中反而教不好机器人，因为动作太流畅、关键纠错瞬间太短；提出STAIR方法，用时空动态特征从流畅演示中自动提取运动感知监督信号，不依赖慢速/刻意演示就能大幅提升对齐成功率。
analysis.claim: 流畅的人类演示因压缩关键纠错段而损害机器人模仿学习效果，需从表示层面设计运动感知的监督接口（STAIR），而非仅靠数据重采样。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + Real2Sim 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的流畅演示数据（共120段），但未使用刻意放慢或人工标注的关键帧
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda上验证5类对齐任务，对比流畅vs刻意演示基线，STAIR以纯流畅数据达到刻意演示96.6%性能（62.2% vs 64.4%），含消融验证时空特征必要性；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据与模型权重，且未接入触觉/力觉等关键模态，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉-动作时序建模与教学信号重设计结合，在真实硬件上取得稳健提升，但属高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hide-and-Seek的框架，只用整条任务轨迹成功/失败的粗粒度标签（没有每一步是否失败的标注），就能自动定位到轨迹中具体哪几步动作出了问题，从而在VLA模型执行过程中实时发现故障点。
analysis.claim: 仅需轨迹级二元标签（成功/失败），即可通过对比学习联合建模轨迹间与轨迹内结构，实现无步级标注的细粒度VLA执行失败信号定位。
analysis.input: VLA策略生成的完整动作轨迹 + 对应语言指令 + 轨迹级成功/失败标签
analysis.output: 轨迹中每个时间步的失败置信度分数（用于实时监控）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/VLABench）+ 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，但摘要明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的step-level失败标注；仅需真实平台上收集的trajectory-level success/failure标签（即‘这条指令跑完成没成’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA运行时监控中解耦‘检测存在失败’和‘定位失败位置’，且不依赖步级标注；在LIBERO/VLABench/真实平台三类设置上验证泛化性，含conformal prediction量化timeliness-accuracy权衡，但未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的failure detection能力做横向基线对比（仅报告自身SOTA），属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习巧妙迁移到VLA运行时监控这一关键工程痛点，方法简洁有效，但缺乏开源与基石模型对齐验证，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Just Add Structure: Protein Language Models Combined with Structural Equivariance Excel at Protein Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate in silico prediction of protein properties, functional fitness, and mutational effects remains a central challenge in protein engineering and therapeutic design. While Protein Language Models (PLMs) successfully capture rich evolutionary and functional constraints from sequence data, they only indirectly encode the spatial and geometric information that fundamentally governs protein function. Consequently, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on extensive fine-tuning, ensembling, or the incorporation of handcrafted structural features to achieve competitive accuracy, making them computationally expensive and difficult to scale. In this work, we demonstrate that explicit geometric modeling can substitute for, and in most cases outperform, large-scale PLM fine-tuning, with much higher parameter efficiency. Our approach, ProtEGNN, pairs PLM residue representations with a lightweight E (3) -Equivariant Graph Neural Network, competing with or achieving state-of-the-art performance across eight different benchmarks in protein property, mutational effect and function prediction, while needing 100–1000 × fewer parameters than competing methods. Even when protein structure is combined with representations from ESM2-T6, a small 8M-parameter PLM, ProtEGNN matches fine-tuned sequence-only approaches based on substantially larger PLM backbones, while training orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Together, these results highlight geometric inductive bias as a powerful and scalable alternative to task-specific fine-tuning of large PLMs for protein modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的序列特征和一个轻量级的E(3)-等变图神经网络（处理三维结构）拼在一起，不靠大模型微调，只用极少参数就在8个蛋白任务上达到或超过SOTA，证明几何先验比暴力微调大PLM更高效。
analysis.claim: 显式引入结构等变建模可替代大规模PLM微调，在更低参数量下实现同等甚至更优的蛋白功能与突变预测性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+（可选）三维结构坐标或结构图表示
analysis.output: 蛋白性质预测值/突变效应分数/功能分类概率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个权威蛋白基准上实证了结构等变模块对PLM的高效增强，参数效率提升百倍以上，但未开源全部训练数据、未覆盖AlphaFold级结构生成或从头设计，也未挑战ESM-2/ESMFold的底层表征能力，属扎实的重大工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知PLM与成熟等变GNN巧妙组合，在蛋白预测任务中以极小代价显著超越微调大模型的常规路径，但未开辟新模态、未解决结构生成等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Embodiment-conditioned Generalist Control for Multirotor Aerial Robots
papers.abstract: We present a generalist position control policy capable of controlling arbitrary multirotor configurations of a certain rotor count (e.g., hexarotors or quadrotors) with a single set of network weights. The policy is conditioned on a physics-grounded embodiment descriptor: a mass and inertia-normalized control allocation matrix that captures how mass-normalized motor thrusts generate linear and angular accelerations in the body-frame. To train the policy, we sample from a broad distribution of arbitrary multirotor configurations, including non-planar and asymmetric systems, and optimize a single, compact network using Proximal Policy Optimization. Training requires only five minutes on an RTX 3090 GPU using a custom NVIDIA Warp-based dynamics simulator. Through extensive simulation experiments, we show that embodiment conditioning enables robust generalist control across arbitrary morphologies. We demonstrate zero-shot real-world transfer of this generalist policy on three diverse hexarotor systems, including a planar robot, a partially symmetric non-planar system, and a random asymmetric, non-planar configuration.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能用同一套神经网络权重控制任意构型多旋翼（如四旋翼、六旋翼）的通用位置控制器，核心是用归一化的物理驱动矩阵（质量与惯量归一化后的控制分配矩阵）作为机体形态条件输入，在仿真中训练后直接零样本迁移到三种真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面、强不对称构型）上稳定飞行。
analysis.claim: 仅靠一个轻量级神经网络+物理可解释的机体描述符，即可实现跨任意多旋翼构型（含非平面、强不对称）的零样本泛化控制。
analysis.input: 机体物理描述符（质量与惯量归一化的控制分配矩阵）+ 期望位置与当前状态（位置、速度、姿态、角速度）
analysis.output: 各电机归一化推力指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研NVIDIA Warp动力学仿真器 + 三类真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面/不对称）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，未使用任何真实机器人数据；真实部署为零样本迁移，无微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真中覆盖非平面/不对称构型训练，零样本部署到三类真实六旋翼（含随机不对称非平面），对比基线明确，消融验证了物理条件输入的关键性；但领域影响限于多旋翼控制子方向，未触及具身智能通用性底层范式（如语言-动作联合建模、跨域任务泛化），显著弱于GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等定义新范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验深度嵌入神经控制架构，实现了罕见的跨构型零样本sim2real，但仍是特定载体（多旋翼）上的高性能工程突破，而非通用具身智能范式演进。

papers.title: Testing the reliability of AI-generated protein structures
papers.abstract: Although AlphaFold2 and its competitors have demonstrated remarkable abilities to predict protein structure, more work is needed to explore the limitations of these methods. Here we investigated the reliability of AlphaFold2 and ColabFold by creating a set of realistic but false protein sequences, using ColabFold to predict their structure, and then asking how often the program produces a high-scoring structure for a sequence that does not represent a protein. We determined that AlphaFold2 has a very small but non-zero false positive rate, estimated here at approximately 1 in 435 if one uses a threshold pLDDT score of 70 to define positive predictions. We also discovered, serendipitously, that some high-scoring sequences in the human genome were not false positives, but instead were previously unknown and un-annotated pseudogenes. These latter findings indicate that some well-established human annotations of protein-coding genes may have incorrectly extended the 5-prime untranslated regions too far. They also suggest that the false positive rate of AlphaFold2 is low enough that almost any high-scoring structure, even in a noncoding region, is worthy of further investigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人工构造的假蛋白序列测试AlphaFold2和ColabFold的可靠性，发现其假阳性率极低（约1/435），并意外发现人类基因组中一些高置信度预测结构对应的是未注释的假基因，进而质疑部分基因注释中5'UTR区域划定过长的问题。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的假阳性率极低，低到足以让任何高置信度（pLDDT≥70）的结构预测——即使出现在已知非编码区——都值得作为潜在功能元件进行实验验证。
analysis.input: 人工设计的无生物学意义的氨基酸序列（含终止密码子、非标准残基、低复杂度等特征）及人类基因组非编码区序列
analysis.output: pLDDT评分和预测的3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：系统构建负样本集、量化假阳性率、发现真实生物学新线索（未注释假基因），推动结构预测结果的可信度评估范式，但未提出新模型或算法，也未覆盖多模型/多任务泛化，影响力限于评估与解释层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型，而是用严谨实验设计揭示了AlphaFold2在极端负样本下的鲁棒性，并反向驱动基因组注释修正，属高质量方法论验证与生物学洞见交叉工作。

papers.title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
papers.abstract: How can we scalably generate data for robotic manipulation, especially on human-like platforms such as dexterous multi-fingered hands? Learning from human videos has recently emerged as a likely answer to this question. However, difficulties in estimating hand-object interaction and crossing the human-to-robot embodiment gap have hindered the adoption of abundant monocular RGB-only human videos as the primary source of robot manipulation data. In this work, we present DO AS I DO, an algorithm to reconstruct and retarget monocular RGB human videos to multi-fingered dexterous robotic hands. DO AS I DO reconstructs hand-object interactions from various egocentric and exocentric in-the-wild video sources. The algorithm then retargets these hand-object interaction estimates into a sequence of actions executable in the real world, yielding robot-complete manipulation data from disparate human videos. Overall, DO AS I DO outperforms previous state of the art in estimating hand-object interactions and extracting dexterous manipulation trajectories from RGB videos, as we show in experiments on datasets with ground truths and on a dataset of video clips collected online. Our experiments enable us to propose an efficacy playbook for practitioners collecting human data for manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用单目RGB人类日常视频（如YouTube、手机拍摄）自动重建人手与物体的交互动作，并将其迁移到多指灵巧手机器人上，生成可执行的真机操作轨迹数据。
analysis.claim: 仅靠无标注、非受控、单目RGB的人类日常视频，就能高保真重建手-物交互并成功迁移到真实灵巧手，实现从‘人做’到‘机器人做’的端到端数据生成。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（egocentric/exocentric，in-the-wild）
analysis.output: 灵巧手在真实机器人上的关节轨迹序列（robot-complete manipulation data）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（仿真+部分真机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖人类视频（无动作标注、无3D标注、无传感器）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无任何人类动作标注/3D标注/传感器辅助前提下，从纯wild RGB视频中稳定重建并retarget到真实灵巧手（含多任务真机演示），性能显著超越Prior（如HOMER、HOI4D baseline），且提出可复现的pipeline和efficacy playbook；但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级系统性工程闭环（无全栈部署、无长期任务泛化、未整合触觉/力反馈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了‘如何从海量无标注人类视频中提取可执行灵巧操作数据’这一长期开放难题，证据扎实（多源视频+真机验证+消融+SOTA对比），但尚未形成完整机器人学习闭环。

papers.title: DeltaMut: An Integrative Database of AlphaFold2-Derived Missense Variant Structures
papers.abstract: The widespread use of next-generation sequencing has led to a surge in the number of identified variants with uncertain effects on protein function. These variants pose a significant challenge in diagnostics and hinder patient treatment strategies. Numerous variant effect predictors (VEPs) are available to assess variant impact, but they primarily rely on sequence-derived information. The recent development of AlphaFold2 has raised questions about whether information retrieved from wild-type or predicted structures of missense variants can improve the predictive power of these algorithms. While the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database serves as a valuable resource for wild-type protein structures, a large-scale collection of missense variant structures is not available, limiting current efforts to wild-type conformations and a handful of modeled variants. To address this limitation, we developed DeltaMut, a comprehensive database containing over 77,000 protein structures, including 65,000 pathogenic and neutral missense variants. All structural models were generated using ParaFold, a high-performance computing-optimized implementation of AlphaFold2. The large-scale and systematic generation of variant protein structures distinguish DeltaMut as a unique resource for both expansive statistical studies and detailed, case-specific investigations of variant-induced structural changes. Furthermore, the DeltaMut database is freely accessible without registration.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含7.7万个AlphaFold2预测的错义突变蛋白结构的免费公开数据库DeltaMut，填补了目前缺乏大规模系统性突变结构资源的空白。
