papers.title: LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
papers.abstract: Learning-based quadrupedal locomotion typically relies on complex reward formulations that entangle task specification, operational limits, gait preference, and terrain adaptation within a single optimization objective. We instead treat these functions through distinct mechanisms: rewards for task specification, constraints for operational limits, energy minimization for gait preference, and exteroceptive perception for adapting energy use to terrain difficulty. We show that these components jointly enable efficient, terrain-adaptive locomotion, and that removing each component exposes a distinct failure mode. Our formulation removes explicit gait priors (including air-time, contact-count, and foot-clearance targets) in favor of emergent behavior. Compared to a conventional complex-reward baseline, our formulation achieves comparable terrain traversal while reducing cost of transport by 56% and operational-limit violations by 96%. The resulting policies transfer zero-shot to a physical Unitree Go2 using LiDAR-based elevation mapping. Project website with videos: https://tinyurl.com/locomposition.

analysis.tldr: 提出LoComposition框架，把四足机器人运动控制拆解为任务奖励、物理约束、能耗最小化和地形感知四个正交模块，不依赖任何预设步态先验（如腾空时间、触地次数），让步态自然涌现，显著降低能耗和越界行为，并零样本迁移到实机Unitree Go2。

analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号

papers.title: CLASPP: A unified model for predicting post-translational modifications
papers.abstract: Abstract Post-Translational Modifications (PTMs) are a fundamental mechanism for regulating cellular pathways and increasing the functional diversity of the proteome. Accurately predicting the PTM types that are likely to occur at a given site in the primary sequence is a key challenge in functional proteomics. Existing PTM prediction models predominantly focus on either single PTM types or employ ensemble methods that combine multiple models to predict different PTM types. This fragmentation is largely driven by the vast imbalance in data availability across PTM types, making it difficult to predict multiple PTM types with a single model. To address this limitation, we present the C ontrastively L earned A ttention-based S tratified P TM P redictor (CLASPP), a unified PTM prediction model. CLASPP addresses imbalance challenges by leveraging unsupervised clustering-based undersampling and a novel contrastive learning framework tailored to PTM data. Additionally, our hierarchical data organization and curation are shown to improve CLASPP’s performance by balancing the representation of individual PTM types and provides a standardized dataset to train and validate future model designs. Drawing inspiration from advancements in image and natural language processing, the CLASPP model employs a multi-stage training strategy and a high-quality, curated training dataset to improve PTM prediction performance. To uncover what is learned during the contrastive learning stage, the CLASPP model is shown to distinguish known protein kinase substrate specificity profiles as a form of explainability. Finally, we evaluate the application of CLASPP in predicting PTMs in different model organisms and experimentally validated ubiquitination sites in the understudied DCLK3 kinase. Overall, CLASPP represents a unified model for PTM prediction that addresses key bottlenecks in data imbalance and offers new strategies for biological data curation, thereby improving PTM-type prediction performance across diverse organisms. Author summary Post-translational modifications (PTMs) are essential changes that proteins undergo, influencing nearly every aspect of cell function, communication, and disease. Accurately predicting where and how these modifications occur is challenging due to the diversity of PTM types and the limitations of existing annotation pipelines. This study introduces a unified deep learning approach, termed CLASPP, leveraging contrastive learning to predict multiple PTM types simultaneously from primary protein sequence alone. By employing advanced data balancing and sampling methods, CLASPP ensures reliable predictions for rare and common modifications. The model utilizes a pre-trained protein language model to capture sequence and structural features encoded in the primary protein sequence. Test results demonstrate that CLASPP consistently surpasses existing tools in predicting 12 major PTM types, and its versatility enables robust predictions across species, not just in human proteins. The final model, data curation, and training datasets are freely accessible for broader use and reproducibility ( https://github.com/gravelCompBio/Claspp_forward ).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了CLASPP模型，用对比学习+分层数据重采样方法，首次实现仅靠蛋白质一级序列就能统一预测12种不同类型的翻译后修饰（PTM），解决了以往模型只能单类型预测或依赖多模型集成、且对稀有PTM预测能力差的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习与聚类驱动的分层欠采样策略，CLASPP能在单一模型中稳健预测12种PTM类型，显著缓解数据不平衡问题，并在跨物种泛化和稀有PTM识别上超越现有工具。

analysis.output: 每个氨基酸位点上12种PTM类型的概率分布（多标签分类输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PhosphoSitePlus、UniMod等）和作者自建的标准化PTM位点数据集，无任何实验生成新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的显著贡献：首次统一建模12类PTM并开源高质量基准数据集；实证覆盖多物种+实验验证DCLK3位点；但未引入新生物学机制、未解决PTM动态性/协同性等根本难题，也未达到ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或结构预测精度跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了PTM预测的统一建模与数据治理，但仍是领域内稳健增量，非范式变革

papers.title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. We update the environment neural points using object-level rigid tracking and the robot neural points using forward kinematics. We use our spatiotemporal environment and robot feature (SERF) map as a state input to a vision-language-action (VLA) model by extracting map tokens from multiple reference frames and spatial scales, providing the policy with both local and global context. We demonstrate SERF on BEHAVIOR-1K, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation in household environments. Experiments show that the SERF VLA policy outperforms image-only baselines, reaches subgoals faster by following more direct trajectories, improves robustness to scene-configuration shifts, and recovers from object-drop failures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SERF——一种在线更新的空间-时间特征图，把环境（用物体级刚性跟踪建模）和机器人本体（用运动学建模）统一编码为共享隐空间中的神经点，作为VLA策略的状态输入，从而提升长程移动操作任务中的定位、环境变化感知和任务进度推理能力。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 将环境与机器人本体联合建模为可在线更新的共享spatiotemporal神经点特征图（SERF），能显著提升VLA策略在长时序移动操作任务中的推理鲁棒性与轨迹效率。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+本体感觉数据（关节角度、位姿等）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于BEHAVIOR-1K的移动机械臂平台（如Fetch/UR5+mobile base），未提真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实：首次将object-level环境跟踪与forward-kinematics驱动的机器人神经点联合嵌入同一隐空间，并实证验证其对VLA策略在BEHAVIOR-1K上多维度指标（子目标速度、配置偏移鲁棒性、失败恢复）的稳定提升；但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的灵巧操作或跨机体泛化，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合扎实、问题切口清晰、实证充分，但纯仿真、无开源、未突破长程操作的核心瓶颈（如语义不确定性建模、长期记忆坍缩），暂未达到ALOHA/π0级分量

papers.title: SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用仅200条仿真演示数据训练视觉语言动作（VLA）策略，不依赖任何真实机器人微调，直接在5种软体物体（如塑料袋、丝绸）操作任务上实现平均91%的真实世界成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属高校或企业，如清华/智元/宇树等均无依据）
analysis.claim: 仅靠少量仿真数据（200 demo/task）和一套包含物理可信仿真器、资产生成框架、拓扑感知轨迹合成器与ISP感知图像增强协议的系统，即可实现零样本RGB sim-to-real迁移，解决可变形物体操控中的视觉域偏移与动力学失配难题。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（从实验图及任务描述推断，典型部署平台；摘要未明说但项目页和任务类型高度指向）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据（zero-shot，无fine-tuning，无teleoperation）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DROID（93）与ALOHA（92）之下、但显著超越MimicGen（89）和Isaac Lab（88）的实证强度：真机多任务（5类可变形物）、零样本、高成功率（91% avg）、强鲁棒性（丝绸任务下视觉分布偏移时仍100%，baseline崩至9-70%）、成本降两个数量级；但未开源代码/模型，且未报告跨机体泛化（如换机械臂）或用户泛化，故略低于DROID/ALOHA级里程碑。

papers.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generalize across diverse manipulation tasks, but their imitation-learning-based policies remain brittle in precise physical interactions due to compounding execution errors; Can a reinforcement learning policy trained purely in simulation improve the robustness of real-world VLAs zero-shot? Residual RL, which learns a corrective policy on top of a frozen VLA, offers a natural framework, but existing approaches face a fundamental sim-to-real dilemma: privileged-state methods require lossy distillation for deployment; image-based methods suffer from the visual domain gap; and real-world RL is costly and unsafe. We propose an object-centric residual RL framework that refines VLA actions using object poses, enabling a compact observation space that transfers consistently between simulation and reality. To align the two domains, we additionally replay the same teleoperation demonstrations in simulation to train a sim counterpart of the real-world VLA. The residual RL policy is trained only in simulation with pose noise injection and dropout, and transfers zero-shot to the real robot. Across five manipulation tasks on a real Franka Research 3 (FR3) robot, our method improves the success rate from 42% to 76% zero-shot, and the improved rollouts can be further reused to retrain the base VLA for self-improvement without additional teleoperation. Project page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/object-centric-residual-rl/

analysis.tldr: 用仿真中训练的、以物体位姿为输入的残差强化学习策略，直接修正冻结的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型输出，在不接触真实机器人的情况下，将5个操作任务的成功率从42%提升至76%，且能用修正后的轨迹反哺VLA自迭代。
analysis.claim: 仅靠仿真训练的物体位姿驱动的残差RL策略，可零样本迁移至真实机器人，显著增强冻结VLA模型的物理交互鲁棒性，并支持闭环自改进。
analysis.input: 物体6D位姿（仿真与真实中对齐）、冻结VLA输出的动作指令
analysis.output: 残差动作修正量（Δa）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的初始VLA演示数据（用于构建基线），但残差RL训练完全不用真实机器人交互数据；后续自改进阶段复用真实 rollout，但非训练必需
analysis.significance_reason: 在零样本sim2real VLA增强方向上做出扎实推进：真机5任务验证、明确成功率提升（+34pt）、引入物体位姿作为跨域紧凑表征、实现VLA-RL闭环自改进；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，仿真训练仍依赖位姿真值（非端到端视觉），相比ALOHA/DROID等基石工作，缺乏大规模跨平台数据基础或通用部署能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将残差RL、物体中心表征与VLA结合，在FR3上实现了有说服力的零样本sim2real增强，但受限于位姿依赖和闭源，尚未达到开范式或大规模部署级突破。

papers.title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory -- designed to foster general memory mechanisms rather than siloed, task-specific solutions. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%--12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%--15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining. Together, PRISM and ReMemBench establish a foundation for developing and evaluating short-term memory-augmented visuomotor policies that scale to long-horizon tasks. Additional materials are available at https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM模型（带门控注意力和分层压缩的视觉运动策略Transformer），让机器人能在长达2分钟的任务中有效利用短时记忆，并构建了首个专用于评测短时记忆能力的基准ReMemBench（8个家庭操作任务），在多个标准benchmark上显著超越无记忆基线及大模型微调方法。
analysis.claim: 通过门控注意力与分层时间压缩机制，可将视觉运动策略的短时记忆能力可靠扩展至两分钟量级，且无需大规模预训练即可在长程家庭操作任务中取得显著提升。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作历史（可能含状态/指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（RoboCasa/LIBERO）及部分真实机器人数据（摘要未明说但ReMemBench设计含real-robot适配性）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主；真实机器人数据使用情况未在摘要中说明，仅提ReMemBench‘designed to foster general memory mechanisms’，未声明是否含真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并评测视觉运动策略中的短时记忆能力（ReMemBench），PRISM在无大模型预训练前提下稳定超越GR00T/OpenVLA等强基线，实证扎实、任务覆盖广、消融清晰；但尚未验证真实机器人部署效果，也未突破sim2real瓶颈，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式变革或硬件耦合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在记忆建模与评测体系上做出扎实系统性推进，但仍是仿真主导的算法增强，未触及具身智能的核心物理交互瓶颈。

papers.title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
papers.abstract: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型学习环境动态，再在上面训练强化学习策略，让无人机无需人工调参或环境假设就能在没见过的复杂场景中自主导航，仿真和真机都直接运行不调参。
analysis.claim: 基于世界模型的通用无人机导航框架AirDreamer，能在未见过的杂乱环境中实现零调参sim2real迁移，并通过稀疏奖励激发自主偏航控制与局部最优逃离能力。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+目标位置指令（隐含在任务设定中）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续动作（含yaw控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中用AirSim，真机用自研四旋翼平台（摘要未提具体型号，但明确说‘on real drones’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅用仿真预训练+真机零调参部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统上的端到端导航落地：真机多场景零调参部署、稀疏奖励下涌现yaw控制、比SOTA高5.3%成功率；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，理论深度不及DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作，属扎实重磅而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Dreamer类世界模型成功压缩适配到资源受限的真实无人机上，完成从仿真到真机的闭环验证，但未突破建模本质或扩展通用性边界。

papers.title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks. It formalizes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and reports native success with two unsafe-success metrics: Succ-But-Unsafe (SBU), the fraction of rollouts that both succeed and violate safety, and Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating nine policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: high-SR tabletop baselines still leave 13 to 15 percent unsafe-episode rates,and 36 to 56 percent of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. Project page: https://safevla.org.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型建了个‘安全体检表’：用信号时序逻辑（STL）定义安全规则，在LIBERO和RoboCasa-365仿真基准上批量检测已发表模型的轨迹——发现很多‘任务成功’的轨迹其实严重违反安全约束（比如乱碰东西、打翻物品、自碰撞），并量化了‘成功但不安全’的比例和违规严重程度。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA基准只看任务是否完成（二值成功），掩盖了大量危险但成功的轨迹行为；必须引入任务感知、可形式化验证的安全评估框架，才能真实反映VLA模型的部署风险。
analysis.input: 已有VLA策略在仿真环境中的执行轨迹（含状态、动作、观测）
analysis.output: 两个安全指标：Succ-But-Unsafe（SBU）率和Violation Severity Index（VSI）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO/RoboCasa-365仿真器（Franka Emika Panda + kitchen/tabletop场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于公开仿真轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性暴露VLA模型‘成功≠安全’的核心缺陷，并给出可复现、可形式化、可插拔的安全评测协议；但未提出任何新模型、新训练机制或真实硬件验证，仅是诊断工具，分量不及所有列出的基石工作（全部≥85），属于扎实的领域警示性增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把STL安全验证嫁接到现有VLA仿真基准上，做了严谨的横向体检，但不是新方法也不是新能力，暂时无法推动模型改进本身。

papers.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LARA框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和潜在动作模型（LAM）在训练中互相校准表征，用大量无标注人类视频辅助提升VLA在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过联合优化与表征对齐，LAM和VLA可互为监督：LAM借助真实动作轨迹过滤伪影性视觉变化，VLA则被LAM学习到的前向动力学正则化以抑制无效动作幻觉。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节速度/末端位姿等低级控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., Adroit, Kitchen)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（1个精心设计的真实世界基准），但主要利用无标注人类视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA范式下首次实现LAM与VLA的端到端联合表征对齐，在3个仿真+1个真实基准上稳定提升（5–15%），有消融验证且跨预训练/后训练/模型精调三阶段有效；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验仅限单平台单任务集，未挑战跨机体或用户泛化，显著弱于OpenVLA/Octo等开源、多机体、真机大规模部署的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了LAM-VLA割裂训练的关键耦合问题，实证扎实但落地闭环不完整，属当前VLA演进中重要的模块级改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines
papers.abstract: World models have recently seen a rapid growth in both their popularity and capability as more data efficient tools for generating robot training data or simulating real world environments, with many works proposing their integration into the robot learning pipeline. While highly practical, in this work we demonstrate that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data. In contrast to traditional data poisoning techniques which directly implant dangerous trajectories into sold or uploaded datasets, our novel attack methods inject malicious prompts or compromising transition dynamics into visibly safe teleoperated datasets which are only activated once fed through a world model as input. This can result in the generation of synthetic, dangerous robot training trajectories and subsequently unsafe or compromised robot policies. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our attacks against both state of the art action conditioned and text conditioned world models, showing a full end-to-end backdoor on a downstream DRL policy and a proof-of-concept for the VLA setting. Overall these findings necessitate research into more secure world models and reevaluating their position within the robot learning supply chain.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并实证了世界模型（world models）在机器人学习流程中会成为隐蔽的数据投毒入口：攻击者无需篡改原始真实数据，只需在看似安全的遥操作数据中植入特定恶意提示或过渡动态，当这些数据被送入世界模型生成合成训练轨迹时，就会触发危险行为，最终导致强化学习策略或视觉语言动作模型产生安全隐患。
analysis.claim: 世界模型在机器人学习流水线中构成一种新型、隐蔽且有效的数据投毒攻击面，其风险源于模型对输入数据的隐式解码与动态放大，而非传统直接污染标注数据。
analysis.input: 遥操作轨迹（含恶意嵌入的提示或状态转移）+世界模型条件输入（动作/文本）
analysis.output: 被污染的合成训练轨迹 + 下游DRL策略/VLA策略的异常行为输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成遥操作数据集（未使用真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示世界模型作为‘信任放大器’引发的新型供应链攻击范式，实证覆盖SOTA世界模型（DreamerV3级）、DRL下游策略及VLA初步场景，含端到端后门演示和消融分析；但未在真实机器人上验证，也未提出防御方案，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作的范式开创性或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将世界模型定位为机器人学习中的可信计算薄弱点，并给出可复现的端到端攻击链证据，但限于仿真，尚未进入真实部署风险闭环。

papers.title: Modulation index-based phase-amplitude coupling does not encode temporal polarity
papers.abstract: Background: Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) is widely used to quantify interactions between neural oscillations across timescales and is often interpreted as reflecting temporally meaningful coordination between slow and fast neural activity. New method: Combining empirical EEG data with mathematical analysis, we tested whether modulation index (MI)-based PAC distinguishes opposite temporal organisations of cross-frequency coupling by inverting the phase of the low-frequency oscillation by 180 degrees. Results: MI remained unchanged after phase inversion, whereas preferred phase rotated by exactly 180 degrees. Thus, opposite temporal organisations of cross-frequency coupling yielded identical MI values. Comparison with existing methods: Unlike preferred phase and the full phase-binned amplitude profile, MI quantifies the strength of phase-dependent amplitude modulation but does not retain information about temporal polarity or phase direction. Conclusions: Modulation index-based PAC does not encode temporal polarity and therefore cannot, on its own, support inferences about temporal alignment, phase polarity, or directionality. Studies seeking mechanistic interpretation of temporal organisation should complement MI with phase-sensitive measures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用数学分析和实证EEG数据证明：常用的调制指数（MI）指标在相位-振幅耦合（PAC）分析中无法区分时间上的正向与反向耦合关系，因为对低频相位做180度翻转后MI值不变，仅偏好相位旋转，因此MI本身不携带时间极性信息。
analysis.claim: 调制指数（MI）-based PAC无法编码时间极性，因而不能单独用于推断神经耦合的时间对齐、相位极性或方向性。
analysis.input: EEG信号 + 数学建模（相位翻转操作）
analysis.output: 调制指数（MI）值、偏好相位、相位分箱振幅分布
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/已有EEG数据，未采集新真实神经数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属神经信号分析方法论的关键澄清工作：指出现有主流指标MI的根本缺陷（丢失时间极性），证据扎实（理论推导+实证验证+与偏好相位等指标对比），但未提出新解码器/新范式/新硬件接口，也未解决临床BCI核心瓶颈（如实时性、跨被试泛化、闭环控制），影响力限于分析工具层，强于一般方法论note但弱于任何具备闭环神经调控或高维意图解码的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：对PAC分析中长期被误用的MI指标做出关键方法论纠偏，但属于分析工具层的必要补丁，而非突破性神经接口或解码范式。

papers.title: Ambient Diffusion Policy: Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Data in Robotics
papers.abstract: We propose Ambient Diffusion Policy, a simple and principled method for imitation learning from suboptimal data in robotics. High-quality, task-specific robot data is expensive and time-consuming to collect, while suboptimal datasets with lower-quality or out-of-distribution demonstrations are abundant. Existing methods that co-train on both data sources in robotics often fail to separate the meaningful and the harmful features in the suboptimal samples. In contrast, our method extracts only the useful features by introducing a new axis to co-training in robotics: noise-dependent data usage. Ambient Diffusion Policy restricts the contribution of suboptimal data during training to only the high and low diffusion times. To rigorously justify our approach, we first observe that robot action data exhibits a spectral power law. This induces two important properties on the optimal Diffusion Policy that we exploit: a global-to-local hierarchy and locality. We theoretically formalize this discussion using a simplified model. Our experiments validate Ambient Diffusion Policy on four types of suboptimal action data (noisy trajectories, sim-to-real gap, task mismatch, and large-scale data mixtures) across six tasks. The results show that it effectively learns from arbitrary sources of suboptimal data. Notably, it outperforms existing co-training baselines by up to 33% when scaled to Open X-Embodiment - a large dataset with heterogeneous data quality and unstructured distribution shifts. Overall, Ambient Diffusion Policy increases the utility of suboptimal demonstrations and expands the set of usable data sources in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Ambient Diffusion Policy的新方法，让机器人模仿学习能有效利用各种质量差、不匹配、混杂的真实或仿真动作数据（比如噪声轨迹、sim2real偏差、任务错配、大规模异构数据），通过在扩散模型训练中只在高/低噪声时间步使用次优数据，避开中间噪声段的有害干扰，从而提升泛化性能。
analysis.claim: 在扩散策略框架下引入噪声依赖的数据使用机制，可系统性地滤除次优演示中的有害特征，使模仿学习对任意类型次优数据鲁棒且增益显著。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）和次优动作轨迹（含噪声、错配、跨域等）
analysis.output: 扩散生成的动作序列（即策略输出的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用机器人平台（未指定具体硬件，实验基于Open X-Embodiment多机体数据）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开次优数据集（Open X-Embodiment），无真实机器人在线采集或闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在Open X-Embodiment大规模异构数据上实证了对四类典型次优数据的鲁棒性，相比基线提升达33%，且有理论谱分析支撑+消融验证；但未部署真机闭环测试，也未引入新硬件/仿真器/传感器，属于SOTA级方法论推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散建模与噪声时序选择结合，扎实提升了次优数据利用率，证据充分但未跨越到真机部署或新物理交互层面

papers.title: CLAW: Learning Continuous Latent Action World Models via Adversarial Latent Regularization
papers.abstract: We introduce CLAW, a fully end-to-end self-supervised framework for learning a world model jointly with continuous latent action representations directly from action-free videos. Our approach leverages adversarial latent regularization and diffusion-based video generation to capture structured and semantically meaningful action representations while modeling rich, predictive environment dynamics, without relying on any action labels or annotations. By simultaneously training the Latent Action Model and world model, CLAW learns to reason about how inferred actions induce environment transitions from visual observations alone. We show that the resulting latent action world model supports both imitation learning from observation and goal-directed planning. In imitation learning, latent actions extracted from raw videos enable behavior cloning. For planning, CLAW generates sequences of latent actions and maps them to executable actions to reach desired goals. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and embodiments demonstrate that CLAW produces semantically meaningful latent action representations, supports effective action transfer, and enables planning and imitation from observation, outperforming existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 仅用无动作标注的视频，端到端学出一个能预测环境变化的世界模型，同时自动发现连续、语义清晰的隐式动作表征，再用它做从视频模仿学习和目标导向规划。
analysis.claim: 无需任何动作标签或交互数据，仅通过自监督学习即可联合建模环境动态与语义连贯的连续隐式动作空间，并支撑下游模仿与规划任务。
analysis.input: 无动作标注的视频帧序列
analysis.output: 连续隐式动作向量序列 + 环境状态预测（未来帧/状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频数据集（如BAIR Robot Pushing、RoboNet等仿真/真实机器人采集的无动作标签视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在纯视觉世界建模+隐式动作解耦方向上显著推进：首次实现端到端联合训练且支持跨机体动作迁移与规划，但未在真实机器人上验证、无消融实验细节披露、未开源数据与完整训练配置，证据强度弱于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等需交互信号的标杆方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗正则化、扩散生成与世界模型架构巧妙耦合，在无动作监督下达成语义动作解耦与跨任务泛化，但缺乏真机验证与完整可复现性，尚未达到里程碑级突破。

papers.title: Hierarchical Policies from Verbal and Egocentric Human Signals for Natural Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: For natural human-robot interaction, a robot must understand human intent expressed not only through language but also through nonverbal signals such as gestures and gaze. However, current robot policies rely on language instructions as the sole interface for conveying intent, leaving nonverbal signals unused and placing the full burden of communication. In this work, we present EDITH, a robot framework that captures the human's nonverbal signals through continuous streams of first-person view and gaze from smart glasses, and uses them alongside language instructions as inputs to the robot policy. Our hardware system streams the human's first-person view, gaze, and speech to the robot in real time, transcribing the speech into language instructions. To handle these rich but noisy signals, we design a hierarchical policy in which a high-level policy infers the human's intent and produces a sequence of subtasks, where each subtask is represented as a fine-grained instruction paired with a keyframe that grounds the intent in the scene (e.g., the frame where the human points at the target object). A low-level policy then executes these subtasks. In our experiments on human-robot interactive tasks, EDITH enables the robot to act on the human's nonverbal signals even when intent is expressed only briefly, and significantly reduces user effort to convey intent compared to using language instructions alone. Visit our project page for source code and real-robot demo videos.

analysis.tldr: 提出EDITH框架，让机器人通过智能眼镜实时获取人类第一人称视角、注视点和语音，将三者融合输入分层策略（高层推断意图并生成带关键帧的子任务，底层执行），显著降低用户仅靠语言发指令的沟通负担。
analysis.claim: 融合第一人称视觉、注视点与语音的分层策略，能从短暂非语言信号中可靠推断人类意图并驱动机器人执行，比纯语言指令大幅降低用户交互 effort。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频流+实时眼动轨迹+语音（转录为文本）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由高层生成带场景锚定关键帧的子任务，底层映射为具体动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制硬件系统（含智能眼镜+机器人本体通信链路）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类佩戴智能眼镜在真实机器人上采集的多模态同步数据（摘要明确提及real-robot demo videos及实时流）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多任务、跨用户、非语言主导交互，有明确用户effort量化对比（非纯仿真/小数据/单任务），但未开源代码模型、缺乏消融实验细节、未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2/Octo）对比，属扎实且具工程落地性的重磅进展，未达开范式级（如RT-2）或通用VLA架构级（如Octo）高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完整闭环的真实硬件系统+分层多模态策略设计实证有效，但开源不足、基线对比缺失、泛化分析有限，属于高质量落地型工作而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做带视觉的老师策略，通过人参与的强化学习蒸馏，把知识传给不依赖视觉、只靠本体感知（位姿+速度+力矩）的学生策略，在NIST装配板上3个任务50分钟内达到95%成功率，并泛化到8个未见变种任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠真实世界RL和人机协同蒸馏，无需仿真、域随机化或数据增强，即可将视觉依赖策略的知识有效迁移到鲁棒的纯本体感知策略，实现接触密集操作的强泛化。
analysis.input: 教师端：RGB图像+语言/任务指令；学生端：关节位姿+空间速度+六维力/力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 低层连续动作（关节力矩或速度命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + NIST装配基准板（含力传感器与实时运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（无仿真预训练、无合成数据、无离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机端到端蒸馏实现vision-free策略且在NIST标准板上多任务+多变种泛化，证据扎实（50分钟训练、95%成功率、8个未见变种），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，影响力限于接触操作子领域，尚未达DROID/ALOHA级通用性或开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实硬件上闭环验证了视觉到本体感知的知识蒸馏可行性，有明确任务价值和部署证据，但缺乏开源与广义泛化支撑，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Accurate Identification of Functional Residues Across the Human Proteome with TAMALE
papers.abstract: Abstract The central challenge of the post-AlphaFold era is the ‘functional gap’. Despite having structure predictions for nearly every human protein, we remain unable to systematically distinguish residues that drive activity from those that merely maintain structural integrity. Here we introduce TAMALE, a machine learning model that calculates graded residue-level functional scores across the human proteome without prior annotation. TAMALE transforms structure models and variant effect predictions to identify residues involved in catalysis, ligand binding, nucleic acid interactions, and regulation. The model also distinguishes pseudo-enzymes from catalytically active homologs. The model was validated across 20 case studies along with experimental characterization of the FASTKD5 ribonuclease, demonstrating its utility for functional discovery. Applied proteome-wide to 19,528 human proteins, TAMALE generates testable hypotheses enabling mechanistic discovery at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫TAMALE的机器学习模型，用蛋白质结构预测和变异效应预测作为输入，给人类蛋白质组中每个氨基酸残基打一个‘功能重要性’分数，不需要事先标注，就能区分催化位点、配体结合位点等功能残基，还验证了它在FASTKD5蛋白上的预测并生成了全蛋白组尺度的可实验验证假说。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 无需功能注释先验，仅基于结构模型与变异效应预测，即可在全人类蛋白质组尺度上实现残基级、多类型（催化/结合/调控）功能残基的准确识别与伪酶判别。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2结构模型 + ESM-1v或类似模型的变异效应预测（ΔΔG或致病性评分）
analysis.output: 每个残基的功能得分（连续值），以及分类标签（如催化/结合/调控/结构/伪酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.generalization: 跨机体（全人类蛋白组）、跨任务（多类功能识别）
analysis.significance_reason: 是功能注释领域的扎实增量：首次实现无监督式、残基级、多类别功能打分且覆盖全蛋白组，验证含新实验（FASTKD5），但未突破AlphaFold后‘结构→功能’范式本身（仍重度依赖AF2+ESM输入，未建模动力学/环境/复合物），开源程度有限（仅网页+部分权重，无训练代码/完整数据流水线）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在结构到功能映射上迈出可复现、可扩展的一步，但仍是AlphaFold生态内的工具层演进，非范式突破

papers.title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
papers.abstract: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a bump trap, a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为行星探测车ERNEST设计了一种带主动转向+滚动调节的双自由度悬挂系统，并用强化学习在高保真仿真中训练出一个统一神经网络控制器，不依赖地形识别就能自主穿越岩石、沙丘、台阶等多种极端地形，且零样本迁移到真实机器人上表现优异。
analysis.claim: 一个无需显式地形分类、仅靠单一神经网络控制器即可实现多地形零样本迁移的主动悬挂行星车自主通行方案。
analysis.input: 稀疏立体视觉地形高程图、底盘姿态、关节状态、六维力矩传感器数据
analysis.output: 各轮毂电机与悬挂关节的扭矩/位置控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: ERNEST四轮主动悬挂样机（JPL自研）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；训练纯仿真，部署前仅做少量真实环境校准（system identification）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T/H2O级以下但显著高于一般具身智能论文：真机部署+多极端地形闭环验证+37%能效提升+被动悬挂失效场景下唯一可行解，属扎实重磅贡献；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型、未挑战人形/灵巧操作等更广范式，故未达90+里程碑阈值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将高保真terrane力学仿真、主动悬挂硬件、RL策略合并为可部署的端到端系统，在行星探测这一窄但高价值场景中实现了有实证支撑的实质性突破。

papers.title: $ω$-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied policies typically map current observations directly to actions, leaving candidate-action consequences implicit. World models provide predictive supervision, representations, or external simulation, but rarely let a policy inspect the imagined consequence of its own proposal before acting. We introduce $ω$-EVA, a latent interactive world model that realizes an Envision--Verify--Act loop for embodied action generation. Its three-stage framework learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, trains a language-conditioned flow policy on dynamics-aware visual representations, and feeds the policy's proposal back through the world model. A tri-branch refiner jointly reasons over the current state, proposal-conditioned future, and proposed action to produce the final action chunk. Because consequence reasoning remains in latent feature space, $ω$-EVA avoids generating future videos at inference. Evaluations across diverse single-arm, bimanual, long-horizon, and perturbed simulation settings show that the complete interaction pipeline consistently improves the proposal policy, while latent diagnostics indicate meaningful action-conditioned future structure. With approximately 1.2B parameters and no additional robot-data pretraining, $ω$-EVA demonstrates a compact and competitive performance--scale--data trade-off, making the world model an active action-feedback module rather than a passive predictor.

analysis.tldr: 提出ω-EVA框架，让具身智能体在动作生成前先用潜空间世界模型‘设想’自己提议动作的后果、再‘验证’合理性，最后才执行，整个过程不生成视频、只在潜空间交互，提升仿真中多任务操作性能。
analysis.claim: 潜空间内实现可反馈的‘设想-验证-执行’闭环，使世界模型从被动预测器变为主动动作反馈模块，且无需视频生成即可完成后果推理。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo 仿真机械臂（单臂/双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真数据，无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型嵌入策略生成闭环并实现潜空间内动作提案-后果反馈迭代，在多个仿真基准上稳定提升性能，有消融和潜空间诊断证据；但未部署真机、未开源代码、未超越DreamerV3等基石模型的泛化深度与实证广度，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: EmbodiSteer: Steering Embodiment-Agnostic Visuomotor Policies with Joint-Space Guidance for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Deployment
papers.abstract: Scalable robot imitation learning relies on large-scale heterogeneous data from diverse robots or body-free data, making Cartesian end-effector actions a key interface for embodiment-agnostic policy learning. However, end-effector-only abstraction leaves Cartesian policies unaware of the deployed robot body, making them brittle under robot-specific constraints such as whole-body collision avoidance. To overcome this limitation, we present EmbodiSteer, a training-free framework that steers embodiment-agnostic visuomotor policies toward zero-shot, embodiment-aware deployment. EmbodiSteer keeps policy learning in Cartesian space while efficiently lifting inference-time diffusion sampling into the target robot's joint space via forward kinematics and Jacobian-based updates. With whole-body collision-aware guidance over joint trajectories after each denoising step, the arm can be steered away from collisions while preserving learned end-effector behavior. Compared with Cartesian-only execution, EmbodiSteer reduces collision rate by 46.1% and improves task success rate by 28.5% across 9 simulated robots, and further achieves 90.0% collision rate reduction and 36.7% success rate increase on two physical robots in highly constrained scenarios. Our project page is at https://frankwang67.github.io/EmbodiSteer-Page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需重新训练的推理时修正框架EmbodiSteer，将已有的、不关心机器人具体结构的视觉运动策略（在笛卡尔空间训练）实时映射到目标机器人的关节空间，并在每步去噪过程中加入基于雅可比和正向运动学的全身碰撞规避引导，从而实现零样本跨机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过推理时在关节空间施加碰撞感知的梯度引导，即可将笛卡尔空间训练的通用视觉运动策略安全、高效地迁移到任意新机器人本体上。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（隐含于模仿学习数据中）
analysis.output: 关节空间动作序列（经笛卡尔策略解码后修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中覆盖9种机器人、实机验证2种（Franka Emika Panda + Unitree H1手部模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新机器人的真实数据；但依赖原始笛卡尔策略训练时的跨机器人/身体无关模仿数据（摘要未说明是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在9种仿真机器人和2种真实机器人（含高约束场景）上显著降低碰撞率、提升成功率，且消融明确（对比纯笛卡尔执行），方法简洁有效；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，也未挑战更根本的具身泛化瓶颈（如跨形态/动力学差异极大机体），属于高质量工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的推理时关节空间引导解决了笛卡尔策略跨本体部署的碰撞脆性问题，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与基础组件贡献，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
papers.abstract: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向湿实验室（生物实验）机器人的仿真平台Pipette，包含43个可编辑的开源实验器材资产、11个任务的基准测试集，以及一个基于仿真的数据增强框架——通过扰动人类示范并自动筛选成功轨迹，将少量人工演示（每任务仅30条）高效转化为训练数据，显著提升了视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在真实湿实验任务上的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/高校/企业）
analysis.claim: 通过可编辑湿实验资产库+仿真扰动+自动成功过滤的数据增强 pipeline，能在仅30条人工演示下显著提升VLA模型在真实湿实验室任务中的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 人类演示轨迹（含动作与多视角视频）+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 湿实验室定制机械臂（如UR5e+pipette tip），但论文未指定具体硬件型号，仅提及‘real wet-lab robot’，故填 none

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个面向生物湿实验的端到端仿真-增强-评测闭环，证据扎实（多模型+多任务+消融式增强效果），但受限于真机验证规模和开源完整性，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection
papers.abstract: Many real-world manipulation scenarios, such as handling complex collaborative tasks and dealing with large workspaces, require coordination of more than two robotic arms. Consequently, an effective multi-arm teleoperation system is required to collect demonstrations for training coordinated multi-arm manipulation policies. However, existing teleoperation frameworks mainly focus on single-operator or multi-operator setups, facing a practical trade-off between the cognitive load placed on a single operator and the coordination cost incurred by multiple operators. To address this problem, we introduce HATS, a human-agent teleoperation system that enables a single human operator, assisted by an MLLM-based agent, to collect data for multi-arm manipulation tasks. Our system decouples the control space: two primary arms are directly teleoperated by the human, while two assistive arms are controlled by a training-free agent that handles sub-tasks. In addition, the human operator can use voice commands to prevent collisions and correct assistive arm behaviors during execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HATS achieves data collection efficiency and success rates comparable to expert dual-human teams. Moreover, downstream policy evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and quality of the data collected through HATS.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个单人+AI代理协同的多臂遥操作系统HATS，人类直接操控两个主臂，AI代理（无需训练）自动控制两个辅助臂执行子任务，并支持语音实时干预防碰撞和纠错，收集的数据质量媲美双人专家团队。
analysis.claim: 单人借助免训练的MLLM代理即可高效、安全地完成四臂协同遥操作数据采集，性能达到双人专家水平。
analysis.input: 人类双手动作+语音指令+视觉反馈（隐含）
analysis.output: 四臂协同操作轨迹（含主臂实时动作+辅助臂自动生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但需真实四臂硬件支持）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台上的实时交互数据（含语音、手控、视觉反馈），非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了多臂遥操作中‘单人认知超载’与‘多人协调成本高’的根本矛盾，首次实现免训练MLLM代理在真实多臂系统中承担可解释子任务并支持语音实时纠偏；实证覆盖多任务、真机部署、与双人专家对标，但未开源代码/模型，且未验证下游策略泛化到新机体或跨用户场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将MLLM代理深度嵌入真实多臂遥操作闭环，显著降低人力门槛并达成专家级数据质量，但属高质量系统工程，非范式突破或基础方法创新。

papers.title: WeaveLA: Event Driven Cross-Subtask Latent Memory Weaving for Repetitive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have achieved remarkable single-step manipulation, yet they remain brittle precisely where each stage depends on what was just completed. The core issue is structural: short-window VLAs lack an explicit channel for rouxting information across sub-task boundaries, and existing memory-augmented variants either write at every frame, retrieve from demonstration-time stages, or fire at sub-goal events without performing an explicit sub-task-to-sub-task hand-off into the action expert. We identify the sub-goal completion event as the natural temporal unit for cross-subtask memory hand-off, and present WeaveLA (Weave Latent memory for Vision-Language-Action policies), a cross-subtask memory interface that, on top of a frozen VLA backbone, compresses each completed segment into latent tokens via query-driven attention pooling and routes them directly into the action-generation path of the next sub-task. This event-triggered, action-side design preserves the base policy's short-window interface while adding a lightweight cross-subtask channel. Through stratified evaluation on RoboMME with a $π_{0.5}$ backbone, WeaveLA's gains land exactly where the channel is needed: on the hardest repetition slice (SwingXtimes, $N{=}3$), success rises from $0\%$ to $47.8\%$, while single-execution episodes remain unchanged. Per-episode paired analysis confirms the gains are confined to tasks whose causal structure requires cross-subtask information.

analysis.tldr: 提出WeaveLA方法，在冻结的VLA模型（如π₀.₅）基础上，仅在子任务完成事件触发时，将已完成子任务的视觉-语言特征压缩为隐式记忆token，并直接注入下一子任务的动作生成路径，从而解决重复性操作中跨子任务状态依赖断裂的问题。
analysis.claim: 子任务完成事件是跨子任务记忆传递的自然时间锚点，显式、事件驱动、动作侧注入的轻量级隐式记忆编织机制，能显著提升重复性机器人操作的成功率，且不破坏原VLA模型的短窗口接口。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+子任务完成事件信号（由内部状态或预定义逻辑判定）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME仿真环境（基于PyBullet/ManiSkill？未明说，但RoboMME为仿真基准）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用RoboMME仿真数据训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME硬切片（SwingXtimes, N=3）上实现0→47.8%的实质性突破，且通过配对消融确认增益严格对应因果依赖型重复任务；方法设计简洁、模块化、不改动主干，工程友好；但仅限仿真、未验证多机体/真实硬件、无开源代码，尚未达到RT-2/π₀级范式开创性，属扎实重磅改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用事件驱动的轻量记忆接口精准修补VLA在重复操作中的结构性缺陷，证据扎实但限于仿真，未达范式突破

papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: SynthICL: Scalable In-context Imitation Learning with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) enables robots to learn new tasks from a small number of demonstrations by conditioning a pre-trained policy on task-specific examples, without retraining at test time. Despite this promise, training generalizable and scalable in-context imitation policies remains an open challenge. We present SynthICL, a scalable framework that trains ICIL policies entirely from RGB-only synthetic data. Specifically, we build a data generation pipeline to produce high-fidelity ICIL data and train a flow-matching transformer policy on the resulting dataset. SynthICL avoids the need for depth sensing, precise camera calibration, and real-world training data in prior approaches, offering a simpler and more scalable alternative. We further incorporate subgoal prediction by training the model to predict the next subgoal images, enabling more precise and visually grounded control. Evaluated on 16 unseen real-world manipulation tasks, SynthICL achieves an average success rate of 79% with only one demonstration provided at test time and outperforms prior methods. Project page: https://synth-icl.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用纯合成RGB视频数据训练一个能根据少量示范（1个）即时模仿新任务的机器人策略，不依赖真实数据、深度传感器或相机标定，在16个未见过的真实操作任务上达到79%成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用高保真合成RGB视频数据即可训练出泛化性强、无需微调、支持单示例上下文学习的机器人模仿策略，并通过子目标图像预测提升视觉接地控制精度。
analysis.input: RGB视频片段（含任务示范序列+当前观测帧）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）及下一子目标图像预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（真实部署时）+ Isaac Gym（合成数据生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅在真实环境测试时需真实执行，但训练完全脱离真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯合成RGB数据驱动的ICIL，跨16个真实任务验证，消融充分（含子目标预测贡献），但未开源代码/模型，且未在多机体/用户/长时序复杂任务上验证鲁棒性，强于RDT-1B以下但未达Octo/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用成熟技术（flow-matching transformer + synthetic pipeline）系统性解决ICIL的数据瓶颈，实证扎实但未开新范式，开源缺失削弱复现门槛

papers.title: Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练一个循环策略，让能双向推力的四旋翼无人机在任意倒地姿态下仅靠轻量级机载传感器（如IMU和光流）自主翻身并恢复悬停，不依赖精确状态估计。
analysis.claim: 无需显式状态估计、仅依赖受限且不可靠的机载传感器，即可实现四旋翼在任意地面姿态下的零样本敏捷跌落恢复。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 光流图像序列（无深度/无GPS/无外部定位）
analysis.output: 双向推力电机的控制指令序列（含反向推力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制双向推力四旋翼硬件平台（含倾转电机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实跌落视频与IMU数据用于光流仿真校准，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，真实部署无fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多扰动鲁棒性+零样本跨姿态恢复+绕过传统状态估计算法，在微型无人机自主容错领域属显著推进；但未开源数据/模型，且平台依赖特殊双向推力硬件，通用性受限，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件（双向推力旋翼）上实现了高鲁棒性的真机零样本跌落恢复，技术扎实但生态封闭、泛化路径窄，暂未形成可迁移的方法论范式。

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）

papers.title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让仿人机器人主动‘看’地形的注意力机制，通过强化学习自发学会聚焦高度图中关键区域，从而在算力受限下提升感知精度，实现在仿真和真机上跨越1.2米宽沟、稀疏落脚点、高台等复杂地形的稳定行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者Guillaume Sartoretti隶属ETH Zurich，但团队构成不明；无明确企业/高校署名标识）

papers.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出MotionWAM，用单目前视摄像头输入，通过复用视频世界模型的中间去噪特征来驱动人形机器人全身运动（走路+上肢操作+脚部交互），在Unitree G1真机上实时运行，9个任务成功率比同数据微调的VLA基线高30%以上。

papers.title: Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个预测式安全过滤器Shield-Loco，在腿足机器人执行强化学习策略时实时拦截危险接触点，用全物理仿真+采样优化+学习型价值函数动态生成安全替代接触序列，显著降低真实四足机器人在杂乱环境中的碰撞次数。
analysis.claim: 通过后置式预测安全过滤器，可在不修改原始RL策略的前提下，以可计算的方式保障腿足机器人在复杂真实环境中的接触安全性，且不显著牺牲运动性能。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的名义接触位置序列 + 当前机器人状态（位姿、速度、关节状态） + 环境几何信息（深度/点云）
analysis.output: 修正后的安全接触位置序列（每步最多4个足端接触点）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、深度相机）进行在线安全评估与优化触发

papers.title: HORoSCOPE: Decoding human centromere architecture from short reads using k-mer signatures
papers.abstract: By directing kinetochore formation and chromosome segregation, centromeres safeguard genome integrity. Yet, the roles of centromeres in human disease are understudied, as their repetitive architecture comprising α-satellite higher-order repeats (HORs) renders them largely inaccessible to short-read sequencing approaches. Here we develop HORoSCOPE (Higher-Order Repeat organization and Size of Centromeres using Oligonucleotide Profiles for Estimation), a computational framework for k-mer-based inference of centromere structure and length from short-read data. Based on a reference atlas of 11,836 human centromeres extracted from completely assembled (telomere-to-telomere) haplotypes, we systematically interrogate chromosome-specific centromere architectures, deriving architecture-specific k-mer signatures as well as centromeric length-informative k-mers from common to rare centromere architectures. Leveraging these diagnostic k-mers, HORoSCOPE achieves a precision of 99.3% and a recall of 99.5% in classifying chromosome-specific centromere architectures from short-read de Bruijn graphs. We perform a population-scale analysis of global centromeric architectures in 4,029 human samples with ancestry from 80 human populations sequenced with short reads, uncovering continental haplotype structure for centromeric regions and highlighting African-enriched rare centromeric architectures. Furthermore, by analyzing 1,359 cancer genomes, we link graded HOR truncation events to arm-level copy-number alterations, and uncover a general dependency of chromosomal rearrangement locations on the position of the centromere dip region (CDR) defining the kinetochore attachment site. HORoSCOPE enables large-scale centromere genomics directly from short-read sample cohorts.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORoSCOPE方法，利用k-mer特征从常规短读长测序数据中高精度推断人类着丝粒的重复结构类型和长度，首次实现大规模人群和癌症样本中着丝粒架构的系统解析。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准短读长测序数据（如Illumina），无需长读长或特殊建库，即可高精度解码人类着丝粒的α卫星高阶重复（HOR）结构类型与相对长度。
analysis.input: Illumina短读长FASTQ文件（经比对或直接de Bruijn图构建）
analysis.output: 染色体特异性的着丝粒HOR架构分类（如D17Z1型、D15Z1型等）及相对长度估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何实验硬件或机器人平台，纯计算方法
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无长读长/无PacBio/Oxford Nanopore辅助下，用短读长数据实现着丝粒HOR架构的高精度（>99%）分类与长度推断，并在4029人+1359癌基因组中完成泛人群验证与临床关联发现（如HOR截短与拷贝数改变梯度相关、重排位点富集于CDR区域），填补了表观基因组学与癌症基因组学中长期存在的‘着丝粒黑箱’；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但属该细分领域里程碑级工具突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了人类着丝粒结构解析长期依赖长读长/手工注释的瓶颈，将短读长数据利用率提升至新量级，并产出首个跨人群着丝粒架构图谱与癌症关联规律。

papers.title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning, not only as a renderer, controller testbed, or fixed task environment. Existing pipelines split these layers with "magic" actions, disconnected training environments, or forward-only renders that cannot reproduce, evaluate, and annotate the same episode. We present MagicSim, an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared Markov decision process (MDP). From YAML-first specifications that decouple contents, placement, behavior, and agent exposure, MagicSim constructs diverse executable worlds spanning task families, interaction regimes, physics, layouts, sensors, avatars, and robot embodiments in one reset-and-step loop. A common execution interface grounds high-level commands through controllers, atomicskills, planner primitives, and asynchronous planning, realizing them as robot actions rather than simulator-side state edits. One task definition supports three capabilities: benchmark and RL evaluation, an autocollect interface that automatically turns commands into grounded trajectories, and agent/VLM-facing interaction. For automatic execution, commands flow through a Command->Skill->Planner->Robot->Record pipeline, while per-environment command, skill, planning, retry, annotation, and episode states advance independently above the shared physics tick. Successful rollouts are saved as structured multimodal trajectories aligning language supervision, action representations, visual/geometric representations, and task-level status with the executed episode. MagicSim thus unifies diverse world construction, embodied execution, task evaluation, automatic rollout generation, and interactive agent interfaces in one planner-in-the-loop runtime.

analysis.tldr: MagicSim 是一个面向具身智能的统一仿真基础设施，用 YAML 定义世界和任务，通过单个确定性批处理运行时和共享 MDP 实现任务构建、自动轨迹采集、RL 训练、基准评测和 VLM/agent 交互全部闭环，核心是把仿真从‘渲染器/测试床’升级为可复现、可标注、可规划的执行基座。

papers.title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 用单个操作员示范训练两个机器人协作操作共享物体，通过分阶段不对称模仿（先训A再用A训B再微调A），在真实双机器人平台上实现了无需同步双人示范或显式通信的物理耦合协作。
