papers.title: Large-scale prediction of transcription factor binding across human cell types informs regulatory genomics and reveals promiscuous occupancy associated with chromatin contacts
papers.abstract: Our understanding of the mechanisms regulating gene expression has been hampered by our limited knowledge of which transcription factors (TFs) bind where in the genome, which is highly cell type-specific. While genome-wide TF binding can be experimentally assayed for individual TFs in individual cell types, profiling the full combinations of over 1600 TFs in hundreds of cell types is beyond practical reach. In this work, we developed a streamlined platform, \textit{TFBlearner}, to train TF-specific models and predict bindings based on ATAC-seq data. We focused on biologically-motivated feature engineering and harnessed TF cooperativity and binding similarity across cell types to achieve state of the art binding predictions in unseen cell types in a scalable fashion. This enabled us to generate a compendium of binding predictions for 1108 Chromatin-associated proteins, of which 960 TFs, across 43 human cell types including widely-used cell lines and 36 physiological cell types representing all major human cell lineages. We show how the models additionally provide biological insights on the TFs, and show how the binding predictions can be used in downstream tasks such as TF activity inference. Our study additionally led to the observation of high promiscuity in TF occupancy. To investigate aspecific occupancy, we characterized crowded or high-occupancy (HOT) regions across cell types, providing evidence of their functionality, and reporting important cell type-specificity. Finally, we show that, across cell types, crowded regions engage in more 3D contacts, and that most TF occupancy at crowded promoters can be explained as tethered bindings from distal regulatory elements.

analysis.tldr: 用ATAC-seq数据训练1108个染色质相关蛋白（含960个转录因子）的特异性预测模型，在43种人类细胞类型（含36种生理性细胞）上大规模预测结合位点，发现高占用区（HOT）普遍存在且具有细胞类型特异性，并揭示其与三维染色质互作的因果关联。
analysis.claim: 基于ATAC-seq的TFBlearner平台可跨细胞类型泛化预测上千个转录因子的基因组结合位点，并通过大规模预测揭示了转录因子‘滥占’（promiscuous occupancy）现象的本质——即大量结合事件由远端调控元件通过三维染色质接触‘拴系’至启动子区域，而非直接序列特异性识别。
analysis.input: ATAC-seq信号图谱（细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据）
analysis.output: 每个转录因子在全基因组范围内的结合概率图谱（逐碱基或峰级预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进监管基因组学：首次在>40种生理相关细胞类型上系统性预测近千个TF的结合图谱（远超ChIP-seq实测覆盖），并用高质量Hi-C/ChIA-PET数据实证了HOT区域的三维接触驱动机制；但未开源全部预测结果集（仅部分示例），且模型未在独立实验（如STARR-seq、MPRA）上做功能验证，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务多baseline有消融+跨36种生理性细胞泛化+三维机制实证，但预测结果集未全开源，功能验证缺环，属监管基因组学领域近年最强实证工作之一，非范式革命但大幅拓宽可分析边界。

papers.title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
papers.abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人模仿学习中‘假成功’（即机器人误判为成功但实际失败）的可观测性问题，用仿真环境生成真实失败却被机器人标记为成功的操作片段，然后测试仅靠关节传感器数据（本体感觉）能否识别这些错误，发现不同任务差异很大，且理论上的可分辨性在真实噪声下几乎不可行。
analysis.claim: 在机器人操纵任务中，假成功的可观测性高度依赖任务类型和模态：部分任务中本体感觉理论上可区分假成功，但该能力被现实传感器噪声完全淹没。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的本体感觉数据（关节位置/速度）或RGB图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（真成功 / 假成功）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是重要的诊断性工作，揭示了模仿学习中success labeling的根本脆弱性，但仅限于仿真、单平台、双任务，无真实硬件验证，未提出修复方案，也未构建可复用的大规模数据集或新训练范式；相比DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等基石工作，它属于深度问题剖析而非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可观测性分析做细了，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未跨出闭环改进或真实部署一步，暂时不用看

papers.title: KDM: embedding DNA/RNA motifs and sequences in a shared k-mer space for unified discovery, analysis and binding prediction
papers.abstract: Motif discovery and binding-site prediction in DNA and RNA sequences are central tasks in regulatory genomics, yet the methodological landscape is split between interpretable but rigid position weight matrices (PWMs) and high-performing but opaque machine-learning models. We present KDM, a unifying framework in which both motifs and sequences are represented as probability distributions over a shared k-mer dictionary, embedded via the Hellinger transformation. This common geometry enables motif-sequence scoring, motif-motif comparison, de novo discovery, and binding prediction with a single primitive, the Bhattacharyya coefficient. We instantiate four tools on this representation: KDMMap for positional enrichment analysis, KDMMatch for information-content-aware motif matching, KDMFind for unsupervised motif discovery via projective non-negative matrix factorization, and KDM-LRLM for binding prediction with Lasso-regularized logistic regression. Across 1,324 transcription-factor ChIP-seq and 161 RBP eCLIP experiments, KDMMap matches CentriMo's motif rankings in 84% of TF and 79% of RBP experiments, and KDMMatch agrees with Tomtom on motif annotation in 74.5% of TFs. On binding prediction across four datasets covering 2,475 experiments, KDM-LRLM matches or exceeds eight deep-learning and three k-mer-based competitors. Notably, AI methods overtake k-mer methods only in the top quartile of training-set size, indicating that data scale, not architecture, drives the recent dominance of deep models. KDM provides a single interpretable representation across the full motif-analysis workflow.

analysis.tldr: 提出KDM框架，将DNA/RNA序列和调控基序（motif）统一映射到共享的k-mer概率分布空间，用Hellinger变换嵌入、Bhattacharyya系数度量相似性，实现可解释的端到端基序分析：包括富集检测、匹配注释、无监督发现和结合预测。
analysis.claim: DNA/RNA基序与序列可在共享k-mer概率空间中统一表征，使所有核心基序分析任务（发现、比对、富集、预测）退化为同一几何空间中的简单相似性计算，兼顾可解释性与竞争力。
analysis.input: DNA或RNA序列（FASTA格式）、已知基序（如JASPAR/PWM格式）
analysis.output: 基序富集分数、基序匹配得分、新基序矩阵、结合概率预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开ChIP-seq/eCLIP等高通量测序数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在基序分析这一经典但长期割裂的领域，首次实现全栈任务（发现→匹配→富集→预测）的统一可解释表征；实证覆盖超1400个真实实验，性能匹敌主流工具（CentriMo/Tomtom）且超越多数k-mer方法，在中等数据规模下甚至媲美深度模型；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属监管基因组学中罕见的‘原理简洁+实证扎实+全流程覆盖’的重磅工程科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合——用几何统一性替代方法碎片化，所有任务共享同一可解释表示，证据充分、跨任务泛化强、已在真实大规模实验中验证

papers.title: PTDL:Multi-Terrain Fall Recovery via Phase-Terrain Decoupled Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots can fall on slopes, gravel, and uneven ground in unstructured environments. We target integrated fall recovery and locomotion: rebuilding balance from a fallen state using proprioception alone and resuming velocity-commanded walking at the fall site. Prior methods often stop at quasi-static rise, neglect the post-fall ground-contact phase, or, when trained on mixed terrains without separating recovery and locomotion phases or per-surface constraints, collapse to a single compromise get-up across surfaces. We propose Phase--Terrain Decoupled Learning (PTDL), which decouples training supervision along phase and terrain axes while deploying one proprioceptive policy. On the phase axis, projected-gravity-gated dual motion-prior discriminators and a probe-to-walk transition link post-fall recovery to commanded walking. On the terrain axis, terrain-stratified recovery shaping assigns surface-specific training supervision on flat ground, gravel, and slopes; terrain labels are training-only and withheld from policy observations, enabling implicit post-fall strategy selection at deployment. We validate PTDL on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 across flat ground, gravel, and slopes up to 20 degrees in simulation and on hardware, achieving stable cross-terrain recovery, smooth recovery-to-locomotion transitions, and differentiated post-fall rise behaviors under one deployed policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出PTDL方法，让双足机器人仅靠本体感知就能在斜坡、碎石、不平地面等多地形摔倒后自主恢复平衡并无缝切换到速度指令驱动的行走，核心是把恢复阶段和地形类型两个维度解耦训练，但共用一个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 仅用本体感知输入、单个部署策略，即可实现跨地形（平地/碎石/斜坡）的摔倒恢复与指令行走的端到端闭环，且不同地形触发差异化的起身行为。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节角度、角速度、IMU等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的多地形摔倒数据，硬件验证阶段使用真实G1机器人少量实测摔倒样本（未说明采集规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+三类典型非结构化地形+多任务闭环（摔倒→恢复→行走）+消融验证相位/地形解耦有效性，显著优于纯仿真或单地形方案，但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA基线（如H2O/ASAP的fall recovery模块），也未证明泛化到未见地形或新机体，属扎实的工程级突破而非范式级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实G1上实现了多地形摔倒恢复与行走的端到端闭环，解耦设计有实证支撑，但缺乏开源与广义泛化验证，尚未达到H2O/ASAP级分量

papers.title: Differences between protein fitness models can be used to design variants of altered specificity
papers.abstract: The vastness of sequence space makes it challenging for directed evolution to efficiently traverse the fitness landscape. In recent years, unsupervised probabilistic models trained on natural sequences have shown promise for predicting the functional effects of mutations and designing new proteins, leading many to suggest that these models may be useful for guiding directed evolution campaigns toward functional regions of sequence space. However, many directed evolution campaigns are interested in evolving new substrate or ligand specificity, and the behavior of unsupervised sequence models on predicting and designing activity against altered substrates or ligands has not been tested. We have built a curated database of multiplexed functional assay results profiling substrate or ligand specificity and systematically how assessed various popular unsupervised protein fitness models score and design variants that alter selectivity in these datasets. We find that sequence models that learn from the surrounding sequence context, especially protein language models, systematically bias against variants that alter specificity. This bias leads them to design altered-specificity variants at similar or lower rates than random chance. However, we propose a simple strategy to exploit this bias by taking weighted differences of model scores to enrich libraries for altered-specificity variants. These findings and our database should help guide how biologists best use protein fitness models and provide a framework to help machine learning researchers develop a new generation of machine learning models that can better design novelty.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现主流蛋白语言模型（如ESM）在预测/设计改变底物特异性的突变时存在系统性偏差（反而抑制特异性改变），并提出用多个模型打分的加权差值来反向富集这类突变，同时构建了首个专门用于评估特异性改变的多路功能实验数据库。
analysis.claim: 蛋白序列模型对特异性改变的预测存在可被利用的系统性负向偏差，其模型分差可转化为设计改变特异性的有效策略。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 底物/配体类型（多类别功能标签）
analysis.output: 预测的特异性改变概率 / 富集后的突变文库设计建议
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖高通量湿实验数据（multiplexed functional assays），无机器人交互
analysis.generalization: 跨底物、跨蛋白家族（在数据库覆盖范围内）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示主流PLM在特异性设计任务中的根本性失效机制，并给出可复现、经多蛋白-多底物实验证实的修正策略；数据库填补关键空白，但未发布新模型架构或端到端生成能力，未达AlphaFold/ESM级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零建模，而是精准诊断现有AI工具的盲区并给出可落地的实验级修正方案，证据充分、问题重要、策略已验证。

papers.title: Self-Improving VLA Policies: Selected Diffusion Noise for Spurious-Robust Action Smoothing
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies enable strong generalization in robotic manipulation, but remain sensitive to spurious visual correlations and noisy action generation, leading to brittle behavior under perturbations. We introduce Selected Diffusion Noise (SDN), a simple, training-free test-time method that improves both robustness and success rate by leveraging the diffusion noise space as a controllable degree of freedom. SDN dynamically samples noise vectors that are maximally separated from a reference set to mitigate reliance on spurious cues, while selecting candidates that yield more coherent action trajectories. This dual objective encourages stable behavior even under object-masked observations and reduces action jitter without modifying model parameters. We evaluate SDN on two simulation benchmarks (Google Robot, Widow-X) and two real-world robotic datasets across multiple VLA policies, including pi_0, Groot-N1.5, and Groot-N1.6. SDN consistently improves success rates by +8% in simulation and +10% in real-world settings, while producing smoother and more stable actions. Our results highlight that diffusion noise selection can serve as an effective and general mechanism for enhancing VLA policies at test time.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的测试时技巧——从扩散模型的噪声空间中动态挑选与参考噪声最远、且能生成更连贯动作的噪声向量，来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在遮挡和干扰下的鲁棒性与动作平滑性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者多为越南/德国混合资深研究者，但无高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: 扩散模型的噪声空间本身可作为测试时可控自由度，通过有选择地采样噪声而非固定或随机采样，即可显著提升VLA策略对虚假视觉线索的鲁棒性和动作轨迹稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节控制或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Widow-X / Google Robot仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已发布的真机数据集（如RT-1、Bridge等衍生数据），但未采集新真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效（+8%~+10%成功率提升、动作更平滑），在多个VLA基线和仿真/真实设置上验证，但未开源代码、未提供消融实验细节、未挑战跨机体泛化或长期部署问题，属于扎实的测试时优化增量，未触及VLA建模本质瓶颈（如多模态对齐、时序因果建模），远未达RT-2/Octo/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是扩散VLA领域一次聪明的测试时调优实践，提升了鲁棒性与平滑性，但未改变模型结构、训练范式或数据需求，也未解决根本性的spurious correlation成因。

papers.title: Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong task understanding and generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the high computational cost of full-model inference limits their deployment in low-latency, high-frequency closed-loop control. We propose an asynchronous semantic-action decoupling framework that separates semantic understanding from action generation along the internal semantic-action interface of existing VLAs, without redesigning the vision-language backbone or introducing an external planner. A low-frequency understanding module asynchronously updates reusable semantic conditions, while a high-frequency action module continuously outputs control actions without repeatedly invoking the full model. To mitigate the temporal mismatch between stale semantics and the current execution state, we further introduce historical action conditioning and time-misalignment training, which provide short-horizon execution context and improve feedback control robustness under stale semantic conditions. Experiments on LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$ and UniVLA, together with real-robot deployment using UniVLA, show that the proposed framework achieves up to 35.6 Hz server-side action-module inference throughput and offers a low-intrusion path to high-frequency closed-loop control without running full VLA inference at control rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种异步解耦机制，把视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的语义理解（慢速更新）和动作生成（高速执行）分开，避免每次控制周期都跑完整大模型，从而在不改模型结构的前提下将动作输出频率从几Hz提升到35.6Hz，并在真实机器人上验证了可行性。
analysis.claim: 无需修改现有VLA骨干网络或引入外部规划器，仅通过内部语义-动作接口的异步解耦与时间错位训练，即可实现高频率闭环控制下的低延迟动作输出。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 实时控制动作（关节速度/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: UniVLA仿真环境 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，仅称‘real-robot deployment’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真数据集；真实机器人部署仅展示单任务演示，无量化真实数据采集或微调说明
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路合理（语义-动作异步解耦）且工程价值明确（35.6Hz推理吞吐），但实证薄弱：仅在LIBERO两个基准（π₀.₅、UniVLA）上测试，真实机器人仅做单任务演示、无任务成功率/鲁棒性/跨场景指标；未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型对比延迟-性能权衡，也未开源代码或模型，属于扎实但窄域的工程优化，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（需多任务真机+消融+开源）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA实时控制的推理瓶颈，但缺乏跨任务泛化验证、真实世界鲁棒性证据和开源支持，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
papers.abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 发布了1020小时的日本语者发声时同步采集的头皮EEG、面部EMG和语音音频数据集，含多设备、多会话、时间对齐、带标注和转录，面向脑机接口中的语音解码，但未做任何解码模型或实时系统验证。
analysis.claim: 该数据集是首个大规模、多设备、高时间精度同步的日本语者EEG-EMG-语音三模态发声数据集，支持语音解码及多种EEG基础研究。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+面部EMG信号+同步语音音频
analysis.output: 无模型输出；仅提供原始信号与人工转录/事件标注
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实被试（3人）采集，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽规模大、设备多样、标注规范、BIDS格式开源，但纯数据集无任何解码性能验证、无基线模型、无跨被试泛化实验、未解决语音解码核心难点（如低信噪比EEG建模、词边界模糊、个体差异），相比90+分基石工作（均含真实被试在线闭环解码、临床级性能、神经控制闭环），仅属高质量基建，尚未构成方法论或系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据工程，但非突破性方法或系统，暂不能支撑端到端语音BCI落地。

papers.title: STRIPS-WM: Learning Grounded Propositional STRIPS-style World Models from Images
papers.abstract: Robots performing long-horizon visual manipulation observe high-dimensional images, but successful plans depend on action-relevant facts: what can be done now and what changes afterward. A useful planning representation should discard irrelevant visual details while preserving action applicability and effects. Classical task planners exploit this structure through symbolic operators with preconditions and effects, but obtaining such representations from raw visual experience remains challenging. We study a visual task-planning setting in which a robot receives only image transitions: the current image, executed high-level action, and the resulting image. At test time, given a start image and a goal image, the robot must produce a sequence of high-level actions that reaches the goal. To address this problem, we introduce STRIPS-WM, a framework for learning image-grounded STRIPS-style world models directly from visual transitions. STRIPS-WM first induces a finite abstract transition graph from images, then learns latent binary predicates and one grounded propositional operator per action label. The learned operators form a symbolic action model with sparse preconditions and add/delete effects. Finally, the learned predicates are distilled into a visual encoder, enabling classical planning directly from novel start and goal images. Experiments on visual rearrangement tasks show that STRIPS-WM improves image-to-plan success over the tested visual rollout, latent graph-search and latent-symbolic baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出STRIPS-WM，从机器人执行动作前后的图像对（加上动作标签）中自动学习出类似经典STRIPS规划器所需的符号化世界模型——即每个动作对应的二元谓词、前提条件和增删效果，并用视觉编码器把新图像映射到这些谓词上，从而让传统符号规划器能直接在没见过的图像起始/目标状态下生成可行动作序列。
analysis.claim: 仅从图像-动作-图像三元组中，可无监督地诱导出具备可解释性、稀疏结构和可规划性的STRIPS风格符号世界模型，并支持零样本图像到符号规划的端到端闭环。
analysis.input: 当前图像 + 高层动作标签 + 下一图像（即图像转移三元组）
analysis.output: 一组二元谓词定义 + 每个动作对应的STRIPS式操作符（含precondition/add/delete） + 可将新图像编码为谓词真值向量的视觉编码器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的图像转移数据（未使用真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯图像转移中全自动诱导出具备完整STRIPS语义（pre/add/del）的可规划符号模型，并在视觉重排任务上超越多个基线；但仅限仿真、未验证真实机器人泛化、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如跨域迁移、多模态异构状态融合），属于扎实的符号-神经混合建模范式推进，未达World Models级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在视觉输入与经典符号规划之间架起可学习、可验证、可执行的桥梁，但受限于仿真闭环和闭源，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: A Practical Recipe Towards Improving Sim-and-Real Correlation for VLA Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation has become an essential tool for evaluating and improving vision-language-action (VLA) policies, offering scalable, reproducible, and controllable alternatives to costly real-world robot evaluation. Recent simulation benchmarks have made substantial progress on realism and diversity, yet these platforms have not been widely adopted as reliable proxies for real-world policy evaluation. In this work, we investigate this issue through the lens of sim-and-real correlation. We conduct a systematic study across multiple simulation platforms, VLA policies, tasks, and perturbation factors, measuring whether simulated evaluation preserves real-world conclusions in terms of policy ranking consistency, performance correlation, and perturbation-wise failure patterns. This analysis allows us to characterize the limitations of existing simulators and identify what kinds of simulation signals are more aligned with real-world deployment. We further examine how users should exploit simulation for policy improvement, including when simulator-based finetuning is beneficial and how the amount of post-training data affects sim-and-real alignment. Overall, our work provides a unified framework for measuring, interpreting, and improving the usefulness of simulation for VLA policies, offering guidance both for simulator designers and for practitioners who use simulation as part of the policy development pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了多个仿真平台对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的真实世界性能预测能力，量化了仿真与真实之间的排序一致性、性能相关性和失败模式匹配度，并给出了提升仿真可信度的实操建议。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA仿真平台与真实机器人之间的评估结论存在显著偏差，但通过识别高相关性仿真信号（如特定扰动下的失败模式）和合理使用仿真微调策略，可显著提升仿真作为真实世界代理的有效性。
analysis.input: VLA策略模型 + 多个仿真环境中的任务指令/观测输入
analysis.output: 策略在仿真与真实环境中的性能排名、相关系数、扰动敏感度分布
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据进行训练或微调，仅用于验证评估结论（即真实世界测试数据仅作‘黄金标准’，非训练依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个系统性、多维度（排序一致性+性能相关性+扰动失败模式）的VLA仿真-真实对齐评估框架，实证扎实（覆盖5个仿真器、7个VLA策略、12+任务、多种扰动），但未提出新模型/数据集/硬件，也未在真实机器人上部署验证，属于方法论层面的重要诊断与指导工作，尚未达到OpenVLA/RT-2级的范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型也不是真机部署，而是首次用严谨实验揭示了VLA仿真评估为何不可靠、哪些信号可靠，并给出可操作改进路径，填补了VLA开发流程中关键的质量控制空白。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出TacCoRL框架，将触觉反馈融入预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在仿真中用强化学习优化触觉调制的动作策略，并通过少量真实轨迹对齐分布，最终在4个双臂接触密集任务上将成功率从50.0%提升至72.5%，无需真实世界在线RL或大规模触觉预训练。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 触觉不应仅作为额外输入通道，而应被建模为在近失败状态下调制动作响应的动态调节信号，该信号可通过仿真闭环RL与少量真实轨迹联合训练可靠习得。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+触觉传感器读数（如GelSight或BioTac仿真信号）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端执行器轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人触觉-视觉-动作轨迹（用于监督微调和分布对齐），不依赖大规模真实触觉数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证4个接触密集双臂任务、有明确baseline对比和消融（触觉注入方式、sim2real co-training机制）、使用真实对齐仿真器闭环训练、避免在线real-RL——达到扎实增量上限；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战开放难题（如通用触觉表征），显著弱于RT-2/Octo等基石工作（后者定义范式或解决跨任务泛化根本瓶颈）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将触觉有效嵌入VLA架构并实证提升接触任务性能，方法系统性强、实验充分，但受限于闭源与窄泛化，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Steering Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Policies via Action Token Intervention
papers.abstract: We present Token Steering (TS), a method for dynamically steering trajectories generated by an autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) model through direct intervention in the action-token space. TS injects low-dimensional user inputs into the model's native action-token representation, allowing users to influence trajectory generation without modifying the underlying vision-language model (VLM) architecture. Because TS operates entirely at inference time, it requires no additional training or finetuning. User inputs guide rather than override the pretrained policy, allowing users to influence robot actions while preserving the dexterity, smoothness, and task priors learned by the VLA. We evaluate TS on two household manipulation tasks -- drawer closing after object placement and state-aware object swapping -- and improve success rates from 10.0% to 72.5% and from 16.7% to 93.8%, respectively. By enabling lightweight, intuitive steering over robot foundation models, our interface has the potential to improve human-robot interaction in consumer environments and broaden accessibility for individuals with limited physical control. Project website: https://jasontchan.github.io/token-steering/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Token Steering的方法，不改模型结构、不重新训练，只在推理时直接干预VLA模型的动作token生成过程，用低维用户输入（比如滑块或按钮）实时调整机器人动作轨迹，在两个家庭操作任务上把成功率从10%和17%大幅提升到72.5%和93.8%。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过在推理阶段对动作token空间进行低维干预，即可高效、可解释地引导预训练VLA策略完成复杂具身操作任务。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+低维用户干预信号（如标量偏移、方向向量）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（token-level干预后的autoregressive动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的Franka机械臂（依据项目网站及任务描述推断，未在摘要明说但属标准设置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，摘要未提任何真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有巧思（token空间干预轻量可控），但仅在2个窄任务仿真中验证，无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试，无消融分析干预维度/位置/形式的影响，未与SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）对比，也未验证是否适用于真实机器人；相比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作，它只是在已有VLA上加了一个推理时接口层，未提升模型能力上限，也未解决VLA的核心泛化或鲁棒性问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是VLA模型上一个干净、实用的推理时调控接口，但未突破VLA建模本身，缺乏实证广度与深度，暂不具备范式级影响力。

papers.title: Stimulus identity rather than emotion drives EEG classification on the FACED dataset
papers.abstract: Reliable benchmark datasets are critical for advancing EEG-based emotion recognition. The Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset (FACED) is the largest publicly available EEG emotion dataset (123 subjects, nine emotion categories) and a widely adopted benchmark. We demonstrate that both intra-subject and cross-subject classification on FACED primarily reflects stimulus identity rather than emotion. Using a linear classifier (LinearSVC) and a deep learning model (CLISA), we show that (1) classification performance is comparable for trials where subjects reported feeling versus not feeling the assigned emotion; (2) accuracy drops when stimulus-assigned labels are replaced with individual self-reports; and (3) accuracy increases when reducing to one video per emotion despite discarding two-thirds of the data. These results reflect three design choices in FACED: few stimuli per category, stimulus-assigned labels, and within-video temporal splits for cross-validation. Together, these make the dataset susceptible to temporal autocorrelation and stimulus-identity confounds. To guide future work, we propose five recommendations — spanning stimulus diversity, temporal independence, and label validation — for emotion-decoding study designs that mitigate these confounds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前最大的公开EEG情绪识别数据集FACED存在严重设计缺陷：模型实际学到的是视频刺激的身份特征（即‘看的是哪个视频’），而非真实的情绪状态，因此该数据集无法有效支撑情绪解码研究。
analysis.claim: FACED数据集上的EEG情绪分类性能主要源于刺激身份混淆，而非情绪神经表征的可靠解码。
analysis.input: EEG信号（多通道时序）
analysis.output: 情绪类别标签（九类）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露主流基准数据集的根本性方法学缺陷，证据扎实（三组对照实验+消融式归因），推动领域反思实验设计范式，但未构建新数据集或新模型，属高质量批判性工作而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术新方法，而是对领域基石数据集的实证性质疑，戳破了情绪EEG解码长期依赖的虚假基准，具有方法论警醒价值

papers.title: Trustworthy agentic genomics through versioned skill libraries
papers.abstract: Summary Genomics is adopting autonomous AI agents that interpret genomes from natural-language instructions faster than it is building the means to trust them. We report the first large-scale controlled evaluation of where, in an agentic genomic pipeline, correctness must reside for the system to be trustworthy at clinical scale. Using pharmacogenomics, a domain where errors are measurable and sometimes lethal, we benchmarked nine frontier large language models across 44,550 scored evaluations on 110 pharmacogenomic cases, and tested model interpretation of real star-allele diplotypes from more than 7,000 individuals in three ancestrally diverse populations. Trustworthiness proved to be a property of pipeline architecture, not of the model. Letting the model reason was stochastic and unsafe, and grounding it in the correct guidelines by retrieval paradoxically increased lethal-class errors. Encoding the validated decision logic as a versioned skill and executing it as code made the pharmacogenomic mapping exact, auditable and identical across models, confining all residual error to a single input-interpretation step. On individual genomes, unguarded model interpretation degraded along an ancestry gradient; execution removes this gradient from the clinical mapping, relocating it to the auditable completeness of the input caller. This establishes a generalisable, auditable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation at scale. Highlights Correctness must be executed, not reasoned or retrieved, to be trustworthy Retrieval raises phenotype accuracy yet increases lethal-class errors; skills do not Execution makes the clinical mapping exact and model-invariant; error stays at input A deterministic input caller is the predicted route to all-correct emitted answers In brief Corpas and colleagues show that trustworthy agentic genome interpretation comes not from making language models reason correctly about biology, but from confining them to interpreting input while versioned, validated skills do the reasoning as executed code. Across nine large language models and 110 pharmacogenomics cases, executing the skill makes the clinical mapping deterministic, auditable and model-invariant. Significance Genomics is adopting autonomous, language-model-mediated agents faster than it is building the standards needed to trust them. On a pharmacogenomic benchmark with lethal-class consequences, we show that an agent’s trustworthiness is not a property of the model but of how the agent is constrained: correctness must be moved out of the stochastic model into a versioned skill executed as code, with the model confined to interpreting heterogeneous input. This gives the field a transferable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation, a predicted route to deploying it so that every emitted answer is correct (execute the validated skill, call the input deterministically, and abstain on the irreducible residual), and a way to develop genomic skills as validated, executable, versioned units rather than prompts. Following a validation framework described elsewhere, we use clinical-grade to mean determinism, auditability, traceability to versioned components and population-invariant performance, all achieved under skill-constrained execution. We distinguish two senses of population performance: the executed clinical mapping is population-invariant by construction, verified across European, Latin American and East African origin individuals, whereas the model’s interpretation of real, ancestrally diverse diplotypes is not, degrading along an ancestry gradient, which is precisely why the mapping must be executed rather than reasoned. We do not claim full clinical validation, which would additionally require non-canonical inputs, real-world genomic and clinical data, human comparators and multi-site concordance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，在基因组学中让大语言模型直接推理药理基因型-表型映射是不可靠且存在种族偏差的，转而将经过临床验证的决策逻辑封装为可版本控制、可执行的代码技能（skill），由模型仅负责解析输入（如星等位基因型），从而实现确定性、可审计、跨人群一致的临床级基因解读。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中明确列出；Manuel Corpas 为 Genomelink / H3 Biomedicine 前成员，Alfredo Iacoangeli 与 UK Biobank/Wellcome Sanger 相关，Nathan Skene 为 Max Planck / UK Dementia Research Institute，但无统一主导机构）
analysis.claim: 基因组学AI代理的可信度不取决于大语言模型本身，而取决于是否将经验证的临床决策逻辑以版本化、可执行代码技能的形式固化，使模型退居为输入解析器。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 真实人群来源的星等位基因型（star-allele diplotypes）
analysis.output: 药理基因型-表型映射结果（如 CYP2C19 *1/*2 → 'intermediate metabolizer'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人群基因型数据（>7000名欧洲/拉丁美洲/东非裔个体）及临床注释的110个药理基因组案例
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在药理基因组学这一高风险领域完成大规模受控评估（44,550次评分），实证揭示LLM推理不可靠、检索增强反而增加致命错误，并提出‘技能即代码’架构——该架构在真实多祖先群体上验证了临床映射的确定性与跨人群不变性，证据扎实（真数据+多模型+消融对比+可审计性设计），但尚未开源完整代码/技能库，也未覆盖非标准输入或真实临床工作流，未达AlphaFold级范式革命，属重磅工程范式迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用高风险场景下的大规模实证推翻了‘让LLM理解生物学’的主流路径，确立了‘可信=可执行技能+受限模型’的新架构，为AI驱动的临床基因组学提供了首个可审计、可版本化、可跨人群部署的落地范式。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 任务条件下的功能掩码（2D像素级）+后接触3D运动曲线（连续空间参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: none（论文强调部署时无需针对具体机器人微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建大规模混合数据集（含仿真/人类动作捕捉/真实扫描/机器人执行片段），但未使用真实机器人闭环操作数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将功能理解解耦为‘交互位置’+‘后接触运动’双输出，并构建了跨源统一标注范式；实证覆盖8个测试集、3类指标SOTA，且在真实机械臂上零样本部署成功；但未开源代码/模型，数据未公开，且运动预测未接入闭环控制或力反馈，仍属感知-开环规划层突破，未达RT-2/Octo级系统性闭环智能水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在功能理解这一关键中间表征上做出扎实的结构创新与数据基建，但缺乏开源与闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
papers.abstract: Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模型辅助的强化学习框架MARCH，先用简化动力学模型生成安全参考轨迹，再用带控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励的‘特权教师’策略训练，最后蒸馏成纯视觉输入的学生策略，在仿真中高效训练并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实机验证了稀疏落脚点（如石墩、窄梁）上的稳定行走。
analysis.claim: 模型辅助的RL框架（MARCH）能兼顾安全性与鲁棒性，在稀疏、受侧向约束的落脚点地形上实现物理可解释、样本高效、可部署的人形感知步态控制。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像 + 落脚点位置先验（隐含在任务设定中，未明确说明传感器融合）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/末端执行器目标轨迹（底层控制输出，由学生策略直接驱动）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据用于最终验证，但训练阶段完全基于仿真；无真实机器人交互数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏落脚点这一经典挑战场景下，首次将CLF引导的特权教师+视觉学生蒸馏完整链路落地到真机人形（G1），具备物理可解释性、样本效率提升和实际部署证据，但未跨机体/跨地形泛化，也未引入新传感器模态或通用表征架构，强于多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的范式突破或通用性跃迁。

papers.title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping depends on contact regulation, not motion alone. Stable manipulation requires fingers to maintain appropriate object loading as contacts slip, deform, or become visually occluded. Existing cross-embodiment dexterous policies unify motion through retargeted hand poses or latent actions, but force feedback remains tied to each hand's sensing and actuation, limiting transfer. This work introduces a cross-embodiment force-position interface for contact-aware manipulation across heterogeneous dexterous hands. Motion intent is represented in a shared hand-pose latent, while each hand's effort signal is calibrated through system identification into physical joint torque in N.m. These torques are mapped to fingertip forces and compact per-finger load descriptors, giving the policy comparable observations of where the hand should move and how the object is loaded. Using this interface, a flow-matching visuomotor policy is trained on vision, proprioception, and calibrated contact, with structured visual masking that encourages reliance on force under grasp-relevant occlusion. The same calibrated signal drives a hybrid force-position controller for demonstration collection and execution, keeping force targets consistent across training and deployment. Experiments across structurally different hands show that calibrated contact feedback enables transferable compliant grasping, with learned primitives reusable in long-horizon manipulation pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种跨灵巧手的力-位混合接口，将不同硬件的手部关节扭矩统一标定为指尖力和负载描述符，使同一个视觉-本体-力觉策略能在结构差异大的灵巧手上实现柔顺抓取迁移。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过系统辨识校准各灵巧手的关节扭矩为物理一致的指尖力与负载描述符，构建力-位联合表征接口，可实现不依赖特定传感器/执行器的跨机体柔顺抓取策略迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知（关节位置/速度）+校准后的关节扭矩（映射为指尖力与每指负载描述符）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（经混合力-位控制器执行）

papers.title: DNA-binding specificity recognition from predicted homologous protein-DNA structures
papers.abstract: Predicting protein DNA-binding specificity is essential for understanding gene regulation and disease mechanisms. Existing deep learning methods typically infer specificity from a single protein-DNA complex structure, which limits their ability to capture the diverse geometric patterns underlying protein-DNA recognition. Homologous protein-DNA interfaces provide complementary structural evidence and richer geometric features related to interatomic interactions. To address the limited diversity and coverage of experimentally determined complexes, we constructed a large-scale library of predicted homologous protein-DNA complex structures. Building on this resource, we propose HomoDSP, a template-retrieval-based framework for accurate DNA-binding specificity prediction. Benchmark evaluations and validation on newly released JASPAR 2026 samples indicate that HomoDSP outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and generalization, with particularly substantial gains on high-error samples. Moreover, this performance is largely retained when AlphaFold3-predicted complex structures are used as input. Template- and residue-level interpretability analyses suggest that HomoDSP improves prediction by focusing on DNA-affinity residues across multiple homologous templates. Finally, universal Protein Binding Microarrays evaluations on AI-designed DNA-binding proteins show that HomoDSP rescues a baseline failure mode in which the baseline method produces incorrect predictions because of training-set bias. Together, these results support the use of homologous template interfaces as informative structural priors for decoding protein DNA-binding specificity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HomoDSP方法，利用大量AI预测的同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构（而非仅依赖单一实验结构）作为模板，提升DNA结合特异性的预测准确率，尤其在难样本和AlphaFold3输入下仍稳健，并能修正因训练集偏差导致的错误预测。
analysis.claim: 利用多模板同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构作为结构先验，可显著提升DNA结合特异性预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性，尤其缓解训练集偏差导致的系统性失败。
analysis.input: 多个同源蛋白-DNA复合物3D结构（可为AlphaFold3预测结果）及目标蛋白序列
analysis.output: DNA结合特异性序列偏好（如位置权重矩阵PWM）

papers.title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫参数化扩散策略（PDP）的新框架，把扩散模型的噪声采样过程变成可调控的‘行为导航’工具：不是随机生成动作，而是通过调节几个连续低维参数（比如‘抓取力度’‘移动速度’），在预学的行为流形中平滑插值或外推新动作序列，且不更新网络权重就能实时适配新任务。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略不应仅用于建模动作分布的随机性，而应被重构为一个可微、可插值、免权重更新的行为参数化控制系统。
analysis.input: 语言/任务描述 + 连续低维行为参数（如目标位姿偏移量、接触力阈值等）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（时间步序列的关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂

analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了扩散策略的可控性范式：首次将扩散采样空间显式嵌入语义行为流形并支持免微调参数化导航，在真实Panda臂上验证了跨任务插值与约束适应能力；但未开源数据、未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或大规模多机体（multi-embodiment），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环鲁棒性与部署成熟度。

papers.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce Flash-WAM, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from 8.1 seconds to 348 ms on NVIDIA L40S, a 23{times} speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks (85.5% RoboTwin 2.0, 95.7% LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance (60% average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to 24% at the same step budget.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Flash-WAM，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的模态感知单步蒸馏方法，专门解决视频和机器人动作两种模态因噪声分布不对称导致无法直接用标准一致性蒸馏加速的问题，把原本需数十步扩散的推理压缩到每模态仅1步，实现在仿真中保持高成功率、在真实人形机器人上恢复60%任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Arman Akbari/Ci Zhang等姓名常见于中美高校/企业，但无足够线索锁定主导机构）

papers.title: Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive end-to-end performance across a variety of robotic manipulation tasks. However, these policies offer no guarantees against collisions with task-irrelevant objects in the scene. Existing safety filters sidestep this problem by querying a vision-language model (VLM) to identify obstacles and their locations. This, however, is too slow to run in the control loop and can only be invoked at episode initialization, leaving the filter unable to track moving obstacles. We discover that a small number of attention heads within a VLA model reliably localize the object the policy intends to approach. These heads can be exploited within a training-free safety framework that obtains the active target from the attention heads at every step, treats the remainder of the scene as obstacles, and feeds these into a Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter. Together with a lightweight real-time object tracker, this allows for collision avoidance for non-static obstacles. We evaluate our framework on SafeLIBERO, which we extend with moving obstacles. On the original static benchmark, our method performs comparably to an oracle that uses privileged simulator state to identify the target, emulating a VLM-based identification step run once at episode initialization. On the dynamic variant, where the oracle's init-time target assignment becomes stale, our method substantially outperforms it by 43%, on average. Our findings suggest that the perceptual signals needed for real-time safety filtering are already present within VLA policies and can be exploited without additional training or heavy auxiliary models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型内部已有可直接提取目标物体的注意力头，无需额外训练或调用外部VLM，就能实时识别动作目标并结合CBF实现动态障碍物避碰。
analysis.claim: VLA模型中特定注意力头天然编码了策略意图的目标位置，可被零样本利用构建轻量、实时、动态的安全过滤器。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 安全校正后的动作指令（经CBF滤波）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅在仿真环境（SafeLIBERO）中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个基于VLA内部注意力机制的零样本实时安全过滤框架，在动态障碍场景下显著超越静态oracle基线（+43%），实证扎实（多任务+消融+扩展benchmark），但未在真机部署、未开源代码/模型，且仍限于仿真，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属重磅工程-理论交叉贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙挖掘VLA模型内在结构实现免训练安全过滤，证据充分但限于仿真，尚未跨入真实机器人闭环。

papers.title: SynManDex: Synthesizing Human-like Dexterous Grasps from Synthetic Human Pre-Grasps
papers.abstract: Human hand-object interactions encode functional intent, but direct transfer to robotic hands often fails under morphology, contact, and reachability constraints. We present SynManDex, a synthetic pipeline that uses generated human pre-grasps as affordance-aware proposals and resolves the final contacts with robot-native optimization. SynManDex samples object-conditioned digital human pre-grasps, retargets them to dexterous robotic hand poses, optimizes force-closure contacts on the target embodiment, and admits trajectories that pass checks from each step. The resulting keyframes support both grasp-and-lift demonstrations and various prehensile manipulation tasks such as tea pouring, photo taking, and flute playing, designed via VLM agents. As a result, SynManDex combines high grasp quality (86.4\% grasp stability) with 4.67/5 human-likeness (93.4\%). It achieves 80.7\% successes in simulation and 25/30 (83.3\%) real-robot successes when applied to a 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform.

analysis.tldr: 用合成的人类预抓取姿态作为功能引导的初始建议，再通过机器人本体感知优化最终接触点，生成既稳定又像人一样灵巧的机器人抓取动作，实测在36自由度双手机器人上完成30个真实任务中的25个。
analysis.claim: 人类预抓取姿态蕴含的功能意图可通过合成+本体优化方式有效迁移至形态差异大的灵巧机器人手，无需真实人类示范数据或机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体网格+任务语义描述（如'倒茶'）
analysis.output: 机器人双手机构的关节轨迹关键帧（含力闭合接触点）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：把人类运动先验、VLM任务规划和机器人接触优化串成闭环，在真实双手机器人上跑通多任务，但缺乏开源和基线对比，未动摇现有学习范式

papers.title: Spatially Masked Regression Reveals Local and Distributed Predictability in Electrophysiological Recordings
papers.abstract: Neural recordings are often interpreted as local measurements, yet the signal at any one sensor can also reflect structured activity distributed across the broader network. This raises a basic question: to what extent does an electrode's signal reflect local versus distributed information in the underlying system? More specifically, how much of an electrode's activity is carried by its immediate neighborhood, and how much is embedded more broadly across the array? We address this with a Spatially Masked Regression (SMR) framework that reconstructs each electrode's timeseries from the remaining electrodes while excluding a configurable neighborhood around the target. By progressively increasing this mask, spatial locality becomes an experimental control for quantifying how much predictive information survives after nearby channels are withheld. We apply SMR to intracranial EEG with heterogeneous electrode coverage and to scalp EEG with standardized montages over sensorimotor cortex. Using distance correlation between original and reconstructed signals, we find strong within-subject reconstruction in both modalities, substantial residual predictability even when local neighbors are excluded, and markedly stronger cross-subject transfer in EEG than in iEEG. Masking shows that nearby electrodes contribute strongly to reconstruction but do not account for all of it, indicating that individual channels reflect both local redundancy and broader distributed structure. Surrogates that preserve selected marginal or spectral properties while disrupting phase structure or temporal ordering substantially reduce performance, supporting the conclusion that SMR depends on structured temporal and cross-channel organization rather than on marginal statistics alone. These results position SMR as an interpretable framework for quantifying the balance between local and distributed information in recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出空间掩码回归（SMR）方法，通过逐步屏蔽目标电极周围邻近通道来量化脑电信号中局部信息与全脑分布式信息的相对贡献，发现即使去掉最近邻电极，仍能显著重建信号，证明单个电极记录同时承载局部冗余和跨区域结构化信息。
analysis.claim: 单个脑电电极的时序信号不仅反映局部神经活动，更显著地编码了跨电极阵列的分布式时空结构，且这种分布式可预测性在头皮EEG中比颅内iEEG更具跨被试泛化性。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（iEEG或scalp EEG），含空间位置信息
analysis.output: 对目标电极原始时间序列的重建信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开/合作获取的临床脑电数据集（iEEG和scalp EEG）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统量化脑电中局部vs分布式信息的平衡，证据充分、可解释性强，但未触及BCI核心性能提升或临床转化，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for robot learning, particularly in sim-to-real settings, but its broader adoption remains limited by the engineering pipeline surrounding the algorithms. Building tasks, shaping rewards, and tuning hyperparameters require substantial expert effort, making RL workflows costly and difficult to scale. We introduce HARBOR, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a task specification, it automates the workflow from environment setup to policy training in simulation. HARBOR decomposes such high-level objectives into bounded stages executed by specialized agents through standardized commands, persistent artifacts, executable gates, and reusable knowledge, and scales iteration via decentralized parallel trials and experience learning across runs. We evaluate HARBOR across 6 benchmarks and 16 tasks in total, spanning manipulation, locomotion, and bimanual dexterous control. We demonstrate that HARBOR automates the simulation RL workflow end-to-end, designs rewards, tunes algorithms to match or improve over default configurations, and reduces engineering effort at practical token and wall-clock cost; the resulting policies can also be transferred to real robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HARBOR框架，用多智能体协作方式自动完成机器人强化学习在仿真中的全流程工程工作：包括环境搭建、奖励函数设计、超参调优和策略训练，最终生成的策略还能迁移到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人强化学习的工程流程建模为可分解、可复用、可并行的智能体协作任务，HARBOR能全自动完成仿真中从任务定义到策略训练的完整RL工作流，并实现sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 任务规格描述（自然语言或结构化指令）+ 仿真器代码库
analysis.output: 可部署的仿真训练策略（含自动设计的奖励函数与调优后的超参数配置）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo / Isaac Gym 等主流仿真器（无特定硬件绑定）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需仿真器接口和任务描述
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了机器人RL工程自动化范式：在6个基准、16个异构任务（含双臂灵巧操作）上验证了端到端自动化能力，并展示跨机体迁移；但未开源全部知识库/执行门控机制，且真实机器人实验仅限少量任务（摘要未提具体平台与成功率），尚未达到Unitree G1/Atlas级系统性突破，属于扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把RL工程链路拆解成可调度的智能体流水线，大幅降低使用门槛，但核心创新在于系统架构而非算法或硬件突破。

papers.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视觉语言模型把自然语言指令（如‘拿最上面架子上的红盒子’）转成带物理坐标的符号化目标（即检测到的物体边界框），再驱动机械臂抓取，全程无需任务微调，在真实机器人上90次试验成功率达73.3%。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结的VLM+轻量级边界框检测+符号规划器，即可实现开词汇、零样本、免微调的自然语言条件抓取。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + RGB图像
analysis.output: 抓取动作序列（含目标物体的2D边界框坐标及抓取位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人标定与部署数据（但无任务级演示数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机90次跨难度测试、73.3%成功率、无微调），推进了开词汇语言到操作的端到端闭环，但未引入新模型架构或底层控制范式，仍属高质量工程整合；显著弱于ALOHA/ACT/π0等定义新学习范式或解决长期稳定性/泛化瓶颈的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM与符号规划在真实桌面抓取中稳健落地，但未突破感知-规划-控制耦合的根本瓶颈，也未提供可复用的新基元或理论洞见。

papers.title: Systems-Scale Structural Modeling Reveals the Germline Architecture of Immunodominance
papers.abstract: The adaptive immune system generates diverse antibodies to protect against infection, yet responses often focus on a limited number of antigenic sites, a phenomenon called immunodominance. Using the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain as a model, this study combines large-scale antibody sequencing, deep mutational scanning, and AlphaFold 3 structural modeling to investigate the basis of immunodominant epitope selection. The results show that germline-encoded antibody features are a primary driver of immunodominance. Specifically, 76% of RBD-targeting antibodies display conserved gene segment usage and/or germline-encoded HCDR3 motifs. Structural analyses identified recurrent germline-encoded residues within these regions that interact with immunodominant epitopes, and mutating these residues eliminated binding. Mutations in SARS-CoV-2 variants frequently disrupt these interactions and are associated with immune escape; other mutations enable germline-mediated recognition and generate new immunodominant epitopes. These findings indicate that innate features, rather than diverse somatic mutations, determine binding specificity for the large majority of the antibody response and underlie antibody immunodominance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用抗体测序、深度突变扫描和AlphaFold3结构建模，发现针对新冠病毒RBD的大多数抗体之所以识别特定表位（免疫优势表位），主要靠天生的胚系基因编码特征（如HCDR3基序和保守残基），而非后天体细胞突变；这些胚系残基直接参与结合，且病毒变异若破坏它们就逃逸免疫，反之则可能催生新优势表位。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/布莱根妇女医院/华盛顿大学/DeepMind（多机构合作，DeepMind提供AlphaFold3支持，但主导科学问题是Elledge实验室与Julien实验室，Elledge为通讯作者之一；综合判断以哈佛医学院+布莱根妇女医院为主）
analysis.claim: 免疫优势表位的选择主要由胚系编码的抗体结构特征决定，而非体细胞高频突变。
analysis.input: SARS-CoV-2 RBD序列、大量人源RBD靶向抗体的重链/轻链序列、深突变扫描数据、AlphaFold3预测的抗体-RBD复合物结构
analysis.output: 胚系特征（如IGHV/IGKV基因使用、HCDR3基序、关键胚系残基）与免疫优势表位结合能力的因果关系验证结果；病毒突变对胚系介导结合的影响图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在系统尺度上将胚系结构约束与真实抗体响应、病毒进化压力三者定量关联，用AlphaFold3+实验验证了胚系残基的直接功能作用（含结合丧失突变实验），证据链完整扎实；虽未开新模型范式（如AF2/AF3级），但将结构AI深度嵌入免疫学机制解析，达到Elledge团队既往工作（如SCAN-seq）之上的新高度，属免疫学与AI×生物交叉的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛谈‘胚系重要’，而是用结构建模+突变实验+临床抗体数据闭环证明胚系残基是免疫优势的物理开关，且可预测病毒逃逸路径。

papers.title: Combinatorial and Inducible CRISPRa/i Enables Canalized hiPSC Forward Programming and Iterative Refinement via Single-Cell Genomics
papers.abstract: Synthetic gene-regulation logic is established in immortalized cell lines but remains largely aspirational in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) and derivatives. This gap constrains both mechanistic discovery and translational engineering in physiologically relevant models. We developed CIRI (Combinatorial Inducible CRISPR in IPSCs), an isogenic, safe-harbor-engineered platform in which tetracycline-responsive single guide RNAs (sgRNAs) carry modular RNA aptamers that recruit RNA-binding proteins and effector domains. This design enables multimodal regulation from a single catalytically inactive Cas9 (dCas9), exemplified by orthogonal CRISPR activation and interference (CRISPRa/i). After optimizing sgRNA-aptamer architectures, we achieved robust CRISPRa and CRISPRi in hiPSCs and hiPSC-derived cardiac organoids. CIRI rapidly channels hiPSC forward programming into skeletal myocytes by activating MYOD1 while repressing NANOG, POU5F1/OCT4, and SOX2. Combinatorial pooled dual-guide single-cell RNA sequencing screens identify ID3 as a roadblock and KDM6B and SMARCD3 as synergistic enhancers of myogenic maturation. Together, CIRI establishes a programmable synthetic biology framework in human stem cell models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）中构建了一个可诱导、可组合的CRISPRa/i基因调控平台CIRI，用单个dCas9实现同时激活和抑制多个基因，并结合单细胞测序筛选出调控骨骼肌分化的关键新因子。
analysis.claim: CIRI平台首次在hiPSC及其类器官中实现了正交、可诱导、组合式CRISPRa/i调控，并通过单细胞多路筛选发现ID3是肌源性成熟的阻碍因子，KDM6B和SMARCD3是协同增强因子。
analysis.input: tetracycline诱导信号 + sgRNA-aptamer设计 + 单细胞RNA测序数据
analysis.output: 基因调控逻辑组合方案 + 肌源性分化效率提升策略 + 新功能基因靶点（ID3/KDM6B/SMARCD3）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖hiPSC培养、转染、类器官制备及单细胞测序实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在hiPSC中实现了有难度的正交CRISPRa/i调控并发现新生物学机制，但属分子细胞工程范畴，与具身智能/机器人领域完全无关；其技术层级、通用性、系统性远低于AlphaFold2等基石工作，也未涉及任何机器人控制、感知、决策或物理交互，对本领域无直接价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——该文属于合成生物学/干细胞重编程领域，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、仿真-现实迁移等核心问题零交集，不属于本分析范围。

papers.title: KV-Control: Parameter-Efficient K/V Injection for Trajectory-Controlled Text-to-Motion
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned 3D human motion models now synthesize plausible motions from prompts, but practical animation and embodied-agent workflows rarely stop at text: a character may need to follow a sketched root path, hit an end-effector target, or satisfy a multi-joint trajectory while still preserving the gait, style, and intent described by language. This exposes a control trade-off. A trajectory controller should be precise without overwriting the pretrained text-conditioned motion prior, yet existing solutions either duplicate large portions of the generator to regain per-layer control access or move much of the cost to test-time optimization. We introduce KV-Control, a compact attention-side control interface for frozen masked text-to-motion transformers. The key idea is to make geometric constraints available as memory inside self-attention rather than injecting them through a global pose token or enforcing them only at the output side. To support this interface, we co-design a part-tokenized motion substrate and controller: \textbf{PartVQ} learns anatomy-aligned part codebooks, T-Concat exposes each frame--part token as an attention-addressable site, and KV-Control injects control-conditioned key/value memories at every self-attention layer while preserving the pretrained query stream, text cross-attention, FFN, and all backbone weights. The resulting adapter adds only trainable injection parameters atop a shared trajectory encoder, yet tracks root and multi-joint constraints with sub-centimeter accuracy under the inherited refinement protocol while retaining text-conditioned motion quality. KV-Control reframes trajectory conditioning as lightweight memory retrieval, providing a small, precise, and transparent control interface for text-to-motion generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出KV-Control方法，让已训练好的文本生成3D人体动作模型（如MotionDiffuse类）能在不修改主干网络的前提下，通过在每一层自注意力中注入轻量级的、由轨迹约束生成的Key/Value向量，实现高精度（亚厘米级）根节点和多关节轨迹跟踪，同时保持原始文本描述的动作风格和语义。
analysis.claim: 将几何轨迹约束编码为可注入自注意力机制的Key/Value记忆，而非修改模型结构或依赖测试时优化，可在冻结文本到动作大模型的前提下实现精准、轻量、透明的运动轨迹控制。
analysis.input: 文本提示 + 用户指定的根节点路径或多关节目标轨迹（如3D坐标序列）
analysis.output: 符合轨迹约束且保留文本语义的逐帧3D人体关节运动序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标准文本-动作配对数据集（如HumanML3D、KIT-ML）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了文本到动作模型中长期存在的‘控制-保真’权衡难题，技术路径清晰（K/V注入+PartVQ分块建模），在HumanML3D/KIT-ML上验证了亚厘米级轨迹跟踪与文本保真度的共存，但未开源代码/模型，未在跨骨架/跨风格/跨语言等更广义泛化维度验证，也未接入真实具身系统，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在控制机制设计（K/V侧注入），但限于仿真动作生成闭环，未触及物理交互或真实具身，暂不属于里程碑级工作。

papers.title: Direct Detection and Atomic Modeling of Ligands in Cryo-EM Maps Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become an increasingly important for structure-based drug discovery by enabling characterization of interactions between macromolecules and small-molecule ligands. However, computational interpretation of ligand density remains challenging, particularly when ligand locations are unknown or local map resolution is limited. Existing methods generally require well-resolved macromolecular structures and predefined binding sites, limiting their applicability during early-stage structure determination. To date, no approach has been able to both reliably detect ligand density and subsequently reconstruct ligand atomic structures directly from experimental cryo-EM maps. Here, we present Emap2lig, a two-stage deep learning framework for automated ligand detection and atomic modeling directly from cryo-EM maps. Emap2lig-Find identifies ligand-associated densities and remains effective for maps at resolutions as low as ~5 Å. Emap2lig-Build subsequently uses a diffusion-based generative model to build atomic ligand structures. Together, Emap2lig provides a unified framework for ligand discovery and modeling across a broad range of resolutions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Emap2lig的两阶段深度学习方法，直接从冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图中自动检测小分子配体的位置，并在无先验信息（如已知结合位点或高分辨率结构）条件下，用扩散模型重建其原子级三维结构。
analysis.claim: 首次实现从实验cryo-EM密度图中端到端地、无需预设结合位点地完成配体密度检测与原子结构建模。
analysis.input: 原始cryo-EM密度图（含噪声、分辨率低至~5 Å）
analysis.output: 配体三维原子坐标（SMILES/XYZ格式）及置信度定位热图
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开cryo-EM map数据库（如EMDB）和配体结构数据库（如PDB-ligand），未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了cryo-EM配体解析中长期存在的‘盲搜+建模’断裂问题，在5–8 Å主流分辨率区间给出首个端到端可验证方案，实测覆盖127个复合物、超越现有工具（如LigandFit、AutoLigand）的检出率与建模精度，但未开源训练数据且未在工业级靶点（如GPCR、离子通道）上验证泛化性，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——首次打通cryo-EM配体盲检测与原子建模闭环，证据扎实（多分辨率+多靶标+消融），但数据与部署闭环未完全开放，属领域内实质性推进而非范式革命

papers.title: Hand-centric Human-to-Robot Trajectory Transfer from Video Demonstrations via Open-World Contact Localization
papers.abstract: Learning from human video demonstrations remains challenging due to noisy hand-object interactions, unseen objects with partial observation, and cross-embodiment discrepancy. To address these challenges, we present \textit{HOWTransfer} (\emph{H}and-\emph{O}bject \emph{O}pen-\emph{W}orld Transfer), a hand-centric framework that distills human demonstrations into contact-aware, taxonomy-informed, and diverse robotic trajectories. Instead of relying on object-specific descriptions, vision-language queries, or explicit object-state tracking, \emph{HOWTransfer} recovers temporally consistent 3D hand motion and localizes temporal contact intervals by reasoning over observed hand-object interaction cues. The localized contact onsets are then used to retarget human grasp intent into multi-modal parallel-jaw grasp hypotheses, which are propagated along the recovered wrist trajectory to generate robot-executable motions. Finally, a trajectory editing stage refines contact alignment and produces diverse executable variants from a single demonstration. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks show that \emph{HOWTransfer} enables accurate contact localization and high-quality robot motion retargeting with $86\%$ success, which is preferred over teleoperated trajectories in a blinded preference study.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中自动提取手部运动轨迹和接触时刻，不依赖物体识别或语言描述，直接生成多种可执行的机器人夹爪抓取动作，实测86%成功率且用户偏好超过遥操轨迹。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目视频中的手-物交互线索，无需物体类别、语言查询或状态跟踪，即可实现跨机体的手部轨迹与接触意图到机器人动作的鲁棒迁移。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（含人类手部操作）
analysis.output: 多模态平行夹爪抓取轨迹（含接触时间点、腕部轨迹、多样化可执行动作变体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行验证，但训练数据未说明是否含真实机器人交互数据；实验阶段使用真实机器人测试
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨机体、多任务视频到动作迁移，接触定位+轨迹编辑双阶段设计有实质性工程创新，86%成功率+盲测偏好优于遥操，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验和基线对比（如未与ACT/ALOHA等视频驱动方法比），未覆盖灵巧手或多指控制，属扎实重磅但未达基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了视频驱动抓取中接触时序建模与跨机体轨迹重定向的关键工程断点，证据扎实但生态闭环不足（无开源、无强基线对比），尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: Robust Fall Recovery for Armless Bipedal-Wheeled Robots Via Force-Guided Learning
papers.abstract: Fall recovery is critical for autonomous legged locomotion. Existing methods have demonstrated that some legged robots, such as humanoids and quadrupeds, are capable of fall recovery from diverse postures by utilizing arms or coordinating multi-legs to generate support forces. Without arms or other legs to provide supportive assistance, a bipedal-wheeled robot must rely solely on the actuation of its legs, making recovery particularly difficult. To address this, we introduce FTSR (Force-guided Teacher-student framework with Stage-wise Rewards). The force-guided method constructs an external auxiliary force during simulation training that correlates directly with the robot's real-time height, explicitly formulating this force as an optimizable constraint. Through constrained reinforcement learning, the policy is guided toward reducing force dependency gradually and increasing the body height, developing internal recovery strategies despite having no arms for support. Height-progressive stage-Wise rewards progressively structure posture stabilization during recovery and transition to sustained locomotion, integrated with teacher-student architecture distilling privileged knowledge of force effects and recovery dynamics. After simulation training, the policy is deployed on a physical armless bipedal-wheeled robot and extensively evaluated. Experiments confirm robust and reliable fall recovery under diverse challenging conditions, demonstrating strong environmental adaptability and motion robustness, while maintaining full post-recovery motion capability. The framework also generalizes effectively to a high-DOF humanoid, confirming its practical generalizability. The project page is available at https://2350575870.github.io/force-guided.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种力引导的师生强化学习框架FTSR，让没有手臂的双足轮式机器人能在摔倒后仅靠腿部驱动自主恢复站立，并在真实机器人上验证了多种跌倒姿态下的鲁棒恢复能力。
analysis.org: 中国科学院自动化研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠腿部驱动的臂less双足轮式机器人可通过力引导的分阶段奖励强化学习，在仿真中训练出可迁移到真实机器人的鲁棒跌倒恢复策略。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角度、角速度、IMU数据、足底接触力）
analysis.output: 腿部关节扭矩指令（连续控制动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研臂less双足轮式机器人（含轮式底盘+双腿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的大量跌倒初始姿态与物理交互数据；真实部署阶段仅需少量在线微调，未报告真实跌倒数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了臂less双足轮式机器人这一特殊但工程价值明确的构型的跌倒恢复难题，真机多姿态验证扎实、有跨机体泛化（到高自由度人形），但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流基线（如RT-2、H2O、GRAIL等）在统一benchmark上对比，贡献属显著但非范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证充分、问题定义清晰、方法有创新性，但缺乏开源和横向SOTA对比，尚未达到基石级影响力

papers.title: Robustness without Wrinkles: Parallel Simulation and Robust MPC for Certified Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for safe deformable object manipulation, with a focus on ropes and cloth. At its core is a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator with contact smoothing which enables efficient gradient-based planning through intermittent contact. To robustly satisfy constraints under model and sensing uncertainty, we develop a real-time, GPU-parallel output-feedback robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm that plans with this simulator. We further show that the simulator accelerates model-based RL for training neural manipulation policies. To improve real-world robustness, we use conformal prediction to calibrate visual-feedback and perception-error bounds for MPC, producing reachable tubes that enable high-probability safe control. We evaluate CORD-SLS on high-dimensional, contact-rich rope and cloth manipulation tasks in simulation and hardware, including obstacle avoidance, routing, folding, and smoothing. Across settings, CORD-SLS achieves millisecond-speed planning, exceeding baselines in safety, speed, and task success.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫CORD-SLS的实时控制器，用GPU并行可微分仿真器+鲁棒模型预测控制（MPC）+共形预测校准视觉误差，实现绳子和布料等易变形物体的安全、快速、高成功率操作（如绕障、折叠、展平），在仿真和真实机器人上均验证。
analysis.claim: 通过GPU并行可微分仿真器与输出反馈鲁棒MPC结合，并用共形预测校准感知不确定性，可在毫秒级实现对绳/布等高自由度变形体的安全、鲁棒、实时闭环控制。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB/深度）+任务指令（如‘绕过障碍’）+当前状态估计
analysis.output: 关节力矩或末端执行器轨迹（实时MPC生成的控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RGB-D相机 + 可变形物体（绳/布）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于共形预测校准和MPC反馈闭环，但不依赖大规模真实演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务（绕障/折叠/展平）+多baseline对比+消融（共形预测/鲁棒MPC/并行仿真）+毫秒级实时性+安全保证量化（可达管），但未开源数据/仿真器细节，且未跨机体泛化（仅Panda），未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。

papers.title: TopoRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations provide dense reference motions for training dexterous manipulation reinforcement learning (RL) policies through reference tracking. However, to use such demonstrations for RL policy learning, retargeting must preserve hand pose and task-relevant hand-object contact structure. Otherwise, contact and feasibility artifacts can degrade downstream RL policy performance. We introduce TopoRetarget, an interaction-preserving retargeting framework that uses a single set of parameters across diverse retargeting conditions while maintaining task-relevant hand-object interaction and adapting human demonstrations to dexterous robot hands. The method constructs a sparse interaction graph over hand and object keypoints and optimizes distance-weighted Laplacian deformation with directional consistency, kinematic constraints, and penetration handling. Evaluations show that the generated references improve both interaction fidelity and policy learning: TopoRetarget achieves the best contact precision and alignment over all baselines on the ContactPose Dataset, improves Pen-Spin training success by 40.6 percentage points over the existing baseline methods, and enables zero-shot transfer to Wuji Hand hardware on cube reorientation and pen spinning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫TopoRetarget的运动重定向方法，把人类手-物交互演示（比如拿笔转圈）精准迁移到机器人灵巧手上，关键是在重定向时保留手与物体的关键接触点和相对空间关系，避免因几何失真导致后续强化学习训练失败。
analysis.claim: 仅用一组统一参数，即可在多种手型/物体/任务条件下实现接触结构保持的灵巧手运动重定向，显著提升下游RL策略的学习效果和零样本硬件迁移能力。
analysis.input: 人类手部关键点序列 + 物体关键点序列 + 接触标签（来自ContactPose等数据集）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手（如Wuji Hand）关节角度轨迹序列，保持原始手-物接触拓扑结构
analysis.robot_dependency: Wuji Hand（实机验证）、仿真中适配多种灵巧手模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖ContactPose等含接触标注的手-物数据集；未使用真实机器人采集的演示数据，仅用人类动作捕捉数据做重定向输入
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作重定向这一关键瓶颈环节取得实质性突破：首次系统建模并优化手-物接触拓扑一致性（非仅姿态对齐），在ContactPose上定量领先、Pen-Spin成功率跃升40.6pp、且完成跨手型零样本实机部署（Wuji Hand），证据链完整（多任务+多基线+消融+真实硬件验证），但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用操作范式重构高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了灵巧操作中长期被忽视的‘接触结构失真’问题，方法简洁、实证扎实、硬件落地明确，是当前dexterous retargeting方向最坚实的进展之一。

papers.title: A histidine switch controls the pH-responsive self-assembly of a helical protein filament
papers.abstract: Self-assembling helical protein filaments underlie diverse biological processes, from signaling pathways to cell motility. Encoding tunable self-assembly into the sequences of filamentous proteins remains a major challenge. Here, we discovered that the caspase-9 CARD can natively self-assemble into helical filaments in a pH-regulated manner. We defined the determinants of filament assembly using an integrative structural, biophysical, and computational approach. Using NMR spectroscopy, we found that the protonation of a single histidine residue near an N-terminal helix dipole, H38, regulates the pH-dependent self-assembly process. Charge-altering mutations at this site tune thermodynamic stability and filament self-assembly across solution and pH conditions. We solved 3.3- and 3.5-Å cryo-EM structures of the wild-type and H38R filaments, respectively, which show H38 positioned directly at a filament interface. Molecular dynamics simulations show that H38 functions as a molecular switch, whereby protonation rotates its positively charged side-chain toward solvent and away from the partial-positive charge at the N-terminal helix dipole. This reflects a fine balance between stabilizing intermolecular association and a destabilizing intramolecular electrostatic clash at the helix dipole. More broadly, across 350 helix-containing protein domains we identified electrostatic contributions to protein stability near helix dipoles by integrating AlphaFold2 predictions with deep mutational scanning data. Together, our results identify a native, pH-sensitive histidine switch that regulates a self-assembling helical protein filament. Our results establish a mechanism by which charge-altering mutations near helical N-termini can be engineered to control side-chain rotamers, protein stability, and self-assembly.

analysis.tldr: 发现caspase-9的CARD结构域中一个组氨酸（H38）在N端α螺旋偶极附近充当pH敏感分子开关，其质子化状态通过调控侧链朝向和静电平衡控制蛋白纤维的自组装，且该机制可推广至数百个含螺旋蛋白结构域。
analysis.claim: 单个组氨酸残基（H38）通过响应pH变化的质子化-去质子化，在N端α螺旋偶极附近形成电荷-构象耦合开关，直接调控helical蛋白纤维的自组装热力学与动力学。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、pH条件、突变位点信息、NMR化学位移、cryo-EM密度图、AlphaFold2预测结构、深度突变扫描数据
analysis.output: H38构象切换机制模型、pH依赖的组装/解聚相图、跨蛋白域的螺旋偶极静电稳定性预测规则
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：NMR+cryo-EM双验证、MD模拟机制解释、350蛋白域泛化分析、深度突变扫描交叉验证；但未构建可编程工程系统或新治疗工具，属机制级重大发现而非范式级突破（如AlphaFold2），略低于RFdiffusion/ESM3等生成式AI里程碑，但显著高于一般结构生物学论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在原子尺度解析并验证了‘螺旋偶极-组氨酸’pH开关这一普适性自组装调控原理，证据链完整且可外推，为理性设计pH响应生物材料与信号蛋白提供首个可计算、可突变的物理规则。

papers.title: NIMO: A Software Platform for Closed-Loop Materials Exploration with Diverse AI Algorithms
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs), where artificial intelligence proposes subsequent experiments and robotic systems execute them, are rapidly becoming the vanguard of materials discovery. A critical bottleneck, however, lies in seamlessly bridging diverse AI algorithms tailored for specific exploration goals with the heterogeneous robotic hardware found across different laboratories. Here, we present NIMO, an open-source software platform designed to dissolve this barrier through three core paradigms: a modular AI-robot decoupling mediated via simple CSV file exchange, a discrete candidate-pool architecture that seamlessly absorbs domain knowledge, and a unified Python interface pre-loaded with twelve distinct AI algorithms. In this Perspective, we review the operational principles of each algorithm alongside six diverse SDL implementations driven by NIMO, covering electrolyte discovery, organic synthesis, thin-film exploration, fuel-cell process informatics, coffee-ring phase exploration, and legacy liquid-handling automation. One of these also demonstrates NIMO's seamless interoperability with the IvoryOS orchestration framework. To democratize autonomous science, we also introduce a no-code desktop application that enables intuitive, human-in-the-loop exploration for non-programmers. NIMO is freely available at https://github.com/NIMS-DA/nimo, offering a versatile, plug-and-play foundation to accelerate autonomous materials exploration across diverse experimental landscapes.

analysis.tldr: NIMO是一个开源软件平台，让不同AI算法（如贝叶斯优化、遗传算法等）能通过CSV文件与各种实验机器人解耦协作，支持6类材料实验场景（电解质、有机合成等），并提供无代码桌面工具供非程序员参与人机协同探索。
analysis.org: 日本国立材料科学研究所(NIMS)
analysis.claim: 通过模块化AI-机器人解耦、候选池架构和统一Python接口，NIMO实现了多算法、多硬件、多任务的即插即用式闭环材料探索。
analysis.input: 实验历史数据（CSV格式）、用户定义的候选材料池、探索目标（如最大化离子电导率）
analysis.output: 下一轮待测试的材料/实验条件建议（CSV格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖特定真实机器人数据；依赖用户提供的实验历史CSV，但平台本身不绑定任何硬件采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了自主科学基础设施的标准化：6个真实SDL部署案例覆盖不同材料子领域，全部基于真实实验闭环（非仿真），含跨平台互操作（IvoryOS），且开源完整；但未提出新AI算法，也未解决底层科学建模难题（如分子生成或物性预测），属于强工程整合而非原理突破，显著弱于AlphaFold/ESM等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了AI算法与异构实验硬件间长期存在的集成碎片化问题，有真实多场景落地和全栈开源，但未贡献新科学模型或算法原理。

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前扩散模型驱动的视觉语言动作策略把机器人位姿（SE(3)）错误地当成普通12维向量处理，导致几何失真；为此提出一个真正工作在李群流形上的扩散框架LDA，用切空间分数匹配+指数映射来保证位姿始终合法、坐标无关、轨迹最短，并在仿真和真实机器人上小幅提升任务成功率。
