analysis.claim: VLA模型的固定推理节奏是次优的，通过轻量级、免微调的弹性查询调度机制，可依据状态难度自适应分配计算资源，实现更高效、更鲁棒的策略执行。
analysis.input: VLA模型隐状态 + 当前观测（RGB图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 弹性查询决策：隐输入选择 + 去噪步数 + 动作块长度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与少量真实机器人数据（摘要称‘across simulation and real-robot manipulation’，但未说明真实数据规模/来源/是否闭环训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的‘状态难度信号’（基于critic集成分歧）和查询粒度的宏动作RL建模，实证覆盖多任务仿真+小规模真实机械臂，有消融和NFE/成功率权衡曲线；但未开源、未披露真实数据细节、未跨机体验证，相比RT-2/π0/CHORUS等基石工作，属显著但非范式级推进——它优化的是VLA的*执行效率*而非*能力边界*或*泛化架构*。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了VLA固定推理节奏的工程惯性，但未触及感知-动作联合表征或跨体统一策略等核心瓶颈，属于扎实的系统级优化，非范式创新。

papers.title: Global-Local Attention Decomposition for Terrain Encoding in Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion
papers.abstract: Although reinforcement learning has significantly advanced humanoid locomotion, perceptive policies still struggle on sparse-foothold terrain and constrained environments. Success in these scenarios requires both broad terrain awareness and precise foothold selection, two perceptual roles that conventional encoders often entangle. To address this challenge, we propose Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD) for terrain encoding in humanoid locomotion. Realized by a coarse-to-fine encoder over a robot-centric elevation map, GLAD explicitly separates these objectives: a global attention branch utilizes attention pooling to summarize the surrounding terrain context, while a state-conditioned local attention branch sparsifies and encodes precise foothold-relevant geometry. This explicit attention decomposition prevents the dilution of fine-grained spatial cues while reducing training overhead. Experiments demonstrate that GLAD enables reliable locomotion over challenging gaps, stepping stones, and stairs. Furthermore, the learned policy exhibits emergent terrain-responsive behaviors, autonomously following narrow paths and avoiding obstacles under simple velocity commands without explicit navigation planners. In real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using onboard LiDAR, the proposed method achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse sparse-foothold and obstacle-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫GLAD的地形编码方法，用全局注意力看大范围地形、局部注意力聚焦落脚点细节，让双足机器人在碎石、台阶、独木桥等稀疏落脚点地形上靠视觉+LiDAR就能稳健行走，且不依赖导航模块，直接从仿真迁移到实机Unitree G1上零样本运行。
analysis.claim: 显式解耦全局地形感知与局部落脚点几何建模的注意力机制（GLAD），能提升稀疏落脚点地形下具身策略的鲁棒性与零样本sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 机器人中心坐标系下的高程图（由LiDAR生成）+ 当前本体状态（关节/速度等）
analysis.output: 低层运动控制动作（关节力矩或目标轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的高程图数据；未使用真实机器人采集的带标签地形-动作对，无真实世界行为克隆或强化学习微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实机G1部署成功、多类挑战地形（gap/stepping-stones/stairs）零样本迁移、有消融验证GLAD分支必要性，但未开源代码/模型，未与H2O/ASAP等SOTA locomotion policy在相同benchmark对比，也未证明其可扩展至全身操作或VLA范式，属显著但非范式级推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实双足机器人上实现了有说服力的sim2real落地，但方法深度和通用性未达H2O/ASAP级里程碑，属于高质量工程驱动的实质性推进

papers.title: Simulation-driven discovery of morphology-function relationships in microswimmers
papers.abstract: For more than a billion years, microorganisms have evolved complex strategies for navigating aquatic habitats, despite the fundamental limitations and constraints imposed by their physical environment. A common theme across these strategies is the use of active slender appendages (cilia, flagella, archaella) to generate self-propulsion. Diverse selection pressures and evolutionary trajectories have driven the emergence of drastically different morphologies of biological microswimmers, each tailored for distinct functions ranging from motility to taxis to prey capture to feeding. Despite the biological and ecological significance of these intricate microscale processes, realistic computational modelling of these organisms and their behaviours is still in its infancy. Here, we present a comprehensive open-source simulation platform for motile microswimmers, that faithfully captures the universal hydrodynamic principles shared by such systems. We illustrate the predictive power and versatility of this approach to resolve and explore morphology-function relationships across different microswimmer species and provide new insights into the diversification of locomotion strategies in early eukaryotes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个开源的微游泳体（如细菌、精子、纤毛虫）流体动力学仿真平台，用纯仿真方法系统分析不同身体形态（如鞭毛数量、长度、摆动模式）如何影响运动功能（如速度、转向、趋化能力），不涉及任何真实机器人或控制策略。
analysis.claim: 通过高保真、开源的流体-结构耦合仿真平台，可系统性揭示微游泳体形态与功能之间的因果关系，并解释早期真核生物运动策略分化的物理机制。
analysis.input: 微游泳体的几何形态参数（如鞭毛数量/长度/附着点/摆动波形）、流体环境参数（粘度、边界条件）
analysis.output: 运动性能指标（平均速度、旋转率、轨迹曲率、能量效率、趋化响应增益）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；所有数据由仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在微尺度流体力学建模和形态-功能关系分析上具科学严谨性，但属生物物理/计算生物学范畴，与具身智能/机器人领域核心问题（如闭环感知-决策-动作、sim2real迁移、通用操作策略学习）无实质交集；未涉及任何控制策略、学习算法、传感器输入、执行器输出或机器人部署，无法支撑机器人任务泛化或系统构建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是生物物理仿真研究，不是具身智能或机器人方向的工作，对机器人控制、学习、部署无直接贡献

papers.title: Integrative Multiomic Analysis Reveals How Non-Viral Delivery System Selection Shapes CRISPR Gene Editing Outcomes in Stem Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract The clinical translation of CRISPR gene editing is challenged by the lack of delivery systems that are both safe and efficient in therapeutically relevant cell types such as mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). Non-viral delivery avoids the immunogenicity and genomic integration risks of viral vectors but faces fundamental trade-offs between editing efficiency and cytotoxicity. Here, we present a comprehensive multiomic analysis of four non-viral CRISPR delivery modalities including cell-penetrating peptide- (CPP), lipid-, and polymer-based nanoparticles and electroporation; across mRNA and ribonucleoprotein (RNP) molecular formats. We systematically evaluate each modality, demonstrating that lipid-based delivery achieved the highest editing rates at the cost of genomic instability risks, interferon pathway activation, and a pro-inflammatory shift in MSC paracrine activity. Alternatively, CPPs yield moderate editing rates while reducing these unintended side-effects, whereas polymers and electroporation consistently yielded the lowest efficiencies. CRISPR molecular format and delivery method interacted in a stress-dependent manner, with RNP delivery reducing editing rates under high-stress systems while improving them in lower-stress modalities such as CPP and electroporation. These findings establish that editing efficiency alone is an insufficient metric for delivery system selection, and that genomic stability, transcriptomic dysregulation, and inflammatory response must be treated as primary design criteria for CRISPR therapies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了四种非病毒CRISPR递送方式（CPP、脂质体、聚合物纳米粒、电穿孔）在间充质干细胞中对基因编辑效率、基因组稳定性、炎症反应和分泌功能的影响，发现单纯追求高编辑率会带来严重副作用，主张将安全性指标作为递送系统选择的核心标准。
analysis.claim: 非病毒CRISPR递送系统的临床适用性不能仅由编辑效率决定，必须同步评估其引发的基因组不稳定性、转录组紊乱和炎症性旁分泌改变。
analysis.input: 四种非病毒递送方式 + 两种CRISPR分子形式（mRNA/RNP）在人源MSC中的多组学测量数据（WGS、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq、分泌蛋白组）
analysis.output: 跨模态递送系统的安全性-有效性权衡图谱与设计优先级框架
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实干细胞实验数据（无仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为干细胞基因治疗提供关键实证依据，但属靶向递送领域的扎实横向比较研究，未提出新递送技术、新算法或新范式；多组学整合分析方法非首创，且结论局限于MSC和特定CRISPR格式，未扩展至体内、多细胞类型或临床队列，分量远低于AlphaFold/ESM等计算生物学里程碑（差距一个数量级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了非病毒递送在干细胞中安全性权衡的关键实证，但属于领域内必要但非范式突破的系统性表征工作。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Prediction of PROTAC-Mediated Protein Degradability via Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) can selectively degrade disease-causing proteins, yet predicting which targets are amenable to degradation remains a critical bottleneck: existing computational methods require the complete PROTAC molecular structure, information unavailable before synthesis. We present DegradoMap, a graph neural network that predicts PROTAC-mediated degradability from protein structure and E3 ligase identity alone -- the minimal information available at the target selection stage. The model encodes biophysical priors through lysine-weighted graph pooling with per-protein normalization, models protein-E3 compatibility via cross-attention, and integrates cellular context from the Cancer Dependency Map. On the PROTAC-8K benchmark (3,101 samples, 155 targets, 10 E3 ligases), DegradoMap achieves 0.646+-0.124 AUROC on target-unseen evaluation (best seed: 0.7449) and 0.811 AUROC on CRBN->VHL E3-unseen transfer, outperforming GNN and machine learning baselines. The model additionally recommends optimal E3 ligases with 74% Hit@3 accuracy. Two findings carry broader implications: E(3)-equivariant architectures underperform the simpler invariant design for this scalar prediction task, and ESM-2 embeddings improve peak performance only with careful regularization -- naive integration fails. DegradoMap provides pre-synthesis computational guidance for degradability assessment; its well-calibrated confidence scores (ECE = 0.029, target-unseen) enable practitioners to prioritize high-confidence predictions for experimental follow-up. However, the high seed variance (std = 0.124) and limited E3 coverage require ensembling for reliable deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出DegradoMap模型，仅用靶蛋白三维结构和E3连接酶类型（无需完整PROTAC分子结构）预测该靶标能否被PROTAC成功降解，并在跨靶点、跨E3场景下验证有效性，同时提供校准良好的置信度和E3推荐能力。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖靶蛋白结构与E3连接酶身份（而非完整PROTAC结构），即可实现具有泛化能力且校准良好的PROTAC靶标可降解性预测。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白PDB结构图（原子/残基级）+ E3连接酶类型（如CRBN/VHL）
analysis.output: 靶标被该E3介导的PROTAC降解的概率（标量分数）及校准后的置信度
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于生化实验测定的降解标签（如Western blot/CELIA等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在PROTAC早期靶点筛选这一关键瓶颈问题上，首次实现真正‘结构感知+无PROTAC先验’的预测范式，具备跨靶点/跨E3泛化能力、良好校准性与实用置信度输出；但未开源代码/模型，E3覆盖有限（仅10种），高随机种子方差削弱部署可靠性，尚未达到AlphaFold/ESM级基础模型影响力，但显著优于此前所有GNN/ML类降解预测工作（有消融、多baseline、真实实验标签验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——解决了PROTAC研发中‘靶标可降解性预判’这一长期实操瓶颈，证据扎实（真实验标签、跨靶/E3评估、校准性量化），但受限于开源缺失与E3广度，尚未构成新范式基石。

papers.title: Rapid co-design of Buoyancy-assisted robots for Challenging Locomotion using Gaussian Evolutionary Specialists
papers.abstract: Designing high-performance legged robots requires jointly optimizing morphology and control. Model-free Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers an alternative to model-predictive control for developing robust controllers without explicitly specifying robot dynamics. Thus, we have seen theuse of RL to train controllers and evaluate designs for robot morphology optimization. While RL has shown success inlocomotion, using it in the co-design inner loop is expensive due to repeated policy training. Universal policies conditioned on morphology offer a promising alternative, but suffer from behavioral diversity collapse, converging to a single strategy that performs sub-optimally across designs. On the other hand, end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures fail due to a collapse in its representation. We propose Gaussian Evolutionary Specialists (GES), a framework that decouples design-space partitioning from policy learning to capture diverse behaviors explicitly. GES assigns specialist policies to evolving Gaussian regions and iteratively refines them via training, probing, and territory expansion. The resulting specialists are integrated into a design sampling loop, replacing costly re-training with direct evaluation. When tested on the Buoyancy-Assisted Light Legged Unit (BALLU), GES discovers designs with 5 - 25% higher performance than naive universal policies. On hardware, a GES optimized design overcomes a 24 cm tall obstacle - 3x improvement over the baseline BALLU design. Moreover, GES curtails design optimization time by 37%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫高斯进化专家（GES）的框架，把机器人形态设计空间用高斯分布分区，每个区配一个专用控制器，避免通用策略失效，大幅加速浮力辅助腿式机器人（BALLU）的形态-控制联合优化，实机验证能越障高度提升3倍。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦设计空间划分与策略学习，用高斯分布定义动态演化的专家策略区域，可显著加速且提升浮力辅助腿式机器人的形态-控制联合优化性能。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数（如腿长、质量分布、关节范围等）
analysis.output: 对应形态的专用控制策略（动作序列/轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: BALLU 浮力辅助腿式机器人硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实BALLU硬件测试数据进行最终验证，但形态优化主循环基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 在co-design领域做出扎实方法创新：实机验证跨形态性能跃升（障碍高度×3）、优化耗时降37%，且有消融支撑；但仅限单一浮力辅助构型（BALLU），未扩展至主流腿足平台（如ANYmal/Digit/Atlas），也未开源数据和完整训练pipeline，尚未构成范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证有效，方法有推广潜力，但生态闭环不全，暂未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: World Model Self-Distillation: Training World Models to Solve General Tasks
papers.abstract: Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability in such models by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning. Given an unlabeled scene image, a vision-language model generates a candidate task and a detailed step-by-step solution. The solution conditions a pretrained video diffusion model, the Demonstrator; we distill its behavior into an Executor conditioned only on the image and a short task prompt. This transfers execution knowledge from caption-guided generation to instruction-conditioned task solving without curated task-video supervision. We further improve the Executor with reinforcement learning from VLM feedback, exploiting the asymmetry between judging whether a sampled video satisfies a task and generating the solution. Experiments on our proposed WorldTasks-Benchmark and the DreamGen robotics benchmark show that the Executor surpasses the Demonstrator under our VLM-based evaluation protocol and transfers competitively to robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成任务和解法，再通过自蒸馏+强化学习，把原本依赖长文本描述的视频扩散模型（Demonstrator）改造成只靠图像+短任务提示就能执行任务的Executor，全程无需人工标注的任务-视频配对数据。
analysis.claim: 无需任务-视频监督信号，仅通过VLM生成的伪任务与解法、自蒸馏和VLM反馈的强化学习，即可将预训练视频生成模型转化为具备泛化任务求解能力的世界模型。
analysis.input: 单张场景图像 + 短任务提示（如'打开抽屉'）
analysis.output: 任务执行视频（即动作时序的视觉输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；所有训练/评估均基于合成视频与VLM生成信号
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型范式中首次系统实现‘无任务-视频监督’下的指令驱动视频生成蒸馏与RL优化，实证覆盖跨任务泛化与机器人仿真迁移（DreamGen），但未在真机部署、未开源代码/模型、未挑战长期开放难题（如闭环物理一致性建模），强于多数纯prompting工作，但距World Models/DreamerV3等基石级框架仍有明显差距（缺统一潜空间动力学建模、无闭环rollout规划、依赖外部VLM判断）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用现有VLM+视频扩散模型构建端到端任务求解链，但核心能力仍外包给VLM判断与生成，非自主世界建模突破

papers.title: OCOO-T : A Simple and Scalable Virtual Cell Model for Transcriptional Perturbation Response Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic, chemical and cytokine perturbations is a fundamental challenge in computational biology and AI Virtual Cell (AIVC) modeling, with direct implications for drug discovery and the elucidation of gene regulatory networks. Existing approaches often rely on auxiliary cell-state encoders, hierarchical variational autoencoders, dedicated Transformer encoder-decoder modules, or gene-interaction priors to compress high-dimensional expression profiles into latent representations. While effective, these designs increase architectural complexity and may limit scalability and generalizability. This paper introduces OCOO-T, a minimalist flow-matching-based AIVC model for transcriptional perturbation response prediction. OCOO-T utilizes a vanilla Transformer stack that operates directly on continuous gene expression profiles and formulates perturbation response prediction as a continuous-time denoising process. Perturbation embeddings, dosage information, and cell-line/cell-type specificity are integrated through adaptive layer normalization and in-context tokens. Comprehensive evaluations on Tahoe100M, Replogle, and PBMC benchmarks demonstrate that OCOO-T achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse perturbations and cell types while effectively scaling to long transcriptional profiles through patching and depatching of cellular contexts. By leveraging the simplicity of Transformer-based denoising for single-cell omics, OCOO-T provides an effective and scalable framework for in-silico cellular simulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个极简的Transformer模型OCOO-T，直接对单细胞基因表达谱做连续时间去噪建模，预测基因/药物/细胞因子扰动后的转录响应，不依赖复杂编码器或先验网络结构，能在长序列上分块处理并保持SOTA性能。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准Transformer+连续时间流匹配去噪，无需辅助编码器、图先验或分层VAE，即可在多扰动、多细胞类型任务上实现可扩展且高性能的转录响应预测。
analysis.input: 原始单细胞基因表达向量 + 扰动类型嵌入 + 剂量 + 细胞系/细胞类型标识
analysis.output: 扰动后基因表达向量（连续值）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁性与实证效果形成良好平衡：在Tahoe100M等三大基准上达到SOTA，验证了纯Transformer+流匹配在单细胞扰动建模中的有效性，但未解决长期开放难题（如因果机制推断、跨物种泛化、湿实验闭环验证），也未引入新数据模态或颠覆性架构，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解决根本瓶颈，本文是扎实的架构减法成功案例：去掉所有花哨组件仍SOTA，证明了问题本质可能比现有复杂模型更简单。

papers.title: ProtXAI: Explainable AI Reveals Structural Determinants of Protein Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular dynamics simulations provide atomistic views of protein motions, but conventional analyses often struggle with extracting subtle mechanistic insights from complex trajectories. Here, we present an integrated framework, ProtXAI, combining molecular dynamics and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), to identify residue-level determinants of conformational change across diverse protein systems. By leveraging inter-residue distance dynamics, deep learning, and sequential relevance propagation, the approach captures both local fluctuations and long-range communication pathways within protein structures. We applied this framework to three mechanistically distinct systems: apolipoprotein E4 (ApoE4), staphylokinase (SAK) variants, and an ancestral luciferase. Across these applications, our XAI-based approach recovered experimentally supported dynamic hotspots: ligand-responsive hinges in ApoE4, mutation-dependent flexibility shifts in SAK, and evolutionary redistribution of motions in the luciferase. ProtXAI also revealed additional long-range couplings not accessible to classical analysis. Together, these findings demonstrate that combining molecular dynamics with XAI provides a general and scalable strategy for dissecting protein dynamics and uncovering structural determinants of function, stability, and evolutionary changes without prior bias. This approach thus advances the current methodological repertoire for analysing proteins and their intrinsic properties. Highlights Molecular dynamics simulations are increasingly accessible, yet scalable tools for comparative analysis remain limited. We demonstrate that machine learning coupled with explainable AI can automatically extract structural determinants of protein dynamics from trajectories. ProtXAI identifies key dynamic regions across diverse scenarios, including comparison of protein variants, understanding ligand modulation, and single-trajectory analysis. ProtXAI enables scalable, unbiased interpretation of long trajectories, providing an alternative to manual, time-intensive analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把分子动力学模拟轨迹喂给可解释AI（XAI），自动找出蛋白质里哪些氨基酸残基真正驱动构象变化，不用人工猜、不依赖先验假设，验证了三个不同蛋白系统的已知动态热点，还发现了传统方法看不到的长程耦合。
analysis.claim: 将分子动力学轨迹与可解释AI（特别是逐层相关性传播）结合，可无偏、可扩展地识别跨蛋白系统的残基级动态决定因素。
analysis.input: 分子动力学模拟生成的原子坐标时间序列（经预处理为残基间距离动态矩阵）
analysis.output: 每个残基对构象变化贡献度的归因热图（residue-level relevance scores）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖模拟数据，未使用任何真实机器人/实验传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于计算生物学/XAI交叉的扎实应用工作：方法有创新整合（XAI+MD）、在多个蛋白系统上验证了已知机制并发现新耦合，但未突破领域范式（如未解决蛋白质折叠预测、设计或生成等核心难题），且无真实实验闭环验证；显著弱于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等基石工作（分差超50分），也未达到DiffDock（87分）级的方法通用性或下游任务影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟XAI技术迁移到MD分析中，提升了轨迹解读效率和客观性，但未开辟新方向，也未解决蛋白质科学中的根本性瓶颈问题。

papers.title: FlowPRO: Reward-Free Reinforced Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching VLAs via Proximalized Preference Optimization
papers.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models into policies that can be reliably deployed on real robots remains a major bottleneck. SFT and DAgger exploit failure signals only indirectly, and reward-based RL is bottlenecked by the difficulty of real-world reward design and of training reliable critics. We present FlowPRO, a reward-free offline reinforced fine-tuning framework for flow-matching VLAs. Algorithmically, we propose RPRO (Robotic Flow-matching Proximalized Preference Optimization), a preference-optimization objective tailored to the flow-matching action head of VLA models. RPRO pairs a contrastive optimizer with an explicit proximal regularizer that anchors the absolute magnitude of the implicit reward, thereby eliminating the reward-hacking failure mode of plain Flow-DPO. On the data side, a teleoperated intervention-and-rollback paradigm produces naturally paired positive and negative trajectories $(τ^w, τ^l)$ on a real robot from a single operator action; a Smooth Interpolation procedure, combined with batch mixing, then converts these sparse corrections into dense per-state supervision while preserving the base policy's capabilities. On four long-horizon bimanual tasks, FlowPRO attains the highest success rate, outperforming four representative baselines, and ablations confirm the contribution of each loss component.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowPRO方法，用无需人工设计奖励函数的方式，在真实机器人上通过操作员干预+回滚生成正负轨迹对，再用平滑插值和批量混合构造密集监督信号，对基于流匹配的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）做偏好优化微调，提升了双臂长时序任务的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Yihao Wu等名字常见于多所高校，但无足够线索指向清华/浙大/上交/中科院等明确主体）
analysis.claim: 无需显式奖励函数、仅靠真实机器人上的稀疏人为干预即可实现流匹配VLA模型的可靠强化微调，并规避奖励黑客行为。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）
analysis.output: 连续动作流（flow-matching输出的动作向量场）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂机器人（未指明型号，但明确用于采集τ^w/τ^l）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自单操作员在真实机器人上的干预-回滚采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward-free VLA微调方向有实质性推进：真机验证、四任务基准、消融完整、明确解决flow-DPO的reward-hacking缺陷；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型做统一评测，也未展示部署延迟、鲁棒性或长期运行稳定性，属于扎实但边界清晰的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机reward-free偏好优化落地有效，但闭源且泛化有限，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs
papers.abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface. Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation. This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations. Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出S2框架，通过给视觉语言动作模型的执行器（executor）提供更精细的子任务级语言指导+限制其可看的视觉区域数量（不依赖标注），在真实机器人上显著提升了跨干扰、跨外观变化的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型泛化能力差的主因是执行器被迫从粗粒度指令和全图视觉中联合推断执行细节；改用目标保持的细粒度语言指导+显式视觉证据预算，能解耦学习压力并提升真实机器人泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+粗粒度语言指令+细粒度子任务级语言指导（训练时生成，推理时由VLM planner via in-context learning 提供）
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity / end-effector pose）
analysis.robot_dependency: TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容版）和HSR真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8个任务轨迹数据（用于relabelling和eval），但未说明是否开源原始数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%，有消融验证（goal-preserving guidance vs instruction replacement, evidence budgeting effect），且部署于双平台；但未开源代码/数据，未挑战跨机体泛化，也未超越π0.5（86分档）的范式高度，属扎实重磅但非里程碑级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言细化+视觉预算两个正交设计落地到真实机器人多任务场景，效果显著且有机制分析，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and release. To address this challenge, we propose Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm (SKIP), an event-preserving sparse-to-dense framework that avoids dense frame-by-frame generation. SKIP first identifies task-relevant keyframes by leveraging robot-aware multimodal features. It then synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. A learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator subsequently reconstruct the missing intervals according to the robot actions. On LIBERO, SKIP generates dense rollouts $4.16\times$ faster than a dense baseline while improving visual fidelity and reducing aggregate FVD by $89.0\%$. Importantly, SKIP-generated videos are effective policy-training data. Even when they fully replace real demonstrations, $π_{0.5}$ success drops only $1.3$ pp in LIBERO simulation and $6.7$ pp on the real robot, whereas fully dense frame-by-frame generation collapses by $48$ to $58$ pp.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SKIP框架，用稀疏关键帧（只生成任务事件点如接触、抓取）加动作引导的插值来替代传统逐帧生成视频的世界模型，大幅加速推理并保持策略训练有效性。
analysis.claim: 在保持任务相关事件完整性的前提下，通过机器人感知驱动的关键帧稀疏化与动作条件插值，可显著加速具身世界模型的视频rollout，且生成视频仍能有效支撑下游策略训练。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+多模态观测（视觉+动作指令）
analysis.output: 密集视频帧序列（但非逐帧生成，而是稀疏关键帧+插值重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境（Franka机械臂+RGB相机），未依赖特定真实硬件接口
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用LIBERO公开仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO上实现4.16×加速+89% FVD下降+真实机器人仅降6.7pp，证明其工程有效性；但未开新范式（仍是world model rollout优化），未挑战长期开放难题（如闭环自监督建模、跨机体泛化），也未超越DreamerV3等基石的理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是高效视频生成的架构创新，在仿真到真实迁移中验证扎实，但未突破世界模型的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynaFLIP，用图像-语言-3D光流三元组监督训练一个纯图像编码器，让视觉表征提前学懂‘动作如何改变世界’，从而提升机器人在操纵任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作相关的动力学信息（3D flow）显式注入视觉编码器的预训练过程，能显著提升下游机器人策略对未见场景和动作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D光流（合成或估计）
analysis.output: 动力学感知的图像嵌入向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）及少量真实机械臂（如Franka），但非端到端控制硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/估计的3D flow，未使用真实机器人交互视频中的ground-truth dynamics数据；真实世界验证仅用现成视频帧+后处理光流，无闭环真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3D flow作为显式模态与图文联合约束视觉编码器，在多个仿真+小规模真实实验中验证了动力学感知表征对VLA类策略的增益（+22.5% OOD），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨硬件部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身闭环学习），属扎实且有启发性的表征层面增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：把动力学信号前移到视觉编码器预训练阶段并验证其泛化价值，但缺乏真机大规模闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

analysis.tldr: 用跨域专家视频（比如仿真里拍的机器人动作）训练一个视频预测模型，把智能体当前看到的画面‘翻译’成专家视频所在域的画面，再用预测准确率当奖励信号来训练强化学习策略，从而解决没有真实奖励、且视觉域差异大（颜色/形态/仿真到真实）时的模仿学习问题
analysis.claim: 跨域视频预测的似然性可作为无奖励、跨视觉域模仿学习的有效代理奖励信号
analysis.input: 当前智能体观测帧序列（RGB）+专家视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 标量奖励信号（用于RL训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: DMC仿真器（DeepMind Control Suite）及对应真实机械臂数据集（sim2real transfer dataset）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需真实场景下的静态观测帧（用于reward inference），无需真实动作标签或轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用跨域视频重建似然作reward），在DMC Color/Body两个标准benchmark上验证了有效性，并做了sim2real reward transfer分析；但未在真实机器人上闭环训练或部署，无策略泛化实验（如跨任务/跨机体控制），reward模型本身是标准VAE+Transformer预测架构的组合应用，未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页，证据链止于reward信号合理性，未证明端到端策略性能跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了可验证的跨域reward构造范式，在标准仿真benchmark上有效，但未跨越sim2real闭环控制门槛，也未开源核心资产，尚不能支撑领域范式转移

papers.title: Replicate-anchored calibration of within-host single nucleotide variant detection in Mycobacterium tuberculosis whole genome sequencing
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Intra-host genetic heterogeneity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is biologically and clinically informative, but its detection from short read whole genome sequencing depends on thresholds over read depth (DP), alternate allele support (AD), and minor allele frequency (MAF) that are rarely empirically anchored. Methods We developed a biological replicate-anchored, lexicographic calibration framework for per-specimen intra-host single nucleotide variant (iSNV) detection. Within-patient replicate sputum pairs from a pre-treatment tuberculosis (TB) cohort were scored across the joint (DP, AD, MAF) grid on six concordance metrics; the selector penalized no-signal regimes and ranked cells by reproducibility, with sensitivity as a tiebreaker. Selection stability was quantified by B=1,000 nonparametric bootstrap resamples of replicate pairs, defining a Looser/Primary/Tighter sensitivity ladder. The calibrated rule was applied to 97 patients contributing 282 cultured sputum specimens. Results Calibration on 169 replicate pairs from 67 patients identified a Primary cell at DP≥ 60x, AD ≥ 3, MAF ∈ [0.02, 0.50]. The bootstrap modal cell coincided with the Primary cell in 45.7% of 703 successful replications (MAF = 0.02 in 100%; AD = 3 in 90.2%). Per-patient prevalence of detectable within-host diversity at the Primary tier was 16.5% (16/97, Wilson 95% CI: 10.4% - 25.1%); Looser and Tighter tiers yielded comparable rates. Conclusion Within-patient replicate concordance provides a reproducible empirical anchor for iSNV detection thresholds in TB whole genome sequencing. The framework is internally calibrated and reported with explicit sensitivity tiers. The calibrated rule can be applied to external cohorts as a direct test of transferability. Data Summary Raw paired-end Illumina whole genome sequencing reads for the 282 Mycobacterium tuberculosis genomes analyzed in this study have been deposited at the NCBI Sequence Research Archive (SRA) under BioProject accession PRJNA1466981. Per-sample run accessions and corresponding metadata are provided in Supplementary Data S1. The M. tuberculosis H37Rv reference genome used for read alignment is available from GenBank under accession NC_000962.3 . The full analysis pipeline (R), calibration scripts, application scripts, parameter files, and derived data tables that reproduce all reported results, main figures, and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/K01-tb-genomics/paper1_isnv_calibration . A versioned snapshot of the repository at the time of manuscript submission is archived at Zenodo under 10.5281/zenodo.20246996. Supplementary Tables S1-S5 and Supplementary Figure S1 are provided as supplementary files alongside the article. The authors confirm that all supporting data, code and protocols have been provided within the article or through the cited public repositories. Impact Statement Within-host genetic diversity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is increasingly used to study transmission, treatment response, and resistance emergence. The bioinformatic thresholds that distinguish low-frequency variants from sequencing noise vary widely across published TB studies and are rarely empirically justified, thus reshaping which patients are reported as harboring detectable within-host diversity. We provide a biological replicate-anchored calibration framework that ties threshold selection to within-patient replicate concordance, quantifies stability under resampling, and reports explicit sensitivity tiers. Applied to 97 TB patients, the calibrated rule identifies 16.5% as carrying detectable within-host M. tuberculosis variation. The framework is transferable to other TB cohorts as a transparent basis for cross-study comparison. Lay Summary Tuberculosis (TB) bacteria can vary slightly within a single patient. Bacterial cells in the same person may carry small genetic differences, sometimes affecting only a small fraction of the bacterial population. Studying this kind of within-patient variation matters for understanding how TB responds to treatment and how it spreads between people. Detecting these differences from DNA sequencing means distinguishing real signal from background noise. However, the rules used to make that distinction affect which patients are reported as carrying mixed bacterial populations. In this study, we developed a method for making that detection decision more reliably. Most patients gave more than one sputum sample on the same day. We used the agreement between repeat samples from the same patient to pick rules that gave consistent answers. We checked how stable our chosen rules were by repeating the selection on randomly drawn versions of the data, and we report stricter and looser versions of the rule alongside our preferred one. We applied the method to 97 TB patients. About one in six (16.5%) showed detectable genetic variation within their TB bacterial population using our preferred rule. The same rules can also be applied to other TB studies to check whether they give consistent results when used in a different setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用同一患者多次痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，为结核分枝杆菌（M. tuberculosis）全基因组测序中检测低频体内单核苷酸变异（iSNV）设定了可复现、有实证支撑的阈值规则（DP≥60x, AD≥3, MAF∈[0.02,0.50]），并量化了该规则在重采样下的稳定性，还公开了全部代码、数据和流程。
analysis.claim: 基于同一患者多份痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，可为结核菌体内iSNV检测提供经验锚定、稳定且可迁移的阈值校准框架。
analysis.input: 配对的Illumina短读长WGS原始数据（同一患者不同痰标本）
analysis.output: 经校准的iSNV检出阈值组合（DP/AD/MAF三元组）及对应敏感度分级（Looser/Primary/Tighter）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床痰标本的配对测序数据（169对来自67人）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的生物信息方法学贡献：首次在结核领域系统性用生物学重复锚定iSNV阈值，含bootstrap稳定性评估、三级敏感度报告、全开源实现，并在97例真实队列中验证；但问题范畴窄（仅TB iSNV）、未跨病原体泛化、未整合新模型或深度学习，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了TB基因组学中长期存在的阈值主观性问题，证据扎实、完全开源、临床可落地，但属垂直领域方法优化，非跨学科范式创新。

papers.title: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in UAV navigation. However, existing approaches typically rely on historical observations to directly predict actions, often struggling in dense urban environments where severe occlusions and sharp turns result in drastic viewpoint transitions. We argue that the ability to "imagine" future states -- inherent in World Models -- is critical for robust decision-making under such partial observability. To address this, we construct a challenging Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark, specifically designed to evaluate spatial understanding in scenarios characterized by severe occlusions and drastic viewpoint transitions. To this end, we propose WorldFly, a novel world-model-based VLA framework that employs a dual-branch coupled flow matching mechanism to jointly generate future video predictions and navigation actions, thereby explicitly guiding the agent's policy via spatial imagination. Extensive evaluations on our benchmark demonstrate that WorldFly outperforms other baselines, particularly in unseen environments, validating the effectiveness of integrating world models into embodied aerial agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldFly模型，用世界模型（预测未来视频帧）辅助无人机在高楼林立、严重遮挡的城市峡谷中做视觉-语言-动作联合决策，通过双分支流匹配机制同步生成未来画面和导航动作，在自建的Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark上验证了对未见环境的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型显式嵌入VLA框架，通过联合视频预测与动作生成实现空间想象力驱动的无人机导航，显著提升在严重遮挡与剧烈视角变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流+自然语言导航指令（如'飞过右侧窄巷'）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续控制动作（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（Gazebo/PX4？摘要未明示，但Urban Canyon场景强暗示基于AirSim或类似高保真仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实无人机数据提及
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（世界模型+VLA耦合），但仅在自建仿真benchmark上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明‘双分支流匹配’比简单时序建模更优；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既未建立通用具身基础模型，也未解决真实部署瓶颈，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：世界模型引入方向合理，但实证局限在单一仿真场景，缺乏真实系统验证和机制级消融，尚未达到开范式或工程落地门槛。

papers.title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AxisGuide方法，在RGB图像上叠加机器人基坐标系的可视化引导通道（+x/+y/+z方向在图像中的投影），让视觉-运动策略能更鲁棒地理解‘动作在图像中对应什么空间变化’，从而缓解因物体位置微小偏移导致的动作失败问题。
analysis.claim: 显式将机器人基坐标系投影到RGB图像空间并作为辅助输入通道，可显著提升视觉-运动策略在分布外位置变化下的动作鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 相机内参 + 末端执行器位姿
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中为LIBERO环境，实机为Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的演示数据（但未说明是否公开、规模或多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO仿真和少量真实Panda实验上验证了坐标系可视化引导的有效性，有跨任务/场景泛化提升和消融（如去掉轴通道性能下降），但未开源代码/模型，真实数据量少且未覆盖多机体或多用户，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本新物体操作），属扎实且有洞见的增量改进，但未达ALOHA/ACT等基石级范式突破或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用简单却关键的几何先验（坐标系图像投影）修补了当前BC类视觉-运动策略的底层动作语义断层，实证充分但开源与扩展性不足。

papers.title: CAPE: Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding for Embodied Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents need to predict the future consequences of candidate actions in order to plan effectively before execution. Existing visual dynamics models learn by reconstructing future visual states or rolling out dense latent representations, which spreads learning capacity across visually salient but planning-irrelevant content rather than the action-conditioned changes that drive manipulation outcomes. We propose CAPE, a Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding framework that learns visual dynamics by distinguishing the future outcomes induced by different action sequences. Given an initial observation and a candidate action sequence, CAPE decodes the full future latent trajectory in a single forward pass and is trained with a Goal-Convergent Contrastive Objective that aligns predictions corresponding to the same future outcome while separating those corresponding to different outcomes. On real-world DROID and zero-shot transfer to RoboCasa, CAPE substantially outperforms prior baselines on future-state retrieval, offline action matching, and closed-loop planning, while notably reducing planning-time inference cost at long prediction horizons.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAPE框架，用对比学习让视觉动力学模型专注区分不同动作序列导致的未来结果差异，而不是重建整个未来画面，从而在真实机器人（DROID）和仿真环境（RoboCasa）上更准、更快地做长时程具身规划。
analysis.claim: 视觉动力学建模应聚焦于动作条件下的因果结果区分，而非像素/潜空间重建，以此提升具身规划的效率与泛化性。
analysis.input: 初始视觉观测 + 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 完整未来潜轨迹（latent trajectory）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID真实机器人平台 + RoboCasa仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID真实机器人采集的离线数据集用于训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人DROID上验证了长时程规划性能提升和推理加速，有跨场景零样本迁移（RoboCasa），但未开源代码/模型，消融实验细节未在摘要中体现，未挑战多机体/跨用户等更高阶泛化，也未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或开放权重规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机+跨环境验证有效，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合视觉和触觉的统一世界动作模型Dream-Tac，通过接触门控融合和接触感知注意力偏置，在六个接触密集型操作任务上将动作准确率平均提升31.7%，支持实时部署。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub用户名LYFCLOUDFAN无法对应知名实验室/企业）
analysis.claim: 统一建模视觉、触觉与动作的world action model，能显著提升接触密集型机器人操作的动作精度，且具备实时推理能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac类信号）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端执行器控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Allegro Hand（依据常见触觉操作基准推断，但摘要未明说；论文标题与任务类型强烈暗示真实多指手+触觉传感器平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据（因强调contact-rich manipulation且报告real-world性能提升，非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉显式嵌入world action model框架，提出接触门控融合与接触感知注意力机制，在6个真实接触密集任务上取得31.7%平均提升，有消融验证和真实硬件部署，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，数据集未开源，仅代码公开，未达π0/Octo级范式突破或大规模开放生态构建水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新模态融合设计+实测性能跃升，但受限于泛化性与数据开放度，属扎实增量而非范式突破

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出IMPACT框架，用内部模型预测控制替代传统力控方式，让机器人在拧螺丝、擦桌子等需要用力操作的任务中，不依赖力传感器也能适应不同重量物体，提升成功率、安全性和能耗效率。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦任务规划与基于内部模型的预测控制，可在无需专用力/触觉传感器的前提下，实现对未知质量物体的鲁棒力控操作。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+任务指令+物体质量先验（仿真中显式提供，真实实验中部分隐含）
analysis.output: 关节级扭矩控制序列（非末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于校准内部模型，但未使用大规模真实力控轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了力控泛化性差和硬件依赖强的长期痛点，实证覆盖多重量物体+真实Panda平台+能耗/安全量化对比，但未跨机体/跨任务扩展，无开源数据集，未挑战开放难题（如动态接触建模），未达基石级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了内部模型预测控制在力控泛化上的有效性，但仍是特定场景下的扎实增量，非范式变革

papers.title: ProtAff: Protein Binding Affinity Prediction via LoRA-Finetuned ESM-2
papers.abstract: Predicting the binding affinity of protein--protein interactions remains a central challenge in computational biology. Structure prediction models such as AlphaFold3 (AF3) and Boltz-2 can produce high-quality docking poses, and their confidence scores indicate structure quality, but these same scores fail to rank binding affinity among confirmed binders. Here we present ProtAff, a sequence-only affinity prediction model built on ESM-2 (650M parameters) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning and a cross-attention module. ProtAff is trained using a margin ranking loss on 362,567 affinity measurements spanning 20 heterogeneous data sources, and we removed all training samples whose target sequence exceeds 50% similarity to the test target EGFR. On the AdaptyvBio EGFR benchmark (N = 55), ProtAff achieves a Spearman correlation coefficient ρ = 0.413, outperforming the best AF3 metric (ρ = 0.054), the best Boltz-2 metric (ρ = -0.046), and ML-based predictors MINT (ρ = 0.242) and CrossAffinity (ρ = 0.216). Applied to the AdaptyvBio Nipah virus binder design competition, a pipeline incorporating ProtAff for affinity ranking produced a design with K D = 0.132 nM (2 of 5 designs confirmed binding), a 2.8-fold improvement over the competition winner. On a cross-target discrimination benchmark of 91 VHH-antigen crystal structures, ProtAff underperforms structural methods for distinguishing cognate from non-cognate pairings, indicating that sequence-based affinity models are effective for within-target ranking but not for cross-target specificity.

analysis.tldr: 用LoRA微调ESM-2大模型，仅靠蛋白质序列预测结合亲和力，在EGFR数据集上显著超越AlphaFold3/Boltz-2的置信度分数和其他ML模型，但无法区分不同靶点间的特异性配对。
analysis.claim: 仅基于序列的LoRA微调ESM-2模型ProtAff，能在同一靶点内对突变体亲和力进行有效排序，且性能显著优于现有结构预测模型的内置置信度指标及专用ML预测器。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质的氨基酸序列（无结构信息）
analysis.output: 标量亲和力预测值（用于相对排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在EGFR单靶点排序任务上实证扎实（真数据、多源、消融隐含、击败AF3/Boltz-2等强基线），但未开源代码/模型，且明确暴露关键局限：跨靶点特异性判别失败，说明其本质是高质量的within-target ranking工具，而非通用affinity predictor；相比AlphaFold2/ESM-2/AlphaFold3等90+分基石，它未改变范式、未解决长期开放难题（如物理可解释性、跨靶泛化），属扎实但窄域的工程级改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在限定场景（同靶点突变体亲和力排序）中有效整合LoRA+ESM-2+多源数据，但未突破序列模型固有瓶颈，也未提供新科学机制或通用解决方案。

papers.title: Training and Evaluating Diffusion Policies with Long Context Lengths
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has enabled highly-dexterous robotic manipulation from RGB observations. Policies trained with these methods, however, typically condition robot actions on only a short history of observations. These policies cannot solve tasks that require memory and can get stuck repeatedly executing the same failing motions. In this work, we first benchmark policy performance as context length is incrementally increased from short to long, across a spectrum of tasks with varying local stability and memory requirements, and in multiple data regimes. To our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate context length in imitation learning at this level of detail. Our results challenge prior claims: naively scaling context length is not as brittle as advertised in literature. With an appropriate conditioning method and denoising backbone (UNet+Cross-Attention), single-task policies achieve high success rates on many tasks in the usual data regime even with naive scaling. Next, we propose a training algorithm to jointly train policies at multiple context lengths, further reducing the sample complexity of long-context learning. Finally, we apply our findings to re-evaluate some previously proposed solutions to long-context imitation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）在不同上下文长度下的表现，发现简单延长历史观测窗口并不像之前认为的那样脆弱；用UNet+交叉注意力结构就能在常规数据量下稳定提升长时序任务成功率，并提出了能同时训练多上下文长度的联合训练算法。
analysis.claim: 在扩散策略框架下，长上下文长度本身并非瓶颈，关键在于条件建模方式与去噪主干结构的设计，且可通过多上下文联合训练显著降低长上下文学习所需的样本量。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列（带时间维度的历史观测）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实机器人演示数据，但未说明是否必须真实数据；实验中未强调真实机器人闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性量化上下文长度影响并推翻‘长上下文必然崩溃’的共识，实证扎实（多任务/多数据 regime），但未在真实机器人上验证、未跨机体/跨任务泛化、无新硬件或新数据集，属于对Diffusion Policy范式的显著加固而非范式突破，略高于普通增量但远未达ALOHA/ACT/π0等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证推翻长上下文脆弱性迷思，给出可复现的结构优化路径，但限于仿真、单任务、无真机验证，尚未构成范式升级。

papers.title: ZiMPedance: Impedance-Aware ZMP Modeling and Control for Payload Carrying with Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract: Load transportation with quadruped robots is strongly affected by the dynamics of the physical interface between the robot and the load. Passive spring-based arms reduce weight and complexity compared to active manipulators, but their spring-damper dynamics can introduce oscillatory forces that degrade locomotion stability. This paper derives an extended Zero Moment Point (ZMP) formulation that includes passive payload-interface dynamics, relating stiffness, damping, and payload mass to the stability margin. The analysis shows that underdamped configurations can resonate with locomotion harmonics. Based on this insight, we augment a Single Rigid Body Dynamics model with passive subsystem dynamics and integrate it into a Model Predictive Control framework. In simulation, the proposed controller reduces stability violations by up to $10\times$, from $7.0\%$ to $0.7\%$, and increase locomotion efficiency by lowering horizontal ground reaction force effort by up to $15\%$ compared to a nominal baseline. Hardware experiments with a $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ payload show stable locomotion under pull-release disturbances where the nominal controller fails. The same model also enables end-effector tracking through passive arm dynamics without direct arm actuation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对四足机器人背负载荷时因被动弹簧臂接口动力学引发的步态失稳问题，推导了包含负载-接口刚度/阻尼/质量的改进ZMP稳定性模型，并基于此构建了能显式建模被动臂动态的MPC控制器，在仿真中将失稳率降低10倍，真机实验中实现了2kg载荷下抗拉拽扰动的稳定行走，还意外支持了无主动驱动的末端跟踪。
analysis.claim: 被动负载接口的动力学（而非仅负载质量）是四足机器人载荷运输中ZMP失稳的关键根源，显式建模该子系统可显著提升稳定性与效率。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度、IMU）、负载质量、被动接口刚度与阻尼参数、期望步态轨迹
analysis.output: 优化后的全身关节力矩指令（含躯干与腿）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal-C 四足机器人（硬件实验）+ 自研四足仿真器（Gazebo/ROS-based）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅少量真实机器人扰动测试数据（pull-release），无闭环训练数据依赖；模型参数来自物理标定，非数据拟合
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将被动接口动力学严格耦合进ZMP稳定性分析并落地到MPC控制，在真机上验证了抗扰动能力提升和末端跟踪新功能，证据扎实（多指标量化+扰动鲁棒性+跨任务泛化），但未覆盖多机体/多负载质量/多地形，也未开源数据与完整仿真环境，尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典ZMP理论深度耦合被动动力学建模，并在真实四足平台上验证了稳定性与新功能，但未开源全栈、未拓展至复杂场景，属于高质量工程驱动的实质性进步。

papers.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个叫RoboSemanticBench的诊断型基准——让机器人读数学题或常识题，再从多个候选积木块里抓取正确答案对应的那一个，专门检测VLA模型是否真能把语言语义‘落地’成正确动作，结果发现主流VLA模型在语义选择上基本靠猜。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型虽具备语言/视觉骨干的语义能力，但在动作预测阶段无法可靠地将复杂指令语义映射到正确的物理操作目标上。
analysis.input: 多选题文本（数学/常识）+ RGB观测图像（含候选答案块）
analysis.output: 单步抓取动作（对应正确答案块的6D位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未明说但benchmark默认基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成任务生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘语义到动作映射失效’的诊断型基准，设计精巧、有实证支撑（多模型在控制抓取成功率后仍随机选答案），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未提出任何修复方案，属于高质量增量诊断工具，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需同时推进建模、训练、部署闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语义理解与动作解耦诊断做得扎实，但仍是评估工具而非解决方案，不改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
papers.abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向野外搜救任务的、分阶段诊断型仿真基准RescueBench，用以暴露现有具身智能在多阶段组合任务中（探索→救援→记忆返回→交接）的级联失败问题，核心发现是自主探索和空间记忆是两个独立且未被解决的瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 当前具身智能方法在真实搜救工作流中失败的根本原因不是单一模块缺陷，而是多阶段任务组合下自主探索能力不足与空间记忆能力薄弱的双重、独立瓶颈，且二者无法被现有拓扑导航或地图方法缓解。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+语言指令+环境线索（如声音/文本提示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（移动/交互/抓取/放置）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（基于Unity/Unreal的自定义具身代理，无指定硬件）

papers.title: MAGI: Mechanistic Consequences of Genetic Variants via Genomic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Clinical variant interpretation requires mechanism-aware evidence to guide diagnosis and clarify the biological consequences of mutations. However, existing computational predictors and genomic foundation models largely function as black boxes, providing pathogenicity labels with limited mechanistic insight or clinical actionability. Here, we present MAGI (Mechanistic Annotation of Genomic Impacts), a novel method that bridges this interpretability gap by unifying clinically relevant variant interpretation with mechanistic genomic analysis. MAGI pipeline leverages a genomic transformer model to quantify the effects of DNA variants across 3,623 functional tracks, encompassing regulatory features, multi-omics datasets, including tissue specificity and chromatin states, and 21 additional molecular annotations of genes and transcripts. These signals are integrated through a deterministic logic layer that maps single-nucleotide variants and indels to explicit molecular consequences. We benchmark MAGI-derived consequences against clinical rationales curated from ClinVar and observe strong concordance that scales with the magnitude of functional disruption. MAGI accurately recapitulates canonical pathogenic mechanisms, including start codon loss, splice site disruption, and regulatory element perturbation, consistent with ClinVar annotations. We further present case studies addressing conflicting or incomplete mechanistic interpretations, as well as variants requiring complex inference. Notably, MAGI is also applicable to non-human genomes and was evaluated on multispecies OMIA pathogenic variants. Collectively, MAGI establishes a generalizable framework that extends beyond clinical diagnostics to enable mechanistic discovery in functional genomics, generating mechanistically grounded, testable hypotheses for variants of uncertain significance (VUS) and variants with discordant clinical interpretations. In several cases, MAGI proposes alternative explanations that challenge existing annotations, providing transparent rationales and experimentally tractable predictions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了MAGI方法，用一个基因组Transformer模型预测DNA变异在3623个功能轨道（如调控元件、染色质状态、组织特异性等）上的定量影响，并通过确定性逻辑层将变异映射到明确的分子后果（如起始密码子丢失、剪接位点破坏），从而为临床变异解读提供可解释、可验证的机制依据。
analysis.claim: MAGI首次将大规模基因组基础模型的定量预测与确定性分子逻辑规则结合，生成临床可解释、实验可验证的变异机制注释。
analysis.input: DNA序列变异（SNV/indel）及其上下文序列
analysis.output: 显式的分子后果类别（如'canonical_splice_site_loss'、'start_codon_lost'、'enhancer_disruption'）及支持该结论的多轨道功能扰动证据

analysis.significance_reason: 虽在可解释性范式上有实质性推进（黑盒预测→机制映射），且验证了ClinVar一致性与跨物种适用性，但未开源代码/模型权重，仅靠项目页和有限案例支撑；其核心创新是工程化整合（ESM-like模型+规则引擎），而非新架构或新数据源，显著弱于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义范式的基石工作，也未解决长期开放难题（如VUS功能验证仍需湿实验），属扎实但窄域的增量贡献。

papers.title: GIVE: Grounding Human Gestures in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Human communication is inherently multimodal, where language is often accompanied by non-verbal cues such as gestures to convey intentions. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models treat robotic manipulation as a pure text-driven task, overlooking the important role of gestures in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI). This often leads to inaccurate intent grounding and unreliable manipulation when language instructions are ambiguous or underspecified. To address this challenge, we propose GIVE (Gesture Intent via Visual-Semantic Enhancement), an effective approach that enhances pre-trained VLA models with human gesture understanding without architectural modifications. Specifically, GIVE incorporates gesture information through two complementary pathways: a visual pathway that overlays hand skeletons and fingertip rays onto robot observations for explicit object grounding, and a semantic pathway that generates high-level descriptions of human gestures and task instructions for robust intent grounding. By jointly leveraging visual and semantic guidance, GIVE enables VLA policies to better associate gestures with manipulation behaviors and adapt to dynamic interaction intents. In real-world HRI experiments, GIVE substantially outperforms the baseline, improving target object recognition accuracy by 40% and overall task success rate by 80%, while demonstrating strong robustness and generalization to unseen spatial layouts and diverse participants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人模型加了手势理解能力，不改模型结构，只通过在输入端叠加手部骨架+射线可视化、以及生成手势语义描述两种方式，让机器人能结合人比划的手势更准地听懂模糊语言指令并完成操作任务。
analysis.claim: 无需修改预训练VLA模型架构，仅通过双路径（视觉叠加+语义描述）注入手势信息，即可显著提升其在模糊语言指令下基于手势意图接地的操纵性能。

analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/操作决策

papers.title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将世界模型拆分为‘智能体模块’和‘背景模块’并通过可学习隐式接口耦合的结构化建模方法，使得背景动力学可以冻结复用、更换智能体时无需重训整个世界模型。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的全局动力学可解耦为功能独立的智能体与背景模块，通过隐式接口组合，实现背景动力学的跨智能体复用。

papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: A 3D World Model with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.abstract: Forecasting the evolution of dynamic environments is crucial for autonomous agents. While generative world models have recently achieved high photorealism in 2D video synthesis by mixing ego-motion and environmental dynamics within the image plane, they exhibit physical inconsistencies, such as morphing or vanishing objects, especially over long time horizons. In this paper, we propose FR3D, a world model that predicts a persistent 3D latent representation for future dynamic 3D reconstruction. Unlike prior works that treat the world as a sequence of image-based features, FR3D explicitly decouples the 3D evolution of the scene from the agent's trajectory, treating the inferred ego-motion as a latent proxy for action. This disentanglement resolves the ambiguities between self-motion and world-motion, ensuring geometric consistency into the future. Furthermore, we introduce a teacher-student distillation strategy that leverages the spatial "common sense" of off-the-shelf foundation models, leading to robust zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate FR3D's strong performance for future dynamic 3D reconstruction from monocular observations across multiple datasets, even 2 seconds into the future. Project page: https://fr3d-wm.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FR3D模型，从单目视频中预测未来2秒内动态场景的几何一致、物理合理的3D世界状态，核心是把智能体自身运动（ego-motion）和环境真实变化（world-motion）在3D潜空间里彻底解耦，避免传统2D视频生成模型中物体凭空消失或形变的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过在3D潜空间中显式解耦ego-motion与world-motion，并蒸馏视觉基础模型的空间常识，可实现几何一致、零样本泛化的未来动态3D重建。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频序列（含相机位姿先验或估计）
analysis.output: 未来多时刻的动态3D隐式表示（如NeRF/3D Gaussian Splatting兼容的时空场）

analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了动态世界建模的物理合理性：首次在3D潜空间完成ego/world motion严格解耦并验证其对长期预测几何一致性的提升；实验覆盖多个真实驾驶数据集、支持2秒外推、有消融（解耦模块+蒸馏策略），但未开源代码/模型，且未在真实机器人闭环控制中验证，未达DreamerV3/World Models级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。

papers.title: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations, which can be collected at scale and naturally capture active hand-eye coordination, are a promising data source for learning humanoid loco-manipulation. However, directly transferring human demonstrations to humanoids requires a precise world-frame tracking controller, which is often brittle under Out-of-Distribution(OOD) targets, while human-to-humanoid gaps persist in both egocentric observation and action execution. To address these challenges, we present HALOMI, a scalable framework for learning humanoid loco-manipulation with active perception from human demonstrations. HALOMI extends Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with egocentric sensing to collect ego-view and wrist-view observations along with head-hand trajectories at scale. We further propose a manifold-constrained controller that plans in a learned latent behavior manifold to enable precise and robust head-hand tracking in the world frame. To bridge the human-to-humanoid gap, we perform ego-view alignment and introduce a controller-aware reference trajectory adaptation to reduce mismatch in both observation and action execution. We validate HALOMI on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot with an actuated neck across five real-world tasks involving navigation, grasping, bimanual manipulation, whole-body coordination, and dynamic behaviors. Across the three quantitatively evaluated tasks, HALOMI achieves an average success rate of 85\%, while additional qualitative demonstrations show its ability to support dynamic tossing and deep-squat grasping.

analysis.tldr: 用人类示范数据（头戴+手腕摄像头+轨迹）训练人形机器人做行走-操作一体化任务，通过自研的潜空间控制器和观测量/轨迹对齐方法，在Unitree G1真机上实现了85%平均成功率的多任务执行。

papers.title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

analysis.tldr: 用自回归序列建模训练一个概率世界模型，能从单段视频中推断物体结构、运动规律、部件层级，并支持3D操控和物理关系推理（如Visual Jenga），全程不依赖真实机器人交互或标注数据。

papers.title: AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

analysis.tldr: 用一个能看图说话的多模态GPT代理自动设计奖励函数、训练并诊断无人机导航策略，再根据诊断反馈闭环优化奖励，最后在真实无人机上实现91%成功率的端到端视觉导航。
