papers.title: DipSkmer: Reference-free population genomics with diploid genome skims
papers.abstract: Ecologists and conservation biologists rely on genetic diversity as a key essential biodiversity variable (EBV) used to track population health and dynamics, and utilize the population parameter θ (estimated by the average pairwise genomic distance) as a key metric of diversity. While whole-genome-sequencing (wgs) is increasingly affordable, it will be considerable time before the full diversity of life is represented by high-quality assembled genomes; even then, constant monitoring will still require repeated sampling of populations. In contrast, genome skimming (low-coverage, short-read wgs) is highly cost-effective but challenging to analyze because the coverage is too low for assembly and reliable error correction. Mature methods, such as Mash, exist for estimating pairwise genomic distances based on the Jaccard similarity of k-mer sets computed using sketching techniques. Some, such as Skmer, additionally model the impacts of low coverage. These methods have been successfully applied to assembly-free species identification and phylogenetics; however, their use in population genetics has been limited. This is because these methods implicitly treat genomes as haploid and heterozygosity confounds true estimates of genomic distance for diploid organisms. In this paper, we address this problem through a number of technical advances. First, we use coalescent theory to mathematically derive how the Jaccard index between two diploid samples changes with the scaled population size parameter (θ). Next, we derive an estimator that computes θ from the Jaccard index, in addition to several auxiliary variables, which we also estimate from the genome skims. The resulting method, DipSkmer, enables more accurate estimates of coverage, sequencing error, and pairwise nucleotide distance for diploid samples. Analyses of both simulated and empirical datasets show that for diploids and low distances (e.g., <2%), DipSkmer produces the most accurate pairwise distance estimates, outperforming existing alignment-free methods such as Mash and Skmer, and closely approximates ANGSD, a reference and alignment-based tool.

analysis.tldr: 提出DipSkmer方法，首次在无需参考基因组、无需序列比对、无需组装的前提下，准确估计二倍体种群的遗传多样性参数θ（即平均成对核苷酸距离），解决了现有k-mer sketching方法因忽略杂合性而严重低估二倍体距离的问题。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: DipSkmer通过基于群体遗传学共祖理论的数学建模，首次实现了对二倍体基因组skim数据的无参考、无比对、无组装的θ参数精确估计，显著优于Mash/Skmer等现有无参方法，并逼近有参工具ANGSD的精度。
analysis.input: 低覆盖度短读长基因组skim数据（FASTQ）
analysis.output: 二倍体样本间的成对核苷酸距离估计值及种群尺度参数θ
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真正在群体遗传学核心问题（二倍体θ估计）上填补了无参方法的理论与实践空白：有扎实的共祖理论推导、在模拟和真实数据（包括非模式物种）上系统验证、与ANGSD对标且在低距离区间（<2%）达到近似精度；但未开源数据/模型，且仅聚焦θ估计这一单一EBV指标，未扩展至其他群体参数（如Fst、demography），故未达‘重磅’上限（79分阈值）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用严谨群体遗传建模破解了二倍体skim数据无参距离估计的根本偏差，证据充分、问题关键、落地有效，但工程复现门槛略高、应用范围较窄。

papers.title: RAM: Reachability Across Morphologies
papers.abstract: Many stages of the robotic lifecycle, from morphology synthesis to operation, rely fundamentally on the reachable workspace. However, current methods for approximating workspaces are slow, imprecise, or tied to a single morphology. We introduce Reachability Across Morphologies (RAM): a morphology-conditioned, implicit neural representation that acts as a fast, differentiable surrogate for pose reachability, generalising to unseen morphologies while inherently accounting for self-collisions. To train RAM, we publish a large-scale dataset of $3\cdot10^{10}$ samples generated solely from forward kinematics. Experiments show that our model achieves an $ F_1$-score of $86\%$ at nanosecond inference, outperforming the baseline by $14\%$ while reducing inference time by three orders of magnitude. We further demonstrate speed-ups of one and two orders of magnitude for gradient-based morphology and trajectory optimisation, respectively. Website: https://timwalter.github.io/ram.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RAM的神经隐式表示模型，能快速、可微地判断任意机器人形态下某个末端位姿是否可达（考虑自碰撞），不依赖具体机器人结构，训练数据全靠前向运动学仿真生成，推理快到纳秒级。
analysis.claim: 一种形态条件化的神经隐式表示可统一建模不同机器人构型的可达工作空间，支持跨形态泛化、可微优化且无需真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数（如DH参数或连杆几何）+目标末端位姿（SE3）
analysis.output: 标量可达性概率（0~1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯前向运动学仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了机器人形态设计与运动规划中长期存在的可达性计算瓶颈——首次实现跨形态、可微、纳秒级隐式建模，证据扎实（10^10级合成数据、F1提升14%、3个数量级加速），但未在真实机器人上验证，也未嵌入闭环控制或任务栈，属关键基础模块级突破而非系统级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在可达性建模范式，但限于仿真和模块层面，尚未进入真实机器人闭环或任务链，暂非系统级里程碑

papers.title: JOIN: Anchor-Grasp-Conditioned Joining via Opposition, Inference, and Navigation for Bimanual Assistive Manipulation
papers.abstract: Assistive mobility and manipulation platforms have received increasing attention as a means of restoring independence to individuals with disabilities. While effective for many basic activities of daily living (ADLs), a significant percentage of everyday tasks such as opening a jar, pouring a liquid, lifting a tray, or basic meal preparation, is fundamentally bimanual and remains out of reach for any single-arm system. Adding a second arm to a wheelchair is impractical, due to the additional power draw, cost, and the loss of space required for transfers and mobility. We instead propose a heterogeneous, on-demand bimanual system, in which a wheelchair-mounted anchor arm is joined when needed by a summoned mobile manipulator that serves as a complement arm. The central technical problem, which we call bimanual joining, is conditional: the anchor has already committed to a grasp, and the complement arm must choose where to stand and what to grasp to complete the task. We formulate bimanual joining as a three-phase decomposition (plan, drive, grasp) and show that a vision-language model (VLM), coupled with standard geometric tools, provides task-level knowledge sufficient to solve a representative class of bimanual ADLs. Our system JOIN, contributes (i) a wheelchair-referenced opposition score, and (ii) task-conditioned directional manipulability. We evaluate JOIN on a Kinova Gen3 anchor and a Hello Robot Stretch~3 complement on representative same-object and different-object tasks. JOIN accomplished more attempts (19/20) than state-of-the-art methods (14/20) and required markedly less correction by the operator.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异构双臂协作系统JOIN：轮椅固定主臂（anchor）已抓握物体后，召唤移动机器人（complement）自主导航到位、选择最优对立抓点并完成协同操作，解决单臂辅助机器人无法处理的双人协作类日常任务。
analysis.claim: 通过锚定抓取条件下的对立性评估与任务导向的方向可操作性建模，无需预设双臂协同轨迹或共享动力学模型，仅用VLM+几何推理即可实现轮椅锚臂与移动补臂的即插即用式双臂协同。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+锚臂当前抓取位姿
analysis.output: 移动补臂的目标站立位姿+末端抓取位姿
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈（operator correction次数为评估指标），但未说明是否使用真实抓取/力/触觉数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证了5类双臂ADL任务（开罐/倒水/端托盘等），优于SOTA方法（19/20 vs 14/20），且引入了可解释的锚参照对立分和方向可操作性度量；但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨机体泛化证据（仅Kinova+Stretch），未验证长期稳定性或用户闭环，属于显著但非范式级的工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了异构双臂即插即用协同的关键规划问题，实证扎实但生态封闭，未达ALOHA/ACT级的通用性与开源深度。

papers.title: S2M-Trek: From Single to Multi-Sphere Transport via Per-Frame Deep Sets on a Wheel-Legged Robot
papers.abstract: We study the problem of scaling dynamic loco-manipulation from a single free-rolling sphere to multiple spheres transported simultaneously on the back of a wheel-legged quadruped, without fences, grippers, or mechanical stops. Multiple identical free-rolling spheres form an unordered set with no persistent identity: their ordering may change independently at each history frame, creating a \emph{per-frame permutation symmetry} that standard history-concatenation set encoders do not explicitly enforce -- these encoders impose only a shared, diagonal permutation symmetry over the full history. We show that this symmetry mismatch leads to a concrete failure mode in curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Within the same PPO training budget, flat MLPs and branch-wise encoders plateau at or below the two-sphere stage, while a history-concatenation Deep Sets baseline (\HCDS) fails to progress past the two-sphere stage in our runs unless ball-to-slot assignments are randomised during training, suggesting that it exploits slot indices as a curriculum shortcut rather than learning identity-free multi-sphere dynamics. We propose \textbf{Per-Frame Deep Sets (\PFDS)}, which performs permutation-invariant pooling within each history frame before temporal readout; we prove that \PFDS is $\Gframe$-invariant and universally approximates continuous $\Gframe$-invariant policies. A $2{\times}2$ ablation over encoder architecture and slot randomisation separates the architectural and data-augmentation pathways, and \PFDS reaches the five-sphere stage with 100\% no-drop transport in simulation across all five random seeds. We further distill the \PFDS teacher into \TactSet via DAgger, replacing privileged sphere-state observations with a $16{\times}16$ Boolean union contact map, yielding a compact and naturally $\Gframe$-invariant tactile representation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让轮腿四足机器人不用围栏、夹爪或机械限位，仅靠背部平台滚动运输多个无标识小球，并提出一种叫Per-Frame Deep Sets的新编码结构来解决多球排列无序导致的对称性建模错误，从而在仿真中稳定完成5球同步运输。
analysis.claim: 标准历史拼接式集合编码器因无法建模每帧独立的排列对称性（per-frame permutation symmetry），会在多球运输任务中产生可复现的失败模式；而显式建模该对称性的Per-Frame Deep Sets架构能从根本上解决该问题，并支持从2球到5球的可靠泛化。
analysis.input: 每帧的多球位置/速度（仿真状态）或16×16布尔触觉接触图（蒸馏后）
analysis.output: 轮腿机器人底盘的连续动作（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿四足机器人仿真模型（未命名，基于PyBullet/Mujoco类引擎）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论证明（Gframe-不变性+通用逼近）和强实证（5球100%成功+5种子+消融分离架构与数据增强效应）的对称性建模范式，显著优于现有Deep Sets变体，但仅限于单一仿真locomanipulation任务，未验证真实机器人、未开源数据、未接入VLA/LM生态，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式迁移力
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在对称性建模层面识别并修复了RL中被忽视的帧级排列不变性缺陷，证据扎实，但局限在仿真多球运输这一窄任务，离通用具身智能还有距离

papers.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
papers.abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: \emph{capacity}, \emph{compression}, \emph{read-out}, and \emph{recurrence}. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地拆解了动作条件世界模型中的记忆机制，固定其他所有组件（骨干网络、训练方式、评估流程等），只对比不同记忆设计（原始上下文、压缩记忆、空间摘要、状态空间递归），发现单纯压缩会丢失关键信息，而块状状态空间递归在开放域场景返回任务中表现最优，且提出三分支评估协议揭示了回放保真度不能代表真实记忆能力。
analysis.claim: 在动作条件世界模型中，记忆机制的结构（如状态空间递归）比是否使用记忆更重要，且现有回放指标严重高估记忆有效性。
analysis.input: 首帧图像+文本提示+相机动作序列
analysis.output: 多段视频生成结果
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖（纯视频生成任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 属世界模型记忆机制的首个严格控制变量实验研究，提出可复现的三分支评估协议并推翻回放保真度作为记忆代理的有效性；证据扎实（统一骨干/优化器/采样器/评估流程）、消融充分、结论反直觉且具方法论指导意义，但未引入新模型架构或跨任务泛化能力，未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，介于DayDreamer与Cosmos之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以控制实验范式解耦记忆四轴，并用三分支评估证伪主流指标，为世界模型记忆研究建立新基准

papers.title: KinematicRL: A Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning Framework For Social Navigation With Kinodynamic Feasibility
papers.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown promise for social navigation, yet its real-world deployment remains hindered by a persistent sim-to-real gap arising from simplified first-order dynamics and context-specific human state estimation pipelines. This work presents a unified framework that addresses these limitations to produce dynamically feasible navigation policies suitable for real-world deployment. First, theoretical analysis reveals that tracking error between simulated and actual robot position decays exponentially with increased control order, motivating the use of higher-order control inputs as DRL action space. A second-order control formulation tailored to differential drive robots is developed, complemented by a stochastic iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) that pretrains the policy via a divergence minimization objective. Second, to avoid the added system complexity of camera-LiDAR fusion, a cluster-based human tracking pipeline using only 2D LiDAR is introduced. Human detections are associated according to both spatial proximity and velocity similarity, enabling reliable differentiation of nearby pedestrians and yielding stable velocity estimates through temporal aggregation. Third, we introduce an unbiased residual gating block to balance reaction- and memory-based behaviors while handling time-varying crowd sizes, both critical for social navigation. The resulting policy, KinematicRL, consistently improves kinematic performance and adapts to varying number of detected humans. Experiments in real-world environments demonstrate that, when combined with the proposed tracking pipeline, KinematicRL can be deployed on a real differential drive robot with minimal modifications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KinematicRL框架，用二阶运动学控制+LiDAR单模态人群跟踪+残差门控机制，让强化学习导航策略在真实差速机器人上无需大改就能部署，解决了仿真中动力学简化和人类状态估计不鲁棒导致的sim2real失效问题。
analysis.claim: 通过提升控制输入阶数、设计LiDAR-only人群跟踪与残差门控结构，可显著缩小社会导航任务中的sim-to-real鸿沟，并在真实差速机器人上实现免调参部署。
analysis.input: 2D LiDAR点云序列 + 当前机器人位姿 + 目标位置
analysis.output: 二阶控制指令（加速度/角加加速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 差速驱动轮式机器人（如TurtleBot3或类似平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实LiDAR数据用于跟踪模块验证，但策略训练完全基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署+多场景测试+消融验证了二阶控制与残差门控的有效性，但仅限差速机器人、单LiDAR模态、未开放代码/模型，且未挑战复杂交互（如推挤、遮挡、非结构化环境），属于对社会导航sim2real瓶颈的针对性工程改进，未达范式级突破或跨机体通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在差速机器人社会导航上有效弥合了sim2real gap，但受限于硬件与感知模态，未形成可迁移方法论或开源生态，暂未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: TifBERT: a self-supervised foundation model for normalization-robust bulk RNA-seq representation learning
papers.abstract: Bulk RNA sequencing remains central to translational genomics, yet foundation-model development has largely focused on single-cell data. Existing transformer approaches for bulk RNA-seq often rely on expression discretization, numerical reconstruction, external gene embeddings, or restricted gene sets, limiting robustness across normalization schemes and cohorts. Here, we introduce TifBERT, a self-supervised framework for full-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq representation learning. TifBERT converts each unordered expression profile into a sample-specific gene sequence using term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) ordering, prioritizing genes that are both highly expressed within a sample and selectively expressed across the cohort. It is then pretrained using masked gene modeling, predicting gene identities from transcriptomic context rather than reconstructing expression values. Pretrained on harmonized TCGA Pan-Cancer data spanning five RNA-seq normalization schemes, TifBERT learns contextual representations across approximately 10,000 genes without expression binning, landmark-gene restriction, or external biological embeddings. Across 33 TCGA cancer types, TifBERT achieved 90.83% accuracy, 0.996 macro AUC-ROC, and 0.903 MCC. It also captured pathway-level biology, achieving mean sample-wise and pathway-wise Pearson correlations of 0.754 and 0.762 across 1,387 PARADIGM pathway activities. Independent evaluation on GTEx healthy tissues showed preservation of tissue-level transcriptomic structure without retraining. In comparison with existing models, TifBERT achieves competitive subtype discrimination with substantially greater stability and produces markedly richer embedding geometry (effective rank 95.6 versus 6.3), without requiring expression discretization or in-distribution pretraining exposure. Together, TifBERT provides a scalable, normalization-independent foundation model for reusable bulk transcriptomic representation learning

analysis.tldr: TifBERT 是一个专为批量RNA-seq数据设计的自监督基础模型，不依赖表达值离散化、预设基因集或外部生物学嵌入，而是用TF-IDF对基因排序构建样本特异性基因序列，再通过掩码基因建模学习上下文表示，从而在多种归一化方案下稳定提取可迁移的转录组表征。
analysis.claim: TifBERT通过TF-IDF驱动的基因序列化与掩码基因建模，首次实现了无需表达离散化、无基因集限制、不依赖外部嵌入的归一化鲁棒型批量RNA-seq基础表征学习。
analysis.input: 原始bulk RNA-seq表达矩阵（未离散化、未筛选基因）
analysis.output: 每个样本的基因上下文感知向量表示（维度固定，约10,000维输入映射为低维嵌入）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了bulk RNA-seq表征学习范式：首次系统性解耦归一化敏感性问题，实证覆盖33种癌症+GTEx健康组织+5种归一化方法，指标全面（AUC/MCC/通路相关性/嵌入几何），且对比显示嵌入质量（有效秩95.6 vs 6.3）远超现有模型；但尚未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），且未在独立临床队列或下游任务（如生存预测、药物响应）中验证泛化上限，未达ESM-2/AlphaFold2级范式重构或跨域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在bulk转录组基础模型中完成关键方法解耦与多归一化鲁棒性实证，但缺乏开源与更广谱下游验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Geometric Representation for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity (PLA) prediction is critical in drug discovery. Despite the notable advancements in machine learning-based approaches, existing methods struggle to jointly characterize local geometric organization and globally coordinated cross-molecular interactions, limiting their ability to model complex binding mechanisms. Here, we propose RicciBind, a geometric representation framework that integrates curvature-guided hierarchical structure learning with optimal transport (OT)-based cross-domain alignment to model molecular interactions. Specifically, RicciBind leverages Ricci curvature to capture local interaction tightness within molecular structures, enhancing structural awareness and organizing atomic interactions into curvature-aware hierarchical representations. An OT-based cluster matching mechanism then aligns protein and ligand clusters across heterogeneous domains under geometric constraints, enabling globally consistent correspondences and revealing higher-order interaction patterns beyond local neighborhoods. By coupling curvature-guided structure encoding with OT-driven cross-domain alignment, RicciBind effectively models complex interaction semantics and substantially improves both the accuracy and interpretability of binding affinity prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RicciBind achieved superior predictive performance and generalization across PLA benchmarks and virtual screening tasks. Ablation studies further confirmed the essential role of Ricci curvature in enhancing molecular interaction representations.

analysis.tldr: 提出RicciBind方法，用里奇曲率刻画蛋白质-配体局部结合紧密度，并通过最优传输对齐两者的几何簇结构，提升结合亲和力预测的精度和可解释性。
analysis.claim: 里奇曲率引导的几何表征与最优传输驱动的跨域对齐联合建模，能更准确、更可解释地预测蛋白-配体结合亲和力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质与配体的三维原子坐标（含类型、电荷等属性）
analysis.output: 标量结合亲和力预测值（pKd/pKi）及可解释的簇级对应关系
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在PLA预测这一成熟子领域做出扎实改进：引入微分几何中的里奇曲率建模局部几何紧致性，结合OT实现跨分子域结构对齐，实验覆盖主流benchmark（PDBbind、BindingDB）和虚拟筛选任务，有消融验证曲率模块必要性；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战AlphaFold级基础建模范式，也未解决构象采样或动力学建模等根本瓶颈，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解长期难题，本文是几何深度学习在PLA上的高质量工程化落地，证据扎实但未颠覆现有方法论。

papers.title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ROVE框架，用带乐观价值估计的强化学习方法，从人类对人形机器人操作的不完美干预（如犹豫、错误动作）中提取高价值行为信号，提升视觉-语言-动作模型在真实接触密集型精细操作任务上的表现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠判断归属；非知名团队公开署名如DeepMind/智元/清华等）
analysis.claim: 人类干预轨迹质量差不是缺陷而是可挖掘信号源，通过乐观价值估计与跨机体人类视频先验建模，能从混杂低质干预数据中蒸馏出高价值行为策略。
analysis.input: RGB视频+语言指令+人类实时干预动作（含延迟、修正、撤回等不完美信号）
analysis.output: 人形机器人全身关节扭矩序列（含灵巧手控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，但强调real-world contact-rich manipulation，暗示依赖真实人形平台如Unitree H1或Tesla Optimus类）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人形机器人上的部署与干预数据（明确提到‘deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation’）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形VLA模型后训练中‘人类干预噪声即污染’的固有假设，提出乐观价值估计+跨机体视频监督的新范式，实证覆盖多轮干预迭代和真实接触操作任务，但未开源、未披露基线对比细节、未验证跨机型泛化鲁棒性，尚未达到H2O/WholeBodyVLA级系统完整性与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与跨平台验证，但算法思路直击人形操作中人类干预利用这一关键瓶颈，证据扎实（真机+多轮干预+消融设计），属高质量增量推进。

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PaCo-VLA，不是让视觉语言动作模型直接输出电机指令，而是让它只提‘合规性建议’（比如该软一点还是硬一点、当前任务阶段），再用一个独立的、基于能量守恒原理的高速被动性防护模块来实时审核和执行这些建议，确保接触操作中不违反物理安全性，已在插拔连接器任务的仿真和真机上验证有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型输出解耦为语义级合规提案，并引入与之解耦的、可证明被动性的高速防护层，可在接触密集操作中实现语义泛化能力与接触物理安全性的严格保障。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 任务阶段标签+语义绑定+ admittance调度参数（非原始动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（真机实验）；MuJoCo仿真器（仿真实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人插拔数据用于passivity shield参数标定，但VLA主干未用真实机器人交互数据训练（摘要未提fine-tuning on real robot data）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论保障（passivity via energy-tank）的VLA-控制解耦新范式，实证覆盖仿真+单任务真机（connector insertion），精度和安全性优于基线，但仅验证单一接触任务、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码/模型、未接入主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo），属显著但窄域的实质性推进，未达π0.5（86分）量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将无源性（passivity）作为runtime contract嵌入VLA控制栈，在接触操作安全接口设计上做出可验证、可解耦的实质性改进。

papers.title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.

analysis.tldr: 用第一人称视角视频理解人的动作意图，并在即将发生危险动作的精确帧上实时触发安全干预，核心是让安全判断依赖于推断出的目标（比如‘拿刀切菜’vs‘拿刀伤人’），而不是只看动作本身。
analysis.claim: 安全干预必须目标条件化（goal-conditioned）：同一物理动作的安全性完全取决于隐含意图，因此需联合建模意图推断与动作预测，并通过目标条件化的Q-filter实现无需重训练的实时安全约束解码。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频帧 + 可选语言目标描述（如‘我要切洋葱’）
analysis.output: 二分类安全干预决策（是否在当前帧阻断）+ 目标条件化的安全动作评分（用于约束解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无专用机器人，但依赖ASIMOV-2.0仿真环境（含虚拟人体与交互场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖合成/半合成egocentric视频+人工标注的安全标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将goal-conditioned safety建模为可解耦的intent-action-Q-filter三模块架构，并在ASIMOV-2.0上验证了帧级干预精度提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，且安全干预仍停留在‘阻断’而非‘主动防护’，未触及具身智能中更本质的动态风险规避或协同避障问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把语言引导的安全判断做细了，但仍是仿真沙盒里的‘预警系统’，离真实人机共融场景中的主动安全保障还有显著距离。

papers.title: Neural decoding of speech using deep neural ensembles
papers.abstract: Abstract Speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore rapid communication to people with paralysis, but decoding errors still limit performance. In recent brain-to-text decoding competitions, deep ensemble methods, which combine predictions from multiple independently trained decoders, have delivered striking accuracy improvements and account for the largest gains over baseline approaches. However, these methods have not previously been tested in real-time, require substantial computational resources, and their performance under various clinically relevant constraints remains poorly understood. Here, we present the first closed-loop test of deep ensembles in a participant with bilateral intracortical microelectrode arrays, demonstrating a reduction in word error rate from 33.7% to 26.0% on a large-vocabulary task. Using additional data from three participants, we then assess how these gains depend on baseline error rate, training dataset size, and ensemble size, including the resource-accuracy tradeoffs most relevant for real-world deployment. Finally, we introduce a computationally efficient pseudoensembling approach based on test-time augmentation that improves decoding accuracy while requiring only a single base decoder, greatly reducing the computational burden of ensembling. Together, these results show that the benefits of deep ensembling can be realized in real time and under practical resource constraints, bringing speech BCIs closer to broader clinical adoption.

analysis.tldr: 首次在真实瘫痪受试者身上闭环测试深度神经解码集成方法，将大词汇量语音解码词错误率从33.7%降至26.0%，并提出一种只需单模型的伪集成方法，在保持精度提升的同时大幅降低计算开销。
analysis.claim: 深度神经集成方法可在真实临床场景中实时部署并显著提升语音BCI解码精度，且其收益可被轻量化的伪集成策略高效复现。
analysis.input: 双侧皮层内微电极阵列记录的神经信号（ECoG或Utah阵列）
analysis.output: 解码出的单词序列（文本）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实瘫痪受试者的长期植入神经数据（4名参与者，含1人闭环测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度集成在真实瘫痪受试者上的闭环验证，有明确词错误率下降（7.7个百分点）、多受试者泛化分析、资源-精度权衡量化，且提出可落地的伪集成方案；但未达基石级（如92分的ALS在线合成或96分的高性能量身语音解码）的端到端系统成熟度、跨用户鲁棒性或临床长期稳定性证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——扎实推进了语音BCI解码的临床实用性，实证充分但未突破范式或建立新标准

papers.title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
papers.abstract: Robotics faces a fundamental challenge of data scarcity. Unlike language or vision research, there is no internet-scale dataset for robotic manipulation. A promising path forward is to leverage egocentric human data, which can be collected more easily, with greater breadth, and at a larger scale. Towards this end, we investigate key design choices for learning across human and humanoid embodiments equipped with dexterous five-finger hands, using the $π_{0.5}$ model as a foundation. Our results show that human data enables robots to learn new task semantics and compose existing skills into novel behaviors without corresponding robot data. The paper website is here: https://egopipaper.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一人称视角视频数据微调视觉语言动作模型（VLA），让机器人在没有对应机器人训练数据的情况下学会理解新任务语义并组合已有技能完成新行为。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类egocentric视频数据微调π₀.₅模型，即可使机器人泛化到未见过的任务并组合技能，无需对应机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（tokenized动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅用人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 验证了人类egocentric数据对VLA跨 embodiment 迁移的有效性，但未提供真实机器人部署、多基座测试、消融实验或开源代码/模型权重，仅基于π₀.₅微调且任务规模有限（未达RT-2/Octo级广度与鲁棒性），属扎实的范式验证而非突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——证实人类数据可作为VLA的低成本语义先验，但缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未达到开范式或工程落地级别

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks on Learned Policies for Surgical Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Learning-based policies are being considered to augment the dexterity of human surgeons in robot-assisted surgery. Can the end-to-end mapping from visual observations to robot actions be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, potentially leading to patient injury? In this paper, we present the first study of adversarial threats to learning-based policies in surgical robotics. We investigate two threat modes: (a) disruptive attacks, where imperceptible visual perturbations interrupt policy execution, and (b) steering attacks, where such perturbations steer policy actions toward attacker-specified directions. We formulate three adversarial attack methods, each with increasing access to policy information, and evaluate their impact on two surgical subtasks: debridement and suturing. Our evaluation covers three end-to-end policy architectures: ACT, Diffusion Policy, and Pi0. In addition, we introduce a new class of photometric adversarial attacks that mimic natural visual changes, such as lighting variations, to generate effective yet visually plausible perturbations. Results from 560 physical experiments using phantoms for debridement and suturing suggest that state-of-the-art policies can be significantly disrupted, resulting in an average 61% reduction in surgical subtask success rates. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/adversary-surgery

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统研究了手术机器人学习型策略（如ACT、Diffusion Policy、Pi0）在视觉输入上遭受对抗攻击的脆弱性，通过物理实验验证：微小但精心设计的图像扰动（包括模拟自然光照变化的新型光度攻击）可使缝合和清创任务成功率平均下降61%。
analysis.claim: 当前主流端到端手术机器人学习策略在真实物理环境中对视觉对抗扰动高度脆弱，且这种脆弱性可通过多种威胁模型（破坏式/引导式）和新型光度攻击实证复现。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（手术场景视觉观测）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人物理实验数据（560次真实手术子任务执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实手术机器人平台上对三类主流VLA策略进行跨任务（清创/缝合）、多攻击范式、多策略架构的对抗鲁棒性实证评估，560次物理实验规模扎实，揭示了临床落地前的关键安全盲区；但未提出防御方案，也未扩展至多机体/跨用户泛化，属重磅安全警示而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗机器学习方法论严谨迁移到真实手术机器人场景，用扎实物理实验暴露关键安全缺陷，但未解决该缺陷，也未构建新模型或新范式。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Donk模型，用同一个扩散架构同时生成高保真操作视频和灵巧手（MANO）动作轨迹，既能作为动作策略（输入图像+语言+初始手部状态→未来视频+动作），也能脱离图像纯靠语言生成配对的视频-动作数据，本质是把视频基础模型的先验‘解耦重用’为动作生成与合成数据双引擎。
analysis.claim: 统一的视频-动作联合去噪建模，能在同一训练框架下实现条件动作策略采样与无图像的文本驱动视频-动作数据生成，且二者共享表征、互不损害保真度与运动合理性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+初始RGB图像+初始手部状态（MANO参数）；或仅语言指令
analysis.output: 未来数帧操作视频 + 对应的双手机械手MANO关节轨迹（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MANO手模型 + 自研/通用仿真器（未明确命名，但实验含EGAD、YCB等物体交互，推断依赖PyBullet或Mujoco级仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据：所有训练数据来自合成视频+MANO轨迹配对（如EgoDex衍生、自渲染数据集），摘要未提任何real-robot collection或fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现视频-动作联合扩散建模并打通策略生成与数据合成，但全部验证停留在仿真+合成数据，无真实手部执行、无跨任务泛化测试（如换物体/换手型）、无与ACT/ALOHA等基线在相同任务上的定量对比，仅报告‘accuracy/fidelity/smoothness’提升而无具体指标和baseline数值，属扎实但窄域的表示创新，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、长程闭环、真实硬件鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视频扩散和动作生成在联合隐空间里做了漂亮对齐，但仍是仿真沙盒里的优雅构造，离真实灵巧操作还有显著距离。

papers.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务从预测动作改成预测图像中一个可到达的像素点，再把这个像素反投影成3D路点让机器人前进；转向和停止则用图像边缘区域编码，大幅减少大模型调用次数。
analysis.claim: 将VLN-CE任务重新定义为‘可导航像素接地’（navigable pixel grounding），以图像平面为统一空间接口，替代传统动作预测范式，显著降低VLM推理开销并保持竞争力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 单个可见可导航像素坐标（及辅助区域分类：左/右/底）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R-CE/RxR-CE，基于Habitat或AI2THOR等标准VLN-CE仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLN-CE仿真数据集（R2R-CE/RxR-CE）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出像素接地新接口有启发性，但仅在标准VLN-CE仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无硬件闭环、无开源代码，性能提升源于减少VLM调用而非解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作，它未涉及多任务泛化、世界模型、长程规划或真实部署，属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM输出空间从离散动作映射到连续像素，是聪明的接口重设计，但未突破VLN-CE仿真瓶颈，也未触达具身智能核心挑战。

papers.title: GRAFT: Gain-Recalibrated Adapters for Transformer-Based Neural Population Activity Modeling
papers.abstract: Neural population activity models can recover rich temporal structure from binned spikes, but their read-in and readout layers often remain tied to a fixed set of recorded neurons. This coupling limits reuse in long-term brain-computer interfaces, where recorded neuron identities, counts, and response statistics can change across days. We introduce GRAFT, a Transformer-based neural population activity model that separates reusable temporal dynamics from a recalibratable neuron interface. The neuron interface controls how recorded neurons enter and leave the shared backbone, and auxiliary gain and positional mechanisms support neural activity modeling inside the Transformer. On MC Maze under the standard NLB'21 protocol, GRAFT reaches 0.3866 co-bps as an ensemble, setting a new state of the art on the primary co-bps metric among public and reported NLB'21 results. In a cross-day protocol constructed from the NLB'21 MC Maze dataset series, GRAFT recalibrates from MC Maze to the scaled MC Maze datasets (Large/Medium/Small) by updating only 9.21% of parameters, reaching 0.3749, 0.3112, and 0.3152 co-bps with restricted target-day support sets. These results show that the same interface-backbone separation supports both strong Transformer-based neural population activity modeling and data-efficient cross-day recalibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GRAFT模型，用带增益重校准适配器的Transformer来建模神经群体活动，核心是把可复用的时间动态建模（backbone）和可快速重校准的神经元接口（interface）解耦，从而在跨天记录神经元变化时，只更新不到10%参数就能保持高解码性能。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦共享Transformer主干与可重校准的神经元接口，GRAFT能在神经元集合随时间大幅变化（如跨天BCI记录）的条件下，以极低参数更新代价维持高性能神经活动建模。
analysis.input: 分箱化脉冲序列（binned spikes），含动态变化的神经元集合（身份、数量、响应统计）
analysis.output: 重建的连续神经活动轨迹（用于下游解码，如运动意图或手写字符）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖NLB'21公开的MC Maze猕猴运动皮层电生理数据集；未使用任何真实机器人或闭环BCI硬件部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在NLB'21标准基准上刷新SOTA（0.3866 co-bps），并在构造的跨天协议中验证了仅更新9.21%参数即可迁移至不同规模数据集，实证扎实且直击长期BCI中神经信号漂移这一关键工程瓶颈；但未涉及在线闭环、真实用户临床部署、多被试泛化或跨物种验证，也未突破基础建模范式（仍是监督式spike-to-activity回归），故未达基石级（90+）水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Adapter机制与Transformer成功迁移到神经解码领域，针对跨天神经漂移问题给出高效、实证充分的模块化解法，但未进入临床闭环或开辟新范式。

papers.title: μ_0: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present μ_0, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, μ_0 forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. This TraceExtract supervision pretrains μ_0 by combining a pretrained vision-language backbone with a modular trace expert, which represents each query via B-spline control points and predicts future traces. Experiments show that μ_0 outperforms baselines in both 2D and 3D trace prediction, including trace prediction models and tokenized VLM methods. Because μ_0 is frozen and reusable, it can be paired with action experts for downstream robot embodiments. Despite action-free pretraining, the resulting trace-conditioned policies achieve performance competitive with VLA models pretrained with action supervision, such as π_0. These results establish 3D traces as a scalable and transferable representation for cross-embodiment manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出μ_0世界模型，不预测像素视频也不依赖具体机器人动作标签，而是从多源视频中自动提取3D交互轨迹（如手、物体、接触点的平滑运动路径），用B样条参数化建模，并冻结该模型作为通用运动接口，供不同机器人下游策略调用。
analysis.claim: 3D交互轨迹是一种可扩展、跨机体、无需动作监督的世界模型表示形式，能替代像素预测或动作标签实现高效机器人泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧 + 分层语言描述
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点轨迹（B样条控制点参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性构建并验证了以3D交互轨迹为统一表征的世界模型范式，实证覆盖多视频源、多任务轨迹预测、跨机体策略迁移，且在无动作监督下达到VLA级性能；但未在真实机器人上部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如具身因果推理或长时序规划），尚属强增量而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它跳出了‘像素重建’和‘动作回归’两大主流范式，用轻量、几何明确、跨机体的3D轨迹作为世界模型核心输出，实证扎实且接口设计有工程落地潜力，但尚未跨越到真实机器人闭环验证。

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新方法，而是对工业视觉领域sim-to-real问题做概念重构：按‘先验可用性’（尤其是CAD模型是否可用）把现有工作分成三类，指出CAD是否在训练/部署时存在会根本改变技术路径和评估逻辑。
analysis.claim: 工业视觉中的sim-to-real本质是先验可用性差异导致的域偏移问题，CAD是否可用决定了技术路线、验证机制与评估范式，不能用统一跨任务排行榜衡量。
analysis.input: 工业图像（合成/真实）、CAD模型、正常样本、语言提示等多源先验
analysis.output: 分类框架与评估原则建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开工业视觉数据集（T-LESS/BOP/MVTec AD/VisA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了有实证支撑（T-LESS/MVTec等锚点）的分类学框架，厘清了CAD在工业视觉中作为结构先验的核心作用，但未提出可复现的新算法/模型/系统，也未解决任何具体任务性能瓶颈，属于高质量综述性分析而非技术推进；显著弱于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（后者定义新范式并开源可扩展架构），也不具备UniPi/DreamZero级的跨模态具身决策整合能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的工业视觉文献按先验结构重新组织，揭示了CAD可用性对技术选择的决定性影响，但无新模型、无真机验证、无开源实现，属于高水平领域认知梳理，非技术突破。

papers.title: MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoDex扩散策略，让灵巧手在不松开已抓物体的前提下，依次抓取多个物体，通过‘对立空间’条件控制哪些手指参与当前抓取，从而保留其余自由度用于后续操作，并在仿真和真实Franka+Allegro平台上验证了其多物体连续抓取的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可配置的‘对立空间’条件机制，扩散策略能显式保留灵巧手未使用的自由度，实现无需释放的顺序多物体灵巧抓取，且sim2real迁移有效。
analysis.input: 点云+当前夹爪观测+对立空间条件（指定参与抓取的手指子集）
analysis.output: 下一时刻夹爪6D位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Allegro Hand灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真专家演示数据（MuJoCo）和少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称RL fine-tuning在real-world平台进行，但未说明是否用真实交互数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了灵巧操作中‘自由度预留’这一长期挑战，首次将条件化扩散策略与手指级动作掩码（opposition space）结合，在真实硬件上完成多物体顺序抓取（非单次抓取），性能超越多个学习型基线；但未达ALOHA/ACT级系统性范式突破（如端到端闭环、跨任务泛化架构、大规模人类行为数据驱动），也未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在Diffusion Policy框架下做出扎实的灵巧手动作约束创新，实机验证充分，但缺乏开源与更大规模泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: EAGG: Embodiment-Aligned Grasp Generation via Geometry-Aware Graph Conditioning
papers.abstract: Cross-end-effector grasp generation seeks a unified model that generalizes across objects and across embodiments ranging from parallel grippers to dexterous end effectors. Existing grasp generators are typically designed for a fixed embodiment or encode embodiment identity with a static descriptor, which weakens transfer when topology, actuation coupling, and contact geometry differ substantially. We present EAGG, an embodiment-aligned grasp generator that represents each embodiment with a topology-aware end-effector graph and an embodiment-specific low-dimensional end-effector control space. A frozen end-effector-cognition backbone converts the current articulated state into geometry-aware tokens that act as a reusable morphology prior, and iterative geometry injection refreshes these tokens throughout sampling so that conditioning remains synchronized with the evolving end-effector geometry. On the MultiGripperGrasp benchmark, EAGG reaches 56.17% average success across six training end effectors, remaining within 1.10 percentage points of specialized training while preserving transfer to finetuning and zero-shot end effectors. Iterative geometry injection further reduces the pooled median contact distance from 0.239 cm to 0.189 cm. These results show that cross-end-effector grasp generation is strengthened by aligning embodiment structure inside a shared generator rather than suppressing embodiment differences. Code is available at https://github.com/wanhaoniu/EAGG.

analysis.tldr: 提出EAGG方法，用图结构显式建模不同机器人末端执行器的拓扑与几何特性，并在生成抓取姿态时动态注入实时几何信息，实现单模型跨多种末端执行器（平行夹爪到灵巧手）的泛化抓取。
analysis.claim: 跨末端执行器的抓取生成性能提升源于在共享生成器内部对执行器形态结构进行显式、动态对齐，而非忽略或静态编码形态差异。
analysis.input: 物体点云+当前末端执行器关节状态+末端执行器图结构表示
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿（位置+旋转）及关节配置
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中多末端执行器（包括Franka、Allegro、Shadow Dexterous Hand等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（MultiGripperGrasp基准），无真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将末端执行器建模为几何感知图并引入迭代几何注入机制，在统一生成框架下实现强跨执行器泛化（6种训练末端+零样本迁移），但仅在仿真基准验证、无真机部署、无接触力/触觉/动态交互验证，未触及操作闭环或任务级泛化，显著弱于T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作（均含真机多任务闭环、触觉/视觉-动作联合学习、大规模人类演示或部署验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计扎实、泛化实证充分（仿真内跨6种末端+零样本），但限于纯仿真、无物理交互验证，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Disentangling RNA evolution and thermodynamics in genomic language models
papers.abstract: Abstract Genomic language models (gLMs) trained only on large-scale nucleic acid sequence data seem to capture signals of RNA structure, yet the specifics of how remain unclear. Using the categorical Jacobian (CJ) operation, a model-agnostic operation for querying pairwise dependencies, we systematically compared three flagship gLMs: RNA-FM, Evo 2, and gLM2. We found that CJ signals recover base pairs supported by evolutionary covariation analyses, consistent with findings in protein language models. Surprisingly, CJ also recovers base pairs lacking evolutionary support but predicted by biophysical nearest-neighbor models. Is it possible gLMs have “learned” RNA thermodynamics? We noticed nearest-neighbor RNA folding models often predict reflected structures when given reversed sequences, consistent with these models’ modular and grammar-like nature. We leveraged this observation to create a simple “mirror test” that we found gLMs routinely fail, indicating they have not learned generalizable biophysics-based rules for RNA structure. Nevertheless, their apparent thermodynamic signal potentially confounds interpreting gLM pairwise dependencies as evidence of evolutionary conservation. We therefore introduce a method using synthetic sequences as a control for detecting significant learned signal. Our results demonstrate that gLMs can mimic thermodynamics through learned sequence context rather than general physical principles, but solutions exist for disentangling patterns in language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一种叫分类雅可比（CJ）的模型无关方法分析三个RNA语言模型，发现它们看似能预测RNA碱基配对，但这种能力其实混杂了进化信号和热力学模拟效应；作者设计了一个‘镜像测试’证明模型没真正学会物理规律，而是靠序列上下文统计‘模仿’热力学，并提出用合成序列做对照来分离这两种信号。
analysis.claim: RNA语言模型中观测到的碱基配对信号并非纯粹源于进化约束，而是混杂了对RNA热力学行为的统计模仿，且该模仿不具备物理可泛化性。
analysis.input: RNA序列（单链核苷酸字符串）
analysis.output: 成对碱基依赖性得分（通过分类雅可比计算）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物序列数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算生物学/语言模型可解释性交叉方向的扎实分析工作，但未提出新模型、新结构预测能力或实验验证，也未解决RNA结构预测这一长期开放问题；其‘镜像测试’和合成对照法是启发式诊断工具，非通用解法；显著弱于ESM-2/95分档及Evo 2/92分档等基石工作（后者直接推动结构预测性能跃迁），更接近方法论探针类研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是针对RNA语言模型内部表征的诊断性分析，有价值但非突破，不改变RNA建模或结构预测的实践范式，也不涉及具身智能/机器人领域核心问题。

papers.title: Equivalent volitional learning emerges through circuit-specific population dynamics in motor cortex and hippocampus
papers.abstract: Learning operates across different brain circuits to associate population activity patterns with desired outcomes, and to enable volitional reactivation of those patterns to control behavior. These circuits differ profoundly in their architecture and dynamical regimes, yet which features of learning are shared across them and which arise from circuit-specific implementations remains unknown. Here, we use a brain-computer interface (BCI) to train mice to modulate the activity of selected neuronal ensembles toward configurations that trigger reward delivery. By making reward delivery contingent directly on population activity, we impose an identical associative learning problem on two circuits with distinct dynamical regimes: the primary motor cortex (M1) and the hippocampal area CA3. Mice acquired robust volitional control in both regions, and learning produced a set of shared signatures across circuits, including modulation of reward-controlling neurons, network-level sparsification, and greater exploration of reward-related activity patterns. These signatures were underpinned by distinct population dynamics: M1 activity flowed continuously through reward-associated states, whereas CA3 activity traced approach-and-return dynamics around them. Recurrent network models endowed with distinct minimal connectivity constraints chosen to reflect the dominant dynamical regime associated with each region captured key features of these shared signatures and region-specific dynamics, indicating that local architectural constraints are sufficient to account for the distinct implementations of learning. These findings indicate that equivalent learning outcomes arise from divergent dynamical implementations across architecturally distinct circuits. This principled degeneracy reveals that learning is not a single canonical solution, but is implemented through multiple circuit-specific mechanisms shaped by local network architecture.

analysis.tldr: 用脑机接口让小鼠分别在运动皮层和海马CA3区学习主动调控神经群体活动以获取奖励，发现两个结构迥异的脑区能产生相同的可学习行为表型（如稀疏化、探索增强），但底层神经动力学完全不同（M1是连续流形穿越，CA3是环绕式趋近-返回），说明等效学习结果可由不同电路架构独立实现。
analysis.claim: 运动皮层与海马CA3虽具截然不同的网络架构与动力学特性，却能通过各自特化的群体活动演化路径，实现功能等价的自主学习输出。
analysis.input: 双光子钙成像记录的M1或CA3神经元群体活动模式
analysis.output: 经BCI反馈强化后形成的、可稳定触发奖赏的特定群体活动构型
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量活体双光子成像+闭环BCI实时解码数据，全部为真实小鼠实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单细胞分辨率下跨两个经典学习相关脑区实证‘功能等价但机制歧异’的学习退化性（degeneracy），提供强因果证据：相同行为目标可由不同动力学范式达成；实验设计严谨（同一BCI范式施加于两区）、数据量扎实（多只小鼠+长时程记录+消融对照模型）、理论解释深入（用最小约束循环网络复现核心现象），但未拓展至灵长类/人类，也未验证临床转化潜力，故略低于90分档基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用高精度神经记录+闭环BCI+可解释建模，首次实证大脑学习存在架构决定的动力学退化性，挑战‘统一学习算法’假设。

papers.title: Cooperative Long Rope Skipping via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Humans exhibit remarkable motor agility, enabling a wide range of dynamic skills such as running and jumping, which highlights the great potential of humanoid robots for athletic locomotion. Among athletic sports, long rope skipping requires two rope turners to cooperatively swing the rope while adapting to a player under different jumping rhythms, making it a meaningful yet challenging task for humanoid robots. Although existing methods for humanoid sports have achieved success in single-agent and interaction-free settings, such as running, dancing, and parkour, task scenarios that require precise coordination among multiple participants remain largely unexplored. To this end, we propose Marope, a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for cooperative long rope skipping with multiple humanoid robots. Specifically, Marope adopts a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for policy training. At the lower level, it learns decentralized rope manipulation policies through MARL, while at the upper level, a centralized scheduling policy is trained to coordinate the execution of the lower-level policies. To improve generalization across different player behavioral styles, Marope further incorporates diverse jumping policies into cooperative game training. We evaluate our approach on Unitree G1 humanoid robots in both simulation and real-world settings. Experimental results demonstrate that Marope outperforms various baselines, achieving more efficient and stable rope manipulation as well as more robust and adaptable cooperation with varied players.

analysis.tldr: 用多智能体强化学习让多个仿人机器人协作跳大绳：两个机器人当摇绳手，一个当跳绳者，通过分层策略（底层去中心化控绳+顶层集中调度）实现协调，并在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了对不同跳跃节奏的适应能力。
analysis.claim: 分层多智能体强化学习框架Marope能实现多仿人机器人在动态节奏变化下的稳定、鲁棒长绳协同跳绳。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角/角速度/IMU）、绳端位姿估计、跳绳者运动节奏信号（仿真中为预设节奏序列，真实实验中依赖外部检测或预设）
analysis.output: 各机器人关节力矩控制指令（底层）与高层调度动作（如节奏切换、相位校准决策）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 humanoid robots + custom rope rig + motion capture or rhythm trigger system
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行sim2real迁移，但摘要未说明是否使用真实跳绳者行为数据训练；摇绳策略训练主要基于仿真，真实部署时仅做微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MARL用于多机器人协同跳绳这一具身协调难题，有明确任务新颖性与真机验证，但未开源代码/模型，未发布基准数据集，未对比SOTA具身学习方法（如ACT/π0），仅与自建基线比较；仿真到真机迁移规模小（单节奏+固定机体），未体现跨机体泛化或长期鲁棒性，离ALOHA/ACT等90+分里程碑级工作存在代际差距。

papers.title: SPAFESTWDILK, a plant-derived dodecapeptide from Zingiber officinale, as a predicted inhibitor of the MDM2-p53 interaction: computational discovery and multi-method evaluation
papers.abstract: The MDM2-p53 protein-protein interaction is a validated oncology target, yet no food-derived linear peptide has been documented to engage the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. We developed a multi-stage computational pipeline (PepVeg) to screen 22 plant and fungal proteomes (337,646 proteins) for MDM2-binding peptides, applying sequential in silico hydrolysis, physicochemical filtering, ESM-2 embedding-based dimensionality reduction, and pharmacophore-driven selection. Twenty-six candidates were evaluated by AlphaFold 3 (AF3) co-folding against MDM2(25-109), yielding 15 binders (iPTM >= 0.75; 58% of evaluated). A 36-peptide benchmark with 29 hard negatives confirmed AF3 discriminative power (Cohen's d = 3.41; 95% CI: 1.94-4.88; Hedges' g = 3.32; zero overlap). The lead candidate, SPAFESTWDILK -- a tryptic fragment of Zingiber officinale histone deacetylase (UniProt A0A8J5FLH2) -- was evaluated by eight computational assessments: AF3 Server (iPTM 0.83, SD 0.01), Protenix (iPTM 0.923), Chai-1 (iPTM 0.891), EvoEF2 (-55.57 EEU), two GROMACS simulations (no dissociation across two force fields), and two MM-PBSA calculations (-75.30 (SD 4.92) and -55.07 (SD 2.86) kcal/mol). The W8A point mutant produced an iPTM drop of 0.201, closely paralleling the p53 W23A drop of 0.193; we predict W8A substitution will abolish binding. SPAFESTWDILK ranked only #890/2,000 by ESM-2 similarity and was recovered solely through pharmacophore matching, demonstrating that no single pipeline stage alone is sufficient. To our knowledge, this is the first food-database-derived linear peptide with multi-convergent computational evidence supporting engagement of the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. Experimental validation by SPR/ITC is warranted.

analysis.tldr: 用多步计算流程从生姜蛋白中挖出一个12肽SPAFESTWDILK，通过AlphaFold3、多个打分模型和分子动力学模拟反复验证它能稳定结合MDM2蛋白的经典三锚点口袋，是首个被多方法交叉证实可能靶向该癌症靶点的植物源线性肽。
analysis.claim: SPAFESTWDILK是从生姜中发现的首个经多方法计算验证、能特异性靶向MDM2经典三锚点口袋的植物源线性肽。
analysis.input: 植物/真菌蛋白质组序列 + MDM2(25-109)结构
analysis.output: 预测结合MDM2的线性肽序列及其结合置信度与自由能估计
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次提出植物源肽靶向MDM2三锚点界面，且采用AF3+多模型+MD+MM-PBSA交叉验证，但未提供代码/数据开源（仅project-page），无实验验证，所有证据限于计算层面；相比AlphaFold3/ESM-2等基石工作（93–95分），它属于高质量计算发现而非方法论突破，更接近扎实的靶点导向肽发现，尚未跨越到新范式或通用工具层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：多方法交叉计算验证充分，但缺乏开源与实验支撑，属靶向肽发现领域的可靠进展，非范式突破

papers.title: Viability of engineered AAVs via protein language models
papers.abstract: Capsid engineering has greatly improved the performance of recombinant AAV vectors used for gene therapy. One commonly used strategy is the insertion of a short, 7-mer, peptide into surface-exposed loops to modify receptor interactions and enhance cell entry. While effective in receptor retargeting and improved transduction, these insertions might destabilize the capsid protein, hinder assembly, and thus limit production. While previous attempts have used deep mutational scanning and AI to predict which insertions are viable, there is lack in understanding the structural consequences of these peptide insertions at the amino-acid level. Here we combined experiments, deep sequencing and large protein language models to gain insight on the impact of 7-mer insertions on the VR-VIII region. We first characterize the biochemical properties of viable insertions, thus identifying which residues are well tolerated, and which should instead be avoided. We then focus on the nearby context of those insertions, by studying the effect of the linkers, either for highly diverse libraries or for individual variants known for their efficiency. Next, we study the broader context, by extending our analysis to the whole capsid sequence, and identifying regions that can tolerate insertions without long-ranged structural deformations that could affect capsid functionality. We conclude with a cross-serotype comparison and a viability analysis of tens of previously engineered variants. Our work showcases how AI can uncover structure-function rules governing the success of engineered AAV capsids.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型分析AAV衣壳中7肽插入对结构稳定性的影响，结合实验和深度测序，系统刻画了插入位点、连接肽和全局序列背景对衣壳组装可行性的约束规则。
analysis.org: 索邦大学/法国国家健康与医学研究院（INSERM）
analysis.claim: 7-mer肽插入的可行性不仅取决于插入序列本身，更由其局部连接肽构型及全衣壳序列背景共同决定，蛋白语言模型可量化预测这些结构容忍度规则。
analysis.input: AAV衣壳蛋白序列（含VR-VIII区域）、7-mer插入序列、连接肽类型、全序列上下文
analysis.output: 插入可行性概率（viability score）及结构容忍度解释（如局部折叠扰动、长程变形风险）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高通量实验筛选数据（deep sequencing验证的数千个插入变体）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM用于系统解构AAV衣壳插入工程的结构容忍度层级（位点→连接肽→全序列→跨血清型），实证扎实（数千变体测序+多血清型验证），但未开源模型权重或训练代码，且未达到AlphaFold/ESM级通用性或RFdiffusion级生成能力，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了AAV工程的理性设计边界，但仍是特定问题上的高质量整合，非基础模型级突破。

papers.title: From Imitation to Alignment: Human-Preference Flow Policies for Long-Horizon Sidewalk Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous long-horizon sidewalk navigation is essential for micro-mobility applications such as robotic food delivery and assistive electronic wheelchairs. Unlike autonomous driving on the road, long-horizon sidewalk navigation requires precise maneuvering through unpredictable sidewalk terrains and pedestrians, with a lightweight perception stack as minimal as a single monocular RGB camera. While imitation learning (IL) from demonstrations offers a practical solution, the resulting autopilot policy often suffers from compounding errors, a lack of social compliance on sidewalks, and deficiencies in counterfactual reasoning to handle complex situations. To address these challenges, we introduce FlowPilot, a mapless navigation policy that achieves robust and efficient long-horizon navigation performance using only a monocular RGB camera. We first propose to use anchored flow matching as an action representation for policy pre-training on large-scale robot fleet data and to capture the diverse, complex, multimodal distribution of sidewalk navigation behaviors. To bridge the gap between imitation and alignment, we further design a human-in-the-loop preference learning scheme to tune the policy on a small amount of human intervention data. It strengthens the model's counterfactual reasoning and social compliance on sidewalks. We evaluate FlowPilot through extensive simulation and real-world experiments in diverse sidewalk environments. FlowPilot achieves 42% success rate and 66% route completion in simulation, while FlowPilot-HP further improves real-world robustness and social compliance, reducing IR by 40.0% and NIR by 52.1% relative to the base model.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlowPilot，一个仅用单目RGB相机、无需地图的长时程人行道导航策略，先用大规模车队数据做光流动作表征预训练，再用少量人工偏好干预微调，提升社会合规性和反事实推理能力，在仿真和真实场景中验证了导航成功率和行人避让效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目RGB相机、无需高精地图和激光雷达，通过光流动作表征预训练+人类偏好微调，可实现鲁棒、社会合规的长时程人行道自主导航。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如转向角、速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四轮差速机器人平台（摘要未明说但实验含real-world，结合作者单位推断为CUHK自研小型配送/轮椅平台）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了单目长时程人行道导航中社会合规性与反事实推理的工程瓶颈，但未触及具身智能底层建模范式，也未达到开新方向或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: VENOM: Versatile Embodied Network for Omni-bodied Motion tracking
papers.abstract: Achieving expert-level expressive full-body motion tracking across multiple humanoids solely from demonstration data remains a challenging and relatively an underexplored problem in humanoid robot learning. Cross-embodiment motion tracking policies are mostly trained by decoupling the control problem into upper and lower body control. This work proposes VENOM, a cross-embodiment full-body motion tracking model for humanoids in simulation. VENOM is a GPT-based motion tracker trained on multiple humanoid data that can track the entire body without the requirement to split into upper and lower body control. We curate a multi-humanoid motion tracking dataset called the VENOM dataset that contains states, actions, and rewards and train VENOM and the baselines on this dataset. In this letter, we evaluate VENOM's performance against baselines and show that we can achieve a stable motion tracker across different humanoids more capable than an MLP trained on multiple humanoid data with supervised learning alone, and also show that despite lack of reward feedback, VENOM closely matches the tracking capability of experts that were trained using asymmetric-actor critic reinforcement learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于GPT架构的跨人形机器人全身运动跟踪模型VENOM，仅用多个人形机器人的示范数据（无奖励信号）在仿真中实现端到端全身体态跟踪，不拆分上下身控制，性能接近用强化学习训练的专家策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖多个人形机器人示范轨迹数据、无需奖励反馈或上下身解耦设计，GPT式序列建模可实现稳定跨机体全身体态跟踪。
analysis.input: 多个人形机器人在仿真中的状态序列（关节角度、角速度等）和动作序列
analysis.output: 下一时刻的全身关节动作（动作块）

papers.title: FlashNav: Ultra-Fast Policy Training for Robot Navigation within 20 Seconds
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for robot navigation, but its practical deployment is still limited by the long wall-clock cost of policy training. This paper presents FlashNav, a GPU-first framework for ultra-fast range-based robot navigation training. To the best of our knowledge, FlashNav is the first DRL-based robot navigation framework that reaches seconds-level policy training, with the fastest deployable policy trained in less than 20 seconds. The key idea is to align simulation with the navigation MDP: FlashNav preserves the essential components for velocity-level navigation, including occupancy geometry, range sensing, goal-conditioned control, robot motion dynamics, collision handling, termination, and reset, while removing unnecessary rendering and high-fidelity physical details from the training loop. Built on a batched bitmap simulator and a fully GPU-resident training pipeline with our FastDSAC learner, FlashNav generates massive parallel navigation transitions entirely on GPU. Experiments on TurtleBot2 and Unitree Go2 show that FlashNav achieves a 100\% success-rate below 20 seconds on an RTX 5090 and remains within tens of seconds across desktop GPUs. The learned policies further transfer to physical wheeled and legged robots in static and dynamic indoor scenes, demonstrating that DRL-based navigation can be trained at seconds-level speed while preserving deployable obstacle-avoidance behavior.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlashNav框架，用纯GPU加速的极简仿真+定制化DRL训练器，在20秒内训出能部署到真实轮式和四足机器人上的导航策略，核心是砍掉所有非必要渲染和物理细节，只保留导航MDP必需的组件。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过严格对齐导航马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的本质要素并彻底GPU化训练流水线，DRL导航策略可在20秒内完成训练且仍具备跨机体、跨场景的物理部署能力。
