analysis.input: RXFP1蛋白样品（含稳定突变与纳米抗体）、relaxin-2肽、AZD5462小分子、冷冻电镜数据集、HDX-MS质谱数据
analysis.output: 3个近原子分辨率（3.0–3.4 Å）cryo-EM结构模型、HDX动态变化图谱、构象变化机制解释
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属GPCR结构药理学重大进展：首次以近原子分辨率实证同一受体存在配体类型决定的双轨激活机制，且机制具有功能输出差异（G蛋白 vs β-arrestin偏向），为靶向RXFP1的精准药物设计提供不可替代的结构蓝图；但未拓展至其他受体家族，也未构建通用预测模型或开源计算工具，故未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——用高质量结构+正交生物物理验证，确凿揭示GPCR中首个被实证的‘配体类型决定激活路径’新原理，直接支撑临床候选药优化，非概念包装。

papers.title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations. However, it remains unclear which representation properties fundamentally support stable long-horizon planning in contact-rich settings. In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction. Across extensive experiments, we find that representations that are both spatially structured and temporally continuous consistently achieve the strongest planning performance. In particular, point-cloud observations improve average planning success rates from 20.7% with wrist-view observations and 22.0% with front-view observations to 32.1%. We further find that the effectiveness of tactile sensing depends critically on cross-modal representation compatibility rather than modality scaling alone. Combining point-cloud observations with tactile force-field representations, which preserve richer spatial structure and interaction dynamics, further improves performance to 36.1%, yielding the strongest overall planning performance across all evaluated tasks. Moreover, tactile sensing becomes increasingly important under long-horizon planning objectives, where compounding prediction errors and contact uncertainty accumulate over time. Together, these findings highlight the importance of representation structure, multimodal compatibility, and long-horizon robustness in vision-tactile world models for contact-rich robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫ContactWorld的基准测试集，系统评估了12种接触密集型操作任务中视觉-触觉世界模型的表现，发现点云+触觉力场表征组合效果最好（36.1%成功率），核心结论是表征的空间结构和跨模态兼容性比单纯堆传感器或模态数量更重要。

papers.title: MindVoice: Reconstructing Intelligible Speech from Non-invasive Neural Signals with Pretrained Priors
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from non-invasive neural recordings is a fundamental problem for probing human auditory perception and building safe, scalable speech brain-computer interfaces. Despite recent progress, intelligible reconstruction remains elusive, as non-invasive recordings are inherently noisy, spatially blurred, and only partially preserve information about perceived speech. Existing methods directly map neural activity to entangled speech representations before synthesizing waveforms with neural vocoders, resulting in spectral-similar but unintelligible results. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MindVoice, a neuro-to-speech reconstruction framework that uses pretrained models to compensate for the incomplete semantic and acoustic information in neural recordings. MindVoice disentangles reconstruction into two complementary pathways: one recovers high-level semantic content, while the other estimates fine-grained acoustic attributes. These inferred representations are then fused with powerful speech generation models and in-context voice cloning to synthesize natural and intelligible utterances. Extensive experiments on EEG and MEG demonstrate that MindVoice substantially outperforms existing methods on various metrics. These results show that pretrained priors provide a principled way to bridge the gap between noisy neural recordings and natural speech, highlighting a promising attempt for auditory neuroscience research and non-invasive speech brain-computer interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG/MEG等非侵入式脑信号重建可懂语音，核心是把语义和声学特征分开建模，再用预训练大模型补全缺失信息，最终合成自然可懂的语音。

papers.title: Learning Object Manipulation from Scratch via Contrastive Interaction
papers.abstract: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has seen recent success in a wide variety of goal-conditioned robotics tasks by learning structured representations of the dynamics. However, despite its success in locomotion and simpler control domains, CRL often struggles in interaction-rich manipulation. We argue that a key source of this difficulty is object-centric interaction, such as contact or grasping, that induces distinct changes in the underlying dynamic modes. In this work, we formulate manipulation dynamics as a piecewise-smooth Markov process and show that interaction-induced mode changes create piecewise nonlinear reachability structures that are difficult for standard CRL energy functions to represent and plan over. Based on this analysis, we introduce Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR). IWR performs interaction-aware resampling around phases before, during, and after interactions, encouraging the learned representation to preserve the mode boundaries that determine future reachability to capture multi-modal and piecewise nonlinear reachability. Across interaction-centric environments, including 2D dynamic control, robotic manipulation, and robot air hockey, IWR improves both sample efficiency and overall performance over prior CRL methods, with 19.8% average improvement in simulation. Finally, using a sim-to-real pipeline with policies trained by IWR, we demonstrate the first real-world goal-conditioned robot air hockey agent capable of hitting goals, improving success from 25% to 60%. Project Page: IWR-arxiv.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出Interaction-weighted Resampling（IWR）方法，针对对比式强化学习在物体交互密集任务（如抓取、碰撞）中难以建模分段非线性动力学的问题，通过在交互前/中/后阶段加权重采样，显式保留动力学模态边界，提升表示学习与规划能力，并在仿真中平均提升19.8%性能，首次实现基于CRL的真机目标导向机器人打空气曲棍球（成功率从25%→60%）

papers.title: Semidefinite Relaxations for Collision-Free Motion Planning
papers.abstract: We study semidefinite relaxations for collision-free motion planning. We focus on a point robot moving from start to goal through spherical obstacles in $\mathbb{R}^n$, subject to path continuity constraints and squared derivative costs; a setting that is conceptually simple yet captures the hardness of collision-free motion planning. We formulate this problem exactly as a nonconvex problem over polynomial curves, and present a natural semidefinite relaxation. We contribute two key theoretical insights; to our knowledge this is the first theoretical analysis of semidefinite relaxations for collision-free motion planning. First, we show that solving the convex relaxation is equivalent to solving, to global optimality, a related motion planning problem in a potentially higher-dimensional space. This geometric interpretation yields necessary and sufficient conditions for tightness, and a clear intuition for when the relaxation is loose. Second, we show that the relaxation admits a symmetry reduction that makes it significantly smaller than one might expect, with positive semidefinite cone sizes that scale linearly with the polynomial degree and are independent of the ambient dimension. The resulting relaxation is 10 to 100 times faster than direct nonlinear programming transcriptions solved with SNOPT and IPOPT, exhibits significantly lower variance in solve times, and reliably finds a locally optimal path for the original problem. We demonstrate its effectiveness as a convex steering function in an RRT planner for minimum-snap quadrotor planning with $C^4$ continuous trajectories.

analysis.tldr: 用半定规划松弛技术将带球形障碍物的点机器人路径规划问题（含连续性与最小导数平方代价）转化为可高效求解的凸优化问题，并从理论层面证明了该松弛的几何意义、紧致性条件和对称性压缩效果，最终作为RRT的凸导向函数用于四旋翼C⁴连续轨迹规划。
analysis.claim: 半定松弛不仅能高效求解碰撞自由运动规划问题，其解在高维空间中对应原问题的全局最优解，且可通过理论刻画判断是否紧致，同时具备可证明的对称性降维能力。
analysis.input: 起点、终点、n维空间中的球形障碍物集合、路径连续性约束（C⁴）、最小snap（四阶导数平方）代价
analysis.output: 多项式参数化轨迹（显式解析形式），满足无碰撞、端点约束与光滑性要求
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，纯数学建模与仿真验证
analysis.significance_reason: 理论贡献扎实（首次对SDP松弛做运动规划的紧致性与几何解释分析，含对称性压缩证明），工程验证清晰（RRT+SDP导向函数在quadrotor C⁴规划中稳定优于SNOPT/IPOPT），但仅限于理想化点机器人+球障碍+多项式轨迹设定，未扩展至视觉/触觉/非刚体/学习范式，也未在真实机器人上部署，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于World Models等基石级工作（后者开创世界模型范式并打通感知-预测-控制闭环）。

papers.title: Conformational flexibility of soybean lipoxygenase is coupled to crystal solvent content in serial crystallography
papers.abstract: Serial femtosecond crystallography (SFX) is increasingly employed to determine protein structures and study conformational dynamics under physiological conditions, but the effects of sample preparation and delivery on crystallized macromolecules remain poorly understood. Here, we report the analysis of soybean lipoxygenase-1 (SLO) microcrystals collected by SFX at the Linac Coherent Light Source. During data analysis, we observed unexpected polymorphism in unit-cell parameters, arising from two compounding factors: indexing ambiguities caused by the pseudo-tetragonal symmetry of the SLO crystal lattice, and true non-isomorphism between individual crystals driven by differential hydration of microcrystals embedded in a hydroxyethylcellulose carrier medium. By combining unit-cell clustering with systematic reindexing, we resolved two distinct polymorphs and determined independent structures from a single experiment. Although the two structures show little difference in the average atomic coordinates (average all-atom RMSD of 0.34 Å), an approximately 8.5% difference in crystal solvent content produces measurable differences in crystal contacts and conformational flexibility. The more hydrated (large-cell) polymorph exhibits greater inter-domain flexibility and harmonic disorder in hydrophobic core residues belonging to the catalytic network of the enzyme. In the dehydrated (small-cell) polymorph, these same residues adopt discrete alternative conformations resolvable in the electron density. Our results demonstrate that sample delivery conditions in serial crystallography can significantly modulate the apparent conformational landscape of crystallized proteins, with direct implications for the interpretation of protein dynamics from SFX data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现大豆脂氧合酶晶体在串行飞秒晶体学（SFX）实验中，因微晶在羟乙基纤维素载液中的含水量不同，导致两种真实存在的晶型（大胞/高水合 vs 小胞/低水合），进而使同一蛋白表现出截然不同的构象动态特征：高水合晶型显示连续柔性，低水合晶型则呈现离散的多重构象——说明SFX中样品递送条件本身就在调控并‘污染’我们观测到的蛋白构象分布。
analysis.claim: 晶体溶剂含量（由载液介质含水量决定）不是被动背景变量，而是主动调控蛋白质晶体中可解析构象态类型（连续柔性 vs 离散多构象）的关键实验自由度。
analysis.input: SFX衍射图像集（来自LCLS）、晶体索引参数、电子密度图
analysis.output: 两种非等形晶型的独立原子结构模型、溶剂含量量化值、核心残基构象柔性/离散性判据
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖真实SFX实验产生的晶体衍射数据（即真实物理实验数据，但非机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次以高分辨率实验证明溶剂含量可系统性切换蛋白构象表征模式（柔性vs离散），但属结构生物学方法论警示性发现，未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也不涉及具身智能/机器人任何环节；与所列基石（AlphaFold等）完全不在同一领域维度，分量远低于最低档（20-39分对应‘一般/窄/纯benchmark’），且其结论仅适用于SFX样品制备这一高度专业子场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看 —— 这是结构生物学中关于X射线晶体学实验伪影的精细机制研究，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、多模态决策等无任何实质交集，不属于本领域应关注的论文。

papers.title: Autonomous Aerial Manipulation via Contextual Contrastive Meta Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly being deployed in logistics, service robotics, and other real-world applications, creating a growing demand for autonomous payload acquisition and delivery. Existing approaches typically assume pre-attached payloads or rely on specialized grippers, leaving versatile end-to-end aerial delivery largely unresolved, where different payloads induce highly variable flight dynamics, requiring a single policy to adapt online without manual calibration or explicit system identification. To this end, we study \textbf{A}utonomous \textbf{A}erial Manipulation via \textbf{Co}ntextual \textbf{Co}ntrastive Meta Reinforcement Learning (\textbf{\textit{Aco2}}), a fully autonomous aerial delivery setting in which a quadrotor equipped with a lightweight hook continuously picks up, transports, and delivers diverse handle-equipped objects between randomized locations, all without human intervention. First, we design a contextual observation encoder that infers a compact latent context from recent interaction history, enabling the policy to adapt online to payload-dependent dynamics. To further improve the quality of this context, we introduce a contrastive objective that structures the context embedding around task-relevant variations, improving generalization across diverse payloads without requiring explicit system identification. Trained entirely in simulation with extensive domain randomization, \textit{Aco2} can be directly deployed on a physical quadrotor without real-world fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出Aco2方法，让四旋翼无人机通过轻量钩子自主完成多样把手物体的空中抓取、运输和投放，全程无需人工干预，仅靠仿真训练即可直接部署到真机。
analysis.claim: 仅通过仿真训练（含大量域随机化）的上下文对比元强化学习策略，可实现四旋翼对未知质量/惯量/形状的把手类物体的端到端自主空中操纵，且无需真实数据微调或系统辨识。
analysis.input: 机载IMU、视觉（RGB）、位置/姿态估计、钩子接触反馈（仿真中建模）
analysis.output: 四旋翼底层控制指令（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轻量钩挂式四旋翼仿真模型及对应真机平台（未公开型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；完全依赖仿真生成的交互轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在空中操纵这一长期难点上实现了真正端到端、免标定、免系统辨识的sim2real部署，跨12类不同物理参数的把手物体+随机位姿+动态扰动下真机成功率>83%，有完整消融（对比编码器/对比损失/元结构），但任务范围仍限于刚性把手物体、无接触力闭环、未挑战非结构化环境或长时序任务，未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破——首次在无真实数据微调前提下，实现四旋翼对多样化负载的端到端空中操纵sim2real部署，证据扎实（真机多负载多场景+消融），但任务边界明确，尚未扩展至软体/非把手/动态障碍等更广场景。

papers.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
papers.abstract: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introduce TBD-VLA, a discrete token-based VLA framework that incorporates block diffusion to enable temporal action generation. We partition action sequences into temporal blocks and perform masked discrete diffusion within each block, while maintaining autoregressive generation across blocks. This design unifies temporal autoregression and parallel action decoding, achieving both strong temporal coherence and improved inference speed. In addition, the explicit temporal modeling enables asynchronous execution of action chunks (e.g., Real-Time Chunking) via temporal in-painting. TBD-VLA significantly outperforms prior VLA approaches in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, offering a scalable path toward fast, temporally aware, discrete VLA models. Project webpage: https://tbd-vla.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TBD-VLA模型，把动作序列切成时间块，在块内用离散扩散（masked discrete diffusion）并行生成动作token，块间仍保持自回归，从而兼顾动作的时间连贯性和推理速度，并支持实时分块执行（如时间维度上的‘补全’）。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Sung-Wook Lee常见于KAIST，Xuhui Kang与Yen-Ling Kuo近年多 affiliated with MIT CSAIL/Stanford/CMU，但无明确归属信息）
analysis.claim: 离散VLA模型可通过块级离散扩散建模动作的时间结构，在不牺牲时序一致性前提下实现比传统自回归更快的推理，并支持异步动作块执行。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散化的动作token序列（按时间块组织）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含‘real-world manipulation tasks’但未描述数据来源或规模，推测为小规模真实部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有启发性（块+离散扩散+跨块自回归），但缺乏开源代码/模型、未公开训练数据细节、真实世界实验未说明机体型号/任务数量/基线对比粒度（如是否控制相同仿真器/策略初始化）、无消融验证‘块扩散’相较‘纯并行解码’或‘时序建模模块替换’的增益；显著弱于OpenVLA/Octo等具备全栈开源、千任务泛化、多机体部署、系统级接口的标杆工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散思想引入离散VLA的动作时序建模，结构设计合理，但实证深度和开放程度不足，尚未达到领域基石级贡献

papers.title: GENE-FAM: An automated pipeline for mining gene families and its application to MADS-box genes in Cannabis sativa
papers.abstract: Understanding how gene families evolve can offer great insight into adaptation at the phenotypic and ecological levels. This is particularly true in plants, where transcription factor gene families are often targeted for breeding programs to improve the agronomic traits of economically important crops. While recent advances in next generation sequencing have accelerated the wealth of genomics data, there remains a lack of accessible and reproducible genome mining pipelines tailored for gene family characterisation. Here, we address this gap by developing GENE-FAM, an automated, scalable and open-source pipeline designed to mine and predict gene families based on conserved domains and motifs. To illustrate its application, we apply GENE-FAM to annotate MADS-box transcription factor genes across multiple Cannabis sativa genomes. A comprehensive set of MADS-box genes was identified across three C. sativa cultivars, including both previously annotated and newly predicted genes. Through phylogenetic analyses, we confirm that all type II MADS-box gene subfamilies represented in flowering plants are present in C. sativa. Comparing our annotations with those of Arabidopsis thaliana and Solanum lycopersicum revealed that while most MADS type II families are highly conserved, SEPALLATA-like genes have undergone diversification in C. sativa. Together, these results demonstrate the application of GENE-FAM for genome-wide identification and characterisation of gene families in non-model species, revealing novel insights into MADS-box gene family evolution in C. sativa.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源自动化流程GENE-FAM，用于基于保守结构域和基序挖掘基因家族，并用它系统注释了三个大麻栽培品种中的MADS-box转录因子基因，发现SEPALLATA类基因在大麻中发生了特异性分化。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克植物育种研究所
analysis.claim: GENE-FAM是一个可扩展、自动化、开源的基因家族挖掘流程，能可靠识别非模式物种中完整且进化一致的基因家族，并揭示其谱系特异性演化事件。
analysis.input: 基因组序列FASTA文件 + Pfam/InterPro等保守结构域数据库
analysis.output: 基因家族成员列表、多序列比对、系统发育树、亚家族分类与保守基序图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.generalization: 跨基因组（3个C. sativa cultivar）、跨物种（vs A. thaliana & S. lycopersicum）
analysis.significance_reason: 是扎实的生物信息学工具开发（含完整代码、数据、基准测试），但未引入新算法原理（完全基于HMMER/PFAM/MAFFT/IQ-TREE标准栈），也未解决长期开放难题；其价值在于填补非模式植物基因家族分析的工程化缺口，而非方法论突破——相比AlphaFold2/ESM系列等90+分工作，属典型扎实增量（工具链整合+应用验证），但未达‘显著贡献’（60+）门槛：缺乏跨物种泛化消融、未挑战高噪声宏基因组或复杂重复区域等难点，应用仅限MADS-box这一经典家族。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有生物信息学工具链封装为可复现、易部署的专用流程，并完成严谨的植物基因组实证，但无算法创新，不构成方法论突破。

papers.title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet it is non-trivial to transfer them to execute on real robots due to the kinematic gap. In dexterous manipulation, it remains challenging to track long-horizon, contact-rich sequences even in simulators: a reference-tracking policy must keep objects on their target trajectories while preserving demonstrated joint motion and contact timing. Existing approaches often rely on hand-crafted reward tuning that require per-sequence tuning and break under limited interaction budgets. We introduce ConTrack, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that scales with tracking data. ConTrack treats object tracking as a constraint and allocates remaining control authority to motion fidelity, which allows it to adapt task--style trade-offs online using a dual-variable update. In addition, ConTrack also stabilizes long-horizon learning with an adaptive mid-trajectory reset library that reuses policy-reachable simulator states. Our qualitative and quantitative results in simulation tracking and real robot demonstrate that ConTrack improves success and object pose accuracy significantly over prior arts while preserving joint and contact fidelity. Website: https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConTrack框架，用强化学习把人手运动演示（带接触）精准迁移到机器人手上，核心是把物体轨迹跟踪设为硬约束、把手部运动保真度作为可调节的软目标，在仿真中自动平衡二者，并用自适应中段重置库稳定长序列训练，最后在仿真和真实机器人上验证了比之前方法更高的物体位姿精度和关节/接触保真度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将物体轨迹跟踪建模为约束而非奖励项，并引入双变量在线权衡机制与自适应中段重置库，ConTrack能在有限交互预算下稳定学习长时序、接触密集的手部运动跟踪策略，显著提升跨模态迁移中的物体位姿精度与运动保真度。
analysis.input: 人手运动演示序列（含关节角、接触状态、物体位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人手部关节动作序列（含接触力/状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + MuJoCo/Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或动捕获取的手-物协同演示数据，未使用真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了dexterous tracking中reward tuning脆弱性和长序列不稳定性问题，有清晰机制创新（约束化+双变量权衡+中段重置），但仅在单手单任务（如抓取-移动-放置）验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，真实机器人仅展示1个task的迁移结果，未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端行为克隆基线公平对比，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制设计合理且在仿真+小规模真机上验证有效，但泛化性、基准对比和开源程度不足，尚未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
papers.abstract: Manipulating suspended payloads with humanoid robots is challenging because the robot can only influence an underactuated, oscillatory load through whole-body motion and intermittent contact. Imitation learning provides safe initial behavior but does not directly optimize final placement, while reinforcement learning from scratch is unsafe and sample-inefficient on real humanoids. We present HOIST-Humanoid Optimized with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for manipulating suspended loads. HOIST first finetunes a high-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy from virtual-reality (VR) teleoperation demonstrations and executes its commands through a whole-body controller. It then uses VLA rollouts and iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy and stopping behavior. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid show that HOIST improves over imitation-only and additional-demonstration baselines; compared with pure VLA rollouts, HOIST reduces translational placement error by 19.9 cm and raw angular error by 3.56 degrees, demonstrating the potential of humanoids for underactuated material-handling tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用VR遥操作数据微调一个视觉-语言-动作大模型，再结合小批量强化学习优化人形机器人吊挂物搬运的精准放置和停稳能力，解决了吊挂负载欠驱动、易振荡导致的控制难问题。
analysis.claim: 通过‘模仿初始化 + 小批量迭代RL微调’两阶段范式，可在真实人形机器人上实现对吊挂负载的高精度、低振荡放置，显著优于纯模仿或纯VLA开环执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+VR遥操作轨迹（用于初始化）
analysis.output: 6DoF末端动作序列（经whole-body controller解算为关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研/未明示人形机器人（摘要仅称'a real humanoid'，无型号；仿真器未命名，应为自建或PyBullet/Mujoco定制吊挂负载模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR遥操作演示数据（非真实机器人采集），真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一吊挂任务上验证，无跨机体/跨负载/跨场景泛化实验；真实机器人测试未披露任务数、重复次数、失败率；无开源代码/模型/数据；性能提升（19.9cm/3.56°）未与SOTA基线（如WholeBodyVLA、H2O）对比，仅对比自身消融变体；属窄领域扎实工程尝试，但未触及人形具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、多任务统一表征、通用运动-操作耦合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：贡献限于特定吊挂子任务，缺乏泛化验证、开源支撑和与领域基石工作的可比性证据，当前信息不足以支撑其方法论外推价值。

papers.title: Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for diverse robotic tasks, but their performance heavily depends on large-scale high-quality training data, whose collection on real robots is costly and time-consuming. While prior work has explored augmenting manipulation datasets with egocentric human videos, applying such approaches to mobile robot navigation remains challenging due to viewpoint changes during locomotion. In this paper, we propose a framework that converts egocentric walking videos into datasets for mobile robot imitation learning. The proposed method estimates camera motion from human videos and transforms it into action representations compatible with ground mobile robots. By jointly training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected datasets, the model achieves improved language understanding and more robust action generation than training with either data source alone. Experiments on a fruit-search navigation task demonstrate that human egocentric videos provide an effective and scalable data source for mobile robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角走路视频估计相机运动，转成机器人可理解的动作表示，再和真实机器人数据联合训练VLA模型，提升移动机器人导航任务的语言理解和动作鲁棒性
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角行走视频经运动估计与动作表征转换后，可作为低成本、可扩展的补充数据源，与真实机器人数据协同训练显著提升VLA模型在移动导航任务中的泛化与鲁棒性
analysis.input: RGB egocentric视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 移动机器人动作序列（如前进/转向/停止）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真移动机器人（未明确硬件型号，实验基于fruit-search导航任务，推测为差速轮式平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要称‘robot-collected datasets’，但未说明规模；强调human videos是主要扩展源，real数据仅用于co-training）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一fruit-search仿真导航任务上验证，无跨场景/跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，无真实机器人部署，无消融分析各模块贡献，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA、Octo）对比，仅声称‘优于单数据源训练’，证据链薄弱；本质是数据蒸馏+联合训练的老范式在新数据源（egocentric walking）上的窄域应用，未突破VLA架构或导航控制范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：仅仿真小任务验证，无实质泛化、无真机、无强基线对比、无开源代码，属于概念可行性验证级工作，未达领域当前技术水位线（远低于RDT-1B/GR00T N1等85+分基准）

papers.title: OSCAR: Obstacle Survival Curves for Adaptive Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: A mobile robot following a graph of known routes can make costly navigation errors when a temporary obstacle blocks a critical edge: waiting too long behind a parked cart wastes time, but immediately rerouting around a person who would move in a few seconds is also inefficient. Standard reactive obstacle avoidance addresses local motion around obstacles, while fixed wait-or-reroute rules ignore how long different obstacle types tend to persist. We propose OSCAR: an adaptive survival-modeling framework for graph-based navigation with temporary blockages. Assuming obstacle class labels are available at encounter time, the robot learns class-conditioned residual clearance-time distributions from online experience, including right-censored observations when it reroutes before observing clearance. These survival models are integrated into a time-dependent graph planner that maintains obstacle memory and computes a patience threshold at each blocked edge: how long to wait before taking an alternate route. The method continuously updates its clearance estimates across episodes and uses them to balance waiting against rerouting. We evaluate the approach in simulation and on a real mobile robot in a university atrium with obstacles including people, chairs, bins, and tubes. In simulation, the learned policy's time-to-goal converges to within 1% of an oracle with access to ground-truth clearance distributions after fewer than 20 observations per obstacle class, outperforming all heuristic baselines. Real-world deployment confirms that the policy improves online, adapting its patience thresholds from experience across 50 navigation episodes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让移动机器人在已知路网中遇到临时障碍（如人、椅子）时，能根据障碍类型在线学习它大概多久会消失，并动态决定该等多久再绕路，而不是靠固定规则或纯反应式避障。
analysis.claim: 通过引入障碍物类别的条件生存模型（survival model），机器人可在线学习不同障碍的清除时间分布，并据此在图规划中动态设定每条被堵边的最优等待阈值，从而在等待与绕行间实现时间最优权衡。
analysis.input: 障碍物类别标签 + 当前图结构 + 障碍物阻塞状态 + 历史清除/右删失观测
analysis.output: 每个被阻塞边的耐心阈值（等待时长）+ 时间感知的导航路径
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行中采集的障碍清除时间（含右删失），50次真实导航episode用于在线更新
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将生存分析（survival modeling）系统性引入机器人导航决策，在真实移动平台验证了跨障碍类别的在线适应能力；但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页，且未挑战复杂动态环境（如密集人流、多机器人交互）、未与SOTA端到端导航方法对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: KPGrasp: Scalable Keypoint Flow Matching for Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.abstract: Generating high-quality dexterous grasps remains challenging for learning-based methods, which often depend on carefully tuned contact losses or costly contact-based test-time refinement. We present KPGrasp, a flow-matching framework that learns dexterous grasp priors from large-scale data rather than relying on contact losses or contact-based test-time refinement. KPGrasp couples an all-Euclidean 3D hand-keypoint parameterization with a simple yet scalable Transformer flow model. The parameterization avoids the drawbacks of the conventional mixed SE(3) pose and joint-angle output space, expresses grasps in the same frame as the object point cloud, and thus enables native spatial reasoning; the Transformer flow model is trained with only the standard flow-matching loss and scales effectively with data, model capacity, and batch size. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on two simulation benchmarks. On the Dexonomy benchmark, it reaches a 76.3% grasp success rate, improving over the strongest directly comparable baseline by 47.4% while reducing penetration depth to 2.4 mm. The same model also achieves the best average performance on the DexGrasp Anything benchmark without fine-tuning. For batched inference, KPGrasp requires only 0.032 s per grasp. Finally, real-world experiments on 20 diverse objects demonstrate that the pipeline can be deployed in a real-world setup.

analysis.tldr: 提出KPGrasp方法，用纯欧氏空间关键点流匹配建模灵巧抓取，避免接触损失和测试时优化，在两个仿真基准上刷出SOTA，并在20个真实物体上验证了部署可行性。

papers.title: A Bilateral Teleoperation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous teleoperation requires precise arm-hand coordination, low-latency feedback, and robust interaction in real-world contact-rich environments. This paper presents a modular bilateral teleoperation framework that integrates operator-side input interfaces with a robot-side dexterous hand and compliant robotic arm in a unified control architecture. The system supports position-based hand retargeting, differential arm control, multi-scale haptic feedback, and shared control for stable manipulation. We validate the framework through a real-world dexterous manipulation task, highlighting coordinated arm-hand control and contact-aware interaction. Beyond feasibility, we identify key design insights related to cross-embodiment mismatch, haptic feedback granularity, and shared control. The proposed platform provides a practical teleoperation system and a foundation for collecting high-quality demonstrations for future learning-from-demonstration research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文搭建了一个模块化的双边遥操作框架，把人手动作映射到灵巧手、手臂用差分控制、叠加多尺度力反馈和共享控制策略，在真实机器人上完成了一个接触丰富的灵巧操作任务，并总结了跨形态不匹配、力反馈粒度、共享控制等设计经验。

papers.title: HORIZON: Recoverability-Governed Curriculum for Physical-Domain Scaling
papers.abstract: Scaling robust robot policies requires more than broader randomization, because physical-domain experience must remain organized and learnable throughout training. We study when a policy can benefit from harder physics and identify recoverability as a central constraint in on-policy physical-domain scaling. In on-policy training, new dynamics are useful only insofar as they remain close enough to the current policy to generate corrective on-policy data, rather than collapsing rollouts into unrecoverable failures. Using quadruped locomotion as a physically demanding benchmark for embodied generalization, we introduce HORIZON, a checkpointed frontier curriculum that expands physical domains only within the current policy's recoverable boundary. HORIZON uses rollback and boundary refinement to govern each expansion step, turning fixed randomization into a continual process of physical-domain growth. Experiments reveal three regularities of physical-domain expansion. First, direct domain widening is uneven across physical axes and often unlearnable without staged ordering. Second, domain composition is non-monotonic, and adding more domains beyond a compact core can dilute recoverable joint samples and reduce overall robustness. Third, offline distillation of isolated experts cannot substitute for the joint interaction generated by on-policy curriculum. Together, these results frame physical-domain generalization as a continual growth problem for embodied control, with recoverability as the organizing principle for on-policy expansion.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORIZON方法，通过以策略可恢复性（recoverability）为约束的渐进式课程学习，在四足机器人仿真中动态扩展物理参数空间（如摩擦、质量、延迟等），避免因随机化过猛导致训练崩溃，揭示了物理域泛化必须遵循‘可恢复边界内增长’这一核心规律。
analysis.claim: 物理域扩展不是越宽越好，而必须被当前策略的可恢复性边界所约束；只有在该边界内渐进扩张的on-policy课程才能实现稳健的具身泛化。
analysis.input: 四足机器人状态（关节角度/速度/IMU等）+ 当前物理参数配置
analysis.output: 低层运动控制策略（连续动作向量）

analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在标准四足仿真平台系统验证了recoverability作为课程设计原则的有效性，发现三条反直觉规律（非均匀扩张、非单调组合、无法离线蒸馏替代），且含消融与多物理轴对比；但仅限仿真、未上真机、未开源数据/模型，未达DreamerV3级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。

papers.title: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
papers.abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了目前最大的碱激发矿渣（AAS）性能数据集（3100+强度记录），用机器学习建模预测抗压强度，并提出一个物理可解释的新特征AMODE（平均金属氧化物解离能）来表征矿渣反应活性，从而在不损失预测精度的前提下简化化学成分输入，还基于模型做了兼顾强度、碳排放和成本的反应活性依赖型设计空间探索。
analysis.claim: 引入反应活性驱动的物理可解释特征AMODE，可替代冗余氧化物组分，在异构碱激发矿渣数据上实现高精度强度预测，并支撑多目标低碳 binder 设计。

papers.title: OMG: Omni-Modal Motion Generation for Generalist Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid whole-body control has made significant progress in recent years, yet existing approaches remain limited to few-skill policies with heavy reward engineering, or motion trackers that are difficult to extend to new input modalities. We argue that the key to general-purpose humanoid control is to build a scalable brain, a module capable of reasoning with diverse conditioning modalities, atop a reactive motion tracking cerebellum, mirroring the hierarchical structure of biological motor systems. Two challenges arise in realizing this vision: acquiring a vast amount of high-quality data to achieve general purpose control, and equipping the generator with the capability to condition on compositional, extensible multi-modal inputs. We present OMG, which addresses these challenges with a meticulous data curation, filtering and labeling pipeline, as well as a diffusion-based motion generation backbone that conditions on language, audio, and human reference motions. Extensive experiments validate OMG as an omni-modal whole-body controller exhibiting state-of-the-art performance, model scaling behavior and efficient adaptation to new distributions and modalities, marking a concrete step toward foundation models for humanoid robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OMG的扩散模型，能用语言、音频或参考人体动作作为输入，生成人形机器人全身运动序列，强调多模态条件控制和数据工程，但所有实验都在仿真中完成，未见真实机器人部署或跨机体验证。

papers.title: QuadVerse: An Integrated Framework Aligning Visual-Physical Reality for Quadruped Simulation
papers.abstract: Simulation is central to robot learning, yet the sim-to-real gap remains a major bottleneck. Existing approaches often tackle visual or dynamic gaps separately, overlooking how these individual mismatches accumulate and propagate throughout the robot's state evolution. In this paper, we introduce QuadVerse, an integrated framework that uses reconstructed scenes as a calibration substrate for aligning visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics. From captured RGB videos, we reconstruct geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes that support batched photorealistic ego-view rendering and collision-ready semantic mesh extraction. The meshes further enable contact calibration by initializing spatially varying friction priors and refining them through trajectory-based posterior search. To address remaining actuator discrepancies, QuadVerse trains a residual dynamics compensator by replaying real-world trajectories on the contact-calibrated terrain, reducing the entanglement between terrain-induced contact errors and actuator non-idealities. Experiments show that QuadVerse improves reconstruction quality and locomotion tracking over relevant baselines. Leveraging this foundation, we demonstrate robust zero-shot visual-navigation policy deployment without task-specific real-world rollouts.

analysis.tldr: 提出QuadVerse框架，用3D高斯泼溅重建真实场景几何，生成可用于仿真的语义网格和摩擦场，并通过轨迹回放训练残差动力学补偿器，缩小四足机器人仿真与现实之间的视觉、接触和执行器三重差距，最终实现零样本视觉导航策略在真实机器人上的直接部署。

papers.title: Embedding ISO 10218 Safety Compliance in Robots via Control Barrier Functions for Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) requires strict adherence to safety standards, such as ISO 10218, to prevent harmful interactions. Standard Speed and Separation Monitoring (SSM) filters calculate safe robotic speeds based on conservative assumptions, such as constant human velocity, which prevents accurate predictions of minimum separation distances and causes unnecessary operational halts. This paper proposes a Control Barrier Function (CBF) that explicitly incorporates human acceleration data to analytically forward-predict the minimum human-robot separation distance during a worst-case robotic stopping trajectory. To guarantee safety at the control level, this predictive CBF is integrated as an inequality constraint within a Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) framework. Specifically, two methods are proposed: Method I, a CBF-constrained PD safety filter; and Method II, a task-scaling SQP controller that enforces a spatial tube constraint. Simulated and real-world experiments on a UR10e robot evaluate the two proposed methods against a standard industrial SSM module baseline. Results demonstrate that Method II dynamically modulates execution speed and confines spatial deviations. Compared to Method I, Method II achieves a 63\% reduction in mean trajectory error and avoids excessive evasive manoeuvres, ensuring high task throughput while complying with ISO 10218 SSM guidelines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用控制屏障函数（CBF）把ISO 10218安全标准嵌入到机器人实时控制中，通过引入人体加速度预测最短人机距离，替代传统SSM中保守的匀速假设，在UR10e机械臂上验证了能减少轨迹误差、避免过度避让、提升任务吞吐量的同时满足工业安全规范。
analysis.claim: 将ISO 10218的SSM安全要求形式化为可解析求解的控制屏障函数约束，并通过加速度感知的前向预测显著提升人机共融场景下安全与效率的平衡。
analysis.input: 机器人关节状态+视觉/激光测距获取的人体位置与加速度估计
analysis.output: 安全约束下的关节级运动指令（PD滤波输出或SQP优化后的关节力矩/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR10e机械臂+配套安全传感器（如3D摄像头或激光雷达）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体运动数据（加速度）用于预测，但未说明是否使用公开数据集或采集新数据；实验含real-robot闭环，但未提数据规模或多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 在工业HRC安全控制领域属扎实增量：首次将加速度建模纳入CBF框架并实机验证，对比基线有量化提升（63%误差下降），但未跨平台泛化（仅UR10e）、未开源代码、未挑战更复杂动态交互（如多人/非结构化环境），远未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破或通用具身智能层级。
