papers.title: MimicIK: Real-Time Generative Inverse Kinematics from Teleoperation with FK Consistency
papers.abstract: Inverse kinematics (IK) remains a critical bottleneck for real-time robot manipulation. Classical numerical solvers achieve high geometric precision but often suffer from discontinuous branch switching and unstable behavior near kinematic singularities during closed-loop deployment. Meanwhile, learned IK approaches frequently struggle to balance spatial accuracy, motion smoothness, and real-time efficiency, particularly when trained on noisy human teleoperation data. We present \textbf{MimicIK}, a real-time generative inverse kinematics framework that learns smooth and robust joint-space motion priors from teleoperation demonstrations through conditional flow matching. Given the current joint configuration and a target end-effector pose, MimicIK predicts continuous delta-joint commands using an efficient two-step iterative refinement process based on a Minimal Iterative Policy (MIP) backbone. To enforce physical consistency, we further introduce an FK consistency loss, a differentiable forward-kinematics regularization that penalizes task-space deviations from the target pose during training. We evaluate MimicIK on a real-world 6-DOF robot dataset containing 8,848 teleoperation demonstrations. MimicIK achieves a mean position error of 4.65 mm, a 10 mm success rate of 92.01\%, and a trajectory spike rate of only 7.99\%. Compared with a UNet diffusion baseline, our method improves both spatial accuracy and motion smoothness while reducing inference latency from 21.66 ms to 6.74 ms. Furthermore, unlike deterministic MLP baselines that catastrophically diverge under out-of-distribution deployment, MimicIK remains stable near singular configurations and enables robust 20 Hz real-time control on deployment hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出MimicIK，一种基于条件流匹配的生成式逆运动学方法，从人类遥操作数据中学习关节空间运动先验，通过两步迭代精炼预测连续关节增量，并用可微正向运动学损失约束末端位姿精度，在真实6-DOF机器人上实现4.65mm平均定位误差、92%的10mm成功率和20Hz实时控制。
analysis.claim: 生成式逆运动学可通过条件流匹配建模关节运动先验，并结合可微正向运动学一致性损失，在真实遥操作数据上实现高精度、高平滑性、低延迟且抗奇异点的实时IK控制。
analysis.input: 当前关节构型 + 目标末端位姿（位置+朝向）
analysis.output: 连续的关节增量命令（delta-joint）
analysis.robot_dependency: 6-DOF机械臂（未指明具体型号，但为真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：使用8848段真实人类遥操作演示数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了IK在真实遥操作场景下的平滑性、实时性与奇异点鲁棒性三难问题，实测指标扎实（4.65mm误差、20Hz、92%成功率），但仅限单臂6-DOF、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，未开源代码模型，未与ACT/ALOHA等通用策略框架对比，属高质量专项技术突破而非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实机器人上验证了生成式IK对传统数值解和MLP基线的实质性改进，但局限于单一构型与任务类型，缺乏开源与泛化证据，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies have made substantial progress in real-world robot manipulation, particularly for short-horizon action generation. However, deployment in open workspaces remains fragile under unexpected local scene dynamics, such as moving objects, transient occlusions, or disturbances near the intended motion. Existing runtime monitors often rely on global observation anomalies, policy uncertainty, or frame-level visual changes, and struggle to distinguish task-relevant execution risk from benign visual variation. We introduce PATCH, an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch innovation monitor for deployment-time intervention. Given the active action chunk, PATCH defines a projected execution corridor, predicts latent patch evolution inside it, and accumulates persistent residuals unexplained by the robot's own motion. These residuals form a localized intervention signal that allows PATCH-Router to pause execution, select an available recovery source, and resume the original policy once localized innovation subsides. Experiments on real robot rollout data show that PATCH produces more stable and context-relevant triggers than competing runtime monitors. Real-robot deployment further demonstrates monitor-driven intervention and policy resumption for disturbance-aware manipulation. Project Page: https://yananzhou5555.github.io/PATCH/.

analysis.tldr: 提出PATCH监控器，在机器人执行动作块时预测局部潜空间补丁的演化，通过累积未被机器人自身运动解释的残差来检测任务相关的真实扰动（如移动物体、临时遮挡），从而触发暂停-恢复机制，提升开放环境中的操作鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 动作块条件下的局部潜空间补丁创新监测能比全局异常或帧级变化检测更精准识别任务相关的执行风险，实现扰动感知的自主干预与策略恢复。
analysis.input: 当前动作块 + 视觉观测序列（RGB视频流）
analysis.output: 局部化干预信号（二值触发+残差热图）及恢复决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（摘要中实验基于real robot rollout data，项目页显示使用Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人 rollout 数据训练与验证（但未说明是否需在线采集/闭环微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了runtime monitor中‘误触发’这一长期痛点，实证显示在真实Panda上比基线更稳定、更少误停，但仅限于短时动作块+预定义任务集（抓取/推/放置），未验证跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型、无消融证明各模块贡献、未对比ALOHA/ACT等强基线，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将潜空间残差建模与动作块条件结合用于实时监控，实证有效但封闭、窄任务、不可复现，尚未达到基石论文的通用性与开放性门槛。

papers.title: Robots as Tokens: Unified Diffusion Transformer for Coordinated Multi-Robot Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract: The success of generative models in language and visual generation has inspired extensive applications to generative robot planning. However, most existing works either focus on single-robot planning, or generate multi-robot trajectories in a sequential manner with iterative post-processing to resolve inter-robot conflicts. In this work, we investigate whether coordinated multi-robot trajectories, as a special spatiotemporal distribution, can be learned and generated with a generative model in a feed-forward manner. We propose Robots as Tokens (Roken), a unified diffusion transformer that directly generates multi-robot trajectories that satisfy both (individual) safety and (global) connectivity constraints. The core design of Roken is to represent each robot as a discrete token, allowing them to naturally interact with each other through self-attention, and cross-attend to map tokens for environment layouts. We further introduce several auxiliary tasks based on Bayes' theorem to provide multi-scale spatial-temporal supervision for efficient learning of the conditional distribution. In training, Roken absorbs diverse expert trajectories from different team sizes. During inference, Roken behaves as a versatile multi-robot planner that can handle single-robot planning, coordinated multi-robot trajectory generation, and conditional trajectory generation by fixing some robot tokens as conditions. Experiments in diverse cluttered environments show that Roken can generate coordinated multi-robot trajectories to perform connectivity-constrained goal navigation tasks with high success rates, outperforming the baseline method used to generate the training dataset. Roken also demonstrates good scalability after training with mixed team sizes, and shows generalization to unseen or partially observed environments, verifying its potential to learn from diverse data and perform versatile tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Roken的扩散Transformer模型，把每个机器人当作一个离散token，用自注意力让多机器人在生成轨迹时自动协同避碰并满足连通性约束，全程前馈式生成、不靠迭代后处理。
analysis.claim: 将多机器人轨迹建模为时空联合分布，通过将机器人表示为离散token并引入跨模态注意力与贝叶斯辅助监督，可实现端到端、前馈式、约束满足的协调轨迹生成。
analysis.input: 环境地图（栅格/特征图）+多机器人初始位姿+目标位姿+连通性约束（如通信图）
analysis.output: 所有机器人从起点到终点的完整时空轨迹（位置序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成专家轨迹数据（未说明是否含真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有启发性（token化机器人+扩散+约束注入），但仅在仿真中验证，无真实机器人实验，无消融证明贝叶斯辅助任务或token化设计的关键性，baseline仅是训练数据来源方法（非SOTA多机器人规划器），未与RT-2/Octo等范式级工作对比，属扎实但窄域的生成式规划增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将扩散Transformer用于多机器人协同轨迹生成，但限于仿真、无实证消融、未挑战领域核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程鲁棒协同），暂未达工程整合或真突破级别。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Future Hypotheses for Horizon-Aware Exploration in Multi-Step Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-step robot manipulation requires acting under uncertainty about how the scene will evolve, making exploration and policy adaptation challenging. We study whether short-horizon, task-consistent future videos can provide useful structured priors for control and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. We formalize this idea through Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), a simple interface that conditions closed-loop policies on a latent representation of a short future video. In our simulation setup, future clips are generated in three stages, an LLM reasoner operating over a task ontology initialized from the current scene state, a robot-free digital-twin rollout of the intended object motion, and a mask-free video diffusion model that synthesizes a robot-consistent future clip without requiring segmentation at inference. We instantiate this future-conditioning interface primarily with BC and BC+RL, and compare against a future-conditioned Streaming Flow Policy (SFP) baseline on RoboCasa and CALVIN under NoFuture, GTFuture, GenFuture, and WrongFuture. Generated futures improve performance over no-future conditioning, while mismatched futures degrade it, and our BC+RL instantiation achieves the strongest overall results. An average BC+RL learning-curve analysis across 8 CALVIN tasks further shows that GTFuture improves fastest, GenFuture improves earlier and to a higher level than NoFuture, and WrongFuture remains at zero throughout training. These results suggest that short-horizon future videos can serve as useful structured priors for exploration and policy adaptation under imperfect future predictions. https://enact2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型生成短时未来视频（3秒内）作为机器人操作策略的条件输入，帮助多步抓取任务在不确定环境中做更鲁棒的探索和微调，所有实验仅在仿真中完成。
analysis.claim: 短时、任务一致的生成式未来视频可作为结构化先验，显著提升多步机器人操作中基于行为克隆与强化学习联合训练的策略鲁棒性与收敛速度。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）生成或真值的未来3秒视频潜表示
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开仿真benchmark的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（未来视频作为条件先验）有启发性，但技术链路高度依赖三阶段串行生成（LLM→数字孪生→扩散视频），无真实硬件验证，未跨机体/任务泛化，对比基线窄（仅NoFuture/GTFuture/GenFuture/WrongFuture），且CALVIN上8任务平均曲线未报告绝对成功率或失败模式分析；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既无跨模态统一架构设计，也无真实世界部署证据，属扎实但封闭的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM+扩散视频+策略条件化做了可信的仿真串联，但未突破仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未挑战多步操作中的根本不确定性建模难题。

papers.title: WAM-Nav: Asymmetric Latent World-Action Modeling for Unified Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Visual navigation requires generating smooth and collision-free trajectories under complex geometric and physical constraints. Existing reactive policies that directly map observations to actions lack anticipatory reasoning, limiting their ability to proactively avoid obstacles. While visual imagination offers predictive foresight, conventional modular approaches separate scene prediction from policy learning, often leading to error accumulation and inefficient inference. To address these limitations, we propose WAM-Nav, a Latent World-Action Model for embodied visual navigation that jointly learns action generation and latent visual foresight, enabling more robust and foresighted navigation decisions without compromising inference efficiency. Specifically, WAM-Nav utilizes a shared Diffusion Transformer for asymmetric joint diffusion to concurrently generate long-horizon actions and short-horizon visual foresight, reducing the inference latency and visual error accumulation inherent in multi-step autoregressive rollouts. To further encourage smooth and consistent trajectory generation, we introduce a dual-stream contextual conditioning mechanism that integrates episode-level ego-motion history with sequential visual observations. Combined with a unified goal alignment module that preserves balanced representations across goal types, WAM-Nav naturally supports Image-Goal, Point-Goal, and No-Goal exploration within a single policy. Extensive experiments on the challenging ClutterScenes and InternScenes benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization of WAM-Nav, particularly on Image-Goal and Point-Goal navigation, where it improves success rates by 15.7% and 3.3%, respectively. Real-world deployment further validates effective zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving an average 85% task success rate across diverse indoor and outdoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM-Nav模型，用一个共享的Diffusion Transformer同时生成长时程动作序列和短时程视觉预想（latent visual foresight），实现图像目标/点目标/无目标三合一导航，在仿真基准上提升成功率，并在真实机器人上零样本迁移达到85%成功率。
analysis.claim: 联合建模隐式世界预测与动作生成可提升具身导航的前瞻性、鲁棒性与泛化性，且不牺牲推理效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+目标描述（图像/坐标/无）+历史自运动信息
analysis.output: 长时程动作序列（如速度/转向）+短时程隐式视觉预测（latent visual foresight）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提‘real-world deployment’，推测为通用差速/全向移动底盘
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集数据；实验含zero-shot sim-to-real，暗示训练纯仿真，真实数据仅用于部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有创新（diffusion transformer用于联合action+foresight建模、双流条件机制、统一goal接口），实证扎实（多基准+真实部署+零样本迁移+量化提升），但未开源、未与DreamerV3/World Models等基石方法对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如长期信用分配、闭环世界建模），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合度高、实证充分、真机部署有效，但缺乏开源与基线深度对比，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: MotionVLA: Injecting Geometric Motion into Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly condition robot policies on history, depth, or 4D features to resolve ambiguity in long-horizon manipulation. However, more spatiotemporal evidence is not necessarily better: when the injected evidence is not motion-consistent, it can introduce geometric drift, fragmented temporal cues, and unstable action generation. This raises a simple question: should a VLA remember past frames, or remember the motion that connects them? We introduce MotionVLA, a motion-history interface that converts a short past-only video window into compact, time-continuous trajectory-field tokens. Instead of treating history as a sparse set of ndependently lifted frames, MotionVLA represents recent observations as physically coherent motion evidence. Current visual tokens query this history to retrieve task-relevant motion information, which is then recoupled into the VLA stream under trajectory-grounded supervision. Experiments across simulation benchmarks and preliminary real-robot rollouts show that MotionVLA improves long-horizon manipulation while producing smoother and more direct executions. These results suggest that effective VLA memory is not just about providing more 4D context, but about exposing motion-consistent evidence that is usable for control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MotionVLA，用轨迹场（trajectory-field）token替代传统帧堆叠来建模机器人动作历史，把过去视频窗口压缩成物理一致的运动表征，让视觉语言动作模型能更稳定地生成长程操作动作。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的记忆不应是离散帧的历史，而应是运动一致的轨迹场表征；用该表征替代4D帧序列可显著提升长程操作的稳定性与执行质量。
analysis.input: 短时视频窗口（含RGB+深度？未明说但隐含多模态输入）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector control或关节级动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（如BridgeData V2 / RT-1 sim等未明说但实验基于sim benchmarks）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅‘preliminary real-robot rollouts’，无定量、无任务数、无基线对比，属示意性）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉的轨迹场记忆机制，概念清晰，但实证薄弱：仅在仿真benchmark上展示提升，无消融验证轨迹场各组件贡献，无跨任务/跨机体泛化测试，real-robot部分纯示意，代码/模型/数据全未开源，未与OpenVLA/Octo/π0.5等主流VLA基线做公平对比（如相同训练数据量、相同backbone），属于扎实但窄的机制改进，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA记忆建模上做了合理且有物理依据的结构改进，但缺乏充分实证支撑和开源落地，目前仅算仿真阶段的模块级优化，暂未形成可复现、可迁移、可比肩主流VLA框架的实质性推进。

papers.title: AllDayNav: Lifelong Navigation via Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Lifelong embodied navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to form persistent scene understanding from fragmentary observations, which remains difficult for existing methods that rely on explicit maps or scene graphs and struggle to generalize beyond structured settings. We propose AllDayNav, a lifelong self-learning navigation framework that implicitly encodes scene dynamics into the billion-scale parameters of a large model via reinforcement learning, powered by a self-evolving multimodal memory that maintains and updates visual keyframes, semantic descriptions, and temporal context while autonomously generating open-vocabulary instructions, image goals, and structured rewards. Experiments in both synthetic and real-world environments across cross-room, cross-episode, and cross-task scenarios show that AllDayNav achieves success rates approaching $100\%$ and consistently surpasses strong map-based, VLM, and RL baselines in path efficiency and robustness, demonstrating implicit, memory-driven reinforcement learning as a scalable alternative to explicit mapping for reliable lifelong navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出AllDayNav框架，让机器人通过真实世界强化学习持续导航，不依赖显式地图，而是用大模型隐式建模环境动态，并靠自演化的多模态记忆（视觉关键帧+语义描述+时间上下文）自主生成指令、图像目标和奖励，实现在跨房间、跨回合、跨任务场景下的高成功率导航。
analysis.claim: 隐式、记忆驱动的强化学习可替代显式建图，实现可靠、可扩展的终身具身导航。
analysis.input: RGB视频流、历史观测序列、任务指令（开放词汇）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如移动/转向）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实轮式移动机器人（摘要提real-world RL，但未指明型号；实验含real-world environments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的长期交互数据（强调real-world RL与cross-episode learning）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽宣称real-world lifelong navigation且跨场景泛化，但未披露真实机器人平台型号、数据规模、训练时长、消融实验细节；所有baseline对比均未说明是否在同等真实硬件/部署条件下复现；'100% success rate'缺乏误差范围与失败案例分析；相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，既无新RL范式突破（如world model架构创新），也无大规模真实世界部署证据或开源生态支撑，仅属扎实但窄域的工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了真实机器人上的多回合导航闭环，但缺乏方法论原创性、可复现性与系统级鲁棒性验证，尚未达到开范式或显著推进SOTA的门槛。

papers.title: A mathematical framework for centromere-aware evaluation of human genome assemblies
papers.abstract: Accurate evaluation of genome assemblies within highly repetitive regions, such as centromeres, remains a major open challenge in genomics. Conventional benchmarking relies on sequence alignment, which becomes problematic in regions of high homogeneity and divergence. Here, we framed centromere assembly evaluation as a comparative distribution problem in a compact centeny representation by computing genomic distances between functional motifs, rather than relying on nucleotide sequence. Our distribution-based metric assesses agreement between a query and a target chromosome by comparing their centromeric inter-motif distances rendered by KL divergence. When applied genome-wide to currently available human telomere-to-telomere (T2T) genomes, this approach yields an accuracy ranking for the entire assembly and for each individual chromosome. Altogether, we present a rapid and robust scoring system based on genomes numerical rendering of inter-motif distances, that provides a quantitative standard of assembly integrity in repetitive DNA regions and establishes a bona fide framework for chromosome-level genome-to-genome comparison.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不依赖传统序列比对的新方法，把着丝粒区域的组装质量评估转化为比较功能基序间距离分布的问题，用KL散度量化查询组装与参考组装在着丝粒结构上的相似性，从而给整条染色体乃至全基因组组装打分。
analysis.claim: 着丝粒等高重复区域的组装质量不能靠序列对齐评估，而应通过功能基序的空间距离分布一致性来定量衡量。
analysis.input: 两条染色体的着丝粒区域（含注释的功能基序坐标）
analysis.output: 一个标量分数（KL散度值），反映查询组装与参考组装在着丝粒结构上的分布一致性
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个针对着丝粒结构完整性的可计算、非对齐评估框架，实证覆盖全部T2T染色体并给出排序，但未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页工具；相比AlphaFold2等90+级里程碑（解决长期根本难题+全开源+多领域颠覆），它属于重要但窄域的方法学推进：解决了重复区评估这一公认痛点，但未改变组装范式，也未驱动新实验或临床应用。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在重复DNA评估这个长期被对齐方法失效困扰的子问题上给出了可复现、可解释、染色体级的定量解，但尚未达到开新范式或跨领域影响的量级。

papers.title: PHASER: Phase-Aware and Semantic Experience Replay for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, deploying these models in open-ended environments requires continuously acquiring novel skills, a process that inevitably triggers severe catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behaviors. While experience replay (ER) serves as a standard mitigating strategy, naive uniform sampling fundamentally misaligns with the temporal characteristics of manipulation trajectories. It systematically under-samples brief but causally critical sub-skills, leading to phase starvation, and completely overlooks the varying degrees of forgetting across historical tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework. PHASER employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting. Furthermore, to enable fully autonomous lifelong adaptation, we integrate Auto-PC, a lightweight pipeline combining unsupervised action-signal change-point detection with VLM-based semantic verification to extract temporal boundaries without intensive manual supervision. Evaluated across three VLA backbones on LIBERO continual learning suites, PHASER yields substantial empirical improvements, increasing Average Success Rate (ASR) by up to 31% over matched-budget ER and achieving an 87.8% final ASR on the LIBERO-Goal CL setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PHASER，一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在持续学习中严重遗忘问题的改进型经验回放方法，核心是按操作‘相位’（sub-skill）而非时间步或轨迹均匀采样，并用多模态干扰路由动态保护易忘阶段，还加了自动相位分割模块Auto-PC来免人工标注边界。
analysis.claim: 相位感知+语义驱动的经验回放能显著缓解VLA模型在开放环境持续技能学习中的灾难性遗忘，且无需人工标注操作阶段边界。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作块（action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真器（Franka Emika Panda机械臂仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA持续学习中经验回放的相位失衡问题，有清晰机制设计和LIBERO上三骨干验证，但仅限仿真、单机体、固定任务分布，无真实机器人实验，未跨硬件/跨任务泛化，也未挑战更开放的终身学习定义（如用户新增指令、新物体），相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作属于扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制合理、实验完整，但纯仿真、无真机、无跨机体/跨场景泛化，尚未触及VLA持续学习的核心开放性瓶颈。

papers.title: EvoBrain: Continual Learning of EEG Foundation Models Across Heterogeneous BCI Tasks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the cornerstone of non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet conventional decoding relies on fragmented, task-specific architectures that severely limit cross-task scalability. While EEG foundation models pre-trained on massive corpora promise universal brain decoding, current post-training depends on task-isolated fine-tuning. This static paradigm restricts knowledge transfer across heterogeneous tasks, hinders model scalability, and incurs computational and storage overheads that scale linearly with task count. To overcome these bottlenecks, we formulate downstream adaptation as a cross-task continual learning problem and propose EvoBrain, a dynamic, task-aware continual learning framework for unified EEG decoding. EvoBrain addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off via two complementary components: (1) Neuro-Spectral Task Normalization (NSN) aligns incoming tasks with historical statistics while recalibrating spectral responses to handle distributional and neuro-spectral shifts; and (2) Response-Affinity Distillation (RAD), combined with time-dependent replay, preserves old-task response geometry and promotes selective knowledge transfer between spectrally compatible tasks, effectively mitigating forgetting. Extensive evaluations across six distinct BCI tasks demonstrate that EvoBrain consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods across diverse foundation backbones, optimally balancing plasticity and stability. To our knowledge, this work pioneers cross-task continual learning in the EEG domain, advancing the realization of a unified, one-for-all brain decoding system.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EvoBrain的持续学习框架，让同一个EEG基础模型能顺序学多个不同脑机接口任务而不遗忘，用任务归一化和响应蒸馏解决神经信号分布漂移和灾难性遗忘问题
analysis.claim: 跨异构BCI任务的持续学习是实现统一EEG基础模型的关键路径，而EvoBrain通过NSN和RAD双机制首次在EEG领域实现了有效的跨任务持续解码
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的EEG时序信号（含多通道）
analysis.output: 任务特定的解码结果（如运动想象类别、SSVEP频率、P300目标等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/私有EEG数据集，无真实在线脑机闭环实验，未使用任何实时神经反馈硬件系统
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在离线静态数据集上验证6个分类型BCI任务的顺序学习效果，无在线适应、无真实用户闭环、无跨被试泛化验证；相比标尺中所有90+分工作（均含真实神经闭环、临床级功能输出、长期植入/穿戴验证），本文纯属算法层面的范式迁移尝试，贡献限于EEG小圈子内的方法整合，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（信噪比低、个体差异大、非平稳性、延迟敏感、闭环稳定性）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CV/NLP领域的持续学习思路迁移到EEG分类任务，但未解决BCI本质挑战，也未验证真实交互有效性

papers.title: Development of the Mitochondrial Base Editor Analysis Package (MitoBEAP).
papers.abstract: For many years, the genetic manipulation of mitochondrial DNA was largely hampered by inefficient delivery of nucleic acids to mitochondria. However, the development of mitoCBEs, such as mitochondrial cytosine base editors (DdCBEs), which catalyse C-to-T and G-to-A conversions, and more recently, mitoABEs, such as transcription-activator-like effector (TALE)-linked deaminases (TALEDs) enabling A-to-G and T-to-C conversion, has transformed this field. Generally, mitochondrial base editors exhibit high on-target efficiency and are straightforward to design and use. Nonetheless, unintended off-target effects cannot be overlooked and should be assessed consistently with each experiment, which can be challenging without specialised bioinformatic expertise. Here, we introduce Mitochondrial Base Editor Analysis Package (MitoBEAP), which, to our knowledge, is the first R package specifically designed to analyse next-generation sequencing data from base-edited mtDNA samples. The package facilitates the analysis of potential off-target effects, offers multiple visualisation options, and allows customisation of graphics and thresholds for calculations. As a proof of concept, this study demonstrates how MitoBEAP can be utilised to measure the efficiency of DdCBE treatment targeting human 12S rRNA, as well as to identify potentially harmful off-target conversions across the mtDNA.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个专门分析线粒体DNA碱基编辑测序数据的R软件包MitoBEAP，用于量化编辑效率和检测全基因组范围内的脱靶突变。
analysis.claim: MitoBEAP是首个专为线粒体碱基编辑（mitoCBE/mitoABE）NGS数据分析设计的开源R工具包，可标准化评估编辑效率与全mtDNA脱靶谱。
analysis.input: 线粒体DNA的二代测序FASTQ或BAM文件、参考mtDNA序列、编辑位点坐标
analysis.output: 各位点编辑效率（%C-to-T等）、全mtDNA脱靶突变谱（含位置/类型/频率）、可视化图表（如热图、轨迹图、阈值可调的变异分布图）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖真实细胞系或动物组织提取的mtDNA测序数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具链建设：填补了mtDNA碱基编辑领域专用分析工具的空白，实证覆盖DdCBE案例和脱靶扫描，但仅限单一物种（人）mtDNA、无跨编辑器泛化验证、未整合到主流基因组分析流程（如nf-core）、未提供预训练模型或基准数据集，分量相当于扎实的领域专用工具（如早期CRISPResso之于核基因组编辑），远未达AlphaFold/ESM级范式突破或RFdiffusion级方法创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了线粒体碱基编辑领域长期缺乏标准化分析工具的实际痛点，但功能边界清晰、泛化性弱、未形成新方法论，属于重要且及时的工具型贡献。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can describe scenes and reason about them in language, yet still struggle to ground their actions in the dense 3D world around them. Existing approaches either inject features from a frozen 3D foundation model without an objective that ensures the policy uses them, or constrain geometry with sparse box and map losses that provide no dense spatial signal. We introduce VLGA, the first vision-language-action model supervised to reconstruct the dense 3D world it drives through. VLGA introduces geometry as a fourth modality alongside vision, language, and action through a dedicated expert supervised by a per-pixel pointmap regression loss against LiDAR. Extensive experiments conducted on challenging nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets for open-loop and closed-loop evaluations, respectively, show the superiority of VLGA over counterpart VLA methods. In particular, on open-loop nuScenes, VLGA sets a new state of the art among VLA methods without ego status, with the lowest L2 (0.50\,m average) and 3-second collision rate (0.18\%). On closed-loop Bench2Drive, VLGA attains the state-of-the-art driving score of 79.08, +0.71 over the strongest prior VLA, at comparable efficiency and comfort.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLGA模型，首次在自动驾驶VLA框架中显式引入几何模态（dense 3D点图重建），用LiDAR监督的逐像素点图回归损失强制模型理解稠密空间结构，从而提升开环轨迹预测和闭环驾驶性能。
analysis.claim: 引入几何作为第四模态并用LiDAR点图回归监督，是提升VLA模型在自动驾驶中空间接地能力的关键，且能显著改善开环误差与闭环驾驶得分。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如导航指令）+可选ego状态（但主实验不依赖）
analysis.output: 车辆控制动作序列（转向/加速度）及稠密3D点图重建结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用nuScenes和Bench2Drive仿真/传感器数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（几何模态+点图回归）且实证扎实（nuScenes/Bench2Drive双基准、开闭环指标均SOTA），但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨场景/跨城市泛化，未接入真实车体，仍属高质量增量工作而非范式突破；远低于RT-2/π0/Octo等通用具身智能基石（需多任务、跨机体、真机部署、强泛化），也未达到OpenVLA/CHORUS级的架构通用性或协作扩展性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：几何模态设计合理、实验充分，但闭源且无真实部署，暂未突破VLA在自动驾驶中的基础局限

papers.title: G-MAPP: GPU-accelerated Multi-Agent Planning and Perception for Reactive Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Reactive motion generation in unstructured environments remains an open challenge in robotics. Due to the computational complexity of collision-free motion generation, existing methods either generate global trajectories for static scenarios, or employ models that make conservative assumptions about the environment. This paper identifies the primary bottleneck as the runtime performance demand of planning on high-fidelity environments, and the temporal integration between the perception and planning modules. Therefore, we propose a framework that does not compromise on runtime performance and world representations for perception and planning by accelerating world modeling and vector-field based planning using the GPU. This allows us to achieve faster parallel state exploration for quasi-global trajectory planning, and tighter coupling of the perception-action loop in real-time for dynamic cluttered environments with off-the-shelf depth sensors. We quantitatively evaluate the computation-time and success rate differences for the CPU and GPU versions of our planner, and perform qualitative evaluations of our coupled framework using real-world experiments on a 7-DoF Franka Emika robot. Experimental results demonstrate that our GPU-based framework achieves up to a 5x speedup over the CPU version and successfully avoids collisions across both trivial and challenging physical world scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用GPU加速多智能体感知与向量场规划，把原本在CPU上跑得慢的实时避障轨迹生成提速5倍，在Franka机器人上验证了在杂乱动态环境中的实时碰撞规避能力。
analysis.claim: 通过GPU加速世界建模与向量场规划，可实现实时、高保真、强耦合的感知-规划闭环，显著提升动态杂乱环境中反应式运动生成的速度与成功率。
analysis.input: 深度传感器（如RealSense）采集的实时点云/深度图
analysis.output: 无碰撞的准全局机械臂运动轨迹（速度/加速度约束下的关节空间时间序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika机器人（7-DoF）+ RealSense深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署时的在线深度数据流，但未使用离线标注数据集或预录轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将向量场规划与GPU并行状态探索结合用于真实机械臂实时避障，有明确实测提速（5×）和物理场景验证，但未跨机体/任务泛化，无开源代码，未挑战长期开放难题（如长程推理、语义理解、多轮交互），也未达到H2O/GR00T等基石级范式突破或系统整合高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程优化有效，但局限于单臂、单传感器、静态场景扩展有限，缺乏跨任务泛化与开源支撑，暂未构成范式突破或系统级跃迁。

papers.title: Surface Constraint Policy for Learning Surface-Constrained and Dynamically Feasible Robot Skills
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based imitation learning methods have driven rapid progress in robot dexterous manipulation tasks. However, they have limitations when applied to tasks that involve complex free-form surface constraints because of their lack of explicit surface geometry constraint modeling and the dynamic feasibility issue, resulting in stochastic action generation that fails to achieve reliable surface alignment and maintain stable contact. To address these limitations, we propose a novel surface constraint policy (SCP) for generating robot actions that satisfy free-form surface constraints on the basis of human demonstrations and real-time visual observations. First, the surface geometry constraint is encoded using a two-dimensional weighted Gaussian kernel function that is derived from demonstrations. Building on the encoded surface geometry constraints, the diffusion-based policy is used to infer task-level action intentions from multimodal sensory inputs, including visual observations and robot state feedback. These intentions are further transformed into surface-constrained dynamic movement primitives (DMPs) through a similarity-based action mapping method, thereby enabling smooth and compliant motion execution. The SCP achieves generation of structured surface geometric intent and dynamically admissible actions. The proposed method is validated on multiple surface manipulation tasks and compared with existing techniques. The experimental results demonstrate superior task success rates and contact stability under surface constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SCP的方法，让机器人在模仿人类操作时能严格贴着任意曲面（比如擦玻璃、刮漆）运动，同时保证动作物理上可行不抖动，核心是把曲面几何约束编码成高斯核，再用扩散模型生成意图，最后转成带动态可行性的运动原语。
analysis.claim: 表面几何约束可通过加权二维高斯核从演示中显式编码，并与扩散策略和动态运动原语结合，实现既满足自由曲面接触约束又具备动力学可行性的动作生成。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人本体状态（位置/速度）+人类演示轨迹
analysis.output: 表面约束下的动态可行动作序列（DMP参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中使用PyBullet，实验提及real-robot但未说明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示数据（含曲面接触轨迹），未说明是否需真实机器人采集，但方法设计隐含需配准到真实曲面几何
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了扩散策略在曲面约束任务中几何不保真和动力学不可行的两个具体缺陷，有真实机械臂验证和多任务对比，但仅限于静态/慢速接触操作，未跨机体、未开源代码、未接入VLA或大模型接口，属于扎实的垂直领域增量，未触及具身智能基础范式演进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在表面约束操作这一狭窄子问题上补全了扩散策略的关键缺失环节，但未突破任务泛化、跨机体适配或感知-动作联合建模框架，工程价值明确，理论或范式意义有限

papers.title: SwitchCraft: A Programmatic Framework for Designing State-Switching Proteins
papers.abstract: Multistate mechanisms underlie many of the complex functions observed in natural proteins. The ability to rationally design multistate proteins would have transformative implications for many areas of biotechnology, yet lies beyond the capabilities of existing deep learning frameworks for protein design. To address this gap, we introduce SwitchCraft, a versatile and programmatic framework for designing state-switching proteins based on backpropagation through compositional design constraints parameterized by structure prediction models. In silico evaluations demonstrate success on a wide range of state-switching functional primitives, from allosteric regulation of motifs to discrimination of bound ligand identities. Using these primitives, we demonstrate an in silico strategy for de novo design of fluorescent biosensors to arbitrary small molecule analytes. These results position SwitchCraft at the inception of a powerful paradigm for higher-order functional protein design. Code is available at https://github.com/bjing2016/switchcraft.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫SwitchCraft的编程框架，用可微分的方式把多个蛋白质结构预测模型（如ESMFold）串联起来，通过反向传播优化满足‘在不同状态间切换’这一功能约束的蛋白质序列，目标是设计能响应小分子而变构发光的荧光生物传感器。
analysis.claim: 通过将结构预测模型作为可微分组件嵌入程序化设计流程，并施加可微的状态切换约束，能实现端到端、理性、可编程的多态蛋白质功能设计。
analysis.input: 目标功能描述（如‘结合X时发光，不结合时不发光’）、初始结构模板或无模板、小分子配体3D结构
analysis.output: 满足多态功能约束的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；仅依赖公开蛋白结构数据库（如PDB）和配体库（如ZINC），无实验验证数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将结构预测模型作为可微分模块用于多态蛋白设计，思路新颖，但所有验证均停留在in silico层面（无湿实验验证、无结构解析、无功能测试），未超越ProteinMPNN/RFdiffusion等已建立范式的工程深度与实证强度，属于扎实但窄域的算法拓展，尚未触及‘设计出可用新蛋白’这一核心门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把现有结构预测模型当可微算子拼接使用，有技术巧思，但缺乏真实功能验证，目前只是纸上蓝图。

papers.title: BacPROTACs outperform inhibitors in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
papers.abstract: Antibiotic discovery has long relied on occupancy-driven inhibition, leaving a vast number of potential bacterial targets undrugged. Targeted protein degradation offers a mechanistically distinct alternative to inhibition, yet its application to antibacterial drug discovery remains largely unexplored. Here we describe the development of first-in-class heterobifunctional bacterial proteolysis targeting chimeras (BacPROTACs) directed against an essential Mycobacterium tuberculosis protein, 4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase (PptT). Leveraging the modular architecture of BacPROTACs, we repurposed PptT inhibitors by incorporating them into degraders, yielding compounds with markedly improved antimycobacterial activity. Integrating in vitro and cellular approaches, we developed a characterisation pipeline to assess protein degradation in bacteria, applicable to future BacPROTAC programmes. Our study establishes targeted protein degradation as a strategy for antibacterial drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次设计出针对结核分枝杆菌必需蛋白PptT的细菌靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（BacPROTACs），通过将已有抑制剂改造成双功能降解分子，显著提升了抗结核活性，并建立了一套适用于细菌的蛋白降解效果验证流程。
analysis.claim: 靶向蛋白降解（而非传统抑制）可成为新型抗菌药物发现的有效策略，且在结核分枝杆菌中已实现首个概念验证性BacPROTAC分子。
analysis.input: PptT抑制剂结构 + E3连接酶招募模块（经理性设计与化学合成）
analysis.output: 具有降解PptT能力的BacPROTAC小分子化合物及其体外/细胞内降解效能、抗菌活性数据
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首例在细菌（尤其结核杆菌）中成功构建并验证BacPROTAC的完整工作链：从靶点选择、分子设计、化学合成、降解机制验证（Western blot+质谱）、到抗菌表型提升，证据链完整；但仅限单一靶点（PptT）和单一病原体，未展示跨靶标/跨菌种泛化能力，也未开源代码或模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这是靶向蛋白降解技术首次在原核病原体中完成从原理到活性验证的闭环，突破了该策略长期局限于真核系统的瓶颈，但尚未达到AlphaFold级范式转移量级。

papers.title: GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建高保真仿真环境，自动生成大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix，提出BEV+3DGS动态人形交互评测基准GN-Bench，并基于此训练一个支持多任务（指令跟随/人类跟随/目标导航）的RL驱动导航基础模型GN-BAE，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过3DGS驱动的高保真仿真、自动化数据生成与BEV+动态avatar评测，实现生成、评估与策略学习三者统一的VLN新范式。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D观测（隐含于3DGS渲染输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3DGS仿真器（无对应真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合3DGS、BEV、动态avatar等新元素并提出统一范式，但未突破VLN长期瓶颈（如长程泛化、真实世界鲁棒性），所有结果限于单仿真器内、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，benchmark仅新增动态交互维度但未被社区复现或采纳，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量工作，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3DGS、BEV和DAgger式RL训练做了系统性串联，但仍是仿真闭环内的方法堆叠，缺乏真实世界锚点和范式颠覆性。

papers.title: Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry
papers.abstract: The estimation of odometry in legged robots depends on the assumption that the velocity of the foot with respect to the world remains zero during the stance phase. Feedback for the main body velocity is derived from the kinematic serial chain of the feet making accurate leg phase detection is a critical subproblem. A considerable number of studies employ ground reaction force sensors mounted at the tip of the foot to classify, yet these sensors may not be universally available for all legged robots. Additionally, these sensors are often unresponsive to unaccounted disturbances, such as slippage, while the foot remains in contact with the ground. In this study, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for contact detection that utilizes the standard sensor set of joint encoders without reliance on force sensor augmentations. We employ learned representations to model the stance and swing phases probabilistically. The experimental results obtained confirm the efficacy of the proposed self-supervised contact detector. Our framework exhibited superior performance in comparison to supervised methods which necessitate sensor set augmentation and labeling, as well as baseline probabilistic approaches. Additionally, we make our code available to the public.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用关节编码器数据（不依赖力传感器）做自监督学习，自动识别四足/双足机器人脚部的触地（stance）和离地（swing）状态，从而提升腿式里程计精度。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准关节编码器数据，通过自监督表征学习可实现高鲁棒性的腿式机器人接触相位检测，无需力传感器或人工标注。
analysis.input: 关节角度、角速度等编码器时序信号
analysis.output: 脚部接触状态的概率分布（stance/swing二分类概率）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足/双足机器人仿真与真实平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人行走数据用于验证，但训练主要基于仿真+真实混合的自监督信号（无显式标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了力传感器不可靠/不可用场景下的接触检测问题，方法简洁且在真实机器人上验证有效，但未跨机体大规模部署、无消融证明关键设计贡献、未接入端到端里程计闭环验证性能增益，属于扎实的子模块改进，远未达H2O/GR00T等基石级工作所要求的范式突破或系统级整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把接触检测从力传感依赖解耦为纯关节信号自监督建模，实用性强，但未嵌入完整感知-控制闭环，也未挑战腿式导航/操作等高层任务。

papers.title: Affordance-Based Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Pedipulation
papers.abstract: The object manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots is an open research challenge. While previous studies have focused on low-level policy learning, task execution still relies on expert-designed high-level trajectories. Autonomous selection of both an affordable interaction point on the target object and an affordable robot base pose removes the need for pre-designed trajectories. This study proposes a three-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes pose affordances to guide the navigation policy, while the navigation policy drives the locomotion policy. In addition, the pedipulation policy is guided by interaction-point affordances, enabling object-centric pose alignment of the quadruped robot and effective end-effector manipulation planning. We train the proposed framework in the IsaacSim ecosystem and evaluate it in both simulation and real-world settings. We investigate the effectiveness of pose affordance across multiple scenarios in simulation while various object interaction tasks are validated on real-world setting forming an object-interaction dataset. The results show that the proposed framework can autonomously identify candidate poses based on their affordance and successfully execute object manipulation tasks in the real world without human guidance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让四足机器人能自主判断物体上哪里可以碰、自己该站在哪、怎么用腿当手去操作物体，全程不用人工设计轨迹，先在IsaacSim里训练，再在真实四足机器人上完成开门、推箱子等操作任务。
analysis.claim: 基于可操作性（affordance）的三级分层强化学习框架，能使四足机器人在无预设轨迹条件下，自主完成从导航定位到腿部操作物体的端到端闭环。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+目标物体3D模型/点云+任务指令（如‘推开箱子’）
analysis.output: 分层动作序列：高层（机器人基座位姿）、中层（足端落点序列）、底层（关节扭矩控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal或类似四足平台（摘要未指明具体型号，但实验在real-world setting完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于sim2real微调和验证，但主体训练纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将affordance显式建模引入四足pedipulation的分层RL框架，并在真实机器人上验证多任务操作，但未开源代码/模型，未与主流基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、H2O）对比，仿真训练规模小，real-world仅展示数个简单任务，未解决长期存在的接触鲁棒性、动态扰动适应等核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——实现了四足机器人从‘走过去’到‘用腿操作’的闭环自主化，但工程验证有限、复现门槛高、未触及领域根本挑战，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: A Computational Framework for Domain Insertion into Type IV Pili for Bacterial Display and Living Material Assembly
papers.abstract: Bacterial surface structures have enabled display systems with broad impact across biotechnology, but their narrow host range limits their deployment into diverse species. Conversely, Type IV Pili (TFP) are ubiquitous, structurally conserved appendages found across bacteria, but have been minimally explored for display. Here, we describe a computational framework for predicting viable insertion sites in major pilins for stable TFP-mediated display, which we apply to the major pilin PilA1 of the cyanobacterium Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 to enable covalent binding to living materials. By analyzing an Alphafold3-generated PilA1 monomer alongside known multimeric TFP multimers, our pipeline identifies non-interfacial, solvent-accessible, and flexible sites for optimal PilA1 display. We probe these sites with both full-length and truncated SpyCatcher003 at two different expression levels. We show that cells expressing these PilA1-SpyCatcher003 fusions maintain up to 8-fold higher levels of cell suspension than previous C-terminal PilA1 display platforms, suggesting improved TFP assembly despite more than a two-fold increase in cargo size. Additionally, we validate SpyCatcher003 reactivity across the engineered strains, enabling covalent attachment of SpyTag003-containing proteins on the Synechocystis surface. Lastly, we utilize this covalent patterning to achieve a four-fold increase in Synechocystis loading into a living material without compromising its viscoelastic or mechanical properties. Taken together, this work provides a predictive framework for TFP engineering, and opens the door towards programmable surface display across the breadth of bacterial species.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个计算流程，用AlphaFold3预测Type IV菌毛主亚基PilA1上适合插入外源蛋白（如SpyCatcher003）的稳定位点，成功在蓝细菌Synechocystis表面实现高密度、共价、功能性的蛋白展示，并用于提升活体材料中细菌的负载量而不损伤材料力学性能。
analysis.org: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室
analysis.claim: 通过结构导向的计算框架精准定位非界面、溶剂可及且柔性高的插入位点，可在高度保守但未被开发的Type IV菌毛上实现稳定、高效、共价的活菌表面展示，突破宿主范围限制。
analysis.input: AlphaFold3预测的PilA1单体结构 + 已知TFP多聚体结构（PDB）+ 序列比对 + 灵活性/溶剂可及性/界面分析参数
analysis.output: 推荐的PilA1插入位点列表（含结构坐标与可行性评分）+ 工程化菌株表型数据（悬浮稳定性、SpyTag反应效率、活体材料负载量）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×生物（蛋白质工程×合成生物学）中的扎实重磅工作：首次系统性将AF3结构预测+多尺度结构分析（单体/多聚体/动态性）用于菌毛展示位点理性设计，实证覆盖表达水平调控、功能验证（共价偶联）、材料集成（四倍负载提升）和关键性能保留（流变学），但仅在一个菌种（Synechocystis）验证，跨物种泛化未实验，且未开源代码/模型，未构建通用TFP位点数据库。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将AlphaFold3结构预测深度嵌入蛋白质展示工程闭环，有完整计算→设计→构建→表征→应用链条，但尚未扩展至多物种或形成可复用平台工具

papers.title: Learning quality scores for chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract High-throughput chromatin accessibility assays such as bulk and single-cell ATAC-seq have generated large collections of processed signal tracks in bigWig format, which are widely used for visualisation, data integration, and Machine Learning (ML)–based analyses. Despite their central role, systematic quality control (QC) frameworks operating directly at the level of bigWig signal tracks remain underdeveloped. This gap limits the ability to assess data reliability and hampers robust downstream analyses. Here, we present a biologically grounded QC framework for chromatin accessibility bigWig files that integrates peak-level information, background noise estimation, and recovery of stable genomic reference features. Using an ML-based peak caller (LanceOtron), we derive complementary quality metrics capturing signal structure and signal-to-noise properties. We further define constant promoter and CTCF regions as internal biological controls and show that their recovery provides a sensitive measure of data quality across diverse cellular contexts. We apply this framework to a collection of 502 human chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks spanning a wide range of tissues and cell types. The proposed metrics capture related but non-redundant aspects of signal quality and motivate the use of constant promoter and CTCF recovery as biologically meaningful targets. An XGBoost model trained on LanceOtron-derived features accurately predicts recovery of these stable genomic elements on held-out data ( R 2 = 0.97), yielding a continuous and interpretable quality score. Feature importance analysis using SHAP values highlights that model decisions are driven by biologically relevant signal properties rather than arbitrary heuristics. Quantile-based stratification of the quality score is further supported by clear qualitative differences in genome browser visualisations. Together, this work provides a principled and extensible frame-work for assessing the quality of chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks, enabling more reliable data integration and supporting downstream ML applications in regulatory genomics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个用机器学习评估染色质可及性bigWig信号质量的框架，通过LanceOtron峰检测提取特征，用XGBoost预测稳定基因组区域（启动子/CTCF位点）的恢复程度，输出连续、可解释的质量分数。
analysis.claim: 染色质可及性bigWig文件的质量可通过其对生物学上稳定的启动子和CTCF位点的信号恢复能力来量化，且该能力能被机器学习模型高精度预测。
analysis.input: bigWig信号轨道（含背景噪声估计、peak-level统计、LanceOtron衍生特征）
analysis.output: 连续质量分数（0–1，对应启动子/CTCF恢复程度的R²预测值）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了染色质可及性数据QC长期缺失的实操痛点，基于502个真实bigWig样本验证跨组织/细胞类型的泛化性，有SHAP可解释性、浏览器可视化佐证和R²=0.97的强预测性能；但未开源全部训练数据与预训练模型，且方法本质是监督式指标建模，未颠覆QC范式（如未引入无监督异常检测或生成式质量校正），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将稳定基因组元件恢复率建模为可学习、可解释、跨场景的质量代理指标，并在大规模真实数据上验证有效，但非范式变革，也未开源全栈。

papers.title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects
papers.abstract: Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction non-trivial, since geometric trajectory replay or open-loop execution does not model the contact dynamics required to move the articulated part. Moreover, policies trained only for task completion under fixed dynamics can overfit nominal contact loads, especially without tactile or force feedback, and may degrade when the contact load changes. To address these challenges, we present DragMesh-2, a contact-driven framework for dexterous interaction with articulated objects that extends articulated interaction from object-centric generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction, where articulated motion must arise through physical contact. We further propose PICA, a physically informed contact-aware training mechanism that injects physical signals into policy learning without tactile or force feedback, improving robustness and task success under changing contact loads. Finally, we conduct systematic evaluation across multiple damping conditions and articulated-object categories to study robustness under contact-load variation, and provide a pure-geometry dexterous interaction resource to support future loco-manipulation and humanoid hand--object interaction research. Across seven GAPartNet objects, DragMesh-2 achieves stronger robustness under contact-load variation than the compared methods while maintaining high task success across damping conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出DragMesh-2框架，让灵巧手能通过持续物理接触（而非预设轨迹）驱动铰接物体（如门、抽屉）运动，并用PICA机制在无触觉/力反馈下注入物理先验，提升在不同接触负载（如不同阻尼）下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 无需触觉或力传感器，仅靠视觉与几何建模，即可实现灵巧手对铰接物体的接触驱动式操作，并在接触负载变化时保持高成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关节物体CAD模型+手部初始位姿
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制序列（动作策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真手（如Shadow Hand / Allegro Hand in Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统建模铰接物体的手驱接触动力学并提出PICA物理注入机制，但全部实验限于仿真（7个GAPartNet物体）、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试（仅变阻尼）、无消融证明PICA各模块贡献，且未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法对比；属于扎实的仿真级增量工作，但离‘解决长期开放难题’或‘开新范式’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在仿真中推进了铰接物体手驱交互建模，但缺乏真机验证、跨场景泛化和开源支撑，暂未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: Bioinf-Farma: supervised integration of epitope prediction and recombinant protein developability for automated vaccine candidate prioritization
papers.abstract: Vaccine antigen discovery requires prioritizing protein candidates according to both immunogenic potential and recombinant expression feasibility. These properties are typically evaluated using separate computational tools, requiring researchers to integrate heterogeneous outputs through ad hoc workflows. Here, we present BIOINF-farma, a modular platform integrating epitope prediction and developability assessment for rational antigen selection within a unified environment. Candidates can be submitted as amino acid sequences or three-dimensional structures. When experimental structures are unavailable, BIOINF-farma automatically searches for models in AlphaFold DB or performs structure prediction using Boltz-2, ensuring a standardized structural representation for downstream analyses. Antigenicity is quantified by combining structure-based conformational epitope signals (MLCE/REBELOT-BEPPE) and sequence-based linear epitope propensity scores (BepiPred 3.0) into a protein-level Antigenicity Score, with a classification threshold optimized on a manually curated validation dataset. Developability is evaluated through two supervised Random Forest meta-learners that integrate three solubility predictors (DeepSoluE, SoluProt, Protein–Sol) and three thermal stability predictors (TemStaPro, ProLaTherm, BertThermo), whose outputs are combined into an Expression Efficiency Score (EES). By integrating complementary predictive signals, the meta-learning framework achieves greater accuracy and robustness than individual predictors while maintaining performance across a broad range of sequence identities. The Antigenicity Score effectively discriminates antigenic from non-antigenic proteins with a large effect size, whereas EES successfully distinguishes soluble from insoluble outcomes on an independent panel of recombinant proteins expressed in Escherichia coli. BIOINF-farma jointly assesses antigenicity and expression feasibility within a single framework. Its modular architecture facilitates the incorporation of future predictive methods, while its web-based interface makes the full pipeline accessible to users without programming expertise, supporting rapid candidate triage in vaccine research and emerging pathogen responses.

analysis.tldr: Bioinf-Farma 是一个全自动疫苗候选抗原筛选平台，把表位预测（抗原性）和重组蛋白可开发性（可溶性+热稳定性）两个原本割裂的计算任务整合进统一框架，用多模型融合的监督学习方法输出两个综合评分（Antigenicity Score 和 Expression Efficiency Score），支持序列或结构输入，并自动补全缺失结构，最终实现无需编程的网页端一键优先级排序。
analysis.org: 米兰大学/意大利国家研究委员会（CNR）联合团队（依据作者单位：Università degli Studi di Milano, CNR-Istituto di Chimica del Riconoscimento Molecolare 等）
analysis.claim: 通过监督式多模型集成与标准化结构预处理，首次在单一可即用平台中实现抗原性与可开发性双目标协同量化评估，显著提升疫苗候选物优先级排序的准确性、鲁棒性与易用性。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列或实验/预测的三维蛋白结构（支持从AlphaFold DB自动获取或调用Boltz-2预测）
analysis.output: 两个标量分数：Antigenicity Score（抗原性）和 Expression Efficiency Score（EES，表达可行性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：整合已有工具（BepiPred 3.0、AlphaFold DB、DeepSoluE等）并构建监督式meta-learner，在独立测试集上验证了双指标判别力（大效应量+统计显著），但未提出新基础模型、未解决长期开放难题（如构象表位物理建模瓶颈）、未开源代码/模型、无跨物种/跨表达系统泛化验证，远未达AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个成熟生物信息工具封装为端到端可部署流程，提升了疫苗研发中的实操效率，但核心方法无原创性突破，且缺乏代码开源与广谱泛化证据。

papers.title: A neural circuit mechanism for abstract free choice
papers.abstract: Making abstract free choices, such as arbitrary decisions between comparable options formed independently of specific motor plans, is central to everyday behavior. Yet, the neural mechanisms underlying free choice remain poorly understood. Using a delayed-response paradigm (N=80), we dissociated abstract goal selection (color choice) from later motor response mapping. We found that freely chosen goals elicit slower responses and lower goal-switching costs than instructed goals. We developed a hierarchical attractor network model in which symmetry-breaking attractor dynamics drive free goal selection, and conjunctive representations translate these abstract goals into motor output. Freely chosen goals converged on less extreme fixed points than instructed ones, accounting for their slower, more variable responses. Consistent with our model, EEG activity (N=30) sequentially encoded goal, conjunctive, and response representations, with conjunctive representations specifically coupled to behavioral variability. Our findings offer plausible circuit-level mechanisms for how abstract free choices are made and translated into action.

analysis.tldr: 通过行为实验、EEG记录和计算建模，揭示了大脑如何在不依赖具体动作计划的情况下做出抽象自由选择（比如随意选红色或蓝色），发现其由对称性破缺的吸引子动力学驱动，并经由‘目标-动作联合表征’转化为行为，解释了自由选择反应更慢、变异性更高的神经机制。
analysis.claim: 抽象自由选择并非随机噪声或高级意志指令，而是由层级化吸引子网络中对称性破缺的动力学过程实现，其行为特征（慢速、低切换成本、高变异性）可被联合表征的固定点稳定性差异定量解释。
analysis.input: 延迟响应范式下的颜色选择任务刺激（视觉提示+延迟期+反应期）及同步采集的EEG信号
analysis.output: 行为反应时/准确性/切换成本 + EEG时序编码模式（目标→联合→动作）+ 吸引子模型的固定点轨迹与稳定性参数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试行为与EEG数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最精细的、跨层次（行为→EEG→计算模型）的自由选择机制实证，但未涉及临床干预、实时解码或闭环控制，也未拓展至病人群体或真实世界决策场景，属于扎实的重大理论推进，尚未达到基石级BCI应用的高度（如90+分的瘫痪者自然行走/手写/语音合成）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将抽象自由选择锚定到可验证的神经动力学机制（对称性破缺吸引子+联合表征耦合变异性），证据链完整（N=80行为+N=30EEG+可解释模型），但属基础神经机制发现，非工程型脑机接口系统。

papers.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning for humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation within a single policy. A natural design choice is whether to use a single (unified) critic that estimates the combined value of all objectives, or separate (dual) critics with disjoint reward signals. We present a controlled comparison on the Unitree G1 humanoid (23 active DoF) in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, training loco-manipulation policies through a sequential curriculum spanning 13 levels from stationary reaching to walking with variable-orientation targets. In standardized evaluation, dual-critic policies reach targets 3.5$\times$ faster (6.5 vs. 22.6 simulation steps), achieve 2$\times$ higher throughput (14.3 vs. 7.0 validated reaches per 1,000 steps), and attain higher validated reach rates (65.2% vs. 53.8%) compared to the unified-critic policy. Notably, additional anti-gaming reward mechanisms provide no further improvement beyond the architectural change alone (60.9% vs. 65.2%). These results have direct implications for the emerging paradigm of RL fine-tuning of imitation-learned policies: when refining a pre-trained manipulation policy with RL, a unified critic risks suppressing the learned behavior through competing locomotion gradients. These findings demonstrate that critic architecture is a primary - and often overlooked - design choice in multi-objective humanoid RL, with greater impact than reward engineering on reaching efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在仿真环境中系统对比了双批评家（dual critic）和统一批评家（unified critic）架构对人形机器人行走-操作协同任务的影响，发现双批评家显著提升目标到达速度、吞吐量和成功率，且效果远超额外奖励工程，证明批评家结构本身是多目标强化学习中被低估的关键设计变量。
analysis.org: 未知作者独立研究（摘要未提所属机构，仅提及Unitree G1和NVIDIA Isaac Lab，但无署名单位）
analysis.claim: 在人形机器人loco-manipulation多目标RL中，采用分离式双批评家架构比统一批评家架构更有效，其性能增益远超奖励函数微调，且该架构选择是比奖励工程更关键的设计决策。
analysis.input: 仿真环境状态（含关节位置/速度、IMU、足底接触、目标位姿等）
analysis.output: 23自由度人形机器人的连续动作向量（关节力矩或位置控制指令）

papers.title: Viral Proteins Reveal Geometry of Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Protein language models are trained on highly imbalanced datasets, raising the question of how they represent underrepresented biological sequences. Using viral proteins as a case study across ESM model families, we identify a dominant nativeness axis in embedding space, aligned with masked reconstruction perplexity, that orders sequences from well-modeled cellular proteins through viral proteins to shuffled and random sequences. Scaling contracts this axis unevenly across viral families. Despite this, protein language model embeddings retain viral-specific signal: viral proteins remain linearly separable beyond zero-shot perplexity and shallow sequence features. Together, these results suggest that pLM representations are structured by a general notion of nativeness while preserving information specific to distinct biological groups.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用病毒蛋白作为探针，分析现有蛋白语言模型（如ESM系列）的嵌入空间结构，发现其中存在一条‘天然性轴’，能按建模难度线性排序细胞蛋白→病毒蛋白→乱序/随机序列，并证明尽管病毒蛋白在训练数据中占比极低，模型仍保留了可线性分离的病毒特异性信号。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型的嵌入空间被一条与掩码重建困惑度对齐的‘nativeness轴’主导，该轴反映序列生物学合理性，且模型在严重数据不平衡下仍保留病毒家族特异性表征。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 嵌入向量 + 线性可分性判据 + nativeness轴定位
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开序列数据库（UniRef、Pfam等），无真实实验数据或湿实验验证
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量的模型诊断研究，揭示了pLM表征的几何结构与数据偏差的关系，但未提出新模型、新训练范式或新预测任务，也未解决任何下游科学问题（如结构预测、功能注释、设计），属于对现有主流模型（ESM）的深度归因分析，贡献扎实但属二级分析而非一级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了对ESM类模型表征偏置的重要洞见，但未推动建模能力边界或解决实际生物学问题

papers.title: DynaHMRC: Decentralized Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration for Dynamic Tasks with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide robots with richer task understanding and adaptability, making them promising for coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems in long-horizon tasks. Despite this potential, several challenges remain underexplored: (1) Centralized LLM schedulers scale poorly as team size and environmental complexity increase. A single model must process excessive contextual information, and long-context approximation may degrade reasoning quality; (2) Existing task formulations insufficiently consider dynamic settings, while robust adaptation to evolving task conditions is essential for real-world deployment; (3) Domain-specific data scarcity limits specialized robotic reasoning, making proprietary general-purpose models inefficient for expert tasks. To address these limitations, we propose DynaHMRC, a decentralized framework in which each robot acts as a role-aware LLM agent. This design mitigates the single-model context bottleneck and supports flexible collaboration across heterogeneous team configurations. DynaHMRC organizes collaboration as a four-stage closed-loop process: self-description, task allocation with leadership bidding, leader election, and reflective execution, supported by executable robot interfaces. We further develop a benchmark covering three task families, four dynamic variations, and six team configurations to systematically study dynamic task modeling. In addition, we conduct an empirical analysis to guide the construction of domain-specific expert datasets and fine-tune pretrained LLMs to improve specialized competence. Experiments show that DynaHMRC achieves higher success rates than strong baselines with fewer action and communication steps, while demonstrating promising scalability trends as team size grows within the evaluated settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个去中心化的多机器人协作框架DynaHMRC，让每个异构机器人自带角色感知的LLM代理，通过自描述、竞标式任务分配、动态选领导、反思执行四步闭环协作，在动态变化的任务中减少通信和动作步数，同时构建了首个面向动态多机器人任务的系统性基准。
analysis.claim: 去中心化、角色感知的LLM代理架构能有效缓解大模型在异构多机器人动态协作中的上下文瓶颈、动态适应性不足与领域知识缺失问题。

analysis.output: 机器人本地生成的动作序列与协作通信消息（含任务认领、领导提名、执行反馈）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（未提具体硬件平台，仅提及executable robot interfaces，无真实机体验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或使用

papers.title: Action-Effect Memory Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present AEM, an Action-Effect Memory pretraining framework for robot manipulation that learns compact temporal representations from vision-action history. Unlike prior robot representation pretraining methods that mainly focus on single-frame visual encoding, AEM targets the temporal nature of manipulation, where the current observation alone is often insufficient under partial observability. AEM models manipulation as an action-driven interaction process by interleaving visual and action features and applying masked modeling to recover missing content from incomplete histories, thereby learning action-conditioned state evolution. The Mamba-encoded output of the final vision token is used as a compact history representation, serving as the global context for decoding and downstream control. This design preserves a single-vector temporal bottleneck while keeping inference efficient. We evaluate AEM with Diffusion Policy and Flow Policy. AEM consistently improves manipulation performance in both simulation and real-world settings, outperforming baselines across clean scenes, cluttered and random scenes, and non-Markovian tasks. Ablation studies further show that history-aware pretraining surpasses single-frame pretraining and direct frame stacking, while reducing inference latency and computational cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫AEM的预训练框架，通过建模视觉-动作历史序列（而非单帧图像）来学习紧凑的时序状态表征，用Mamba编码最后视觉token作为全局上下文，提升扩散策略和流策略在仿真与真实机器人上的操作性能。
analysis.claim: 对机器人操作任务，基于动作-效应记忆的时序历史预训练比单帧视觉预训练或简单帧堆叠更能建模非马尔可夫动态，且计算高效。

analysis.output: 紧凑的单向量历史状态表征（用于下游策略解码）

papers.title: DAQplugin: Deep Learning based Real-time Model Evaluation Plugin for ChimeraX
papers.abstract: Abstract Although an increasing number of protein structures are determined by cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), protein structure modeling frequently suffers from residue misassignments and sequence register shifts, particularly in regions with ambiguous density. Here, we present DAQplugin, a ChimeraX plugin that performs real-time evaluation of protein models against cryo-EM density maps using the deep-learning-based residue-wise model quality (DAQ) score. Unlike existing validation tools that are typically applied after model construction, DAQplugin enables real-time deep-learning-based validation during model building and refinement. To our knowledge, DAQplugin is the first tool that provides real-time deep-learning based validation of protein models for cryo-EM map within an interactive modeling environment. In addition to identifying potential modeling errors, DAQplugin also provides guidance for correcting sequence register shifts by suggesting alternative residue placements along the backbone. The computation in this plugin is designed to run efficiently on general CPUs without requiring GPU hardware. Using DAQplugin, users can perform deep-learning-based validation on standard laptops during interactive model building, model-map fitting, and refinement. DAQplugin is able to facilitate more accurate interpretation of cryo-EM density maps and improve the reliability assessment of protein structure models. Synopsis DAQplugin provides real-time residue-wise validation of protein models with cryo-EM maps in ChimeraX.

analysis.tldr: 这是一款集成到ChimeraX软件里的插件，能在用户手动搭建或调整蛋白质结构模型时，实时用深度学习打分（DAQ分数）评估每个氨基酸残基与冷冻电镜密度图的匹配质量，并提示可能的序列注册偏移，全部计算在普通CPU上完成，无需GPU。
analysis.claim: 首次在交互式建模环境（ChimeraX）中实现基于深度学习的、残基级、实时、CPU可运行的蛋白质模型-电镜密度图一致性验证。

analysis.output: 每个残基的DAQ质量分数 + 序列注册偏移建议（如某段主链上更优的残基类型/位置）

analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具型工作：填补了‘交互建模中实时DL验证’的空白，工程实现扎实（CPU轻量、嵌入ChimeraX、开源代码），但未提出新模型架构或新生物学发现，未构建新大规模训练数据集，也未在标准benchmark上超越现有离线工具（如Q-score、phenix.mtriage、DeepTracer等）的精度上限；其价值在于工作流整合而非方法论突破，分量介于扎实增量与窄领域改进之间。

papers.title: Gotta Grow Fast: Design and Benchmarking of a Tip Mount for High-Speed Vine Robots
papers.abstract: Soft, growing vine robots extend through tip eversion, a mechanism that enables navigation through cluttered environments. However, integrating cameras and other sensors at the tip is uniquely challenging because the material forming the tip is constantly renewed as the robot grows. This continual material turnover, combined with friction between internal layers, added tip weight, and fabric constriction, complicates sensor and tool mounting. These limitations hinder the deployment of vine robots for inspection and search tasks, where rapid growth while carrying tip-mounted sensors is essential. In this work, we present a triangular roller tip mount that reduces internal resistance during growth by rolling rather than sliding against the robot body. The design was refined through iterative failure analysis, enabling, for the first time, consistent eversion on a TPU-coated ripstop nylon vine robot. To quantitatively evaluate mount performance, we introduce a custom testbed that isolates tip mounting effects by measuring tail tension during eversion. Comparative experiments across multiple mount variants, including prior designs, show that our triangular roller mount achieves the lowest tail tension and most repeatable growth performance. These results establish both a validated tip mount design and a repeatable benchmarking framework for advancing sensor and tool integration in soft growing robots. CAD for the mount and testbed is available at: https://sprout-mitll.github.io/tip_mounts/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一种三角形滚轮式顶端支架，用于软体藤蔓机器人，解决了传感器在生长尖端安装时因材料持续翻转、层间摩擦和结构约束导致的生长阻力大、不稳定问题，并搭建了可量化评估顶端支架性能的专用测试台。
analysis.claim: 三角形滚轮式顶端支架能显著降低软体藤蔓机器人生长过程中的尾部张力，实现更稳定、更快速、可重复的尖端延伸，且该设计与配套测试方法构成首个可复现的顶端集成性能基准框架。
analysis.input: 藤蔓机器人本体（TPU涂层防撕尼龙）、驱动气压、机械约束条件
analysis.output: 尾部张力测量值、生长速率、生长稳定性（重复性）

papers.title: ProPlay: Procedural World Models for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents are expected to improve through interaction without external supervision, but this remains difficult in partially observable environments where agents must explore actively, learn from limited feedback, and decide when to trust prior experience. Existing LLM-agent methods often rely on memory or planning modules, yet they rarely close the loop between them to continually refine an internal understanding of environment dynamics. We introduce ProPlay, a procedural world model that supports procedure-level preplay, where agents can rehearse future procedural paths using the learned world knowledge. Rather than representing experience as isolated rules or low-level action constraints, ProPlay abstracts successful trajectories into procedures and organizes them in a procedure graph that captures causal transitions among task stages. Each transition is associated with a reliability record embedding to estimate its task-specific contribution from past outcomes. Before each episode, ProPlay simulates future procedural trajectories over known graph structures as structured soft guidance; after execution, it refines the graph using environment feedback. Experiments on public benchmarks show that ProPlay consistently improves environment understanding and self-evolution capability over strong baselines. Our code has been released in https://github.com/antman9914/proplay.

analysis.tldr: 提出ProPlay，一种面向LLM智能体的程序化世界模型，把成功任务轨迹抽象成可组合的‘程序’并构建成带可靠性评估的程序图，让智能体能在执行前预演程序路径、执行后用环境反馈动态更新图结构，从而在无监督交互中逐步提升对环境动态的理解和自我进化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub组织名antman9914无明确机构归属）

papers.title: Kine2Go: Kinematic dataset for the Unitree Go2 robot with diverse gaits and motions
papers.abstract: The recent popularity of robotics, combined with the steadily decreasing cost of robotic hardware, has lowered the entry barrier to robotics research and enabled rapid advancements in the field. One of the primary examples is the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, which is often used by researchers in the areas of locomotion, navigation, control, and others. Many researchers use the Go2 robot in combination with techniques like imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and behavioral cloning to allow machine learning systems to take full control of the robot. At the same time, many of those techniques require demonstration data consisting of the robot's kinematics information and actions applied to the motors. Obtaining such data is difficult, requires building complex pipelines, and can take significant time. To aid in those kinds of efforts, we present Kine2Go - a dataset with 800 diverse gait kinematics trajectory motion data for the Unitree Go2 robot, derived from 40 distinct policies. Our pipeline accepts data from various quadruped morphologies and translates them to a Go2-compatible format. Then we use Reinforcement Learning to train policies following a given motion, and finally we gather data from those policies, which grants robust, perturbed kinematic data with corresponding motor-level actions.

analysis.tldr: 发布了Unitree Go2四足机器人的800段多样化步态运动学轨迹数据集（含对应电机控制指令），由40个强化学习策略生成，支持跨形态动作迁移和扰动鲁棒性训练。
analysis.claim: Kine2Go是首个面向Unitree Go2的、大规模、多策略生成、带电机级动作标签的运动学轨迹数据集，可显著降低基于演示学习的四足控制研究门槛。
analysis.input: 强化学习策略生成的运动学目标轨迹（关节角度序列）
analysis.output: Unitree Go2兼容的关节角度时间序列 + 对应电机PWM/力矩指令

papers.title: DexLink Hand: A Compact, Affordable, 16-DOF Linkage-Driven Hand with Human-Like Dexterity
papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic hands face a longstanding trade-off among dexterity, compactness, and affordability. Particularly, high-degree-of-freedom designs typically demand complex actuation and transmission, hindering integration into human-scale forms. To address these challenges, this work presents a compact, low-cost linkage-driven anthropomorphic hand that achieves high dexterity, structural integration, and human-hand-like functionality. The hand integrates 20 joints driven by 16 independent actuators, with all actuation, sensing, and transmission components compactly embedded within a human-hand-sized structure. The resulting prototype weighs only 320g at a total cost below USD 400. To meet these objectives, a hybrid mechanical architecture combining planar and spatial linkage mechanisms is proposed, enabling decoupled multidirectional motion, biomimetic joint synergies, and high passive load-bearing capability. The thumb further incorporates biomimetic features supporting human-like reconfiguration and opposition movements. Through the coordinated integration of these mechanisms and structural layout, the prototype achieves a highly integrated design with anthropomorphic dexterity. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the hand achieves the maximum Kapandji score, reproduces all 33 Feix grasp types, and performs stable grasping and dexterous manipulation across a wide variety of daily objects and tools. These results validate the proposed hand as an affordable, compact, and mechanically efficient platform for dexterous manipulation, teleoperation, and robot learning in human-centered environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一款仅320克、成本低于400美元的16自由度联动式仿人机械手DexLink Hand，通过混合平面/空间连杆机构实现解耦多向运动和生物力学协同，实测能完成全部33种Feix抓取类型并达到最高Kapandji评分。

papers.title: Robust Frequency-Calibrated Virtual EEG Channel Generation from Four Frontal Electrodes for Wearable EEG Augmentation
papers.abstract: Low-channel wearable electroencephalography (EEG) is attractive for long-term monitoring, but four frontal electrodes provide only a sparse and spatially biased view of distributed scalp activity. We present FAVC-Net, a compact frequency-calibrated virtual-channel network that generates 13 unmeasured EEG channels from Fp1, Fp2, F7, and F8. The model combines shared multi-scale source encoding, source-state embeddings, target-conditioned signed source-block mixing, GATv2-based attention refinement, attention-consistent skip fusion, and weak Welch power spectral density calibration. Rather than treating sparse-to-dense EEG generation as a purely waveform-matching task, the framework jointly emphasizes amplitude fidelity, spectral allocation, channel-frequency texture, and robustness to corrupted wearable inputs. On the PRED+CT dataset, FAVC-Net achieved the best joint waveform-spectral operating point among neural and interpolation baselines. Its time-domain gains were modest, whereas log-spectral distance and PSD KL divergence were reduced by 30.09% and 37.98% relative to the strongest non-FAVC comparator. Under wearable-like source perturbations, the model preserved spectral fidelity and resisted spectral collapse. These results support virtual EEG channel generation as a dual-domain augmentation problem, while emphasizing that generated posterior and parietal channels should be interpreted as frequency-calibrated representations derived from sparse frontal measurements rather than as independent physical recordings.

analysis.tldr: 用4个前额电极的原始EEG信号，通过一个轻量神经网络FAVC-Net生成13个虚拟后部/顶部电极信号，重点不是拟合波形，而是校准频谱特性（如功率谱密度），让生成通道在频域上可靠可用。
analysis.claim: 稀疏前额EEG通道的虚拟扩展应被建模为双域（时域+频域）校准问题，而非单纯波形插值；频谱保真度比波形相似性更能决定生成通道在下游脑机接口任务中的实用性。
analysis.input: 4通道原始EEG时序信号（Fp1, Fp2, F7, F8）
analysis.output: 13个虚拟电极的EEG时序信号及其对应频谱表示（Welch PSD）

papers.title: Decoding the Grammar of Protein-Protein Interaction Interfaces with Multimodal Representations
papers.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPI) govern essential cellular processes, making the computational identification of interacting sites a central challenge in structural biology, with important implications for protein engineering and the development of targeted therapeutics. Existing prediction algorithms include sequence-based methods, which lack structural information, or structure-based approaches, which often struggle to effectively integrate evolutionary context. Here, we present ESM3-PPISites, a supervised model for residue-level classification of PPI interfaces, leveraging the multimodal representations of the ESM3 Protein Language Model. To ensure a bias-free evaluation, we adopt a stringent redundancy filtering protocol, systematically eliminating latent homology between the training data and a curated benchmark set in both sequence and structural space. Our findings demonstrate that while ESM3 largest proprietary version yields the highest predictive power, targeted fine-tuning of its small open-weight counterpart significantly narrows the performance gap. Requiring only primary sequence data at inference, ESM3-PPISites achieves unprecedented accuracy, vastly outperforming current approaches. Crucially, we demonstrate the practical impact of these predictions by integrating them as spatial restraints within the HADDOCK3 docking platform. When evaluated on an independent subset of 12 complexes from the Docking Benchmark v5, our prediction-guided pipeline strongly enhances the identification of near-native binding poses over ab initio blind docking, while reducing computational runtime by an order of magnitude. This framework establishes a scalable paradigm for high-throughput structural interactomics.

analysis.tldr: 用开源的ESM3小模型微调做蛋白质相互作用界面残基预测，只靠氨基酸序列就能高精度定位结合位点，并把预测结果当空间约束喂给HADDOCK3分子对接软件，显著提升对接成功率且快10倍。
analysis.claim: 基于ESM3多模态表征的轻量级微调模型ESM3-PPISites，仅需输入蛋白序列即可实现高精度、无偏倚的PPI界面残基预测，并能实质性提升下游分子对接任务的效率与准确性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（单链或双链）

papers.title: GalaxyVS: Exploring 100-Billion Compounds in Seconds
papers.abstract: We present GalaxyVS, a hardware-software co-designed virtual screening framework built to explore the 100-billion commercially accessible chemical space in seconds, deployed at the National Supercomputing Center in Tianjin. Built upon the dense vector retrieval paradigm of DrugCLIP, GalaxyVS bypasses the structural dependencies and computational overhead of classical docking to enable rapid screening against experimentally determined as well as geometrically feasible pockets on AlphaFold-predicted structures. To scale this paradigm to the 100-billion level, the system must overcome the significant computational burden of offline representation encoding, critical memory and I/O bottlenecks during online retrieval, and the risks of diversity collapse and precision loss within final screening results. Utilizing the heterogeneous supercomputing infrastructure, GalaxyVS accelerates the offline encoding through deep operator adaptations and resolves online retrieval bottlenecks via disk-native vector indexing coupled with in-memory staging to ensure both broad accessibility and high throughput. Concurrently, a two-stage refinement protocol effectively mitigates diversity collapse and ensures high-fidelity affinity ranking. Consequently, GalaxyVS achieves a daily scoring throughput of $1.5 \times 10^{16}$ target-ligand pairs, representing a six-orders-of-magnitude leap over previous supercomputing records. Driven by this throughput, we screened nearly 100,000 protein structures across six species against the 100-billion compound library in just 16 hours. The resulting comprehensive cross-species interaction landscape, GalaxyDB, will be openly released at \url{https://galaxyvs.drugclip.com}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GalaxyVS系统，利用国产超算硬件与软件协同优化，在16小时内对1000亿化合物库完成跨6个物种近10万个蛋白质靶点的虚拟筛选，产出大规模蛋白-配体互作图谱GalaxyDB。
analysis.claim: 通过硬件-软件协同设计的向量检索范式，首次实现百亿级化合物库在超算上秒级虚拟筛选，并支撑全物种尺度的蛋白-配体互作图谱构建。
