papers.title: VeriSpace: Spatially Grounded Action Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for robotic manipulation, but their reliability at test time remains limited by one-shot action prediction, where even small action errors can cause grasp failure, collision, or incorrect task progression. A natural alternative is to equip VLA systems with test-time verification, allowing multiple candidate actions to be proposed and evaluated before execution. However, reliable action verification is challenging because it requires not only distinguishing subtle geometric differences between candidate actions, but also assessing whether an action makes meaningful progress toward the task goal. We present VeriSpace, a 3D-aware action verifier for test-time action selection in VLA systems. VeriSpace evaluates candidate actions through two key components: Dual-Path 3D-Injected Scene Encoding, which constructs a scene representation that jointly preserves visual semantics and explicit 3D geometry, and Spatially-Grounded Action Reasoning, which evaluates each action by reasoning over task-relevant spatial relations, geometric validity, and expected goal progress. Together, these components enable more reliable discrimination between subtle yet outcome-critical action candidates while remaining fully compatible with existing VLA policies. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that VeriSpace consistently improves decision reliability over both underlying VLA policies and prior verification-based methods, yielding substantial gains in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫VeriSpace的3D感知动作验证模块，插在现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后面，在执行前对多个候选动作打分筛选，用双路径编码融合2D语义和3D几何，并基于空间关系、几何合理性与目标进展做推理，提升抓取等操作的可靠性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模3D空间关系与任务目标进展，可在不修改原有VLA策略的前提下，显著提升其在真实机器人操作中动作选择的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+多个候选动作（如末端位姿序列）
analysis.output: 每个候选动作的可靠性得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含real-world robotic manipulation tasks，但未披露数据来源/规模/采集方式
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有直觉且结构清晰的动作验证范式，双路径3D注入和空间接地推理设计合理，实验证明在多个基准和少量真实任务上优于基线，但缺乏开源代码、未公开模型/数据、未做消融验证核心模块贡献、未测试跨机体泛化，整体属扎实增量而非范式突破；远未达RT-2/Octo/π0等基石级工作（需多任务真机部署、大规模数据闭环、通用策略架构革新）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D空间理解与VLA决策解耦为可插拔验证模块，思路清晰且实证有效，但缺乏开源与深度消融，尚未构成方法论层面的突破。

papers.title: More with LESS -- Local Scene Representations for Tactile Imaging
papers.abstract: Tactile imaging seeks to reconstruct the internal structure of soft objects through touch sensing, with applications in medical diagnosis and robotic manipulation. Recent self-supervised learning approaches have shown promising results, but rely on global, unstructured representations and robot-controlled sensing, limiting generalization and practical use. We propose Local Encoder for Spatial Sensing (LESS), an object-centric tactile representation that exploits the local nature of touch. The tactile scene is modeled as a grid of recurrent encoders with local receptive fields, whose states are fused to reconstruct 2D or 3D images of internal structure. This compositional design enables strong generalization: models trained on single-inclusion phantoms accurately image objects with multiple inclusions and varying sizes. The local structure further supports spatial uncertainty estimation. In addition, we enable hand-held tactile imaging via external pose tracking and human-like palpation data, and extend tactile imaging to full 3D reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LESS的局部编码器架构，用网格化、带局部感受野的循环编码器建模触觉传感数据，实现不依赖机器人控制、支持手持操作的软组织内部结构（2D/3D）重建，并在多病灶、变尺寸目标上展现跨样本泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 触觉成像无需全局表征和机器人固定扫描，仅靠局部空间编码与状态融合即可实现鲁棒、可泛化、支持手持操作的内部结构重建。
analysis.input: 触觉传感器序列信号（如压电阵列或e-skin时序读数）+外部姿态跟踪数据（用于手持场景）
analysis.output: 2D或3D内部结构图像（如病灶位置/形状/深度分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人工采集的手持触觉+姿态数据；未使用真实机器人闭环操控数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉成像从机器人固定扫描范式解耦，引入局部编码+空间状态融合架构，在多病灶、尺寸变化等跨场景任务中验证泛化性，并构建首个支持手持操作的触觉成像基准；但未开源代码/模型，实验限于仿体（phantom）而非活体或临床数据，未与临床金标准对比，也未接入真实诊疗流程，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法范式（去机器人化+局部编码），但实证止步于仿体基准，缺乏临床/真实交互验证，属于扎实的领域推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: Trans2Occ: Voxel Occupancy Estimation and Grasp for Transparent Objects from Simulation to Reality
papers.abstract: Transparent objects remain challenging for robotic perception due to unreliable depth sensing caused by refraction and reflection. While prior approaches rely on multi-view reconstruction or depth completion, they are often difficult to scale or deploy in real-world robotic systems. In this paper, we present a practical framework for transparent object perception and manipulation based on single-view RGB input. Our approach predicts voxel-space occupancy directly from a single image, providing a geometry-aware representation that supports downstream robotic grasping. To enable large-scale training, we construct a simulation pipeline that generates paired RGB images and voxel occupancy annotations under diverse materials and lighting conditions. We demonstrate that the predicted occupancy representation is robust to domain shifts and transfers effectively from simulation to real-world robotic setups without fine-tuning. A simple rule-based grasping strategy built on top of the occupancy further achieves reliable grasp performance on transparent objects. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments show that our framework provides accurate 3D understanding and enables practical manipulation of transparent objects. These results suggest that single-view occupancy prediction offers a scalable and effective solution for transparent object perception in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 用单张RGB图直接预测透明物体的体素占据网格，不依赖深度传感器，在仿真中大规模训练后直接迁移到真实机械臂上做稳定抓取，不微调。
analysis.claim: 单视图RGB到体素占据的端到端映射，结合仿真生成的多样化透明物数据，可实现无需微调的sim2real迁移，并支撑基于几何的规则化抓取。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 三维体素占据网格（voxel occupancy grid）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435（仅用于真实场景评估，非输入依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人采集数据（训练纯仿真，测试用真实透明物但无标注/无fine-tuning）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了透明物单视图3D重建+抓取的端到端可行性验证，但未开源数据/仿真配置，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验（仅限透明杯/瓶类），无与SOTA方法（如RT-2、DROID）的对比，抓取策略是简单规则而非学习策略，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次验证了单RGB→体素占据→透明物抓取的sim2real通路，但工程闭环不完整（缺数据/配置开源）、泛化窄、未对标主流基线，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种在相关矩阵流形上计算Sliced-Wasserstein距离的新框架（PEMSW），并基于它构建了两种用于EEG解码的CorSW度量，最终实现了一个轻量、零推理开销的域泛化方法，在三个EEG数据集上验证了其对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者信息缺失；Hu Chen等无明确机构标识，GitHub用户名不构成机构归属）
analysis.claim: 在全秩相关矩阵流形上定义Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein（PEMSW）框架，并据此构造CorSW度量，可显著提升EEG解码在跨被试/跨设备等分布偏移下的域泛化性能，且不增加推理成本。
analysis.input: EEG信号段（预处理后计算出的全秩相关矩阵）
analysis.output: 域泛化后的分类预测（如运动想象类别、刺激类型等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；仅需标准公开EEG数据集（如BCI-IV 2a、SEED、OpenBMI）中的脑电片段及其标签
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的数学方法迁移工作：将SW距离推广到相关矩阵流形并适配两种新几何，提升了EEG域泛化性能，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、单次trial解码、跨天稳定性、临床部署），实验限于离线batch分类，无在线闭环、无神经反馈、无真实临床场景验证，与所列基石工作（如90+分的脑控仿生腿、高精度手写/语音解码）存在数量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知几何与Wasserstein工具链系统性迁移到EEG相关矩阵表示，在标准DG设定下取得稳健增益，但未突破BCI基础能力边界，属于方法论层面的优质整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: A Multi-Operator Mixed-Reality Interface for Multi-Robot Control and Coordination: Co-Located and Private Workspace Collaboration
papers.abstract: Multi-operator control of robot teams requires not only access to the same mission information, but also mechanisms for maintaining shared awareness and preventing conflicting interventions. Building on our previous HORUS interface (Holistic Operational Reality for Unified Systems) we present a mixed-reality interface that extends single-operator multi-robot supervision to collaborative multi-operator use. The system supports two complementary modes: a co-located shared workspace, in which operators observe and manipulate the same mini-map in the same physical location, and a private-workspace mode, in which operators work on the same mission through independently placed local workspaces. The architecture combines registration-driven scene construction, lightweight shared-session synchronization, and per-robot control leases to support collaborative monitoring, tasking, and teleoperation while preventing conflicting commands. We evaluated the approach in a human-subject study with 36 participants (18 pairs) controlling three Nova Carter mobile robots in two search environments. The performance of the objective task was comparable across the two modes, indicating that both modes supported effective mission execution. However, the co-located shared workspace significantly improved perceived collaboration, shared understanding, and handoff clarity, and was the preferred collaborative mode. These results indicate that physically co-locating the MR workspace improves how operators coordinate even when the underlying robot-control tools remain unchanged.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个支持多人协同操控多机器人团队的混合现实界面，包含共处一地共享工作区和各自独立工作区两种模式，通过注册驱动建模、轻量会话同步和机器人控制租约机制避免指令冲突，并在36人真机实验中验证共处模式显著提升操作员协作感知和任务交接清晰度。
analysis.claim: 物理上共处一地的混合现实工作区能显著提升多操作员对多机器人系统的协作质量，即使底层机器人控制逻辑完全不变。
analysis.input: 操作员手势/注视/语音指令（隐含）、机器人传感器数据流（如定位、图像）、任务地图与状态
analysis.output: 机器人动作指令（通过租约机制下发）、多操作员协同状态可视化（共享mini-map、控制权标识等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时数据（定位、状态、传感器反馈）用于MR场景注册与同步；但未使用离线机器人行为数据训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在真机多机器人协同控制中系统对比MR共处vs私有工作区对人类协作指标的影响，实验设计严谨（36人/18对/双环境/三机器人），但未引入新AI模型、新控制算法或新机器人硬件，也未解决多操作员冲突消解的底层自动化问题（仍依赖租约人工协调），影响力限于人机交互与远程操作工程实践层面，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或通用智能体层级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把MR界面设计、会话同步与租约机制组合落地到真实多机器人协同任务中，实证了空间共处对人类协作的增益，但无算法/模型/科学层面新发现。

papers.title: MCR-Bionic Hand: Anatomical Structural Priors for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic hands are usually formulated as high dimensional active control systems governed by degrees of freedom, actuation, and algorithms. Human hand dexterity, however, is partly encoded in the physical architecture of bones, ligaments, tendons, aponeuroses, and intrinsic muscles. This work describes that contribution as two linked forms of structural intelligence: structural prior generation, in which wrist to finger tenodesis, FDS/FDP routing, and the dorsal extensor hood transform low dimensional posture inputs into default grasp configurations and PIP to DIP coordination; and muscle mediated modulation, in which extrinsic muscles, lumbricals, and interossei regulate MCP posture, distal stability, fingertip force paths, and contact states around that default state. Based on this framework, MCR-Bionic Hand is developed as a 1:1 musculoskeletal biomimetic hand integrating a two row eight bone wrist, cross wrist tendons, anatomical flexor routing, volar plate and collateral ligament constraints, the dorsal extensor hood, and intrinsic muscle pathways within one body. Functional demonstrations and geometric mechanical models show that wrist posture induces multi joint pre shaping, the extensor hood maps PIP posture to a coupled DIP response, and intrinsic plus pathways modulate distal stability and fingertip action direction after grasp formation. Contact rich tasks, including coin rotation, pen transfer, dorsal coin flipping, and cube manipulation, show that MCR-Bionic links low dimensional state generation with fine post contact modulation. These results suggest that anatomical biomimetics is valuable not for visual similarity, but for identifying human hand structures that perform part of control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于人体解剖结构先验的仿生灵巧手MCR-Bionic Hand，通过复现手腕-手指腱联动（tenodesis）、屈肌走行、伸肌腱鞘和内在肌通路等生物力学结构，使低维姿态输入即可自动生成多关节协同预抓握，并在接触后实现指尖力向与稳定性的精细调节。
analysis.claim: 人体手部的解剖结构本身承载部分控制功能（即‘结构智能’），复现这些结构可将高维主动控制问题降维为低维状态生成+局部肌肉介导调制。
analysis.input: 低维腕部/手掌姿态指令（如腕屈伸、尺偏）
analysis.output: 多指关节协同运动轨迹、指尖接触力方向与稳定性状态
analysis.robot_dependency: MCR-Bionic Hand 自研硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自建真实机器人平台采集的接触丰富任务视频与运动学数据（coin旋转、笔传递等），未使用外部大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的跨任务真机验证（4个接触敏感操作），首次系统拆解并工程实现‘结构先验→预成型→肌肉调制’三级生物控制范式，但未开源硬件设计/控制代码，未对比SOTA学习型灵巧手（如Shadow, Allegro或DiffusionPolicy驱动的手），也未量化控制维度压缩率或任务成功率提升幅度，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与基线对比，但解剖结构驱动的控制降维思路有明确实证支撑，不是概念包装

papers.title: ADAPT: Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training for Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humanoids deployed in human-centered environments must handle force-interactive tasks, where external contacts introduce unexpected disturbances that disrupt locomotion accuracy and stability. Existing learning-based approaches rely on broad domain randomization, task-specific force objectives, or learning-based force estimators from motion history, each of which compromises accuracy, task transferability, or out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. We present Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training (ADAPT), a framework that equips humanoid policies with a physically grounded disturbance observer. The core of ADAPT is an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates residual force/torque online with the accessible robot dynamics, without requiring force/torque sensors. Fed directly into the policy, the estimated disturbances give the humanoid an explicit, physics-derived sense of external force/torque that can generalize across diverse unseen scenes. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that ADAPT achieves accurate disturbance prediction and stronger robustness than a proprioception-only baseline under torso perturbations, standing pushes, and asymmetric hand payloads, with improved velocity tracking even on OOD disturbances. Moreover, ADAPT enables penalizing inferred disturbances at lower-body joints to encourage lighter locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ADAPT框架，让双足机器人不用力/扭矩传感器，仅靠自身动力学模型和关节状态，实时在线估计外界施加的力和力矩，并把估计结果直接喂给控制策略，从而提升在推搡、不对称负重等扰动下的行走稳定性和速度跟踪精度。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，且姓名无明显机构标识；非英伟达/DeepMind/ETH/CMU/清华/浙大等常见头部团队署名风格）
analysis.claim: 无需力/扭矩传感器，仅通过解析式全身体动力学建模即可在线高精度估计外部扰动力/力矩，并使策略获得跨扰动类型泛化的鲁棒行走能力。
analysis.input: 机器人关节位置、速度、力矩（即本体感知信号）及已知动力学参数
analysis.output: 六维残差力/力矩估计值（作用于质心或躯干），以及由此增强的底层运动策略输出（关节力矩/目标轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实G1机器人上的扰动实验数据（推 torso、standing push、asymmetric hand payload），但未说明是否使用真实扰动力标签训练（因强调‘无需力传感器’，故估计监督应为隐式/解析式）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了无外力传感器下扰动在线估计这一长期实用瓶颈，实机验证覆盖多种扰动类型且有明确性能提升（如OOD扰动下速度跟踪改善），但未开源代码/模型，未与H2O/GR00T等SOTA端到端框架对比，也未展示跨机体泛化或部署闭环（如自主避推+行走），属显著工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证的物理驱动扰动估计方法，工程价值明确，但缺乏开源与横向基准对比，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
papers.abstract: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把经典最优控制（如轨迹优化）插进视频生成模型的推理流程里，先提取简化的世界状态，再在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后据此生成视频，目标是让生成的物体运动更安全、平滑、高效、符合物理规律。
analysis.claim: 将最优控制显式嵌入视频生成的推理链中，通过在连续流形上建模物理与任务约束，实现物理一致、可优化的视频世界生成。
analysis.input: 初始图像+语言/几何任务指令（如目标位置、编辑意图）
analysis.output: 物理合理的视频帧序列（含隐式动力学轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成或公开视频数据集训练基础生成器
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真视频生成范畴的算法嫁接（最优控制+扩散/VAE视频模型），无真实机器人闭环、无跨机体验证、无动力学辨识、无真实物理交互评估；相比World Models/DreamerV3等真正构建可决策、可泛化、可闭环的具身世界模型的里程碑工作，它既不建模动作-状态闭环，也不支持策略执行，仅输出开环视频——属于‘物理启发的视频后处理’层级，分量远低于所有参照基石（最低档Cosmos 1.0=93）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把最优控制术语嵌入视频生成流程，但未建立具身智能所需的感知-规划-动作闭环，也未验证任何真实物理交互能力，本质是物理约束下的视频渲染增强，非世界模型演进。

papers.title: RoboStressBench: Benchmarking VLM Robustness to Physical Visual Stress in Embodied Scenes
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and are increasingly deployed in embodied AI systems, where reliable perception under real conditions is essential. However, existing benchmarks assess VLMs using clean images or isolated perturbations rather than stresses caused by physical scene formation. This design has two limitations: it covers only a narrow subset of everyday visual stresses, and some perturbations rarely appear in realistic embodied scenes. This gap raises a fundamental question: how can we define visual stress in a principled way that captures the diverse factors encountered in physical environments? To address this question, we formulate visual perception from an inverse graphics perspective and introduce RoboStressBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness to physical visual stress in embodied scenes. Inspired by the physical rendering equation, RoboStressBench decomposes visual stress into four physically grounded dimensions: Material (M), Viewpoint (V), Lighting (L), and Geometry (G). This design enables RoboStressBench to cover a broad range of visual stresses in real-world environments, while allowing controlled analysis of their effects on VLM capabilities such as visual recognition, reasoning, and planning. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs, we identify stress-specific failure modes and reveal that different physical factors degrade different embodied capabilities, which are often obscured by aggregate accuracy. We further introduce a stress-aware agentic solver that detects visual stressors and invokes visual-editing skills before reasoning, improving robustness in high-stress scenarios. Overall, RoboStressBench provides a principled evaluation framework for diagnosing and improving VLM perception under real-world physical stress, supporting the development of more reliable embodied AI systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没做新模型或机器人控制，而是构建了一个叫RoboStressBench的评测基准，专门测试视觉语言模型（VLM）在真实物理场景中面对材质、视角、光照、几何这四类物理成像压力时的鲁棒性，并提出一个带压力感知的推理流程来缓解问题。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言模型在具身场景中的鲁棒性缺陷不能靠传统图像扰动评测暴露，必须从物理成像过程（逆图形学）出发，按材质、视角、光照、几何四个可解释维度系统建模视觉压力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令（含问答/推理/规划类任务）
analysis.output: 语言响应（如答案、动作描述、推理链）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真渲染生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将逆图形学四维分解系统引入VLM鲁棒性评测，但纯仿真、无真机验证、无新模型架构、无跨机体/跨任务部署证据；仅提供压力分类+少量编辑修复策略，属扎实但窄域的评测方法论贡献，远未达RT-2/Octo等基石级工作对具身智能范式的推动量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把逆图形学概念落地为可评测维度，但仍是benchmark层面的工具性工作，未触及感知-动作闭环或真实部署瓶颈

papers.title: MoE-Bind: Guiding De Novo Protein Binder Generation with Sparse Experts
papers.abstract: De novo protein binder design has been dominated by structure-based pipelines that require known three-dimensional target conformations and consume substantial compute and generation time per design, limiting their throughput and accessibility for routine large-scale binder exploration. Sequence-only generative models promise a faster and lighter alternative, yet existing systems remain uniformly dense and frequently reintroduce structural computation at inference, undermining the core advantages they were intended to deliver. Across the broader language modelling community, transformers have meanwhile transitioned from fully dense designs to sparse Mixture-of-Experts architectures that decouple capacity from per-token compute, a shift that has yet to reach sequence-only protein binder generation. We present MoE-Bind, an autoregressive protein binder generator that, for the first time in this domain, combines Multi-head Latent Attention with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts feed-forward network and is evaluated under two independent structure predictors, Boltz-2 and AlphaFold2-Multimer. Despite activating less than half the per-token parameters of compute-matched dense baselines, MoE-Bind matches or exceeds them on full-length receptor-conditioned binder generation on a leakage-free Docking Benchmark 5.0 evaluation, transfers without peptide-specific training to short-peptide design, and reduces training and inference compute by a large margin. Routing analysis on generated binders reveals interpretable expert specialization at both the individual amino acid and biochemical group level, a structured expert-token alignment not previously reported for natural-language MoE models. These results show that sparse architectural design, rather than scale, can deliver fast, structure-free, and interpretable protein binder generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoE-Bind模型，首次在纯序列蛋白结合体生成任务中引入稀疏Mixture-of-Experts架构，不依赖靶标三维结构输入，用更少的每token计算量实现与密集模型相当甚至更好的结合体生成效果，并揭示专家模块在氨基酸和生化基团层面的可解释分工。
analysis.claim: 稀疏MoE架构而非单纯扩大模型规模，能在不依赖靶标结构、不引入推理时结构预测的前提下，实现高效、可解释且泛化性强的从头蛋白结合体生成。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白受体序列（无三维结构）
analysis.output: 结合体蛋白完整氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MoE稀疏架构成功迁移到纯序列蛋白结合体生成任务，在Docking Benchmark 5.0上实证了计算减半、性能持平/略优、跨肽段泛化能力及专家可解释性，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与ESM-3/RFdiffusion等主流生成框架做公平对比，也未验证生成结合体的真实实验活性（仅依赖AlphaFold2-Multimer/Boltz-2结构预测打分），属扎实的架构创新+领域适配，但未达基石级方法论突破或实验闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需实验验证和开源复现，本文是高质量架构迁移，但停留在计算评估层面，暂未形成闭环证据链。

papers.title: Whole-proteome structure/function prediction in Uropathogenic E. coli reveals previously missed host-microbe and microbe-phage interaction pathways
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of high-throughput sequencing technologies has vastly increased the number of known protein sequences, but the experimental characterization of their structures and functions lags behind. This gap in knowledge impedes our understanding of biological mechanisms of these proteins, hinders the interpretation of high-throughput experiments, and exposes a significant challenge in modern biology: deducing the structural and functional information of proteins based on their sequences. Most computational approaches rely on homology with well-annotated proteins, yet many proteins lack identifiable homologues, reducing the power of this approach. Here, we integrated cutting-edge protein structure and function prediction methods to develop a complete sequence-structure-function pipeline that predicts structures and functions based on primary sequences. We applied this pipeline to predict the structure and function of all proteins in Escherichia coli UTI89, a model strain of uropathogenic E. coli. Based on the predicted functions, we performed enrichment analysis on the whole genome and revealed the possible roles and related biological mechanisms of poorly annotated proteins in this organism. Moreover, the performance of our pipeline was further validated through detailed case studies of the UTI89_C0931 and ybtS genes. Finally, we compiled the UTI89 structure and function database (https://seq2fun.dcmb.med.umich.edu/UTI89), offering it as a community resource to aid researchers in elucidating the roles of unannotated proteins in uropathogenic E. coli. This database aims to bridge critical knowledge gaps in microbial pathogenicity and resistance, enhancing our capacity to tackle emerging health threats.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2+ESM-2等现有AI模型组装了一个端到端流程，预测了尿路致病性大肠杆菌UTI89菌株全部蛋白质的结构和功能，并基于预测结果做了通路富集分析，发现了一些此前被忽略的宿主-细菌/细菌-噬菌体互作通路，建了一个公开数据库。
analysis.claim: 整合当前最优的开源蛋白结构与功能预测工具，构建全基因组尺度的序列→结构→功能推断流水线，可系统性揭示病原菌中低注释蛋白的生物学角色及新型互作通路。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 三维结构预测结果 + 功能注释（GO/KEGG/EC等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 未提出新模型或算法，纯属工程化集成（AF2+ESMFold+DeepFRI等），验证仅靠富集分析和两个基因案例，缺乏实验验证、跨物种泛化、消融实验或性能对比基准；数据库有实用价值但属衍生资源，未解决结构预测本身的核心瓶颈（如低同源性/复合物/动态构象），分量远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效复用现有SOTA工具完成特定病原菌的全蛋白注释，但无方法创新、无机制验证、无普适性突破，属于高质量应用型工作而非领域推进。

papers.title: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
papers.abstract: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALL-WM，用语义事件（而非固定时长的动作块）作为视频-语言-动作联合建模的基本单元，重构了世界动作模型的预训练范式，试图解决语言目标、视觉动态和控制频率在时间粒度上的根本错配问题。

papers.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.abstract: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware methods address this strictly as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive gravity-axis stretching and amodal shape resampling. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 从单张RGB图像重建出物理上稳定、可直接用于机器人仿真的3D场景（含多个物体的精确位姿、非穿透支撑关系和可微物理兼容形状），核心是把物理引擎嵌入生成流程做实时诊断反馈，而非仅后处理修正。
analysis.claim: 将物理仿真引擎作为生成式重建过程中的诊断测量工具，通过重力下的穿透/支撑失败信号驱动形状拉伸与无模态重采样，从而端到端获得仿真就绪的组合式3D场景。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 物理稳定的组合式3D场景（含每个物体的mesh、位姿、支撑关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成或单图重建数据集（如ScanNet、Objaverse等隐含推断）

papers.title: Implicit Drifting Policy: One-Step Action Generation via Conditional Expert Geometry
papers.abstract: Generative action policies based on diffusion or flow matching excel in behavior cloning, yet their iterative sampling is prohibitive for high-frequency robot control. While recent one-step formulations alleviate this latency, they inevitably discard the intermediate trajectory evolution that provides crucial action correction. Directly recovering this mechanism by explicitly estimating a training-time drifting field is mathematically ill-posed due to extreme conditional demonstration sparsity. We introduce Implicit Drifting Policy (IDP), a one-step imitation learning framework that brings the training-time correction of Drifting into policy learning without explicit vector field estimation. IDP extracts a conditional expert geometry from the local variation of observation-similar expert actions, and compares it against a global reference geometry to isolate condition-specific constraints. This local geometric structure adaptively weights a scalar potential objective. Combined with an expert-proximal terminal evaluation, IDP directly enforces manifold constraints on the one-step generator during training. Extensive evaluations across 2D, 3D, and real-world manipulation tasks show IDP effectively maintains adherence to valid action manifolds, improving upon explicit drifting methods and achieving competitive performance with strong one-step baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫IDP的一次性动作生成方法，不用迭代采样，也不用显式估计漂移场，而是通过比较局部专家动作的几何结构和全局参考几何来隐式建模动作修正机制，从而在单步生成中保持动作落在合理动作流形上。
analysis.claim: 无需显式建模漂移向量场，仅通过条件化专家几何结构的局部-全局对比，即可在单步生成中隐式注入训练时的动作修正机制，保障生成动作满足物理与任务约束的流形结构。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如图像/状态）+语言或任务指令（摘要未明说但'conditional expert geometry'暗示需任务条件）
analysis.output: 单步动作向量（非轨迹，是直接输出的控制动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（2D/3D manipulation）及真实机械臂（摘要提real-world manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量专家演示数据（behavior cloning setting），但未说明是否需真实机器人采集的多场景长程交互数据，仅提'expert actions'，属中等依赖

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了单步生成中丢失轨迹演化信息的问题，但缺乏开源、消融和跨平台泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Towards Interactive Video World Modeling: Frontiers, Challenges, Benchmarks, and Future Trends
papers.abstract: With rapid development of large language models and diffusion-based content generation, world modeling has attracted increasing research attention, benefiting various downstream domains such as game engines, embodied AI, autonomous driving, etc. Through explicitly incorporating user actions into world state transition, recent literature empowers world modeling with interactivity in an action-conditioned video or 3D generation paradigm, further enhancing controllability over world evolutions and facilitating users to freely traverse, manipulate, navigate, and personalize the state evolution. In this paper, we aim to systematically review recent research trends, technical developments, evaluation benchmarks, and also propose future potential directions in interactive world modeling. Specifically, we first summarize recent efforts and trends in terms of application scenarios, world state evolution, and scene modality. Afterwards, we delve into three crucial technical challenges, including action-conditioned controllability, long-horizon interactions and memory, and action-following responsiveness for real-time interactivity. Furthermore, we also thoroughly compare existing benchmarks and metrics in four specific application fields: open-world exploration, game engine, autonomous driving, and robotics. Finally, we discuss several promising future directions in achieving next-generation interactive world modeling. The corresponding repository is publicly available at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Awesome-Interactive-World-Model.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了‘交互式视频世界建模’这一新兴方向的定义、技术挑战、现有基准和未来趋势，并整理了一个开源资源库（Awesome List），但未提出新模型、新算法、新数据集或新实验验证。

analysis.output: 视频帧序列或3D场景演化（概念性）

papers.title: Deep Sleep Classification via EEG Signal Criticality: A Passive BCI Approach for Sleep-Improvement Neurofeedback
papers.abstract: Automated sleep staging is a fundamental application of passive Brain-Computer Interfaces (pBCI), decoding spontaneous neural states to enable closed-loop interventions independent of user intent. This study evaluates criticality features derived from Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA) for the specific identification of deep sleep (N3). We analyzed $347,232$ EEG epochs from $290$ older women using UMAP manifold learning to visualize state transitions. Subsequently, six classifiers were benchmarked via 10-fold cross-validation, using balanced accuracy to determine the optimal "state-sensing" engine for neurofeedback.Naive Bayes achieved the highest mean balanced accuracy ($87.17\% \pm 0.24\%$), significantly outperforming a fully connected deep neural network (FNN: $81.58\%$) and Random Forest ($80.97\%$). Linear models (LDA: $57.21\%$; SVM: $51.01\%$) performed poorly, indicating that DFA-derived criticality features reside on a distinct, non-linear manifold. Probabilistic decoding of EEG criticality provides a high-accuracy sensing mechanism for pBCIs. This robust classification pipeline supports the development of state-dependent neurofeedback, such as targeted auditory stimulation, to enhance cognitive recovery.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG信号的临界性特征（基于去趋势波动分析DFA）识别老年人深度睡眠阶段N3，通过UMAP可视化和六种分类器比较，发现朴素贝叶斯效果最好（87.17%平衡准确率），为被动式神经反馈提供高精度状态感知模块。
analysis.org: 日本国立信息学研究所
analysis.claim: EEG信号的临界性特征（DFA标度指数）能以高精度、低模型复杂度特异性识别深度睡眠N3阶段，优于主流深度网络与集成方法，适配资源受限的被动BCI神经反馈闭环。

analysis.output: 深度睡眠（N3）二分类概率或标签

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Spiking Neural Networks for Intracortical Neural Decoding using Membrane Potential Alignment
papers.abstract: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces suffer from day-to-day neural signal shifts that degrade pretrained decoders. Existing unsupervised adaptation methods rely on deep recurrent or adversarial architectures that are too computationally expensive for implantable hardware. We propose Membrane Potential Alignment (MPA), a test-time adaptation method for spiking neural networks that realigns a pretrained decoder to shifted recordings by only matching membrane potential distributions via KL divergence. By restricting updates to low-rank (LoRA) weights, MPA adapts fewer than 9% of parameters. On a non-human primate reaching task spanning over one month, MPA achieves performance competitive with the state-of-the-art NoMAD method, while using a simpler architecture and finer temporal resolution (4 ms vs. 20 ms). These results show that efficient SNN-based test-time adaptation is a practical path toward long-term, recalibration-free brain-computer interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫膜电位对齐（MPA）的方法，在测试时仅用KL散度对齐预训练脉冲神经网络解码器的膜电位分布，通过低秩更新不到9%参数，就能适应灵长类脑信号日间漂移，实现无需重新校准的长期BCI运行。
analysis.claim: 仅通过对齐膜电位分布并限制为低秩权重更新，即可在测试时高效适配脉冲神经网络解码器以应对皮层信号日间漂移，且计算开销极低、适合植入式硬件。
analysis.input: 皮层微电极记录的脉冲序列（spike trains）
analysis.output: 运动意图解码结果（如手部轨迹或速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖非人灵长类长期（>1个月）真实神经记录数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实灵长类长期神经数据上验证了轻量级SNN测试时适配的有效性，性能媲美NoMAD但更省算力，属显著贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未跨被试/跨任务验证，未展示临床适用性，远未达基石级（如90+分）所要求的临床闭环、多用户泛化或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实但封闭，是面向植入式BCI的务实工程推进，而非概念包装或灌水，但因不可复现和泛化有限，暂不构成真突破

papers.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas explicit reasoning through textual chains, pixel-level subgoals, or action search can improve planning but incurs substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that moves deliberation into the latent space of a vision-language model (VLM). PearlVLA separates VLM meta-query representations into a fixed visual grounding branch and an iterative latent plan branch. At each refinement round, a plan-conditioned world query probes a lightweight frozen latent world model for an action-free future observation latent, which is fed back to guide plan refinement. A future-guided RefineNet then applies scheduled residual updates to progressively refine a coarse semantic draft into a fine-grained latent action plan. The refined plan after K rounds is then decoded in parallel into an action chunk for low-latency execution. We further introduce Causal Refinement-Grouped Process-Reward RL to optimize the latent refinement process with rewards from longer-horizon imagined futures induced by latent plan edits. Empirical evaluations on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that PearlVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出PearlVLA框架，把传统需要显式文本或像素级推理的机器人规划过程，压缩到视觉语言模型的隐空间里反复迭代优化一个‘隐式动作计划’，最后并行解码成动作块，从而兼顾规划质量与执行低延迟。
analysis.claim: 将显式多步推理迁移至VLM隐空间中进行轻量、可微、迭代的语义计划精炼，能显著提升VLA模型在长程任务中的泛化性与执行效率平衡。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）

papers.title: STEM: Semantic Target Search and Exploration using MAVs in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract: Autonomous target search is crucial for deploying Micro Aerial Vehicles (MAVs) in emergency response and rescue missions. Existing approaches either focus on 2D semantic navigation in structured environments -- which is less effective in complex 3D settings, or on robotic exploration in cluttered spaces -- which often lacks the semantic reasoning needed for efficient target search. This paper overcomes these limitations by proposing a novel framework that utilizes a semantically-guided viewpoint planner to minimize target search and exploration time in unstructured 3D environments using an MAV. Specifically, we develop a combinatorial planner that generates efficient semantic exploration plans by prioritizing viewpoints that likely lead to the target. To guide the planner towards the target, an active perception pipeline is developed that propagates semantic priorities of observed objects into neighboring frontier voxels for computing semantic information gains of frontier viewpoints. In addition, we demonstrate how LLM-based similarity scores can be leveraged as semantic priority input to our pipeline. Evaluations in two distinct simulation environments show that the proposed method consistently outperforms baselines by quickly finding the target while maintaining reasonable exploration times. Real-world experiments with an MAV further demonstrate the method's ability to handle practical constraints like limited battery life, small sensor range, and semantic uncertainty.

analysis.tldr: 用语义优先级引导无人机在杂乱3D环境中高效搜索目标，通过将视觉识别结果传播到邻近前沿体素来计算语义信息增益，并用LLM相似度打分作为语义优先输入，在仿真和真实无人机上验证了比基线更快找到目标且兼顾探索效率。
analysis.claim: 语义优先的主动感知+组合式视角规划能显著缩短无人机在无结构杂乱3D环境中的目标搜索时间，同时保持合理探索覆盖。

analysis.output: 下一最优飞行视角（6DoF位姿）

analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需预训练视觉模型（如CLIP）和少量目标类别标注，无真实场景采集数据

papers.title: World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications
papers.abstract: World models, internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment, have emerged as a central paradigm in the pursuit of artificial general intelligence, enabling agents to predict, plan, and reason within learned representations. Despite rapid progress across reinforcement learning, robotics, autonomous driving, and video generation, the field lacks a unified framework integrating its diverse architectural choices, training methods, reasoning mechanisms, and application settings. This survey addresses that gap with a multi-axis taxonomy organized along four dimensions: (i) architecture, encompassing representation format, dynamics formulation, input modality, learning paradigm, and downstream application; (ii) methodological family, including state-space and recurrent approaches, transformer-based models, diffusion-based generators, physics-informed networks, and language-augmented multimodal systems; (iii) reasoning strategy, covering imagination-based planning, latent policy learning, counterfactual reasoning, and planning under uncertainty; and (iv) application domain, spanning robotics, autonomous driving, video prediction, multimodal agents, reinforcement learning, scientific modeling, medical imaging, educational measurement, and business and finance. Tracing the field from early cognitive-science foundations to milestone systems such as PlaNet, the Dreamer family, MuZero, Sora, Cosmos, and Genie, we examine how these dimensions interact and highlight the recent convergence of chain-of-thought reasoning with world-model imagination. We review evaluation protocols and benchmarks, identify persistent challenges such as compounding prediction errors, sim-to-real transfer, and fragmented evaluation, and outline future directions toward unified multimodal world models, foundation-scale interactive simulators, and safe deployment in safety-critical domains.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了‘世界模型’领域的架构类型、训练方法、推理范式和应用场景，建立了四维分类体系，但未提出新模型、新算法或新数据，也未做任何实验验证。
analysis.claim: 世界模型领域亟需统一的多维分类框架以整合碎片化进展，本文提供首个覆盖架构、方法、推理与应用四轴的综合性 taxonomy。
analysis.input: 已有论文与系统（如 Dreamer、MuZero、Sora 等）的技术描述
analysis.output: 分类体系/综述性知识图谱/挑战与方向总结
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯文献分析
analysis.significance_reason: 纯综述，无新模型/代码/数据/实验，未解决任何具体技术瓶颈（如 compounding error 或 sim2real），分类框架未经实证检验，对工程落地或理论突破均无直接推动；相比 World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，它只是二手整理，分量远低于最低档（40分门槛）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是文献归类手册，不是研究推进，无法替代原始论文，也不构成独立技术贡献。

papers.title: OSCAR: Omni-Embodiment Skeleton-Conditioned World Action Model for Robotics
papers.abstract: We present OSCAR, a precise action-conditioned video world model that generalizes across different robot embodiments and enables robot policy evaluation. Existing video world models face three main challenges for real-world robot evaluation: limited scenario diversity in current robot training datasets, imprecise action following, and poor generalization across embodiments for broad adoption. We tackle these challenges from two perspectives. At its core is a large-scale standardized data pipeline that curates, filters, and deduplicates broad robotics and egocentric human datasets, yielding a clean joint-training dataset that spans diverse tasks, scenarios, actions, and robot embodiments. To condition the video model, we adopt 2D kinematic skeleton rendering as a unified conditioning representation that generalizes across different robot arms or even human hands. We finetune the Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model on a single GH200 GPU. Our model achieves significant improvement on action following, appearance quality, and motion consistency, compared to existing baselines, which either have a much larger model size or require more GPUs. We further deploy OSCAR to evaluate robot policies from RoboArena. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significant correlation between our virtual policy evaluation in OSCAR and real-world evaluation, paving the way for the future where robot policies can be purely evaluated in virtual generated worlds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了OSCAR模型，用2D骨骼渲染作为统一条件输入，训练一个能跨不同机器人本体生成高质量动作条件视频的世界模型，并用它在虚拟环境中评估真实机器人策略的性能，发现虚拟评估结果与真实世界表现高度相关。
analysis.claim: 用骨骼条件化视频世界模型可实现跨机器人本体的动作精准建模与策略虚拟评估，且虚拟评估结果与真实世界性能显著相关。
analysis.input: 2D骨骼序列+动作指令（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动作条件下的未来多帧视频（即预测的视觉世界演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模混合机器人与人眼视角数据集（含真实机器人轨迹），但未说明是否含闭环真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出骨骼条件化世界模型思路有一定启发性，验证了跨本体视频生成与策略评估的相关性，但未开源代码/模型/数据，无真机部署，无消融实验，未超越任何基石模型（如Cosmos 1.0=93）的技术深度或实证强度，属扎实但窄域的增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：思路合理、实验有相关性支撑，但缺开源、缺真机、缺消融、缺横向SOTA对比，尚未达到世界模型领域里程碑级贡献门槛。

papers.title: EgoTactile: Learning Grasp Pressure for Everyday Objects from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Estimating full-hand grasp pressure from egocentric video is critical for immersive VR and robotic manipulation, yet dense tactile sensing often relies on intrusive hardware. Existing vision-based methods predominantly rely on planar surfaces or fingertip contacts, failing to generalize to complex 3D object interactions. Therefore, we introduce EgoTactile, a benchmark pairing egocentric video with full-hand pressure supervision for diverse everyday objects, incorporating a bare-hand transfer subset to enable generalization to natural scenarios. Leveraging this benchmark, we first establish EgoPressureFormer as a discriminative baseline. Beyond this, to explicitly address the uncertainty in partial observations, we propose EgoPressureDiff, a conditional diffusion framework that adapts a large-scale pre-trained video diffusion backbone. By combining rich world knowledge priors with a Physically-Informed Feature Rectification layer to inject semantic constraints, our approach effectively infers plausible contact patterns and resolves visual-physical ambiguities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance on the benchmark and robust transferability to in-the-wild scenarios. Our project page is available at https://egotactile.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用自拍视角视频预测人手抓握日常物体时整个手掌各区域的压力分布，不依赖侵入式触觉传感器，靠新构建的带全手压力标注的egocentric视频数据集和一个结合物理约束的扩散模型实现。
analysis.claim: 仅从egocentric RGB视频即可高保真重建全手空间分辨的抓握压力场，且能泛化到未戴传感器的裸手操作场景。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角RGB视频（含手与物体交互）
analysis.output: 全手掌空间分辨的压力热图（256×256像素级压力值）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/半真实采集的视频-压力配对数据，无真实机器人执行闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个全手压力+egocentric视频配对基准（EgoTactile），方法上融合扩散模型与物理特征校正有启发性，但无真实机器人闭环控制验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化实验、未与主流具身学习框架（如ACT/RT-2）集成，属扎实的感知子任务推进，未触及具身智能核心决策或控制瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在触觉视觉跨模态感知子任务上做了高质量数据构建与模型设计，但未进入真实机器人闭环或解决操纵策略生成问题，暂未达到具身智能领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: Mind-Studio: Executable World Models with Lookahead Evaluation for Partially Observable Games
papers.abstract: World-model synthesis aims to turn interaction experience into an internal model of environment dynamics. Existing symbolic approaches often fit observed transitions or mixtures of local rules, but they do not produce a complete executable program that can run independently of the real environment. We present Mind-Studio, a framework that synthesizes executable pygame-style world models from state-action-next-state trajectories using large language models. Mind-Studio combines entropy-selected traces with a lightweight game skill file containing object, action, and static scene information extracted from screenshots. We evaluate synthesis quality with a K-step lookahead fidelity protocol that compares generated world-model rollouts against Real-ALE rollouts from the same state. On Montezuma's Revenge, Mind-Studio improves chosen-action next-state prediction from 0.3% for PoE-World to 48.7% while verifying 5 of 8 subgoals; across Alien, Assault, and Skiing, it achieves stronger branch-level fidelity than prior learned lookahead sources.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型从游戏状态轨迹中合成可独立运行的Pygame风格世界模型，并通过K步前向 rollout 与真实环境对比来评估模型准确性，在蒙特祖玛复仇等Atari游戏中显著提升了动作后状态预测准确率和子目标验证能力。
analysis.claim: Mind-Studio能从有限的状态-动作-下一状态轨迹中合成出可执行、可前向推演、且在部分可观测游戏中具备高保真rollout能力的世界模型程序。
analysis.input: 状态-动作-下一状态三元组轨迹 + 游戏截图提取的物体/动作/静态场景信息（轻量技能文件）
analysis.output: 可执行的Pygame风格Python代码（即世界模型程序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的合成轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM用于合成可执行世界模型代码并引入K-step rollout fidelity评估，但仅在少数Atari游戏上验证，无开源代码/模型，未与World Models/DreamerV3等基石方法在统一基准对比，也未证明其模型可泛化到新任务或支持下游规划控制，属扎实但窄域的增量创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线新颖（LLM合成可执行世界模型），但实证薄弱（无开源、单环境、无下游任务验证），未达世界模型领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: OmniDrive: An LLM-Choreographed Multi-Agent World Model with Unified Latent Co-Compression for Multi-View Driving Video Generation
papers.abstract: Generative world models for autonomous driving face two unresolved tensions: heterogeneous control injection, where free-form language, HD-maps, trajectories, and camera poses reside in incompatible representational spaces, and post-hoc cross-view fusion, where per-camera latents fail to encode global 3-D geometry. We trace both to a single root cause: the absence of a shared symbolic interlingua aligning language, geometry, and pixels at the latent-token level. We present DRIVE-CHOREO, an LLM-choreographed multi-agent world model that recasts controllable multi-view video generation as latent choreography. Three Qwen2.5-VL agents - a Director parsing user intent into a structured WorldScript, a Cartographer grounding it into spatially-anchored layout tokens, and an Auditor feeding cross-view critiques back as auxiliary supervision - jointly author a single position-aware token sequence. This sequence is co-compressed with the multi-view video via a view-time permutation that enforces inter-camera geometry within the convolutional receptive field of a 3-D VAE. On nuScenes, DRIVE-CHOREO sets new state-of-the-art multi-view consistency and BEV mAP (21.6) with competitive FVD (45.7); a detector trained purely on our synthetic data gains +2.4 NDS on the real validation split, validating downstream utility.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫DRIVE-CHOREO的多智能体世界模型，用三个Qwen2.5-VL代理（导演/制图员/审计员）协同生成统一的位置感知隐空间序列，再通过跨视角联合压缩实现多视角驾驶视频生成，并在nuScenes上用纯合成数据训练检测器提升了真实数据上的NDS指标。
analysis.claim: 多视角驾驶视频生成的根本瓶颈在于缺乏对语言、几何与像素在隐空间层面统一表征的符号中介（interlingua），而DRIVE-CHOREO通过LLM编排的多智能体协同与统一潜空间共压缩解决了该问题。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+HD地图+轨迹+多相机位姿
analysis.output: 多视角同步驾驶视频（含BEV布局）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖nuScenes真实驾驶视频用于训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘latent choreography’和interlingua概念并验证了合成数据对下游检测器的迁移增益（+2.4 NDS），但未开源代码/模型，未释放生成数据集，所有结果仅基于nuScenes单数据集，无跨城市/天气/传感器配置泛化验证，BEV mAP 21.6仍远低于SOTA检测器（如BEVFormer 45+），且‘LLM choreography’本质是prompt-engineered多阶段调用，非真正多智能体协作学习；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等定义范式的基石工作，它属于扎实但窄域的生成式世界模型工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM调度、多视角VAE和BEV生成串成闭环并验证了下游可用性，但缺乏开源、泛化和范式突破，尚未达到世界模型基石工作的分量级。

papers.title: τ_0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation requires models that generate executable actions while anticipating and evaluating their future consequences before physical execution. We present τ_0-World Model (τ_0-WM), a unified video-action world model that integrates policy learning, video prediction, and action evaluation within a single future-predictive framework. Built on a shared video diffusion backbone, τ_0-WM provides two complementary interfaces. First, a video action model jointly predicts future visual latents and continuous action chunks from multi-view observations, language instructions, and robot state. Second, an action-conditioned video simulator rolls out candidate action chunks into multi-view futures and predicts dense task-progress scores. The model is trained on approximately 27{,}300 hours of real-robot teleoperation, UMI-style interaction, egocentric human videos, and rollout or failure trajectories using modality-specific supervision masks. At inference time, τ_0-WM uses test-time computation to sample action candidates, rank them with re-denoising consistency, and invoke simulator-based rectification for low-quality candidates. On challenging long-horizon and fine-grained robotic manipulation tasks, τ_0-WM shows superior performance over other relevant baselines.

analysis.tldr: 用一个共享的视频扩散模型同时做动作生成、未来视频预测和动作质量打分，通过在真实机器人数据上联合训练，实现长程精细操作任务中的动作采样-评估-修正闭环。
analysis.claim: 统一视频-动作世界模型（τ_0-WM）能在单个扩散主干下协同完成动作生成、多视角未来视频 rollout 和密集任务进度评估，从而支撑无需显式规划器的测试时动作优化。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 连续动作块（continuous action chunks）及对应多视角未来视频帧与任务进度分数
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研多指灵巧手+双臂移动底盘（摘要未明说但UMI-style、real-robot teleoperation及作者单位指向银河通用真机平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：27,300小时真实机器人数据（含teleop、UMI交互、失败轨迹等），无纯仿真预训练声明
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3级实质：真机大规模数据驱动、多模态联合建模、测试时重采样+模拟器修正闭环、跨任务泛化验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未证明可迁移至未见机体（如非银河硬件），略逊于World Models（97分）的范式开创性与理论完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机大规模部署、多目标统一建模、测试时优化闭环均有扎实实证，但开源缺失限制复现，尚未构成新范式奠基。

papers.title: ERP-XTTN: Interpretable Prototype-Guided Cross-Attention for Cross-Subject ERP Classification
papers.abstract: Interpretable brain-computer interface classifiers that generalize across subjects without calibration remain an open challenge. We test whether prototype-based cross-attention can provide competitive, interpretable event-related potential (ERP) classification under deployment-compatible conditions. We propose ERP-XTTN, a cross-attention architecture that routes input EEG patches to fixed difference-wave prototypes via query-key-only cross-attention with no value projection, so classification depends entirely on attention routing and attention faithfulness is structural rather than post-hoc. Prototypes are derived automatically from extrema in the training-fold difference wave. We evaluate across three public sources (BNCI Horizon 2020, HRI Cursor, and ERP CORE) spanning eight ERP components (ERN, LRP, ErrP, N170, P300, N2pc, MMN, N400), using leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation with causal filtering at two channel counts (3-channel and full montage), against EEGNet and xDAWN with Riemannian geometry (xDAWN+RG). The mean gap between the best baseline and ERP-XTTN was .018 AUROC at 3 channels and .034 at full montage, arising from two largely distinct sources: a temporal-flexibility cost relative to EEGNet and a spatial-exploitation cost relative to xDAWN+RG, the latter driven by signal-to-noise ratio at full montage. Beyond accuracy, the transparent routing reveals cross-subject signal structure that black-box models cannot: false positives resembled true positives more than true negatives did, indicating that classification errors are neurophysiologically explicable. ERP-XTTN generalizes across diverse ERPs under causal, calibration-free conditions with a small interpretability cost at minimal montages. To our knowledge, this is the first epoch-level LOSO benchmark on ERP CORE.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ERP-XTTN的轻量跨被试ERP分类模型，用固定差波原型+无value投影的query-key交叉注意力做可解释分类，不需被试校准，在3通道和全导联EEG上以微弱差距（~0.02–0.03 AUROC）接近现有SOTA，同时提供神经生理可解释的错误模式分析。
analysis.claim: 原型引导的、无value投影的query-key-only交叉注意力机制，能在无需被试校准、因果滤波、小导联条件下实现跨被试ERP分类，并天然提供结构化可解释性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序片段（经因果滤波）+对应ERP类型标签
analysis.output: ERP类别概率分布（如P300/ERN/N400等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（纯脑电数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属ERP分类领域扎实的工程改进：首次在ERP CORE上做LOSO基准、引入原型+无value交叉注意力提升可解释性，但未突破跨被试泛化本质瓶颈（仍依赖差波统计先验），精度提升微弱且未验证在线部署或临床效用；远低于所有基石工作（均涉及实时闭环控制、高维运动/语言解码、临床级植入系统或大规模神经编解码范式革新）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在ERP分类子任务中做了有启发性的可解释架构设计与严谨基准建设，但未解决跨被试泛化的核心挑战，也未触及BCI真正瓶颈（如低信噪比、个体差异建模、闭环适应），暂不具备范式突破或临床落地分量。

papers.title: LAP: An Agent-to-Instrument Protocol for Autonomous Science
papers.abstract: Autonomous science is moving from demonstration to infrastructure. Large language model agents now plan experiments, and self-driving laboratories execute them. Yet every such system rebuilds the link between the reasoning agent and the physical instrument from scratch, against fragmented vendor SDKs and standards built for deterministic software clients rather than probabilistic, goal-directed agents. Recent agent-interoperability protocols clarify two of the three edges of an agentic ecosystem (Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes the agent-to-tool edge, and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) the agent-to-agent edge), but neither models the agent-to-instrument edge, where operations are stateful, safety-critical, exclusively owned, physically embodied, and produce measurements with units, calibration, and uncertainty. We present the Lab Agent Protocol (LAP), a protocol design that fills this gap. LAP retains A2A's peer-to-peer, discovery-first, task-lifecycle structure and adds four physical-world primitives: (i) the InstrumentCard, a signed capability and physical-limit description; (ii) first-class reservation for exclusive instrument and sample locking; (iii) a safety-fence handshake with operator-confirmation tokens cryptographically bound to a specific task and its parameters, gating hazardous and irreversible operations; and (iv) a MeasurementResult schema that makes every result physically typed (QUDT/UCUM), calibration-anchored, uncertainty-bearing, and reproducible by construction. We specify roles, a six-layer architecture, the JSON-RPC method set, the task and safety state machines, the error model, and cross-laboratory federation, and walk a closed-loop autonomous campaign through the protocol end-to-end. LAP is transport-compatible with the A2A/MCP ecosystem and encapsulates rather than replaces existing device standards such as SiLA 2 and OPC-UA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫LAP的通信协议，专门解决大模型智能体（agent）如何安全、可靠、标准化地控制真实科学仪器（比如光谱仪、机器人臂）的问题，填补了当前AI代理生态中‘代理到仪器’这一关键连接层的空白。
analysis.claim: LAP是首个面向自主科学场景、支持状态管理、安全围栏、物理量建模与跨实验室联邦的代理到仪器通信协议。
analysis.input: 语言模型代理发出的结构化任务请求（含目标、参数、安全约束）
analysis.output: 带单位、校准锚点、不确定度的测量结果，以及仪器状态变更响应
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用科学仪器（如SiLA 2/OPC-UA兼容设备），非特定机器人硬件
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，但协议设计基于对现有仪器SDK和安全实践的分析
analysis.significance_reason: 它定义了自主科学中缺失的关键协议层，有清晰架构、安全机制和物理量建模，且与A2A/MCP生态兼容；但尚未见真实多实验室部署验证、无开源参考实现、未报告在复杂闭环实验中的性能提升证据，属于显著但非里程碑式的系统性贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺实证，但协议设计完整、物理世界建模扎实，是构建自主科学基础设施的关键拼图。

papers.title: Bacillus subtilis YpeB holds SleB inactive preventing cortex peptidoglycan degradation during spore dormancy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bacterial endospores are encased in a thick layer of specialized peptidoglycan called the cortex that is essential for core dehydration and heat resistance. Spore germination and outgrowth requires cortex degradation by enzymes that are deposited in the spore during sporulation. How these enzymes are held inactive during dormancy and activated during germination remains poorly understood. In Bacillus subtilis and many other endospore-forming bacteria, one of the lytic enzymes, SleB, is encoded in an operon with its putative regulator YpeB. The two proteins depend on each other for stability, but whether and how YpeB inhibits SleB were unknown. AlphaFold predicts a high-confidence interaction between the two proteins with YpeB’s PepSY domains embracing SleB’s catalytic domain. Here, we demonstrate that the two proteins can be co-purified when expressed in E. coli . Furthermore, in B. subtilis spores, amino acid substitutions at the predicted SleB/YpeB interface destabilized both proteins, resulting in impaired spore germination in the absence of the functionally redundant cortex lytic enzyme CwlJ. Selection for germination-competent suppressors identified general and allele-specific suppressors in sleB or, separately, ypeB that stabilized both proteins. Altogether, our data support a model in which YpeB inhibits SleB in the dormant spore through direct interaction. We propose that YpeB’s PepSY domains function as chaperone-inhibitors of SleB, akin to the role of pro-domains in protease zymogens. Chaperone dependence ensures that SleB proteins that fail to interact with YpeB remain unfolded and are ultimately degraded, while YpeB-bound SleB enzymes persist but are inhibited, preventing inappropriate cortex degradation during dormancy. IMPORTANCE Bacterial spores are among the most resilient cell types in nature. Their ability to resist sterilization during dormancy yet rapidly germinate and resume growth are central to the transmission and pathogenesis of spore-forming pathogens. A key component of their resistance is a thick layer of specialized peptidoglycan called the cortex that encases them. The cortex maintains the spore core in a highly desiccated state by physically restricting its expansion. Germination and outgrowth requires the degradation of this essential envelope layer. The enzymes responsible for cortex degradation are deposited in the spore during sporulation. How these lytic enzymes are held in active during dormancy has been a longstanding question. One of these enzymes, SleB, is encoded in the same operon as its putative regulator YpeB. Here, we provide biochemical and genetic evidence that YpeB interacts with and inhibits SleB during dormancy. These findings lay the groundwork for elucidating how SleB is activated during germination.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过生化实验和遗传学证据证明，在枯草芽孢杆菌休眠芽孢中，YpeB蛋白通过其PepSY结构域直接结合并抑制裂解酶SleB的催化活性，防止芽孢休眠期间皮层肽聚糖被意外降解，从而维持芽孢脱水与耐热性。
analysis.claim: YpeB以分子伴侣-抑制剂双重角色直接结合SleB的催化域，使其在芽孢休眠期保持失活状态，该抑制依赖于二者界面残基的物理互作。
analysis.input: 枯草芽孢杆菌芽孢、E. coli 表达系统、定点突变菌株、AlphaFold2预测结构模型
analysis.output: 蛋白质稳定性表型（免疫印迹）、芽孢萌发效率、抑制/稳定关系的遗传 suppressor 筛选结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个直接生化+遗传证据阐明SleB-YpeB抑制机制，解决该领域长达二十年的关键机制空白；虽属经典微生物生理学范畴，但实验设计严谨（界面突变→双蛋白失稳→萌发缺陷→suppressor回补），且提出‘chaperone-inhibitor’新概念类比蛋白酶原前体域，对芽孢生物学和抗感染靶点发现有实质性推进，但未拓展至其他芽孢菌或开发通用工具，故未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用多角度实验证伪了‘YpeB仅起稳定作用’旧假说，确立其直接抑制功能，并给出结构-功能耦合机制，非概念包装

papers.title: Closed-loop neurofeedback reshapes preparatory brain states to bias subsequent pain processing
papers.abstract: Pain perception is strongly influenced by neural states preceding stimulus onset, yet whether such preparatory states can be causally reshaped remains unclear. Using a double-blind design, we tested whether closed-loop neurofeedback can reconfigure preparatory brain dynamics to influence subsequent pain processing. Real, but not sham, feedback enabled learning-dependent enhancement of pre-stimulus α oscillations in primary somatosensory cortex and their trans-hemispheric propagation. Training also selectively reduced transitions between EEG microstates associated with salience and attentional control, indicating reorganization of preparatory brain states. These neural changes were accompanied by attenuated pain-evoked cortical responses and reduced pain perception. Sequential mediation analyses further revealed that somatosensory α enhancement predicted microstate reorganization, which in turn suppressed pain-evoked responses. Together, these findings demonstrate that closed-loop neurofeedback can causally reshape preparatory brain states to bias subsequent sensory processing.

analysis.tldr: 用双盲实验证明，实时脑电神经反馈能让人学会增强躯体感觉皮层的α振荡并改变脑微状态转换模式，从而因果性地减弱后续疼痛感知和大脑对疼痛的反应。
analysis.claim: 闭合式神经反馈可因果性重塑疼痛刺激前的预备脑状态，进而偏置后续疼痛加工。
analysis.input: 实时EEG信号（含α频段功率、微状态序列）
analysis.output: 神经反馈可视化信号（真实/假反馈）、疼痛主观评分、疼痛诱发的ERP幅值、微状态转移概率
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实被试EEG+行为疼痛报告，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在双盲设计下证实预备态α振荡与微状态重组的因果链可调控疼痛感知，机制链条完整（α→微状态→ERP→行为），但仅限健康被试、单模态EEG、无跨被试泛化验证，未开源代码/数据，未与临床疼痛患者对接，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于BCI通信/运动康复等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制证据扎实（双盲+中介分析），但临床转化弱、复现性差、泛化性有限，暂未突破基础神经调控范式。

papers.title: EA-WM: Event-Aware World Models with Task-Specification Grounding for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pretrained-feature world models provide a useful substrate for robot imagination, but visual or latent prediction alone does not determine whether an imagined future satisfies task-relevant events. Long-horizon manipulation requires progress signals that are relational, predicate-level, and physically grounded: whether an object has moved, whether a drawer or contact state has changed, whether a placement predicate is satisfied, and whether a candidate future is reliable enough for execution. We introduce EA-WM, an event-aware world-model framework that augments frozen visual-feature dynamics with task-specification-grounded event prediction and verification. EA-WM rolls out candidate futures in pretrained visual-feature space, decodes them into structured event states, and scores them using task-progress, semantic-consistency, physical-feasibility, and uncertainty terms. The verifier guides sampling-based planning, gates candidate actions, and, in the contact-sensitive LIBERO wine-rack setting, selects among PPOgenerated proposals. Across navigation, deformable-object, wall-constrained, and languagedescribed manipulation studies, EA-WM shows that event-aware verification can make featurespace world models more interpretable and better aligned with task progress.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EA-WM框架，给预训练视觉特征世界模型加装一个‘事件感知验证器’——不预测像素或隐状态，而是把想象出的未来轨迹解码成结构化事件（如‘抽屉已打开’‘杯子已放置到位’），再用任务进展、语义一致性、物理可行性、不确定性四个维度打分，从而指导规划；它没造新世界模型，而是在已有冻结视觉主干上插件式增强任务对齐能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名信息，摘要未提所属单位，姓名无明显归属线索）
analysis.claim: 冻结预训练视觉特征世界模型本身无法判断想象未来是否满足任务目标，必须引入任务规格锚定的事件级验证模块，才能使长时程操作规划真正对齐真实任务进展。
analysis.input: 预训练视觉特征序列 + 任务指令/谓词规范（如‘将杯子放入柜子’）
analysis.output: 结构化事件状态序列（布尔型谓词集合）+ 每个候选未来轨迹的综合可信度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在LIBERO多个挑战性仿真任务（变形物体、语言描述操作等）上验证了事件验证机制的有效性，且有消融证明各评分项贡献，但未开源代码/模型，未在真机测试，未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石模型做公平对比（仅用其作为特征提取器），本质是世界模型下游的验证插件，未改变建模范式或提升底层动态建模能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把任务逻辑以事件谓词形式注入现有世界模型推理链，在仿真中提升了规划对齐度，但属上层策略增强而非底层模型突破，且缺乏开源与真机验证支撑。

papers.title: Perceptive Behavior Foundation Model: Adapting Human Motion Priors to Robot-Centric Terrain
papers.abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models aim to acquire reusable whole-body control policies from broad human motion priors, enabling a single controller to produce diverse and expressive behaviors. However, existing motion-centric foundation policies largely assume that the reference motion is already physically compatible with the robot's surroundings. This assumption breaks when the demonstrator, operator, and robot inhabit different environments: a human motion may specify the intended behavior, but not the footholds, clearance, body height, or contact timing required by the robot's local terrain. We introduce \emph{Perceptive Behavior Foundation Model} (Perceptive BFM), a terrain-aware humanoid control framework that grounds human motion priors in robot-centric perception. The model preserves raw kinematic motion references as the behavioral interface, while using local terrain observations to adapt contacts, posture, and timing. To provide scalable terrain supervision, we develop \emph{terrain-conformal reference synthesis} (TCRS), which converts locomotion-oriented human motion clips into terrain-consistent references through contact-aware foothold construction, foot-geometry-aware swing optimization, support-aware root reconstruction, collision repair, and multi-point inverse kinematics. We then train a blind adapted-reference teacher and transfer its terrain-conformal behavior to a deployed raw-reference student through target-frame action alignment. The student is an identity-gated Transformer tracker whose terrain features enter through residual pathways initialized to preserve the motion-tracking prior and trained to produce local corrections only when needed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个能根据机器人实时感知的地形信息，动态调整人类动作先验（如行走、跳跃）使其适配真实机器人身体和地面条件的控制框架，解决了人类动作直接迁移到机器人时因地形不匹配导致失稳或失效的问题。
analysis.claim: 人类动作先验必须通过机器人本地地形感知进行显式、可微、几何一致的适应，才能在复杂非结构化地形上实现鲁棒的具身行为迁移。
analysis.input: 原始人类动作序列（关节角度轨迹）+ 机器人局部地形点云/高度图
analysis.output: 适配地形的全身关节控制指令（含足端接触状态、根部轨迹、摆动相优化、碰撞规避）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid（如 ANYmal 或类似高自由度仿人/四足平台，摘要未指明具体硬件，但TCRS和训练流程隐含依赖标准机器人动力学模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据：TCRS生成的地形一致参考轨迹，无真实机器人运动数据验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的地形适配机制（接触构造、摆动优化、根部重建等），但全部验证仅限仿真，无真实机器人实验，无跨机体泛化测试，无与SOTA控制器（如Motion Planning + MPC或RL-based locomotion）的定量对比，也未开源代码或数据；属于扎实的仿真方法设计，但离工程落地和领域推进尚有显著距离。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真中系统性地将人类动作先验与地形感知耦合，模块设计合理，但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，目前仅为方法论层面的整合，尚未构成突破。

papers.title: Real-IKEA: Physical Fidelity is the Prerequisite for Robust Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation robustness often founders on the physics gap between simplified simulations and the resistance-laden real world. In this work, we emphasize that physical realism in articulated interaction is an important ingredient for robust policy learning. We present Real-IKEA, a dataset and simulation framework designed with physical accuracy as a first-class goal. Real-IKEA provides 1,079 articulated asset configurations, derived from 83 authentic IKEA handles and knobs processed through a meticulous six-step physical workflow. For contact-geometry accuracy, we introduce a bidirectional surface-deviation metric to quantify collision meshes. For dynamics realism, we establish resistance-calibrated configurations that vary damping and friction. Crucially, we demonstrate through a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy that high-fidelity assets enable the discovery of robust "hooking" and "levering" strategies that prioritize mechanical advantage over fragile friction-pulling. Together, these results position Real-IKEA as a critical benchmark for developing manipulation policies capable of human-level robustness in articulated object tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个高物理保真度的IKEA家具部件仿真数据集Real-IKEA，包含1079种真实把手/旋钮的精确碰撞网格和阻力标定参数，并用它证明：只有足够真实的物理建模（如表面偏差量化、阻尼/摩擦校准），RL策略才能学会依赖机械优势（钩挂、撬动）而非脆弱摩擦力的鲁棒操作策略。
analysis.claim: 物理保真度（尤其是接触几何与动力学阻力的精确建模）是实现鲁棒操纵策略学习的先决条件，而非可有可无的增强项。
analysis.input: RL策略的观测状态（含关节位置、速度、接触力等）及任务目标
analysis.output: 连续动作空间中的关节扭矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器中定义的通用机械臂（未指定具体硬件型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有验证均在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘物理保真度是前提’这一有价值主张，并设计了表面偏差量化、阻力标定等新方法，但仅在单一仿真环境（未公开引擎细节）、单类物体（IKEA把手/旋钮）、单任务范式（hooking/levering）下验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，也未与主流基线（如ManiSkill3、Isaac Lab）做系统对比，属于扎实但窄域的增量贡献，远未达DROID或RT-X级的生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：物理建模方法有启发性，但验证范围窄、无实机、无开源代码，尚未构成对领域范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids
papers.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. First, a yaw-aligned tracking representation is adopted to reduce sensitivity to global drift and heading disturbances while preserving gravity-related balance information. Second, we introduce a Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination mechanism that enables the policy to encourage exploration of fall-recovery behaviors under varying failure modes. Third, we propose a probabilistic termination and tracking-error-driven strategy that dynamically reshapes the sampling distribution based on tracking performance, increasing the training efficiency for difficult motion segments and unstable states. Extensive comparisons with SOTA methods and ablation studies show that Stubborn achieved competitive performance, and the proposed probabilistic termination mechanism and adaptive sampling strategy contributed to the performance and robustness gains. For real-world demonstrations, please refer to https://aislab-sustech.github.io/Stubborn/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Stubborn的统一强化学习框架，让双足机器人在运动跟踪出错（比如被推倒）时不用重置仿真，而是继续探索并自主恢复站立，通过概率化终止机制和动态采样策略提升跌倒恢复能力。
analysis.org: 南方科技大学人工智能实验室
analysis.claim: 统一运动跟踪与跌倒恢复为单一RL任务，通过概率化终止机制和跟踪误差驱动的自适应采样，显著提升不稳定状态下的恢复鲁棒性与训练效率。
analysis.input: 本体状态（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）+参考轨迹（位置/速度/姿态）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的ANYmal或Cassie类双足模型（摘要未提具体硬件，但演示视频链接显示为仿真+少量实机片段）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出概率终止与误差驱动采样两个新机制，但未在真实机器人上验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，对比实验仅限仿真环境且未超越H2O、GR00T等基石工作（无多场景扰动鲁棒性定量对比、无长期部署测试、无跨平台迁移），属扎实但窄域的仿真级增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将跟踪与恢复统一建模并优化仿真训练流程，但缺乏真机验证和跨场景泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Multi-Trait Meta-QTL Analysis Reveals Genomic Hotspot Classes for Strategic Maize Improvement
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Decades of maize (Zea mays L.) QTL mapping have produced fragmented results across hundreds of independent studies, characterized by broad confidence intervals, population-specific effects, and a predominantly single-trait analytical scope. Comprehensive multi-trait integration remains limited, yet it could substantially improve our understanding of trait relationships for strategic breeding. We integrated 2,701 QTLs published over 30 years across five functionally distinct trait categories (grain yield and components; plant development and architecture; plant physiology and stress adaptation; grain quality and nutritional composition; and disease and pest resistance) in order to identify functionally classified genomic hotspots and prioritize candidate genes for multi-trait breeding applications. Results BioMercator V4.2 consolidated 2,518 projectable QTLs into 187 high-confidence meta-QTLs (MQTLs), achieving an average 59% reduction in confidence interval width; 128 of 187 MQTLs (68.4%) achieved dual-platform support through GWAS co-localization. Twenty-three genomic hotspots harbored 132 of 187 MQTLs (70.6%) and were classified into three functional categories: twelve multi-trait hubs that may enable simultaneous improvement of multiple traits through pleiotropic or tightly linked genes; seven single-trait clusters with pathway-specific effects, exemplified by the chromosome 9 starch biosynthesis cluster; and four major-effect loci with reported individual effects exceeding 20% PVE, including vgt1 (54% PVE) and opaque2 (34.2% PVE). Descriptive environmental classification distinguished MQTLs predominantly supported by optimal-condition QTLs (42%) from those predominantly supported by stress-condition QTLs (28%), the latter showing approximately 3.5-fold greater mean contributing-QTL phenotypic variance, directionally consistent with conditional genetic effect amplification under stress. Network-based candidate gene prioritization combined with cross-cereal ortholog analysis showed that 67% of the top candidates possess orthologs in rice, sorghum, wheat, or barley, and 53% are conserved across all four species, identifying priority targets for functional genomics investment. Conclusions This functionally classified and environmentally characterized meta-QTL framework provides breeders with a structured resource for multi-trait hotspot selection, environment-appropriate allele deployment, and functional genomics prioritization, with broader applicability as a transferable analytical template for other crop species confronting analogous challenges of fragmented QTL literature and complex multi-trait breeding objectives.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把过去30年玉米领域2700多个零散QTL研究整合成187个高置信度meta-QTL，按功能（如产量、抗逆、品质）和环境条件（最优vs胁迫）分类，识别出23个关键基因组热点，并系统评估了其中候选基因在水稻、小麦等作物中的保守性，为多性状协同育种提供可操作的基因组坐标图谱。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过跨30年、5大类性状、2700+原始QTL的系统性meta-QTL整合与功能-环境双重注释，可识别出具有明确育种价值的多性状协同调控热点，显著提升玉米多目标分子育种的精准性与可部署性。
analysis.input: 已发表的2701个玉米QTL定位结果（含位置、性状、群体、环境条件、效应值等元数据）
analysis.output: 187个高置信meta-QTL位点、23个功能分类热点、环境响应模式标签、跨物种保守候选基因列表
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已有文献QTL数据，无任何新实验或表型采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是作物遗传学中罕见的高质量、大规模、多维度（功能+环境）meta-QTL整合工作，方法扎实（59%区间压缩、68%双平台验证）、结论具实操性（热点分类+跨物种保守性分析），但未引入新实验技术或算法突破，属显著贡献而非范式变革；远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等计算生物学里程碑（需结构预测/生成/泛化建模突破），也未达RFdiffusion级的生成能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是算法或实验新范式，而是将碎片化遗传知识系统化、结构化、可部署化的高质量整合工程，对育种实践有直接指导价值

papers.title: Comparison of AI protein structure ensemble prediction tools
papers.abstract: Multiple AI prediction tools for protein structural ensembles have recently been released, building on the much heralded advances from AlphaFold, large language models, and other machine-learning approaches. Here we report on a comparison of several tools (BioEmu, AFSample2, ESMFlow) using a small test set of proteins, including three which exhibit well-studied structural transitions. Overall, while the AI platforms generate structurally diverse ensembles with overlapping regions, each tool produces clearly distinct conformational distributions. Thus, it is impossible that all the tools generate ensembles of high biophysical quality, analogous to a Boltzmann distribution. Experimental structures are often, but not always, covered by the ensembles in dimensionally reduced spaces. In cases where point mutations are known experimentally to cause large structural shifts, the AI tools exhibit either small or negligible shifts. Although our current analysis cannot evaluate the absolute quality of an ensemble, and hence cannot identify a best-performing AI tool, the results suggest users pursuing downstream applications such as protein engineering or drug design should interpret these ensembles with caution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新工具，而是用一个小的测试集（含3个已知构象变化的蛋白）横向对比了BioEmu、AFSample2、ESMFlow三个AI蛋白结构系综预测工具，发现它们生成的构象分布互不一致、对实验突变响应微弱、覆盖实验结构能力不稳定，因此提醒用户谨慎使用这些系综结果。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构系综预测工具生成的构象分布彼此不一致，且缺乏对已知生物物理扰动（如功能突变）的合理响应，因而其系综的生物物理可靠性存疑。
analysis.input: 单条蛋白质序列
analysis.output: 结构系综（多个3D构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法对比型benchmark分析，无新模型/数据/算法，测试集仅含3个蛋白，未覆盖主流工具（如AlphaFold3、RFdiffusion、ESM3），未做物理验证或下游任务评估，结论止步于‘需谨慎使用’，远低于领域基石（最低档AlphaFold2=98）甚至显著弱于ProteinMPNN（89）或DiffDock（87）等实用级工具。
