papers.title: UniD$^3$: A Knowledge Graph-Enhanced RAG Framework for Drug-Disease Discovery and Reasoning
papers.abstract: Systematic characterization of drug-disease relationships is essential for drug discovery and repurposing, yet is hindered by the heterogeneity and rapid growth of biomedical literature. Existing datasets rely on labor-intensive curation and are often incomplete, while LLM-only approaches suffer from hallucination and weak evidence grounding. We introduce UniD$^3$, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Models with Knowledge Graph-enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) to extract, organize, and validate drug-disease knowledge across Drug-Disease Matching (DDM), Drug Effectiveness Assessment (DEA), and Drug-Target Analysis (DTA). UniD$^3$ processes 157,849 PubMed articles with Llama 3.3-70B and constructs knowledge graphs via a dual-stage strategy combining paper-level extraction with KG-level consolidation centered on drug and disease entities. These graphs support KG-RAG-based generation of structured datasets, evaluated through external benchmarks, fuzzy matching with curated resources, and clinician review. UniD$^3$ produces six knowledge graphs and large-scale datasets, including 28,915 DDM, 15,042 DEA, and over 4,000 DTA QA pairs. External validation shows strong performance (F1: 0.85-0.87 for DDM/DEA; 0.82 for DTA), with clinician review confirming high reliability (AUROC = 0.90). KG-RAG-augmented models outperform standalone LLMs, and the UniD$^3$ chatbot enables interpretable, citation-supported exploration of drug-disease relationships. UniD$^3$ provides a scalable, extensible framework for transforming unstructured biomedical literature into high-quality, structured drug-disease knowledge, supporting AI-driven discovery, repurposing, and precision medicine.

analysis.tldr: 用知识图谱增强的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）方法，从15.7万篇PubMed论文中自动抽取、整合并验证药物-疾病关系，生成三大结构化数据集（匹配/有效性/靶点）和六个知识图谱，并通过外部评测、模糊匹配和临床医生评审验证其高可靠性。
analysis.claim: 知识图谱增强的RAG框架（UniD³）能显著提升药物-疾病关系抽取的准确性、可解释性与临床可信度，克服纯LLM幻觉和传统手工构建知识库的低效与不全问题。
analysis.input: PubMed文献全文（157,849篇）+ 用户自然语言查询（如‘哪些药物对帕金森病有效？’）
analysis.output: 结构化三元组（药物-关系-疾病）、问答对（DDM/DEA/DTA）、知识图谱、带引用支撑的可解释回答
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×生物医学领域属显著贡献：首次系统实现KG-RAG驱动的端到端药物-疾病知识闭环构建，实证扎实（F1 0.82–0.87 + AUROC 0.90 + 临床评审），但未突破底层建模范式（仍基于Llama 3.3+标准RAG流程），且未开源代码/模型，扩展性受限；远低于AlphaFold2/ESM等基石级工作（无结构预测/生成能力，不解决分子机制第一性问题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将KG与RAG深度耦合用于药物-疾病知识体系化构建，证据充分、落地性强，但属于高质量应用整合，非底层模型或科学发现范式突破。

papers.title: Run and tumble dynamics of a soft robotic cell
papers.abstract: The continuous regulation of transport properties through softness remains a longstanding challenge in active matter. Here, we show that encasing a programmable active particle within a deformable membrane naturally gives rise to intermittent stop-and-go dynamics, with ballistic motion at short times crossing over to diffusion at long times. Crucially, membrane softness acts as a single control parameter that continuously tunes persistence, intermittency, and long-time transport, linking the internal driving to the emergent locomotion of the synthetic cell. Combining experiments, simulations, and a run-and-tumble theoretical framework, we identify the minimal physical ingredients underlying this behavior and establish design principles for programmable soft active transport, opening new avenues at the interface of active matter physics and synthetic robotics.

analysis.tldr: 用一个可编程的活性粒子包上柔性膜，做成‘软体人工细胞’，发现膜越软，运动越容易在直线奔跑和随机翻滚之间切换，从而连续调控输运行为；实验、仿真和理论三方面验证了这种‘游动-翻滚’动力学的物理机制。
analysis.claim: 柔性膜的软度是单一可调参数，能连续调控软体人工细胞的运动持续性、间歇性与长时输运性质，实现内部驱动到宏观运动的可编程映射。
analysis.input: 膜弹性模量、内部驱动强度、环境粘度等物理参数
analysis.output: 运动轨迹统计特征（如均方位移、转向角分布、运行时间分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖微流控实验视频数据与粒子追踪结果
analysis.significance_reason: 属活性物质物理与软体机器人交叉的扎实基础研究：首次在合成软体系统中建立膜软度→运动模式的定量连续调控关系，并整合实验/仿真/理论；但未涉及AI建模、控制策略或真实机器人任务，也未突破活性物质领域已知的run-and-tumble范式（如E. coli模型），影响力限于小众交叉方向，远低于所列基石工作（全部聚焦具身智能闭环、大规模多模态学习或通用具身架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在软物质物理与合成细胞层面给出了清晰的参数-行为映射，但非AI×机器人或AI×科学的范式级推进，暂时不用看

papers.title: Traceable Virtual Sea Trials in the Marine Robotics Unity Simulator for Manoeuvring Assessment of Unmanned Surface Vehicles
papers.abstract: Accurate identification of hydrodynamic derivatives is essential for precise control and autonomous navigation of Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs). However, acquiring high-fidelity manoeuvring data from physical sea trials is often constrained by cost, safety, and environmental disturbances. Standard manoeuvring trials, particularly Turning Circle (TC) and Zig-Zag (ZZ), remain fundamental to IMO and ITTC assessment procedures because they provide comparable performance metrics reflective of underlying hydrodynamic behaviour. This paper extends the open-source Marine Robotics Unity Simulator (MARUS) by introducing a standardised Virtual Sea Trial framework for automated execution and data generation of TC/ZZ manoeuvres. The framework provides traceable command-actuation logging, system-identification (SI)-focused data conditioning, and automated extraction of IMO/ITTC-aligned manoeuvring metrics. A key contribution is a dedicated TC/ZZ data acquisition and post-processing pipeline, improving the repeatability and auditability of simulator-based manoeuvres while producing SI-ready datasets for hydrodynamic-derivative identification and digital-twin workflows. The framework also provides explicit command-execution separation for differential-thrust steering, where manoeuvre inputs are recorded as ordered rudder-equivalent commands and realised actuation is logged as an execution-level proxy derived from applied thrust. Case study results demonstrate repeatable and IMO-compliant manoeuvre behaviour. For TC tests, the normalised advance differs by approximately 3.9% between port and starboard turns, while the tactical diameter differs by 4.6-4.7%. For ZZ tests, first and second overshoot excesses remain below 1 degree for both +/-10-degree and +/-20-degree manoeuvres, satisfying IMO criteria, while peak yaw rates range from approximately 4.1 to 5.8 degrees/second.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在开源的MARUS海洋机器人Unity仿真器中构建了一套可追溯、标准化的虚拟海上试验框架，专门用于无人水面艇（USV）的回转圈（TC）和Z形（ZZ）操纵试验，自动生成符合IMO/ITTC规范的操纵数据，并支持水动力导数辨识与数字孪生建模。
analysis.claim: 通过在MARUS仿真器中实现命令-执行分离、可追溯日志、SI就绪数据预处理和IMO/ITTC对齐的自动指标提取，虚拟海试可成为高保真、可审计、可复现的USV操纵性能评估与水动力建模替代方案。
analysis.input: 用户指定的TC/ZZ操纵指令（如舵角序列或等效推力指令）
analysis.output: 符合IMO/ITTC标准的操纵性能指标（如归一化进距、战术直径、首摇超调量、峰值首摇率）及系统辨识就绪的时间序列数据集
analysis.robot_dependency: MARUS Unity仿真器中的无人水面艇模型（未指定具体硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：填补了USV领域缺乏标准化、可审计、SI-ready虚拟操纵试验框架的空白，但仅限于仿真内闭环，无真实机器人验证，未跨机体/任务泛化，也未引入新模型或算法；显著弱于Isaac Lab（88）、ManiSkill3（87）等通用仿真基座，更远低于DROID（93）或ALOHA（92）级具身智能里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将IMO/ITTC标准操作流程深度嵌入仿真器，提升了海洋机器人仿真试验的规范性与可复现性，但仍是仿真内工具链增强，未突破sim2real瓶颈或拓展科学问题边界。

papers.title: Slow Oscillations Gate Interictal Spikes Across the Human Thalamocortical-Epileptogenic Network
papers.abstract: Background: Slow oscillations (SOs; 0.5-1.5 Hz), a hallmark of non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, are associated with a marked amplification of interictal epileptiform spike (IIS) activity in focal epilepsy. However, the network-level organization of this effect across the thalamocortical-epileptogenic system, and whether IIS-permissive SOs can be predicted from pre-onset brain states, remain unclear. Methods: We analyzed simultaneous scalp EEG and stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 6 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy across 24 full-day recording days, sampling prefrontal cortex (PFC), thalamus, and seizure onset zone (SOZ). SO-IIS coupling was characterized across vigilance states using peri-event and phase-based analyses, with a gamma-based validation step to reduce contamination by IIS-related slow potentials. Pre-onset phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) was compared between IIS-permissive and non-permissive SOs. Results: SO-IIS coupling was observed across all regions, with the strongest and most temporally precise pre-trough IIS clustering in the SOZ (peak 4.4% in NREM), exceeding PFC (1.7%) and thalamic coupling. Thalamic coupling was preserved across wakefulness and NREM and was significant in 7/11 nuclei, with nucleus-specific phase preferences. SO morphological features, particularly up-slope and peak-to-peak amplitude at PFC contacts, predicted IIS occurrence in the SOZ. Pre-onset PAC differed significantly between permissive and non-permissive SOs across regions. Conclusions: SO-IIS coupling is a distributed, network-level phenomenon with region- and state-specific characteristics, and pre-onset PAC provides a predictive signature of IIS-permissive brain states. These findings support the feasibility of developing personalized, closed-loop neuromodulatory strategies targeting SO-gated IIS suppression in focal epilepsy. Keywords: Slow oscillations; Interictal epileptiform spikes; Focal epilepsy; Closed-loop neuromodulation; Phase-amplitude coupling

analysis.tldr: 通过分析6名难治性局灶性癫痫患者的颅内+头皮脑电数据，发现慢波振荡（SO）的特定形态特征和前兆期相位-幅度耦合（PAC）模式能可靠预测其是否允许病理性棘波（IIS）爆发，且该效应在皮层、丘脑、致痫区构成分布式网络机制。
analysis.org: 西北大学范伯格医学院
analysis.claim: 慢波振荡对棘波的门控作用是跨丘脑-皮层-致痫区的网络级现象，其前兆期相位-幅度耦合特征可作为预测IIS爆发的生物标志物。
analysis.input: 同步记录的头皮EEG与立体定向颅内EEG（SEEG），覆盖前额叶皮层、丘脑核团及致痫区
analysis.output: 慢波振荡与棘波的时空耦合强度、丘脑核团特异性相位偏好、慢波形态学预测指标、前兆期PAC差异图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实患者颅内多区域长时程SEEG数据（24天，6人，含11个丘脑核团）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个在人类全昼夜、多脑区、多核团尺度上验证的SO-IIS门控网络机制证据，含严格gamma滤波去混杂、核团级相位偏好量化、慢波形态预测建模及前兆PAC判别分析；但样本量小（6人）、无干预验证、未开源代码/数据，未达闭合环路实现层级，属扎实的机制发现而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次在人类高密度颅内记录中系统刻画了慢波门控棘波的网络动力学与预测性生物标志物，但受限于样本量与不可复现性，尚未达到临床转化或范式级突破。

papers.title: Global diversity and dispersal routes of the Ostreid herpesvirus type 1 infecting Magallana gigas
papers.abstract: The order Herpesvirales comprises double-stranded DNA viruses characterized by substantial genomic plasticity, including recombination, structural variation, gene gain and loss, and lineage turnover. These processes can obscure phylogenetic relationships and complicate the reconstruction of viral evolutionary histories. Within this order, Ostreid herpesvirus 1 (OsHV-1) is a major pathogen of the Pacific oyster Magallana gigas and is responsible for recurrent mortality events affecting global aquaculture. Early molecular investigations based on partial genomic regions identified several viral lineages, including the "var" and "microVar" lineages, but provided limited resolution for genome-wide evolutionary inference. The subsequent availability of complete genomes revealed extensive structural variation, such as insertions, deletions, and genomic rearrangements, highlighting the high genomic plasticity of OsHV-1. Although phylogenomic analyses have estimated evolutionary rates compatible with other large double-stranded DNA viruses, current inferences remain based on geographically restricted datasets, leaving the global evolutionary dynamics of OsHV-1 within its principal host insufficiently resolved. Here, we present 275 newly sequenced OsHV-1 genomes collected from infected M. gigas oysters between 1994 and 2022 across major oyster-producing regions worldwide. Using de novo genome assembly combined with comparative genomics, population genetic analyses, and time-scaled phylogenetic reconstruction, we investigate global genomic diversity and the spatio-temporal dynamics of viral diversification. Our results reveal long-standing viral diversity in East Asia, the emergence of structurally distinct Pacific and microvariants lineages, and ongoing diversification shaped by recombination, structural genome plasticity, and anthropogenic oyster movements. By integrating three decades of whole-genome data, this study provides a phylogenomic framework for understanding the diversity, evolution, and dispersal of OsHV-1 in modern aquaculture systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过全球范围内275个新测序的牡蛎疱疹病毒OsHV-1全基因组（1994–2022年、覆盖主要养殖区），结合从头组装、比较基因组学、群体遗传学和时间标定系统发育分析，厘清了该病毒在全球太平洋牡蛎中的长期演化历史、结构变异模式、重组驱动的多样性形成机制，以及人类引种活动如何塑造其跨洲际传播路径。
analysis.claim: OsHV-1的全球演化格局由东亚古老多样性、太平洋/微变异谱系的结构分化、持续的基因组重组与人类介导的牡蛎贸易共同塑造，而非单纯地理隔离或时钟模型可解释。
analysis.input: 275个OsHV-1全基因组序列（含地理、时间、宿主来源元数据）
analysis.output: 时间标定的系统发育树、结构变异图谱、重组热点识别、群体历史推断、全球扩散路径重建
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模、时空覆盖最广的OsHV-1全基因组数据集与严谨的演化分析框架，显著推进了水产病原病毒分子流行病学研究，但属特定病原体的高质量描述性工作，未提出普适性算法/模型/实验范式，也未解决跨物种或跨病毒科的深层演化理论问题，分量不及任何AI×生物基石工作（如ESM系列或AlphaFold），但强于一般纯计算benchmark论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是水产病毒演化领域近年最扎实的实证研究，数据规模与分析深度俱佳，但属于垂直领域内的重要进展，非范式突破或通用技术输出。

papers.title: GeoHAT: Geometry-Adaptive Hybrid Action Transformer for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Whole-body mobile manipulation requires coordinating mobile base and manipulator under shifting viewpoints, posing challenges in geometric perception and action generation. Current policies either rely on 2D features or sparse 3D representations that lack dense spatial structure, and typically encode arm and base within one action vector that ignores their distinct control demands. Moreover, existing dense fusion strategies risk corrupting pretrained representations under noisy depth while incurring heavy computational overhead. We present GeoHAT, an end-to-end diffusion-based framework built on a simple principle: geometry should be injected only where reliable and attended to only where needed. GeoHAT employs a lightweight Fourier spatial encoder that maps dense per-pixel 3D coordinates into geometric tokens without an additional 3D vision backbone. These tokens are then selectively injected into vision foundation model features through per-token gated fusion modulated by depth validity, preserving the semantic prior while enriching spatial understanding. For action generation, a Hybrid Whole-Body Action Decoder decomposes arm and base into distinct subspaces and lets each action modality attend to its task-relevant visual context through sparse cross-attention, while causal temporal modeling captures intra-timestep coordination and inter-timestep dependencies. Experiments on the ManiSkill-HAB simulation benchmark demonstrate that GeoHAT achieves a 79.3% mean success rate, surpassing the strongest baseline by 23.7%. Furthermore, real-world experiments on diverse tasks also confirm consistent improvements over all baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出GeoHAT框架，用轻量傅里叶空间编码器将密集3D坐标转为几何token，再通过深度有效性门控的稀疏跨模态融合注入视觉基础模型特征，并用分离式混合动作解码器分别建模机械臂和移动底盘的动作，最终在仿真和真实机器人上均显著提升移动操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 几何信息应仅在可靠处注入、仅在需要处关注，通过门控稀疏融合与解耦动作建模，可在不破坏视觉先验的前提下提升移动操作的空间感知与动作生成能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 移动底盘与机械臂的联合动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确具体机器人平台，仅提‘real-world experiments on diverse tasks’，无型号/品牌/传感器细节
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集的数据；实验含real-world但未披露数据来源或规模，推测为小规模自采
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有合理性（几何token化+门控融合+解耦动作解码），仿真提升显著（+23.7%），且验证了真实场景泛化性，但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据、未披露真实硬件配置与任务细节、无消融实验支撑核心设计选择，也未与ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy等基石方法对比，属于扎实但封闭的增量改进，未达工程整合级（需至少code+real-robot多任务+消融）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了移动操作中几何表征与动作解耦的局部问题，但闭源、缺消融、未对标基石方法，暂不具备可复现的范式影响力

papers.title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Affective and cognitive disorders manifest as distributed, time-varying brain network dynamics across regions, channels, and time, challenging robust representation learning from EEG/sEEG for clinical diagnosis. We propose RECTOR (Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling), an end-to-end self-supervised framework that unifies joint region-channel-temporal representation learning beyond fixed anatomical priors. At its core, RECTOR-SA is a hierarchical, block-sparse self-attention induced by Adaptive Functional Partitioning that evolves region structures from static anatomical definitions to adaptive functional regions. The self-supervision is driven by Masked Topology and Representation Learning, which jointly optimizes three complementary objectives: Masked Predictive Modeling, Topological Structure Modeling, and Cross-View Consistency. Across diverse benchmarks, RECTOR sets a new state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification. Crucially, its strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization underscores its potential for large-scale pre-training on heterogeneous EEG/sEEG, providing interpretable insights at both region and channel levels.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RECTOR的自监督模型，专门从脑电（EEG/sEEG）信号中学习情绪和认知状态表征，通过动态划分功能脑区、掩码建模区域-通道-时间三维结构，在情绪识别和任务参与度分类任务上刷出新SOTA，并声称对缺损通道和不同电极布设方式有强鲁棒性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Jinhan Liu与Mahsa Shoaran无明确知名机构关联线索）
analysis.claim: 无需固定解剖先验，通过自监督联合建模脑电信号的区域-通道-时间三维拓扑结构，可学习鲁棒、可解释、跨布设泛化的表征，支撑情绪与认知状态判别。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的EEG/sEEG时序信号（含多通道、多时间点、隐含空间位置）
analysis.output: 情绪类别或任务参与度标签（分类输出），以及可解释的功能脑区/通道重要性图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开/私有脑电数据集（如DEAP、SEED、sEEG临床数据等）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽引入区域-通道-时间联合掩码建模和自适应功能分区，但未披露所用数据集细节、未开源代码/模型、无消融验证核心设计（如Adaptive Functional Partitioning的实际贡献）、未在临床真实场景（如跨中心、跨设备、小样本部署）验证鲁棒性；仅报告标准离线分类准确率提升，属窄域算法改进，远未触及BCI临床落地的核心瓶颈（如个体间差异、长期漂移、低信噪比下的实时解码）。

papers.title: GALILEO: Embodied AI scientist for autonomous therapeutic discovery in dynamic membrane systems
papers.abstract: Generalizable Agentic Laboratory Intelligence for Learning, Experimentation, and Optimization (GALILEO) closes the prediction-to-intervention gap in therapeutic peptide discovery. Unlike prior AI-scientist systems, GALILEO couples an Observation-Thought-Action-Summary (OTAS) reasoning loop with robotic peptide synthesis and multimodal phenotyping. Candidate peptides are retrieved from a clinically informed peptide prior (CPP) and locally edited through auditable operations. GALILEO autonomously prioritized LRRC8C and SLC25A1 branches and used wet-lab feedback to update target beliefs, sequence policies, assay choices, and mechanism hypotheses. Peptides generated under this framework blocked LRRC8C currents, perturbed osmolyte/redox homeostasis, and promoted tumor-dependent T-cell activation, while SLC25A1 peptides disrupted citrate-export metabolism, reduced extracellular acidosis, and enhanced CD8+ T-cell function. These results establish retrieval-and-editing-based physical learning as a route for auditable, experimentally grounded interventions and transferable membrane-blocker rules.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫GALILEO的AI科学家系统，能自主完成从肽序列检索、局部编辑、机器人合成、多模态表型检测到机制假说更新的全闭环治疗性肽发现流程，重点针对动态膜蛋白系统（如LRRC8C和SLC25A1），并在湿实验验证中实现了功能导向的肽设计与生物学机制反推。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明确机构署名如DeepMind/AlphaFold团队/中科院/清华等；通讯作者信息缺失；仅从姓名风格推测可能含中英合作，但无法确认主导方）
analysis.claim: 检索+可审计编辑的物理学习范式（retrieval-and-editing-based physical learning）能实现可追溯、实验驱动、跨靶点泛化的膜蛋白干预肽自主发现。
analysis.input: 临床知情肽先验（CPP）、湿实验反馈信号（电生理、代谢物、免疫表型等多模态读数）
analysis.output: 可执行的肽序列、机器人合成指令、靶标优先级排序、机制假说更新、 assay选择策略
analysis.robot_dependency: 机器人肽合成平台 + 多模态表型分析硬件（如膜片钳、代谢检测、流式细胞仪）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实湿实验反馈（明确提及‘wet-lab feedback to update target beliefs’，且所有关键结论均基于湿实验结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现AI科学家在膜蛋白靶向肽发现中端到端闭环（检索→编辑→合成→多模态表型→机制迭代），且所有核心结论（LRRC8C电流阻断、SLC25A1代谢重编程、T细胞功能增强）均基于真实湿实验验证，跨两个独立靶点展示可迁移规则；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未提供可复现的benchmark细节，也未与ESM/AlphaFold等结构建模范式深度耦合，属重磅工程级突破而非基础模型级跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将大语言推理、机器人自动化与多模态湿实验闭环打通，并在真实生物学问题上产出可验证机制性成果，但缺乏开源与方法普适性证明，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式开创地位。

papers.title: Learning Controlled Separation of Small Objects Between Two Fingers with a Tactile Skin
papers.abstract: We introduce and solve the novel task of controlled separation of small objects with two fingers of a multi-purpose robotic hand: after grasping into a box of small objects, the task is to drop as many of them until a desired number remains between the fingers. The objects are small compared to the width of the fingers but also in absolute terms. In our case little pellets with a diameter of only 6mm are handled. We show that the task can be performed purely tactile (no vision) using a spatially-resolved tactile skin on a fingertip. The separation policy is trained in simulation via reinforcement learning using a straightforward sparse reward, which basically checks if the desired number of objects is reached. In simulation experiments, we provide an exhaustive analysis of the benefits of using spatially-resolved tactile feedback: while an ideal (high-resolution) tactile sensor allows solving the task almost perfectly, a sensor with lower spatial resolution (here 4x4 taxels) still leads to an improvement of up to 20% compared to using only the fingers' joint sensors. For this analysis, we further train an estimator alongside the policy that predicts the ground truth contact positions. Finally, we demonstrate the successful sim-to-real transfer for the DLR-Hand II equipped with a tactile skin.

analysis.tldr: 用带空间分辨能力的指尖触觉皮肤，纯靠触觉（不用视觉）让机器人双手指在抓取一堆小弹珠后，精准控制松开数量，只留下指定个数夹在指间，整个策略在仿真中训练、成功迁移到DLR-Hand II真机上。
analysis.claim: 空间分辨的触觉反馈（即使低分辨率）对微小物体夹持中的受控分离任务具有不可替代性，且该能力可通过纯触觉RL策略实现并完成sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 指尖触觉皮肤的空间触压分布（taxel阵列）+手指关节角度
analysis.output: 手指关节速度/力矩控制指令（连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: DLR-Hand II + 自研触觉皮肤
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅用仿真生成的触觉-动力学轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦于一个具体、狭窄但有实际意义的微操作子任务（受控分离），提供了扎实的仿真消融（高/低分辨率触觉对比）、联合训练估计器验证感知有效性，并完成了单机体真机部署；但无跨手型/跨物体泛化，无开源代码模型，未与主流端到端策略（如ACT/RT-2类）对比，也未解决触觉鲁棒性、长期扰动或开放词汇指令等更广义挑战。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定微操作+触觉驱动范式下验证了空间触觉的价值并完成真机落地，但任务封闭、泛化弱、生态孤立，不属于范式突破或系统级推进。

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Optimization for Robust Protein Stability Prediction
papers.abstract: Multimodal $ΔΔG$ predictors integrating protein language models with inverse-folding representations achieve strong in-distribution accuracy on the Megascale dataset but exhibit limited robustness on out-of-distribution (OOD) proteins, persistent forward-reverse bias on paired-mutation benchmarks, and under-representation of rare stabilizing mutations. Existing approaches address these limitations primarily through additional architectural components, leaving optimization-level intervention comparatively underexplored. We introduce a constraint-aware optimization framework combining Balanced Mean Squared Error, a Siamese anti-symmetric regularizer, and a novel OOD-margin consistency loss on the per-position feature representation, requiring no architectural changes to the SPURS backbone. Across eleven benchmarks and three random seeds, the framework improves Spearman correlation on S669 from 0.486 to 0.540 ($σ=0.002$ across seeds), matching the published SPURS baseline (0.50) without architectural modification, and on S461 from 0.653 to 0.711, with consistent smaller gains on five additional OOD datasets. A controlled diagnostic on Ssym reveals that anti-symmetric training does not eliminate systematic forward-reverse bias, indicating that gains arise through implicit regularization rather than exact thermodynamic constraint enforcement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没改模型结构，只在训练优化层面加了三种约束性损失（平衡MSE、反称正则、OOD特征间隔一致性），提升了现有蛋白稳定性预测模型SPURS在多个跨分布数据集上的鲁棒性，尤其改善了对罕见稳定突变的识别和部分前向-反向偏差。
analysis.claim: 优化层面的约束设计（而非架构修改）可显著提升蛋白ΔΔG预测器在OOD场景下的鲁棒性和热力学一致性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+单点突变位置与氨基酸替换（如 A123V）
analysis.output: 突变导致的自由能变化ΔΔG数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在SPURS基线上做优化改进，跨11个基准有统计显著提升（尤其S461 +5.8点），但未突破ΔΔG预测的根本瓶颈（如物理可解释性缺失、长程构象效应建模不足），也未引入新数据模态或新任务范式；相比ESM/AlphaFold等基石工作（90+分），它只是特定子任务（OOD稳定性预测）的稳健性补丁，非范式转移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在不改动模型结构的前提下，用优化策略缓解了蛋白稳定性预测中长期存在的OOD泛化弱和前向-反向偏差问题，但未触及底层建模缺陷，也不具备跨任务迁移价值。

papers.title: Multiscale reconstruction of protein conformations from cryo-EM images
papers.abstract: We present a novel multiscale algorithm for directly recovering the atomic model structure of a protein from single-particle cryo-EM data. Our algorithm is able to estimate protein structures to state-of-the-art accuracy for high-noise and low-contrast data. It is also robust to misspecifications in the TEM image formation model. These desirable properties are primarily due to the use of an explicit representation of the protein backbone in terms of bonds, torsion angles and bond angles, which supplies rich prior information to the structure recovery process. We apply our method on three protein cryo-EM datasets, generated using an electron microscope digital twin, and show that using a multiscale approach yields an improvement of the root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) and template modelling (TM) scores with respect to the ground truth. Furthermore, there is evidence that larger-scale structures are being prioritised with the multiscale algorithm, which reduces the possibility of convergence to bad local minima.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种多尺度算法，直接从单颗粒冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）图像中重建蛋白质原子级三维结构，用显式的键-二面角-键角骨架参数化作为强先验，在数字孪生仿真数据上验证了比单尺度方法更低的RMSD和更高的TM分数。
analysis.claim: 显式建模蛋白质骨架几何约束的多尺度优化框架，能在高噪声、低对比度cryo-EM图像下更鲁棒、更准确地恢复原子模型，且对电子显微镜成像模型误设不敏感。
analysis.input: 单颗粒cryo-EM二维投影图像（含噪声与CTF失真）
analysis.output: 蛋白质原子坐标（Cα主链+侧链可选）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（electron microscope digital twin），无真实cryo-EM实验数据验证
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在数字孪生仿真数据上验证，未在真实cryo-EM数据（如EMPIAR）上测试，未与主流工具（CryoSPARC、RELION、DeepTracer、IsoNet、AlphaFold-EM）做公平对比，无消融实验证明多尺度设计的必要性，也未展示对分辨率<3.5Å或异质样本等实际瓶颈问题的改进；属于方法学层面的稳健性改良，但未触及当前领域核心瓶颈（如伪影鲁棒性、构象异质性建模、原子精度侧链放置）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真验证、无真实数据基准、未对标主流工具、缺乏消融与泛化分析，尚不具备进入蛋白质结构计算主流工作流的实证基础。

papers.title: VLALeaks: Membership Inference Attacks against Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control and have garnered widespread attention. However, the memorization of training data inherent to VLA, coupled with the high cost of robotic data acquisition, raises serious concerns regarding data privacy leakage and intellectual property infringement. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a given sample belongs to the training set. While representing a significant privacy threat, this attack remains underexplored in the context of VLA models. To bridge this gap, we propose VLALeaks, which is based on attention discrepancies in VLA models. We reveal, for the first time, the privacy vulnerabilities of VLA models. Specifically, it comprises a two-stage process: (1) membership feature extraction, and (2) attack model construction. Experimental results across multiple VLA benchmarks demonstrate that VLALeaks readily reveals membership information and achieves optimal attack AUC and TPR@1\%FPR, highlighting the privacy vulnerabilities in current VLA model deployments. Our work is the first systematic study of MIAs on VLA models, aiming to provide insights for secure and trustworthy VLA models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的数据成员推断攻击（MIA），提出一种基于注意力机制差异的攻击方法VLALeaks，实验证明多个主流VLA模型在训练数据上存在显著隐私泄露风险。
analysis.claim: VLA模型因训练数据稀缺且易被记忆，存在可被量化检测的成员推断漏洞，VLALeaks能以高精度识别某样本是否参与过模型训练。
analysis.input: 原始图像-语言-动作三元组样本（用于攻击时作为查询输入）
analysis.output: 二分类预测：该样本是否属于目标VLA模型的训练集
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需VLA模型对给定样本的内部注意力输出（如attention maps）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为VLA领域首个MIA工作，但无开源代码/模型/数据，未披露攻击所需访问权限级别（白盒/黑盒），实验仅报告AUC/TPR@1%FPR等指标，缺乏真实部署场景下的隐私影响评估（如泄露敏感任务轨迹、用户指令模板等），也未与机器人领域隐私威胁模型（如逆向策略、技能窃取）建立关联，属窄口径安全分析，未触及VLA核心能力或可靠性问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：是安全子方向的初步探索，但缺乏可复现性、攻击实用性验证和领域相关性深度，对VLA模型研发、部署或伦理治理无实质推动。

papers.title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable dual-agent videos synthesizing both speaker speech and expression alongside listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个能实时感知对方视频、用心理理论（ToM）推断其隐藏意图、再生成带情绪反应的双人互动视频（说话者+倾听者动作表情）的闭环数字人系统，不是简单播语音配嘴型，而是让两个AI角色在信息不对称下‘真正对话’。
analysis.claim: 通过构建感知-推理-表达闭环的双智能体框架，结合心理学驱动的Persona-Scenario数据集，在信息不对称条件下，显式心智状态推理比全知脚本模式更能激发高质量、有社会深度的对话。
analysis.input: 对方视频流（含面部/肢体/语音）
analysis.output: 双人协同视频：说话者语音+口型+表情 + 倾听者实时反应性微表情/点头/视线等非语言反馈
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成视频与标注数据，无真实机器人或真人交互数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将ToM显式建模引入社交数字人闭环生成，并构造了有心理依据的评估数据集，但所有实验均在合成视频和静态场景中进行，无真实交互验证，未测试跨人格/跨文化/跨任务泛化，对话质量提升仅体现在特定自动指标上，且未开源代码或模型，实质推进限于方法论演示层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把ToM、多模态感知、可控视频生成串成闭环是完整工程实践，但缺乏真实交互验证和开放性，尚未构成社会AI领域的实质性突破。

papers.title: Leveraging genome-wide association studies and genomic prediction for distinctness, uniformity, and stability (DUS) testing in maize
papers.abstract: Testing for distinctness, uniformity, and stability (DUS) is a requirement for plant variety registration and based on phenotypic traits, which is time-consuming and sensitive to envi-ronmental variation. Advances in genomics allow to complement DUS testing with molecular markers, for which two models in DUS testing were proposed by the Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV). A use cases was described for maize, but an implementation has been hindered by a lack of suitable markers and validated analytical frameworks. We ad-dress these challenges by integrating historical DUS characteristics scores from 352 European hybrid maize varieties with high-density genome-wide single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data. Using genome-wide association studies (GWAS), we identified 18 genomic regions and candidate genes associated with 12 DUS characteristics, enabling the development of diag-nostic markers consistent with the UPOV model "Characteristic-Specific Molecular Markers". Since most DUS traits are polygenic, we combined GWAS-informed marker selection with XG-Boost-based machine learning to predict notes of DUS characteristics. This approach achieved strong predictive performance across multiple traits (mean accuracy 0.67), demonstrating its potential for managing reference collections under UPOV model "Combining phenotypic and molecular distances in the management of variety collections". Both approaches were validated for two characteristics using independent public USDA-NPGS maize datasets (>1,700 accessions) highlighting the value of public data for method validation. We also identify key limitations of historical DUS data, including imbalanced and sparse trait representation, and discuss mitigation strategies. Despite these constraints, our results demonstrate that molecular markers may improve maize DUS testing, enabling faster, more accurate variety registration and supporting accelerated crop improvement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用全基因组关联分析（GWAS）和XGBoost机器学习，把玉米品种DUS测试（区分度、一致性、稳定性）从传统耗时的田间表型观察，转向基于SNP分子标记的预测，实现了部分性状的准确预测，并验证了UPOV提出的两种分子辅助DUS模型。
analysis.claim: 基于历史DUS评分与高密度SNP数据，可构建符合UPOV框架的性状特异性分子标记及多性状预测模型，显著提升玉米品种DUS测试效率与稳健性。
analysis.input: 高密度SNP基因型数据 + 历史DUS性状评分（352个欧洲杂交种）
analysis.output: 12个DUS性状的预测评分（分类等级）及18个关联基因组区域/候选基因
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖植物育种历史表型与基因型数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的农业基因组学应用研究：首次在玉米中系统实现UPOV两种分子DUS模型的实证落地，有独立数据集验证（USDA-NPGS >1700份材料），但未开源代码/模型，性状预测精度中等（均值0.67），且受限于历史DUS数据稀疏与不平衡；远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破，也未解决核心瓶颈（如DUS性状定义模糊、跨环境泛化差），属领域内有价值的工程化推进而非科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——将UPOV分子DUS框架首次在玉米中完整闭环验证，但受限于数据质量与开源程度，尚未形成可推广的方法论或工具链。

papers.title: ROG-Grasp: Root-Oriented Geometry for Robotic Grasping and Placement
papers.abstract: Orientation-aware manipulation is essential in post-harvest agricultural processing, where produce must be grasped and placed in consistent configurations. This paper presents ROG-Grasp, a geometry-based robotic grasping and placement framework that estimates the produce orientation from root surface geometry using RGB-D perception. A YOLO-based root detector and point cloud plane fitting are used to infer the root normal, enabling stable grasp pose generation and orientation-constrained Cartesian motion planning. Experiments on tomatoes and onions demonstrate high success rates and stable execution time in both isolated and cluttered scenarios. Compared with vision-language-action (VLA) policies, the proposed method achieves more reliable and accurate grasp completion with faster execution. These results highlight the effectiveness of geometry-driven perception for practical orientation-controlled manipulation tasks. A video of our paper is available online https://youtu.be/Ir2UtGODdMo.

analysis.tldr: 用RGB-D相机识别果蔬根部几何结构（如根尖方向），通过拟合根部表面平面估计法向量，从而生成稳定抓取位姿和朝向约束的运动轨迹，专用于农业采后加工中要求一致朝向的抓取与摆放任务。
analysis.claim: 果蔬根部表面几何（而非语义或纹理）是可靠且计算高效的朝向感知线索，可替代大模型VLA策略实现更鲁棒、更快的定向抓取与放置。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（含深度点云）+果蔬类别（番茄/洋葱）
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿 + 朝向约束的笛卡尔运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的番茄/洋葱根部点云数据（摘要未提合成数据，实验均在真机完成）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决农业定向操作这一窄领域实际问题，方法清晰、真机验证扎实（多场景/多物体/对比VLA），但未开源代码/模型，无跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、无长期部署证据，技术组件均为成熟组合（YOLO+PCA平面拟合+IK），未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、开放词汇理解、世界建模）。

papers.title: LRP2: A proteogenomics pipeline for long-read informed protein isoform analysis and discovery
papers.abstract: Most human genes produce multiple RNA isoforms, yet it remains unclear which isoforms are translated into stable, functional proteins. Long-read RNA-sequencing resolves full-length transcript structures and, when paired with mass spectrometry, can provide empirical evidence of isoform translation. Despite this opportunity, comprehensive workflows integrating isoform discovery, open reading frame prediction, peptide identification, and protein inference remain limited, leaving users to handle these steps piecemeal. Here, we present LRP2, a modular, end-to-end long-read proteogenomics pipeline built in Nextflow. LRP2 scales transcript discovery to hundreds of samples via PacBio's latest Isocall tool, removes technical artifacts with SQANTI QC, generates and classifies predicted proteomes via CPAT and SQANTI Protein, performs multi-group differential expression and usage analysis via edgeR, DRIMSeq and a long-read adaptation of LeafCutter, and integrates protein-level evidence from DDA and DIA MS data through FragPipe. For cross-dataset comparison of novel isoforms, LRP2 employs deterministic splice-junction, coordinate-based isoform identifiers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫LRP2的生物信息学流程，把长读长RNA测序数据和质谱蛋白质组数据自动串联起来，从RNA转录本发现、开放阅读框预测、肽段鉴定到蛋白异构体推断全链路自动化，目标是找出哪些RNA异构体真能翻译成稳定蛋白。
analysis.claim: LRP2是首个支持大规模样本、端到端整合长读长RNA测序与质谱数据以系统性发现和验证蛋白异构体的可复现、模块化proteogenomics流程。
analysis.input: PacBio长读长RNA-seq数据 + DDA/DIA质谱原始数据
analysis.output: 经实验证据支持的蛋白异构体列表（含确定性splice-junction标识符）及差异表达/使用分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯计算生物学）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具链工程整合（Nextflow+PacBio+SQANTI+CPAT+FragPipe），但未提出新算法模型，无新实验验证，未建立领域新范式或解决长期开放难题；相比AlphaFold2等90+分基石工作，它只是将已有工具标准化串联，且仅面向小众proteogenomics子领域，影响力有限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有的长读长RNA分析和质谱分析工具用Nextflow封装成流水线，提升了可复现性，但无算法/生物学新发现，不属于突破。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Inner-loop Dynamics Estimator for Aerial Manipulation under Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Aerial manipulators enable physical interaction in hard-to-reach environments; however, the combined problem of direct whole-body aerial manipulation under rapid arm motion, payload changes, and related unknown dynamic uncertainty remains a largely unsolved problem. We present a hierarchical control framework that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with an inner-loop dynamics estimator to address this problem. The RL outer loop maps desired 6-degrees-of-freedom (DOF) end-effector targets to coordinated whole-body commands, enabling direct task-driven control without relying on a fully accurate coupled dynamic model in the policy layer. An inner loop then tracks these commands while compensating for transient inertial shifts and uncertainty during execution via a dynamics estimator scheme without requiring system model knowledge. We validate the proposed approach on a custom quadrotor equipped with a 3-DoF manipulator through hardware experiments under varying payload conditions. Compared with RL+PID and RL+INDI+PID baselines, the proposed method reduces end-effector tracking error and improves task success rate across the tested hardware conditions. These results show that combining learned whole-body coordination with estimator-based low-level compensation improves the precision and robustness of aerial manipulation under changing operating conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个分层控制框架，外层用强化学习把末端目标映射成整机动作指令，内层用无需精确模型的动力学估计器实时补偿飞行器-机械臂耦合系统在载荷突变、快速运动下的动态不确定性，并在自研四旋翼+3自由度机械臂硬件上做了真实实验验证。
analysis.claim: 无需精确耦合动力学模型的分层架构（RL外环 + 数据驱动动力学估计内环）可显著提升空中机械臂在载荷变化和动态不确定性下的末端跟踪精度与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 6自由度末端期望位姿、当前状态观测（含IMU/关节编码器等）
analysis.output: 整机协调控制指令（旋翼推力+关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四旋翼+3-DoF机械臂硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在不同载荷下的闭环执行数据用于训练和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了空中机械臂在真实载荷扰动下的鲁棒操作问题，有实机多工况验证和基线对比，但仅限单一平台、未开源、无跨机体/跨任务泛化证据，属于扎实的垂直领域工程改进，远未达H2O/GR00T等具身智能基石级工作所定义的新范式或通用能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定空中机械臂硬件上实现了带动力学估计的RL分层控制，实证有效但封闭、不可复现、泛化范围窄，尚未构成方法论层面的突破。

papers.title: RDGen: Demonstration Generation for High-Quality Robot Learning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot control. However, their performance remains fundamentally constrained by the availability of high-quality robot trajectory data. In current robot learning practice, such data are primarily collected through human teleoperation, which is labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. In this paper, we propose RDGen, a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework for generating high-quality robot demonstrations. Rather than employing reinforcement learning solely as the final control policy, RDGen leverages trained RL policies as a structured trajectory generator. The system consists of a VLM-based task parser that identifies task-relevant objects, a Grounding DINO-based object localizer, and an RL policy transferred from simulation to the real robot. Successful rollouts are then harvested as clean, high-quality demonstrations for downstream VLA training, while the simulation stage further provides a scalable source of additional trajectories at little marginal cost. Experiments on a pick-and-place task demonstrate that the transferred RL policy achieves a high task success rate. Compared with human teleoperation, RDGen produces significantly smoother trajectories and yields superior downstream VLA performance. These results indicate that RL-generated demonstrations can serve as more reliable and consistent supervisory signals for robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用仿真训练的RL策略在真实机器人上自动生成高质量操作轨迹（如抓取放置），替代费时费力的人类遥操，生成的数据更平滑、下游VLA模型训练效果更好。
analysis.claim: RL策略经sim2real迁移后可作为高质量机器人演示生成器，其产出的轨迹比人类遥操更平滑、更适合作为VLA模型的监督信号。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验在真机完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人成功rollout用于验证和筛选，不依赖大规模真实演示数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一pick-and-place任务上验证，无跨任务/跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，无消融分析RL生成数据相比人类数据的具体优势来源，未开源代码或数据，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA）对比下游性能，实质贡献限于‘用RL生成演示’这一已有思路（如MimicGen）的轻量变体，但缺乏规模、鲁棒性与可复现性支撑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：方法思路不新，实证薄弱，无开源，仅单任务小规模真机验证，未达到当前领域基石工作（如MimicGen=89）的严谨性与影响力门槛。

papers.title: Scale Buys Interpolation, Structure Buys a Horizon: Certified Predictability for Equivariant World Models
papers.abstract: Scale buys interpolation; structure buys a certified horizon. A world model's average error says nothing about whether a particular prediction can be trusted, or for how long. For equivariant latent world models we give a computable, multi-step certificate of the predictable horizon: $T$-step rollout error is provably constant over each symmetry orbit (Theorem A) and stratified channel-by-channel by the predictor's Lyapunov spectrum, $T_j(ε)\sim\log(1/ε)/λ_j$. The horizon is two-sided -- a matching lower bound makes approximate equivariance provably horizon-limited -- and the certificate is exclusive to structure: orbit-constant error characterizes equivariance, so no non-equivariant model has it at any scale. Empirically, on 40-D Lorenz-96 only a $\mathbb{Z}_N$-equivariant network recovers the full Lyapunov spectrum ($R^2{=}0.98$); dense and recurrent baselines fail. Because the spectrum is faithful, the certificate acts, a priori: under a fixed sensing budget a $c\times$-inflated certificate provably needs $c\times$ the budget, and the equivariant certificate meets a budget its inflated dense counterpart cannot -- with zero calibration data. The same read-out, unchanged, audits public pretrained world models training-free: TD-MPC2 checkpoints land on the certificate's own scope taxonomy -- calibrated where strongly expansive (ratio 0.94-1.02), optimistic where weakly expansive, correctly abstaining where contracting -- a map a deployed monitor replicates cell-by-cell, out-of-sample. Across the official 1M-317M multitask ladder, calibration does not improve with parameters. On V-JEPA 2-AC (1B, real robot data) the measured cross-check correctly overrides an over-promising tangent spectrum -- the cross-validated audit, not the raw number, is the deployable object. Scale buys interpolation, not a calibrated horizon.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对等变潜世界模型的可证明预测可信度理论框架，能严格计算多步预测的‘可预测时间窗口’（horizon），该窗口由模型内在的李雅普诺夫谱决定，并证明只有等变结构才能提供这种轨道恒定误差的证书，纯靠扩大参数规模无法获得；它还用该证书对多个公开预训练世界模型（如TD-MPC2、V-JEPA）做了零样本、免训练的部署级可靠性审计。
analysis.claim: 只有具备显式等变结构的世界模型才能提供可证明的、轨道恒定的多步预测误差证书，该证书由其李雅普诺夫谱严格刻画，且不可通过单纯扩大模型规模获得。
analysis.input: 状态序列（如Lorenz-96系统演化轨迹）
analysis.output: 可证明的T步预测误差上界（即‘可预测时间窗口’）及按通道分层的李雅普诺夫谱估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，实验基于40维Lorenz-96仿真和公开预训练checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3（96分）与World Models（97分）之间的关键理论缺口：首次为世界模型提供可证明、可审计、免校准的预测可信度证书，并实证验证其在多个SOTA模型上的零样本部署监控能力；虽未开源代码/模型，但理论严密、实验跨模型、结论具工程判据力，属理论驱动型重大推进，但尚未落地真机闭环验证，故略低于DreamerV3级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立世界模型预测可靠性的可证明证书体系，将‘能预测多久可信’从经验观察升格为可计算、可审计、可部署的数学属性，且实证穿透多个SOTA模型。

papers.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representation introduces costly geometric decoding and slows down causal action generation. To address the trade-off, we present WAM4D, a fast 4D world action model that uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, then removes the register branch for lightweight action inference. To prevent non-causal shortcuts, we further design causal mixture attention for the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM backbone, defining modality-specific visibility among video, action, and geometry tokens. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that WAM4D improves spatial consistency and achieves competitive action prediction while maintaining efficient inference.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM4D模型，用轻量级空间寄存器token在训练时引入3D几何先验，推理时移除该分支，实现兼顾空间一致性与快速动作预测的4D世界动作建模。
analysis.claim: 通过可剥离的空间寄存器token机制，将预训练几何先验高效注入因果视频-动作Transformer，在不牺牲推理速度的前提下提升4D世界模型的空间一致性与动作预测质量。

analysis.output: 未来动作序列+4D世界状态（含深度/几何结构）的紧凑隐式表示
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提RoboTwin 2.0（仿真）和real-world manipulation tasks但无细节
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出寄存器token与因果混合注意力等新设计，但缺乏真实机器人多任务验证、无消融实验细节、未开源、未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石模型在统一基准上对比；RoboTwin 2.0为仿真，real-world仅泛泛提及，实证强度远低于分量标尺中任意一项（最低门槛DayDreamer=93），属扎实但窄幅的架构改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了合理但局部的模块化改进，有技术细节但缺乏系统性实证支撑，尚未达到领域基石级贡献

papers.title: Slots, Transitions, Loops: Learning Composable World Models for ARC
papers.abstract: ARC tests in-context rule induction: given a few input-output demonstrations, a model must infer the hidden rule and apply it to a new query. While many approaches express ARC rules through language, code, or symbolic programs, ARC itself is visual-symbolic: rules appear as grid transitions over objects, colors, shapes, and spatial relations. We introduce Loop-OWM, an object-centric world-modeling architecture that learns these rules as composable transitions over structured states. It combines color-prototype slots, demonstration-conditioned task summaries, and a looped transition model with dense propagation and slot-conditioned correction. On both ARC-1 and ARC-2, Loop-OWM outperforms non-looped and looped baselines with comparable or fewer parameters. These results suggest that ARC rules can be learned not only as language descriptions or searched programs, but also as transitions over visual-symbolic world states.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Loop-OWM模型，把ARC视觉推理任务建模成对象槽位（slots）上的可组合状态转移过程，用循环式世界模型学习输入-输出网格图之间的视觉符号化变换规则，不依赖语言或程序生成，直接在像素级结构化表征上做推演。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所

papers.title: FlipItRight: Stable Pose-Targeted Throw-Flip Across Diverse Objects
papers.abstract: We propose FlipItRight, a framework for stable planar pose-targeted throw-flip with a high-DoF manipulator. The task is decomposed into an object-level planner, which generates candidate release states satisfying the desired landing pose, and a robot-level planner, which evaluates executability and constructs a feasible swing motion. Treating the release state as an explicit intermediate representation enables principled candidate filtering, adaptive selection of release and pre-swing configurations, and structured near-release motion design -- in particular, approximately constant end-effector velocities during the final swing phase to improve robustness to release-timing uncertainty. We validate on a real platform across objects of varying shape, size, and mass, achieving a 90% success rate across 120 trials. Ablation studies confirm that each design choice contributes to throwing performance, and the framework requires no prior data or learned model, enabling direct deployment on new objects and targets without environment-specific calibration or data collection.

analysis.tldr: 用机械臂把各种形状大小重量的物体抛起并精准翻转，让它们以指定平面朝向稳稳落地，全程不依赖任何训练数据或学习模型，纯基于物理建模和运动规划实现。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模释放状态作为中间表示，结合对象级与机器人级双层规划，可在无任何真实数据或学习模型的前提下，实现跨多样物体的稳定姿态目标抛翻。
analysis.input: 目标平面姿态（如某面朝下）、物体几何与质量参数（形状/尺寸/质心/惯量）
analysis.output: 完整关节轨迹（含预摆、加速、释放前恒速摆动段）

analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（摘要明确声明‘no prior data or learned model’）

papers.title: An Augmented Reality Brain-Robot Interface for Generalist Robot Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract: The integration of augmented reality (AR) and EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offers a promising path for enabling intuitive control of robots for assistive purposes. However, existing AR brain-robot interface (BRI) systems are often constrained to task-specific structures, limiting their utility in real-world environments. We present an AR BRI designed for generalist robot arm manipulation that combines gaze-based object selection with motor imagery action control. Our system uses eye-tracking for intuitive object targeting and context-aware visual overlays ("Place" and "Use") to guide the user through tasks within a shared autonomy framework. We evaluated the interface through a feasibility study with 18 healthy participants performing three multi-step activities of daily living: drinking, using a drawer, and operating an oven. Our results demonstrate that this interaction paradigm enables effective sequential task execution and high user engagement, achieving a "Good" usability rating (SUS > 70). These findings support the feasibility of the proposed interaction paradigm for complex BCI-driven robotic assistance, and motivate future evaluation with the intended target population. Project website: https://ar-bri-manip.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用AR眼镜+EEG脑电+眼动追踪，让用户通过看物体再想象动作来控制机械臂完成喝水、开抽屉、用烤箱等日常多步任务，属于概念验证型脑控机器人交互系统。
analysis.claim: 基于AR与EEG的通用型脑-机器人接口可通过注视选择+运动想象实现多步日常生活任务的共享自主操控，且具备可接受的可用性。
analysis.input: EEG信号+眼动轨迹+AR场景视觉反馈

analysis.significance_reason: 仅18名健康被试在纯仿真中完成3个预设任务，无真实机器人闭环、无患者数据、无跨任务泛化测试、无消融实验、无开源代码/模型；相比基石工作（如90+分的临床级BCI神经假体或脊髓接口），它停留在人机交互范式探索层面，未解决BCI解码可靠性、低信噪比鲁棒性、长期稳定性等核心科学问题，也未突破脑控操作的性能瓶颈。

papers.title: Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative policies provide a powerful policy class for reinforcement learning by inducing rich stochastic exploration through iterative action generation. However, the stochasticity of diffusion policies is not suitable for stable and precise control in high-dimensional robotic systems, where small action variations can accumulate into inconsistent motion and reduced robustness. To address this issue, we propose SteerGenPO, a latent-space reinforcement learning framework that steers a trained generative policy into a robust deterministic robotic controller. The key idea is to replace stochastic latent sampling of the trained generative policy with a learned latent actor that predicts a state-dependent latent input for the generative policies. This separates exploration and control: stochastic generative sampling provides diverse action proposals during policy learning, while deterministic latent steering provides stable and adaptive control at deployment. We evaluate SteerGenPO on six Isaac Lab benchmarks and a Unitree G1 locomotion task. The results show SteerGenPO improves over both classical RL and generative RL baselines, while its deterministic latent steering produces more stable inference-time behaviors and more reliable command responses.

analysis.tldr: 提出SteerGenPO框架，把训练好的扩散类生成策略（本身随机、不适合机器人控制）改造成确定性控制器：不直接采样随机隐变量，而是用一个学习到的‘隐空间执行器’根据当前状态预测确定性隐输入，从而在保持生成式策略探索能力的同时实现稳定实时控制。
analysis.claim: 生成式强化学习策略可通过解耦训练时的随机探索与部署时的确定性隐空间引导，转化为高稳定性机器人控制器。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（如关节角度、角速度等）
analysis.output: 确定性隐变量（作为预训练生成策略的输入），最终输出为确定性动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅在Isaac Lab仿真和Unitree G1真机上做部署验证（无闭环真实数据收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理洞见（解耦生成式探索与确定性执行），但在实证上仅验证于6个标准仿真任务+1个真机步态任务，无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，无消融证明隐空间设计必要性，未开源代码或模型，远未达到H2O/GR00T等基石工作所要求的范式级通用性、多模态整合或全栈部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——改进了生成式RL在机器人控制中的部署稳定性，但缺乏泛化验证、开源支持和跨场景证据，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: RealityBridge: Bridging Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting Driving Simulations and Real-World Videos
papers.abstract: Long-tail hazardous scenarios are essential for safety-oriented autonomous driving, yet they are difficult to collect and reproduce at scale. Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulation offers a promising alternative by reconstructing real driving scenes and supporting controllable scene editing. However, edited 3DGS-rendered videos still suffer from a significant Sim-to-Real gap, including rendering artifacts, degraded foreground assets, inconsistent illumination, and temporal flickering. Existing restoration and video generation methods are insufficient for this task, as they often fail to jointly repair 3DGS-specific artifacts, improve visual realism, and ensure temporal consistency. To fill this gap, we propose RealityBridge, a structure-preserving and asset-aware Sim-to-Real framework for edited 3DGS driving videos. RealityBridge uses multimodal controls, including rendered videos, foreground masks, edge maps, and semantic masks, together with a lightweight GateNet for adaptive condition allocation across backbone layers. We further construct targeted training data and introduce autoregressive long-video training with reward-guided post-training to improve restoration quality, temporal stability, and hallucination suppression. Extensive experiments on internal and public driving datasets show that RealityBridge outperforms existing methods in artifact removal, illumination harmonization, and long-sequence temporal consistency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RealityBridge框架，把可编辑的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）生成的自动驾驶仿真视频，通过多模态条件控制和轻量门控网络，修复渲染伪影、光照不一致和时序闪烁问题，使其更接近真实行车视频。
analysis.claim: 通过结构保持与资产感知的多模态修复框架，可显著缩小编辑后3DGS驾驶视频与真实世界视频之间的Sim-to-Real差距。
analysis.input: 3DGS渲染视频+前景掩码+边缘图+语义掩码
analysis.output: 修复后的高保真、时序一致的合成视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖真实驾驶视频用于构建训练/评估数据集（非闭环控制反馈）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量Sim-to-Real视频修复工作，但未涉及任何闭环控制、策略学习或机器人部署；其贡献限于视觉域的后处理增强，在自动驾驶仿真链路中处于下游环节，无法与RT-X/DROID/ALOHA等定义新范式或打通感知-动作闭环的基石工作相比，仅比纯刷榜或无实证的纯概念方法扎实，属于扎实增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在3DGS驱动仿真视频修复上做了系统性工程优化，但未触及自动驾驶核心决策或具身交互，不属于突破或领域基石。

papers.title: PLAN-S: Bridging Planning with Latent Style Dynamics for Autonomous Driving World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models (LWMs) have strengthened end-to-end autonomous driving by forecasting compact scene dynamics for downstream planning. However, existing LWM-based planners usually generate trajectories directly from entangled latent representations. This compact latent-to-planner pathway lacks explicit modeling of risk, drivability, and diverse style preferences, making driving-style dynamics difficult to supervise, inspect, or modulate before a final trajectory is selected. We propose PLAN-S (PLANning with latent Style dynamics), a planner-facing bridge that addresses this compactness-controllability dilemma by decoding a style-conditioned, four-channel semantic cost map from the latent representation. The cost map is conditioned on ego state and driving style and is consumed up-stream of the planning decision through two host-side interfaces: attention-level fusion for regression planners and reward-level fusion for anchor-score planners. We validate PLAN-S on two architecturally distinct hosts, ResWorld on nuScenes and WoTE on NAVSIM, while keeping the host backbones frozen to isolate the contribution of the proposed bridge. On nuScenes, PLAN-S reduces L2 at every horizon over the baseline, with 0.55 m average L2 and a 42% relative reduction in the 3 s collision rate. On NAVSIM, the rule-cost variant reaches 89.4 Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS), while the learned cost variant provides complementary gains on baseline-challenging scenes. Ablations show that the cost pathway contributes most directly to safer trajectory selection. Qualitative results further show that PLAN-S can produce diverse cost maps, with spatially consistent variations aligned to different driving styles.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PLAN-S，一种插在世界模型隐空间和下游规划器之间的‘风格感知成本图解码桥’，把原本黑箱的隐状态解耦成四个语义通道（如风险、可行驶性等）的成本图，并支持按驾驶风格调节，从而让规划器能更安全、更可控地选轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过在隐式世界模型与规划器之间引入风格条件化的四通道语义成本图解码模块，可显著提升自动驾驶轨迹的安全性与风格可控性，且无需微调原规划器主干。
analysis.input: 世界模型输出的紧凑隐状态 + 自车状态 + 驾驶风格标签
analysis.output: 四通道语义成本图（风险/可行驶性/舒适性/风格对齐度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实车辆数据，基于nuScenes和NAVSIM仿真数据训练验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在nuScenes/NAVSIM上报告了L2下降和碰撞率降低等量化提升，但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验验证各成本通道独立贡献，未测试跨数据集/跨规划器泛化，也未在真车或闭环仿真中验证安全性收益；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，它只是在LWM下游加了一个轻量解耦接口，未触及世界建模本质或决策范式变革，属扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐空间解耦为语义成本图是合理设计，有实测增益，但缺乏开源、消融、泛化与闭环验证，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: DLO-Lab: Benchmarking Deformable Linear Object Manipulations with Differentiable Physics
papers.abstract: We address the challenge of enabling robots to manipulate deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes, cables, and rubber bands. Prior work has primarily focused on narrow, task-specific problems, often relying on real-world demonstrations or handcrafted heuristics. Such approaches, however, struggle to scale to the wide variety of materials and tasks encountered in practice, and collecting sufficiently diverse real-world data is often impractical. Additionally, existing simulation environments offer limited support for the broad spectrum of material behaviors necessary for generalizable DLO manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a differentiable simulator explicitly designed for versatile DLO manipulation. Our simulator models a wide range of material properties-including (in)extensibility, elasticity, bending plasticity, and complex interactions with other objects-providing a robust foundation for learning and evaluating manipulation skills. Building on this simulator, we propose a benchmark suite of representative tasks that highlight the unique challenges of DLO manipulation. The successful execution of these tasks is often hindered by the topological complexity and grasp sensitivity inherent to DLOs. Therefore, we introduce a specialized DLO agent that explicitly manages these challenges by proposing strategic grasping points and decomposing long-horizon tasks to maximize control authority. Finally, we evaluate various policy-learning algorithms using our framework, alongside sim-to-real transfer experiments, demonstrating our platform's potential to advance DLO manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专为可变形线状物体（如绳子、电缆）操作设计的可微分物理仿真器DLO-Lab，并配套发布首个覆盖材料多样性、任务拓扑复杂性和抓取敏感性的基准测试套件，以及一个能主动规划抓点+分解长程任务的专用智能体，但所有实验仅在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过构建高保真可微分DLO仿真器与结构化基准，首次系统性支撑可泛化、可优化的线状柔性物体操作学习，克服了现有仿真缺乏材料谱系支持和任务定义零散的问题。
analysis.input: 初始DLO状态（几何+材质参数）+任务目标（如打结/穿环/绕柱）
analysis.output: 序列化机器人末端位姿与夹爪动作

analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部合成生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统构建DLO专用可微分仿真+结构化基准，填补领域空白，但无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨材料泛化验证、无SOTA算法对比消融、未开源代码或模型，仅展示若干策略在仿真内可行，属扎实但窄域的增量贡献，远未达ALOHA/ACT等基石级工作（需真机多任务+部署验证+开源生态）的分量。

papers.title: Visuotactile and Explicitly Force-Controlled Robotic Ultrasound for Abdominal Volumetric Reconstruction
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present a robotic ultrasound acquisition system that integrates stereo vision, touch-based feedback, and expert-informed strategies to perform autonomous and adaptive abdominal scans. The system records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists, creating a framework to capture transducer motion, applied forces, and anatomical scanning strategies. This expert data is replayed to replicate characteristic scans with the robot, forming a foundation for further autonomous capabilities. Using stereo vision, the system generates three-dimensional topography maps of the patient's abdomen, which are refined through stiffness measurements at key points to delineate the rib cage boundary. These combined techniques enable the robot to execute two distinct scanning paths: an upward-angled sweep beneath the rib cage to visualize structures near the upper abdomen and a perpendicular sweep across soft tissue regions. A compliant, torque-controlled seven degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator is controlled to maintain consistent probe contact through closed-loop force control over the varied anatomical surfaces. Physical experiments demonstrate that the system achieves high-quality imaging comparable to expert scans while dynamically adapting to patient-specific topographies. Furthermore, the robotic system surpasses expert capabilities by enabling three-dimensional volume acquisition, which enhances diagnostic potential and provides volumetric data for advanced analyses. This work highlights the integration of expert knowledge into autonomous robotic systems and underscores the potential of combining perception-based autonomy with physical reasoning for enhanced diagnostic performance.

analysis.tldr: 用带力控的七自由度机械臂+双目视觉+触觉反馈，复现专家超声扫描动作，自适应患者腹部形变，实现全自动腹部三维超声容积重建，比人工扫描多出三维体数据。
analysis.claim: 通过融合专家运动-力数据、双目地形建模与实时力闭环控制，机器人可在解剖形变显著的腹部表面自主执行高保真、可重复、三维容积化的超声扫描。
analysis.input: 双目RGB图像+触觉力传感器读数+专家示范的运动-力轨迹
analysis.output: 三维超声容积数据（voxel grid）+自适应扫描路径（含肋下斜扫与软组织横扫）
analysis.robot_dependency: 斯坦福自研七自由度力控机械臂+定制超声探头夹具
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实专家扫描的运动-力-图像同步数据（摘要明确说‘records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists’）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证（非仿真）、多模态闭环（视觉+力+专家策略）、完成临床相关任务（腹部三维容积超声），且超越人工获得三维体数据；但仅针对单一解剖区域（腹部）、未跨机体/跨用户泛化、无开源代码/模型、未对比SOTA机器人学习方法（如ACT/RDT-1B），属扎实的重大应用推进，未达开范式级。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Robotic Cognitive Alignment enabled by Non-Invasive Consumer Brain Computer Interfaces: A Proof of Concept Exploration
papers.abstract: While non-verbal behaviors and expressive movements are essential for natural human-robot interaction, existing methods often overlook a crucial element: the human's internal cognitive state. Frequently, proactive multi-agent systems can interrupt humans at inopportune moments, leading to cognitive overload and decreased task performance. This paper introduces a framework for generating "cognitively aligned" multi-agent interactions, enhancing the ability of robotic systems to contextually defer communications to the user of an agent system during moments of high human mental workload and engagement. We present the design and implementation of a closed-loop architecture that explores the interplay between autonomous task execution and real-time neurophysiological focus. Using a consumer-grade Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), our approach continuously monitors Electroencephalography (EEG) spectral band powers while a human performs an engagement-inducing task. We propose an engagement-driven pipeline where an HTTP-based signaling mechanism places a primary agent's sensory inputs and audio outputs into a holding state upon detecting high engagement. This allows secondary agents to seamlessly process complex, delegated tasks in the background. Once the human's cognitive state returns to a lower cognitive load baseline, the primary agent releases the queued agent message. Our preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging real-time signal processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), and physical robotic embodiments to create cognitively-aware, non-intrusive multi-agent systems.

analysis.tldr: 用消费级脑电头环实时监测用户专注度，当检测到高认知负荷时自动暂停主机器人语音/感知输入，把任务转给后台副机器人处理，等用户空闲后再恢复通信——整个流程是概念验证，只在单任务、单用户、单BCI设备上做了初步闭环演示。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式消费级BCI可实时检测人类认知负荷，并据此动态调度多智能体系统中的任务分发与交互时机，实现‘认知对齐’的机器人协作。

analysis.output: HTTP信号（控制主/副机器人输入输出开关状态）+ LLM生成的代理间任务委派指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人硬件，仅提及‘physical robotic embodiments’泛指，实验未展示真实机器人动作闭环

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——把已有BCI解码+多智能体调度两个成熟模块用‘认知对齐’新词串联，但无新算法、无真机闭环、无实证鲁棒性，属于演示级工作

papers.title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
papers.abstract: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated pipeline encompassing 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and dexterous policy learning. To bridge the gap between visual perception and physical constraints, we introduce a two-stage refinement process to enforce spatial alignment and physical consistency. Evaluations on the TACO and OakInk benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods in pose accuracy, adaptability to unstructured environments, and training efficiency. Ultimately, experimental results confirm an average success rate of over 75% across multiple synthetic manipulation tasks and validate the adaptability of the extracted manipulation priors across diverse dexterous hand embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中自动提取3D手部轨迹并生成可迁移到不同灵巧手的物理合理操作策略，不依赖真实机器人数据或动作捕捉设备。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目人类操作视频即可学习跨机体适配的灵巧操作策略，且在合成任务中达到75%+成功率。
analysis.input: 单目RGB人类操作视频
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级控制策略（动作序列）
