papers.title: Population genomics of a biocontrol agent: Insights into post-introduction establishment in parthenium beetle
papers.abstract: Biological control agents often experience demographic bottlenecks during introduction, which can reshape genetic diversity and inbreeding pattern influencing establishment and long-term ecological success in the introduced populations. The leaf-feeding beetle Calligrapha (Zygogramma) bicolorata, introduced in multiple countries across the globe to control the weed Parthenium hysterophorus, provides an opportunity to examine how introduction bottleneck and post-introduction breeding practices shape genomic variation and inbreeding patterns. We analyzed whole-genome variation in the introduced beetle population in India by sampling six regions encompassing its current distribution in the country. Using genome-wide variation data, we assessed population structure, genetic diversity, and inbreeding patterns across regions, and inferred historical changes in effective population size to reconstruct post-introduction demographic trajectories. The analyses reveal subtle genetic structure across regions, with overall genetic diversity relatively low compared to other invasive and biocontrol insects. Inbreeding patterns vary among populations, with some regions exhibiting higher cumulative runs of homozygosity than others. Notably, regions subjected to intensive propagation of beetle populations show elevated signature of inbreeding alongside reduced historical effective population size. These results underscore the dynamic genomic consequences of biocontrol introduction and subsequent breeding practices, providing insight into the evolutionary trajectories of introduced biocontrol agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用全基因组测序分析了印度引进的无性繁殖生物防治甲虫（斑点泽甲）在六个地区的遗传多样性、近交程度和有效群体大小变化，发现人工扩繁强度高的地区近交更严重、历史有效群体更小，揭示了生物防治引种与后续养殖对基因组的动态影响。
analysis.org: 印度国家生物科学研究所
analysis.claim: 生物防治甲虫在引入后的人工扩繁实践会显著加剧近交并压缩历史有效群体大小，导致区域性基因组差异。
analysis.input: 来自印度六个地区的斑点泽甲全基因组重测序数据（WGS）
analysis.output: 群体结构、遗传多样性（π、He）、近交系数（ROH）、历史Ne动态推断结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属应用型群体基因组学研究，方法常规（PCA/ROH/PSMC），样本量小（6个地理群体）、无功能验证、无跨区域预测或干预实验，未建立新模型或数据库，也未解决长期开放问题（如如何优化引种策略）；相比AlphaFold2等基石工作（90+），它属于窄领域描述性分析，贡献限于特定生物防治案例的实证补充。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是典型的小规模描述性群体基因组分析，无新算法、无开源数据/代码、无机制探索或可推广结论，对AI×生物交叉领域无实质性推动。

papers.title: Radiomic Feature Selection Using Gradient Loss of Deep Neural Network for Lung Cancer Stage Detection
papers.abstract: Radiomics enables extraction of quantitative imaging biomarkers from medical images and has become an important tool for computer-aided cancer diagnosis. However, radiomics datasets are typically high-dimensional with limited samples, making feature selection a critical step for building reliable predictive models. This study proposes a Gradient-Loss Recursive Feature Elimination (GL-RFE) framework that integrates gradient sensitivity analysis from a deep neural network to identify the most influential radiomic features for lung cancer stage detection. A total of 106 radiomic features were extracted from chest Computed Tomography (CT) scans using the PyRadiomics extension of the 3D Slicer platform. The proposed method evaluates feature importance by computing gradients of the network loss with respect to input features and recursively eliminates features with minimal contribution. The resulting top-15 radiomic features are used to train a deep neural network classifier for distinguishing early-stage and advanced-stage lung cancer. The proposed framework achieves strong classification performance, with accuracy of 90.22%, precision of 90.10%, recall of 90.24%, and F1-score of 90.16% on the test dataset. Visualization analyses, including correlation heat maps and distribution plots, further confirm reduced feature redundancy and improved class separability. Compared to conventional feature selection techniques, GL-RFE effectively captures nonlinear feature interactions and enhances model generalization. The presented protocol provides a reproducible and interpretable methodology for radiomics-based cancer stage detection and is particularly suitable for high-dimensional, small-sample biomedical datasets, with potential applications in other domains such as genomics and multimodal clinical analysis.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GL-RFE的新特征选择方法，用深度神经网络损失函数对输入放射组学特征的梯度来衡量重要性，从106个CT影像特征中挑出15个最优子集，用于区分肺癌早晚期，测试集准确率达90.2%
analysis.claim: 基于梯度损失的递归特征消除（GL-RFE）能比传统方法更有效地筛选非线性交互强、冗余低、泛化性好的放射组学特征子集，提升小样本高维医学数据下的肺癌分期分类性能。
analysis.input: 106维放射组学特征（源自胸部CT图像，用PyRadiomics提取）
analysis.output: 二分类结果（早期 vs 晚期肺癌）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/自建CT影像衍生的离线特征表，无真实设备或时序交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一小规模回顾性CT特征数据集（未说明样本量、中心数、分割/标注细节）上验证，无外部验证队列，无消融实验验证梯度机制必要性，未开源代码或模型，所有指标未与SOTA端到端深度学习方法（如ViT+CT patch）对比，仅对比传统统计型特征选择（如RFE、LASSO），属方法学微调而非范式突破；放射组学领域近年已有多篇类似梯度/注意力驱动的特征筛选工作，本文无理论或实证层面的显著超越。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——属于放射组学中常见的特征工程微创新，缺乏可复现性、外部验证和与现代端到端模型的基准对比，未触及AI×生物医学的核心瓶颈（如多中心泛化、病理-影像对齐、因果解释），也远未达ESM/AlphaFold级分量
